    [EventSubscriber(Table,18,OnAfterValidateEvent,Name,Skip,Error)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillUpdateFileOnValidateCustomerName@1112500000(VAR Rec@1112500000 : Record 18;VAR xRec@1112500001 : Record 18;CurrFieldNo@1112500002 : Integer);
    VAR
      RecRef@1112500005 : RecordRef;
      DocTable@1112500004 : Record 18;
      ArchMng@1112500003 : Codeunit 5158202;
      UpdEntryNo@5158210 : Integer;
      FilterTable@5158211 : Record 18;
      FilterTable2@5158212 : Record 5050;
    BEGIN
      WITH Rec DO BEGIN
        CASE CurrFieldNo OF
          FIELDNO(Name):
            BEGIN
              DocTable.RESET;
              DocTable.SETVIEW(Rec.GETVIEW);
              DocTable.SETRANGE("No.","No.");
              RecRef.GETTABLE(DocTable);

              //Update file - all values
              ArchMng.InitUpdFileRel('AVKU',3,"No.",18,RecRef);

              //Parameter:
              // 1 - d.3 document type / folder type
              // 2 - d.3 identification field no. (100 = DocID)
              // 3 - d.3 identification value
              // 4 - NAV table no.
              // 5 - RecordRef with current filter

              //Update file - single value
              ArchMng.InitUpdFileSV('AVKU',3,"No.",18,4,Name);
              // 1 - d.3 document type / folder type
              // 2 - d.3 identification field no. (100 = DocID)
              // 3 - d.3 identification value
              // 4 - NAV table no.
              // 5 - update field no.
              // 6 - update field value

              //@9.01 - KM.PABE ---
              //Following Code is an Example to Create a Update-File
              //with Information from Multiple Table
              UpdEntryNo := 0;
              ArchMng.InitUpdFileMulti('AVKU',3,"No.",18,UpdEntryNo);

              // 1 - d.3/ecspand document type / folder type
              // 2 - d.3/ecspand identification field no. (100 = DocID)
              // 3 - d.3/ecspand identification value
              // 4 - Primary NAV table no [Table of Identification Field No. and Value].
              // 5 - Entry No of Update-File. (Filled in Function - Call by Reference)

              //New Var: FilterTable - You can use many as you want
              //In this Case:
              //FilterTable: Customer
              //FilterTable2: Contact

              FilterTable.RESET;
              FilterTable.SETVIEW(Rec.GETVIEW);
              FilterTable.SETRANGE("No.","No.");
              RecRef.GETTABLE(FilterTable);
              ArchMng.CreateTableFilterMultiRel(RecRef,UpdEntryNo);

              FilterTable2.RESET;
              FilterTable2.SETRANGE("No.",Rec."Primary Contact No.");
              RecRef.GETTABLE(FilterTable2);
              ArchMng.CreateTableFilterMultiRel(RecRef,UpdEntryNo);
              //@9.01 + KM.PABE +++
            END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Page,5158234,OnAfterGetRecPublisher,"",Skip)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetIntegrationViewOnAfterGetRecordArchiveAdditionalFields@5158214(VAR Sender@5158210 : Page 5158234;Rec@5158211 : Record 5158219);
    VAR
      DocArchRel@5158224 : Record 5158206;
    BEGIN
      // - km.dlink.9.01 ---
      IF Rec."Document No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
        DocArchRel.RESET;
        DocArchRel.SETRANGE("Table ID",Rec."Table ID");
        DocArchRel.SETRANGE("Document Type",Rec."Document Type");
        DocArchRel.SETFILTER("Related Document Viewer ID",'<>%1','');

          IF DocArchRel."Use Publice Subscriber" THEN BEGIN
            Sender.SetArchiveURL(DocArchRel."Related Document Viewer ID",DocArchRel."Archive Document Type",Rec."Process No.");
          END;
        END;
      END;
      // + km.dlink.9.01 +++
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Page,344,OnBeforeFindEntries,"",Skip)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE AddArchiveLogBeforeFindEntryNavigate@5158213(VAR Sender@5158210 : Page 344;VAR DocEntry@5158212 : Record 265;DocNoFilter@5158213 : Code[250];PostingDateFilter@5158214 : Text[250]);
    VAR
      ArchLogEntry@5158211 : Record 5158208;
    BEGIN
      IF ArchLogEntry.WRITEPERMISSION THEN BEGIN
        ArchLogEntry.RESET;
        ArchLogEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Posting Date");
        ArchLogEntry.SETFILTER("Document No.",DocNoFilter);
        ArchLogEntry.SETFILTER("Posting Date",PostingDateFilter);

        IF ArchLogEntry.COUNT <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          DocEntry.INIT;
          DocEntry."Entry No." := DocEntry."Entry No." + 1;
          DocEntry."Table ID" := DATABASE::"Archive Log Entry";
          DocEntry."Document Type" := 0;
          DocEntry."Table Name" := COPYSTR(ArchLogEntry.TABLECAPTION,1,MAXSTRLEN(DocEntry."Table Name"));
          DocEntry."No. of Records" := ArchLogEntry.COUNT;
          DocEntry.INSERT;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Page,5158233,SetDropZoneValues,"",Skip)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE DropZoneSetValues@5158212(VAR Sender@5158210 : Page 5158233;VAR AddArchiveField@5158211 : Record 5158219);
    VAR
      DocArchRel@5158226 : Record 5158206;
      FilterTable3@5158223 : Record 5158219;
      ArchAddFieldsIns@5158220 : Record 5158219;
      SalesHeaderFilter@5158225 : Record 36;
      SalesLineFilter@5158224 : Record 37;
      PurchHeaderFilter@5158222 : Record 38;
      PurchLineFilter@5158221 : Record 39;
      SalesShptHeadFilter@5158247 : Record 110;
      SalesShptLineFilter@5158246 : Record 111;
      SalesInvHeadFilter@5158245 : Record 112;
      SalesInvLineFilter@5158244 : Record 113;
      SalesCrMemoHeadFilter@5158243 : Record 114;
      SalesCrMemoLineFilter@5158242 : Record 115;
      SalesHeadArchFilter@5158241 : Record 5107;
      SalesLineArchFilter@5158240 : Record 5108;
      SalesRetRcptHeadFilter@5158239 : Record 6660;
      SalesRetRcptLineFilter@5158238 : Record 6661;
      PurchRcptHeadFilter@5158237 : Record 120;
      PurchRcptLineFilter@5158236 : Record 121;
      PurchInvHeadFilter@5158235 : Record 122;
      PurchInvLineFilter@5158234 : Record 123;
      PurchCrMemoHeadFilter@5158233 : Record 124;
      PurchCrMemoLineFilter@5158232 : Record 125;
      PurchHeadArchFilter@5158231 : Record 5109;
      PurchLineArchFilter@5158230 : Record 5110;
      PurchRetShptHeadFilter@5158229 : Record 6650;
      PurchRetShptLineFilter@5158228 : Record 6661;
      CustomerFilter@5158248 : Record 18;
      VendorFilter@5158249 : Record 23;
      RecRef@5158219 : RecordRef;
      RecRef2@5158218 : RecordRef;
      RecRef3@5158217 : RecordRef;
      DropZoneFunctions@5158216 : Codeunit 5158215;
      ArchMng@5158215 : Codeunit 5158202;
      MemoryID@5158214 : Text[30];
      SourceType@5158213 : ' ,Sales,Purchase,Service';
      TempFilterKey@5158212 : Integer;
      ArchText50001@5158227 : TextConst 'DEU=Indexwerte fÅr Tabelle %1 konnten nicht angelegt werden;ENU=Error: index values for table %1 coud not be created';
    BEGIN
      // - km.dlink.9.01 ---

      IF AddArchiveField."Document No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
        TempFilterKey := DropZoneFunctions.CreateIntRandomNo;

        RecRef.GET(AddArchiveField.RecID);

        DocArchRel.SETRANGE("Table ID",RecRef.NUMBER);
        DocArchRel.SETRANGE("Table ID",AddArchiveField."Table ID");
        DocArchRel.SETFILTER(Direction,'<>%1',DocArchRel.Direction::Outgoing);
        CASE AddArchiveField."Table ID" OF
          18,36,110,112,114,5107,6660: BEGIN
                DocArchRel.SETRANGE("Source Type",DocArchRel."Source Type"::Sales);
                SourceType := SourceType::Sales;
              END;
          23,38,120,122,124,5109,6650: BEGIN
                DocArchRel.SETRANGE("Source Type",DocArchRel."Source Type"::Purchase);
                SourceType := SourceType::Purchase;
              END;
        END;
        IF DocArchRel.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          IF DocArchRel."Use Publice Subscriber" THEN BEGIN
            CASE AddArchiveField."Table ID" OF
              18: BEGIN
                    //"Header" Filters
                    CustomerFilter.SETRANGE("No.",AddArchiveField."Document No.");
                    IF NOT Sender.SetMemoryValues(MemoryID,1,RecRef.NUMBER,CustomerFilter.GETVIEW,FORMAT(TempFilterKey),TRUE) THEN
                      MESSAGE(ArchText50001,RecRef.NUMBER);
                            // Parameter:
                            // 1 - MemoryID
                            // 2 - memory no.
                            // 3 - table no.
                            // 4 - table filter
                            // 5 - TempFilterKey
                  END;

              36: BEGIN
                    //Header Filters
                    SalesHeaderFilter.SETRANGE("Document Type",AddArchiveField."Document Type");
                    SalesHeaderFilter.SETRANGE("No.",AddArchiveField."Document No.");
                    IF NOT Sender.SetMemoryValues(MemoryID,1,RecRef.NUMBER,SalesHeaderFilter.GETVIEW,FORMAT(TempFilterKey),TRUE) THEN
                      MESSAGE(ArchText50001,RecRef.NUMBER);
                            // Parameter:
                            // 1 - MemoryID
                            // 2 - memory no.
                            // 3 - table no.
                            // 4 - table filter
                            // 5 - TempFilterKey

                    //Line Filters
                    SalesLineFilter.SETRANGE("Document Type",AddArchiveField."Document Type");
                    SalesLineFilter.SETRANGE("Document No.",AddArchiveField."Document No.");
                    SalesLineFilter.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','');
                    RecRef2.GETTABLE(SalesLineFilter);
                    IF SalesLineFilter.FINDFIRST THEN
                      IF NOT Sender.SetMemoryValues(MemoryID,2,RecRef2.NUMBER,SalesLineFilter.GETVIEW,FORMAT(TempFilterKey),FALSE) THEN
                        MESSAGE(ArchText50001,RecRef2.NUMBER);
                   END;

            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {

    PROCEDURE ArchiveSales@5158203(VAR SalesHeader@1140002 : Record 36);
    VAR
      ArchSetup@1140001 : Record 5158202;
      ReportSelection@1112500006 : Record 77;
      SalesShipHeader@1112500002 : Record 110;
      SalesShipLines@1112500005 : Record 111;
      SalesInvHeaderdlink@1112500007 : Record 112;
      SalesInvLines@1112500008 : Record 113;
      SalesCMHeader@1112500013 : Record 114;
      SalesCMLines@1112500012 : Record 115;
      SalesRetHeader@1112500011 : Record 6660;
      SalesRetLines@1112500010 : Record 6661;
      ArchiveAdditionalFields@1112500009 : Record 5158219;
      RecRef@1112500003 : RecordRef;
      RecRef2@1112500004 : RecordRef;
      DocNo@1112500001 : Code[20];
      TotalAmount@1112500000 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      IF (NOT ArchSetup.FINDFIRST) OR (NOT ArchSetup."Archive activ")
        THEN EXIT;
      TotalAmount := 0;
      WITH SalesHeader DO BEGIN
        IF NOT ArchiveAdditionalFields.GET(36,"No.","Document Type",0,0) THEN
          ArchiveAdditionalFields.INIT;
        CASE "Document Type" OF
          "Document Type"::Order:
            BEGIN
              IF Ship THEN BEGIN
                DocNo := "Last Shipping No.";
                SalesShipHeader.SETRANGE("No.",DocNo);
                RecRef.GETTABLE(SalesShipHeader);
                SalesShipLines.SETRANGE("Document No.",DocNo);
                RecRef2.GETTABLE(SalesShipLines);
                CreateArchDoc(ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Shipment",ArchiveAdditionalFields."Process No.",DocNo,TotalAmount);
              END;
              IF Invoice THEN BEGIN
                DocNo := "Last Posting No.";
                IF SalesInvHeaderdlink.GET(DocNo) THEN BEGIN
                  SalesInvHeaderdlink.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
                  TotalAmount := SalesInvHeaderdlink."Amount Including VAT";
                END;
                SalesInvHeaderdlink.SETRANGE("No.",DocNo);
                RecRef.GETTABLE(SalesInvHeaderdlink);
                SalesInvLines.SETRANGE("Document No.",DocNo);
                RecRef2.GETTABLE(SalesInvLines);
                CreateArchDoc(ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Invoice",ArchiveAdditionalFields."Process No.",DocNo,TotalAmount);
              END;
            END;
          "Document Type"::Invoice:
            BEGIN
              IF "Last Posting No." = ''
                THEN DocNo := "No."
                ELSE DocNo := "Last Posting No.";
              IF SalesInvHeaderdlink.GET(DocNo) THEN BEGIN
                SalesInvHeaderdlink.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
                TotalAmount := SalesInvHeaderdlink."Amount Including VAT";
              END;
              SalesInvHeaderdlink.INIT;
              SalesInvHeaderdlink.SETRANGE("No.",DocNo);
              RecRef.GETTABLE(SalesInvHeaderdlink);
              SalesInvLines.SETRANGE("Document No.",DocNo);
              RecRef2.GETTABLE(SalesInvLines);
              CreateArchDoc(ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Invoice",ArchiveAdditionalFields."Process No.",DocNo,TotalAmount);
            END;
          "Document Type"::"Return Order":
            BEGIN
              IF Receive THEN BEGIN
                DocNo := "Last Return Receipt No.";
                SalesRetHeader.SETRANGE("No.",DocNo);
                RecRef.GETTABLE(SalesRetHeader);
                SalesRetLines.SETRANGE("Document No.",DocNo);
                RecRef2.GETTABLE(SalesRetLines);
                CreateArchDoc(ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Ret.Rcpt.",ArchiveAdditionalFields."Process No.",DocNo,TotalAmount);
              END;
              IF Invoice THEN BEGIN
                DocNo := "Last Posting No.";
                IF SalesCMHeader.GET(DocNo) THEN BEGIN
                  SalesCMHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
                  TotalAmount := SalesCMHeader."Amount Including VAT";
                END;
                SalesCMHeader.INIT;
                SalesCMHeader.SETRANGE("No.",DocNo);
                RecRef.GETTABLE(SalesCMHeader);
                SalesCMLines.SETRANGE("Document No.",DocNo);
                RecRef2.GETTABLE(SalesCMLines);
                CreateArchDoc(ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Cr.Memo",ArchiveAdditionalFields."Process No.",DocNo,TotalAmount);
              END;
            END;
          "Document Type"::"Credit Memo":
            BEGIN
              IF "Last Posting No." = ''
                THEN DocNo := "No."
                ELSE DocNo := "Last Posting No.";
              IF SalesCMHeader.GET(DocNo) THEN BEGIN
                SalesCMHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
                TotalAmount := SalesCMHeader."Amount Including VAT";
              END;
              SalesCMHeader.INIT;
              SalesCMHeader.SETRANGE("No.",DocNo);
              RecRef.GETTABLE(SalesCMHeader);
              SalesCMLines.SETRANGE("Document No.",DocNo);
              RecRef2.GETTABLE(SalesCMLines);
              CreateArchDoc(ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Cr.Memo",ArchiveAdditionalFields."Process No.",DocNo,TotalAmount);
            END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateArchDoc@5158204(ReportUsage@1140008 : Integer;ProcessNo@1140007 : Code[20];DocNo@1112500003 : Code[20];TotalAmt@1112500004 : Decimal);
    VAR
      ArchDoc@5158203 : Record 5158203;
      ArchReport@5158204 : Record 5158205;
      ReportSelection@1112500000 : Record 77;
      RecRef@1112500005 : RecordRef;
      RecRef2@1112500006 : RecordRef;
      ArchMng@1112500002 : Codeunit 5158202;
      ArchLineNo@5158205 : Integer;
      ArchivateRep@1112500001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      ReportSelection.RESET;
      ReportSelection.SETRANGE(Usage,ReportUsage);
      ReportSelection.SETFILTER("Report ID",'<>%1',0);
      IF NOT ReportSelection.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT;

      ArchReport.SETRANGE("Report No.",ReportSelection."Report ID");
      ArchReport.SETRANGE(Archivate,TRUE);
      ArchivateRep := ArchReport.FINDFIRST;

      IF ArchivateRep THEN BEGIN

        //Document
        ArchDoc.RESET;
        IF ArchDoc.FINDLAST THEN
          ArchLineNo := ArchDoc."Entry No.";
        ArchDoc.INIT;
        ArchDoc.Status := ArchDoc.Status::Created;
        ArchDoc."Created (DT)" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        ArchDoc."Created by" := USERID;
        ArchDoc."High Priority" := ArchReport."High Priority";
        ArchDoc."From Time" := ArchReport."From Time";
        ArchDoc."To Time" := ArchReport."To Time";
        ArchDoc."Report No." := ArchReport."Report No.";
        ArchDoc."Process No." := ProcessNo;
        ArchDoc."Language ID" := GLOBALLANGUAGE;
        ArchDoc."Source Type" := ArchDoc."Source Type"::Sales;
        CASE ReportSelection.Usage OF
          ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Shipment" : ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Shipment";
          ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Invoice"  : ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Invoice";
          ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Ret.Rcpt.": ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Return";
          ReportSelection.Usage::"S.Cr.Memo"  : ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Cr.Memo";
          ReportSelection.Usage::"P.Receipt"  : ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Shipment";
          ReportSelection.Usage::"P.Invoice"  : ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Invoice";
          ReportSelection.Usage::"P.Ret.Shpt.": ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Return";
          ReportSelection.Usage::"P.Cr.Memo"  : ArchDoc."Document Type" := ArchDoc."Document Type"::"P.Cr.Memo";
        END;
        ArchDoc."Document No." := DocNo;
        ArchDoc.TotalAmountInclVAT := TotalAmt;
        REPEAT
          ArchLineNo := ArchLineNo + 1;
          ArchDoc."Entry No." := ArchLineNo;
        UNTIL ArchDoc.INSERT;

        //Filters
        ArchMng.CreateTableFilter(RecRef,ArchDoc);
        ArchMng.CreateTableFilter(RecRef2,ArchDoc);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE TransferProcessNo@1112500004(SourceType@1112500003 : Integer;DocType@1112500004 : Integer;DocNo@1112500002 : Code[20];NewDocType@1112500001 : Integer;NewDocNo@1112500000 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      FromProcessNos@1112500006 : Record 5158214;
      ToProcessNos@1112500005 : Record 5158214;
    BEGIN
      FromProcessNos.SETRANGE("Source Type",SourceType);
      FromProcessNos.SETRANGE("Document Type",DocType);
      FromProcessNos.SETRANGE("Document No.",DocNo);
      IF FromProcessNos.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          ToProcessNos."Source Type" := FromProcessNos."Source Type";
          ToProcessNos."Document Type" := NewDocType;
          ToProcessNos."Document No." := NewDocNo;
          ToProcessNos."Process No." := FromProcessNos."Process No.";
          IF ToProcessNos.INSERT THEN;
        UNTIL FromProcessNos.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      ===========================================================================
      Project.........: d.link for Microsoft Dynamics NAV
      Version.........: dlink.11.00
      Product Manager.: Michael Hau         - MIHAU - Konica Minolta IT Solutions GmbH
                        Ulrich Cimander     - ULCI  - Konica Minolta IT Solutions GmbH

      Developer.......: Stephan Bîhmer      - STBO  - Konica Minolta IT Solutions GmbH
                        Ulrich Cimander     - ULCI  - Konica Minolta IT Solutions GmbH

    PROCEDURE DoCapture@1000000002(VAR PspLog@1000000005 : Record 5227626;VAR SalesPspCard@1000000004 : Record 5227625) : Boolean;
    VAR
      URL@610800003 : Text;
      ResponseText@610800005 : Text;
      WebClient@301510004 : DotNet "'System, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      JsonBody@301510000 : Text;
      Token@301510001 : Text;
      QuickSalesDocumentValue@301510006 : Record 5275389;
      QuickSalesHeader@301510007 : Record 5104606;
      PaymentID@301510008 : Text;
      StringAmount@301510002 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF (SalesPspCard."Status Code"='CAPTURE') AND
      (SalesPspCard."Status Amount Capture"  =SalesPspCard."Status Amount Reservation") THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
      GetSetup(SalesPspCard,1);
      SimulationMode:=GlobalPspSetup."Payment handling active";
      //OAuth20Setup.GET('ZAVER');
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",SalesPspCard."Source Document No.");
      IF QuickSalesHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        //MOKT Closed 24.09.25
        {
        QuickSalesDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
        QuickSalesDocumentValue.SETRANGE(Identifier,'TRANSACTIONID');
        IF QuickSalesDocumentValue.FIND('-') THEN
          PaymentID:=QuickSalesDocumentValue.ValueText;
        }
        //MOKT Closed 24.09.25
        PaymentID := QuickSalesHeader."External Transaction No."; //MOKT Added 24.09.25
      END;
      IF PaymentID = '' THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);
      // Parameter vorbereiten
      PspLog.I_ReceiptText:=PaymentID;
      URL := PSPExtendedSetup."URL 1"+'payments/link/v2/'+PaymentID+'/capture';
      Token :=PSPExtendedSetup."Account Key";
      StringAmount:=FORMAT(SalesPspCard."Status Amount Reservation");
      StringAmount:=DELCHR(StringAmount,'=','.');
      // JSON Body bauen
      JsonBody :=
          '{' +
          '"amount":'+FORMAT(StringAmount)+','+
          '"currency":"' +SalesPspCard."Status Valuta" +
          '"}';

      // WebClient initialisieren
      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Accept', 'application/json');

      // POST Request senden
      ResponseText := WebClient.UploadString(URL, 'POST', JsonBody);

      // Response anzeigen
      IF NOT PaseZaverResponse(ResponseText,PspLog,SalesPspCard) THEN BEGIN

        PspLog.MODIFY;

        SalesPspCard.MODIFY(TRUE);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END ELSE BEGIN

        EXIT(PspLog."Transaction OK");
      END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PaseZaverResponse@301510002(ResponseText@301510000 : Text;VAR PspLog@301510006 : Record 5227626;VAR SalesPspCard@301510005 : Record 5227625) : Boolean;
    VAR
      JObj@301510001 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      JToken@301510002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken";
      CapturedAmount@301510003 : Decimal;
      CanCapture@301510004 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
       // JSON in JObject parsen
      JObj := JObj.Parse(ResponseText);

      // capturedAmount auslesen
      JToken := JObj.SelectToken('capturedAmount');
      IF NOT ISNULL(JToken) THEN
          EVALUATE(CapturedAmount, FORMAT(JToken.ToString()));

      // canCapture auslesen (in allowedPaymentOperations)
      JToken := JObj.SelectToken('allowedPaymentOperations.canCapture');
      IF NOT ISNULL(JToken) THEN
          IF FORMAT(JToken.ToString()) = 'False' THEN
              CanCapture := TRUE
          ELSE
              CanCapture := FALSE;

      // Deine Logik
      IF CanCapture THEN BEGIN
          PspLog.I_Amount := PspLog.O_Amount;
          PspLog.I_Valuta := PspLog.O_Valuta;
          PspLog.I_Function := 'CAPTURE';
          PspLog.I_Valuta := SalesPspCard."Status Valuta";
          PspLog."I_Error Code" := '200';
          PspLog."I_Error Text" := 'OK';
          SalesPspCard."Status Description" := '';
      END ELSE
          SalesPspCard."Status Description" := 'Captured not possible';

      PspLog."Transaction OK" := CanCapture;
      PspLog.MODIFY(TRUE);

      SalesPspCard."Status Code" := PspLog.I_Function;
      SalesPspCard.MODIFY(TRUE);

      IF CanCapture THEN
          EXIT(TRUE)
      ELSE
          EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PaseZaverResponseCancel@301510004(ResponseText@301510000 : Text;VAR PspLog@301510006 : Record 5227626;VAR SalesPspCard@301510005 : Record 5227625;CancelZaver@301510007 : Boolean) : Boolean;
    VAR
      JObj@301510001 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      JToken@301510002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken";
      CapturedAmount@301510003 : Decimal;
      CanCapture@301510004 : Boolean;
      RefundAmount@301510008 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
       // JSON in JObject parsen
      IF NOT CancelZaver THEN BEGIN
        JObj := JObj.Parse(ResponseText);

        // capturedAmount auslesen
        JToken := JObj.SelectToken('paymentStatus');
        IF NOT ISNULL(JToken) THEN BEGIN
           PspLog."I_Error Code" := '200';
            PspLog."I_Error Text" := FORMAT(JToken.ToString());
            SalesPspCard."Status Description" := FORMAT(JToken.ToString());
            IF FORMAT(JToken.ToString()) = 'CANCELLED' THEN
                PspLog."Transaction OK" := TRUE
            ELSE
                PspLog."Transaction OK" := FALSE;
            PspLog.MODIFY;
            EXIT (PspLog."Transaction OK");
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        JObj := JObj.Parse(ResponseText);
         JToken := JObj.SelectToken('refundAmount');
          IF NOT ISNULL(JToken) THEN
              EVALUATE(RefundAmount, FORMAT(JToken.ToString()));
          IF RefundAmount =SalesPspCard."Status Amount Capture" THEN BEGIN
            // z.B. in PspLog speichern:
            PspLog."Transaction OK":=TRUE;
            PspLog.I_Amount := RefundAmount;
            PspLog.I_Function := 'REFUND';
            PspLog."I_Error Code" := '200';
            PspLog."I_Error Text" := FORMAT(JObj.SelectToken('status').ToString()); // PENDING_MERCHANT_APPROVAL oder SUCCESS spÑter
            SalesPspCard."Status Description" := 'Refund sent - Status: ' + PspLog."I_Error Text";
            PspLog.MODIFY;
            EXIT (PspLog."Transaction OK");
          END;
       END;

       EXIT (PspLog."Transaction OK");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckPaymentStatus@301510000();
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510009 : Record 36;

      URL@301510003 : Text;
      ResponseText@301510007 : Text;

    BEGIN

      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Payment Method Code",'ZAVER');

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckOrder@301510005(OrderNo@301510000 : Text);
    VAR
      FreshSalesEntries@301510010 : Record 50033;
      SalesHeader@301510009 : Record 36;
      QuickSalesHeader@301510001 : Record 5104606;
      SalesPSPCard@301510002 : Record 5227625;
      FreshSalesMgnt@301510011 : Codeunit 50032;
      WebClient@301510006 : DotNet "'System, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      JsonBody@301510005 : Text;
      Token@301510004 : Text;
      PaymentStatus@301510008 : Text;
      URL@301510007 : Text;
      ResponseText@301510003 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo) THEN
        EXIT;

      QuickSalesHeader.RESET;
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",OrderNo);
      IF NOT QuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT;

      GetSetup(SalesPSPCard,1);

      URL := PSPExtendedSetup."URL 4" + QuickSalesHeader."External Transaction No.";
      Token:=PSPExtendedSetup."Account Key";
      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);

      ResponseText := WebClient.DownloadString(URL);
      PaseZaverResponseStatus(ResponseText,SalesPSPCard,PaymentStatus);

      IF PaymentStatus = 'CANCELLED' THEN BEGIN
        SalesPSPCard."Status Code" := 'CANCELLED';
        SalesPSPCard.MODIFY;

        SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo);
        SalesHeader."Cancelling Reason Code" := '007';
        SalesHeader.MODIFY;
        COMMIT;
        SalesHeader.SetSkiptStornoMail(TRUE);
        SalesHeader.DELETE(TRUE);

        IF FreshSalesEntries.GET(OrderNo,10000,FreshSalesEntries.Status::"Order Archived") THEN
          EXIT;

        FreshSalesMgnt.InsertFreshDeskEntry(4,OrderNo,10000);
      END;
    END;

        LGnlLedgSetup.GET;

      END;
      PSPLog.O_Amount := 0;
      PSPLog.INSERT(TRUE);
      COMMIT;
      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE DoRefund_Archive@301510007(VAR SalesPspCard@1000000004 : Record 5227625;VAR SalesHeader@301510010 : Record 5107) : Boolean;
    VAR
      URL@301510008 : Text;
      ResponseText@301510007 : Text;
      WebClient@301510006 : DotNet "'System, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      JsonBody@301510005 : Text;
      Token@301510004 : Text;
      QuickSalesDocumentValue@301510003 : Record 5275389;
      QuickSalesHeader@301510002 : Record 5104606;
      PaymentID@301510001 : Text;

      LGnlLedgSetup@301510014 : Record 98;
      LCurrency@301510015 : Record 4;
      mokt@301510016 : Codeunit 50005;
    BEGIN
      IF SalesPspCard."Status Code" = 'CANCELLED' THEN
        EXIT(TRUE); //MOKT 16.12.25

      IF (SalesPspCard."Status Code"='CAPTURE') AND
      (SalesPspCard."Status Amount Capture" <> SalesPspCard."Status Amount Reservation") THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
      IF ((SalesHeader.Invoice) OR (SalesHeader.Ship)) AND (SalesHeader."Document Type"=SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order) THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);

      PSPLogSearch.RESET;
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("Log Entry",SalesPspCard."Log No.");
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE(O_Function,'REFUND');
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("I_Error Code",'200');
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("Transaction OK",TRUE);
      IF PSPLogSearch.FIND('-') THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);


      CLEAR(PSPLog);
      PSPLog.INIT;
      PSPLog."Log Entry" := SalesPspCard."Log No.";
      PSPLog."Payment handling with" := SalesPspCard."Payment handling with";
      LPspLogCheck.SETRANGE("Log Entry",SalesPspCard."Log No.");
      IF LPspLogCheck.FINDLAST THEN
        PSPLog."Entry No." := LPspLogCheck."Entry No." + 1
      ELSE
        PSPLog."Entry No." := 1;
      PSPLog.O_Function := 'REFUND';

      PSPLog.O_OrderID := SalesPspCard."No.";
      PSPLog.O_Name := SalesHeader."Bill-to Name";

      IF SalesHeader."Currency Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
        LCurrency.GET(SalesHeader."Currency Code");
        PSPLog.O_Valuta := LCurrency."Currency Code as ISO 4217";
      END ELSE BEGIN
        LGnlLedgSetup.GET;
        PSPLog.O_Valuta := LGnlLedgSetup."LCY Code as ISO 4217";
      END;
      PSPLog.O_Amount := 0;
      PSPLog.INSERT(TRUE);
      COMMIT;

      GetSetup(SalesPspCard,3);
      PSPLogSearch.RESET;
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("Psp Comm. Log Entry No.",SalesPspCard."Log No.");
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE(O_Function,'REFUND');
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("I_Error Code",'200');
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("Transaction OK",TRUE);
      IF PSPLogSearch.FIND('-') THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);

      PSPLogSearch.RESET;
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE(PSPLogSearch."Log Entry",SalesPspCard."Log No.");
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE(O_Function,'CAPTURE');
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("I_Error Code",'200');
      PSPLogSearch.SETRANGE("Transaction OK",TRUE);
      IF PSPLogSearch.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        CancelZaver:=TRUE;
        PaymentID:=PSPLogSearch.I_ReceiptText
      END;
      SimulationMode:=GlobalPspSetup."Payment handling active";
      IF NOT CancelZaver THEN BEGIN
        QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",SalesPspCard."Source Document No.");
        IF QuickSalesHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          QuickSalesDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
          QuickSalesDocumentValue.SETRANGE(Identifier,'TRANSACTIONID');
          IF QuickSalesDocumentValue.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            //MOKT Closed 24.09.25
            {
            QuickSalesDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
            QuickSalesDocumentValue.SETRANGE(Identifier,'TRANSACTIONID');
            IF QuickSalesDocumentValue.FIND('-') THEN
              PaymentID:=QuickSalesDocumentValue.ValueText;
            }
            //MOKT Closed 24.09.25
            PaymentID := QuickSalesHeader."External Transaction No."; //MOKT Added 24.09.25
          END
        END;
        IF PaymentID = '' THEN
          EXIT(FALSE)
        ELSE
          PSPLog.I_ReceiptText:=PaymentID;
      END;
      Token:=PSPExtendedSetup."Account Key";
      IF CancelZaver THEN BEGIN
          URL :=PSPExtendedSetup."URL 1"+'refund/v1/';
          StringAmount := FORMAT(SalesPspCard."Status Amount Capture");
          StringAmount := DELCHR(StringAmount, '=', '.');
          EVALUATE(PSPLog.O_Amount,FORMAT(StringAmount));

          JsonBody :=
              '{' +
              '"description": "RÅckerstattung fÅr Bestellung ' + SalesPspCard."Source Document No." + '",' +
              '"paymentId": "' + PaymentID + '",' +
              '"invoiceReference": "' + SalesPspCard."Source Document No." + '",' +
              '"refundAmount": ' + StringAmount + ',' +
              '"merchantReference": "REFUND-' + FORMAT(SalesPspCard."Log No.") + '",' +
              '"merchantMetaData": {' +
                  '"origin": "chronext",' +
                  '"user": "service@chronext.de"' +
              '},' +
              '"initializingRepresentative": {' +
                  '"username": "service@chronext.de"' +
              '},' +
              '"merchantUrls": {' +
                  '"callbackUrl": "https://salini.de/api/zaver/refund-callback"' +
              '}' +
              '}';

      END ELSE BEGIN
          URL := PSPExtendedSetup."URL 1"+'payments/link/v2/'+PaymentID+'/cancel';
          StringAmount := FORMAT(SalesPspCard."Status Amount Reservation");
          StringAmount := DELCHR(StringAmount, '=', '.');
          EVALUATE(PSPLog.O_Amount,FORMAT(StringAmount));
          JsonBody :='';
      //        '{' +
      //        '"amount": ' + StringAmount + ',' +
      //        '"currency": "' + SalesPspCard."Status Valuta" + '"' +
      //        '}';
      END;



      IF SalesHeader."No." = 'X74138649760' THEN BEGIN
        mokt.TextExportToFile(JsonBody);
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      // WebClient initialisieren
      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      //WebClient.Headers.Add('Accept', 'application/json');

      // POST Request senden
      ResponseText := WebClient.UploadString(URL, 'POST', JsonBody);

      // Response anzeigen
      IF NOT PaseZaverResponseCancel(ResponseText,PSPLog,SalesPspCard,CancelZaver) THEN BEGIN
          PSPLog."I_Error Code" := 'PENDING';
        PSPLog."I_Error Text" := GlobalPendingMsg;
        PSPLog.MODIFY;
        SalesPspCard."Payment Method Status" := SalesPspCard."Payment Method Status"::Pending;
        SalesPspCard."Status Code" := PSPLog.I_Function;
        SalesPspCard.MODIFY(TRUE);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END ELSE BEGIN

        EXIT(PSPLog."Transaction OK");
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      //Chron-63 NKON 22.05.2 Anlage
    }
    END.
  }
}

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateReturnPurchOrder@301510001();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;
      PurchaseHeader@301510001 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301510002 : Record 39;
      SystemValueLine@301510003 : Record 5105031;
      HeaderCreate@301510004 : Boolean;
      Vendor@301510005 : Record 23;
      LineNo@301510006 : Integer;
      CeateLine@301510007 : Boolean;
      Item@301510008 : Record 27;
      itemLedgerCheck@301510009 : Record 32;
      PostedWhseReceiptLine@301510010 : Record 7319;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510011 : Record 7505;
      BoxLoc@301510012 : Boolean;
      Cert@301510013 : Boolean;
      Zust@301510014 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(61034,COMPANYNAME) AND SystemValueLine."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN
        Vendor.GET(SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order");
        PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Vendor No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE(Status,PurchaseHeader.Status::Open);
        PurchaseHeader.CALCFIELDS("Completely Received");
        PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Completely Received",TRUE);
        IF NOT PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          CLEAR(PurchaseHeader);
          PurchaseHeader.RESET;
          PurchaseHeader.INIT;
          PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order");
          PurchaseHeader.INSERT(TRUE);
          PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Buy-from Vendor No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Shipping Agent Code",Vendor."Shipping Agent Code");
          PurchaseHeader."Vendor Cr. Memo No.":=PurchaseHeader."No.";
          PurchaseHeader.Invoice:=TRUE;
          PurchaseHeader.Ship:=TRUE;
          PurchaseHeader.MODIFY;
          HeaderCreate:=TRUE;
        END ELSE
          HeaderCreate:=PurchaseHeader.FIND('-');

        ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Location Code","Reserved Quantity");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
        IF ItemFilter <> '' THEN BEGIN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",ItemFilter);
        END ELSE
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','BOX');
        IF Commis THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Commission,TRUE)
        ELSE
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Commission,FALSE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Blocked By Whse. Rcpt.");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Blocked By Whse. Rcpt.",FALSE);
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          PurchaseLine.RESET;
          PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
          PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
          IF PurchaseLine.FINDLAST THEN
            LineNo:=PurchaseLine."Line No."+1000
          ELSE
            LineNo:=1000;
          REPEAT
            PurchaseLine.RESET;
            PurchaseLine.INIT;
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
            PurchaseLine."Line No." := LineNo;
            LineNo+=1000;
            PurchaseLine.INSERT(TRUE);
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Unit of Measure Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Unit of Measure Code");
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity);
            ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost",ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)");
            PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Commission,ItemLedgerEntry.Commission);
            itemLedgerCheck.SETCURRENTKEY(Positive,"Location Code","Entry Type","Serial No.");
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE("Serial No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE("Entry Type",itemLedgerCheck."Entry Type"::Purchase);
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE("Document Type",itemLedgerCheck."Document Type"::"Purchase Receipt");
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE(Commission,FALSE);
            IF itemLedgerCheck.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
              PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Posted Source No.");
              PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Posted Source No.",itemLedgerCheck."Document No.");
              PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
              PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
              IF PostedWhseReceiptLine.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
                PurchaseLine.Box:=PostedWhseReceiptLine.Box;
                PurchaseLine.Certificate:=PostedWhseReceiptLine.Certificate;
              END;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              Zust:=FALSE;
              Cert:=FALSE;
              BoxLoc:=FALSE;

              ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",5401);
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",10);
              IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
                IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'new' THEN
                  Zust:=TRUE
                ELSE
                  Zust:=FALSE;
              END;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",11);
              IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
                IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'ja' THEN
                  BoxLoc:=TRUE
                ELSE
                  BoxLoc:=FALSE;
              END;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",13);
              IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
                IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'ja' THEN
                  Cert:=TRUE
                ELSE
                  Cert:=FALSE;
              END;
              PurchaseLine.Box:=BoxLoc;
              PurchaseLine."Used good":=Zust;
              PurchaseLine.Certificate:=Cert;
            END;
            //PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Appl.-to Item Entry",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
            PurchaseLine.MODIFY;
            CeateLine:=TRUE;
            COMMIT;
            PurchaseLine.AutoReserve;
            itemLedgerCheck.RESET;
            itemLedgerCheck.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code","Location Code","Reserved Quantity");
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE("Item No.",'BOX');
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
            itemLedgerCheck.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
            itemLedgerCheck.SETRANGE(Commission,FALSE);
            IF itemLedgerCheck.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              PurchaseLine.RESET;
              PurchaseLine.INIT;
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
              PurchaseLine."Line No." := LineNo;
              LineNo+=1000;
              PurchaseLine.INSERT(TRUE);
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("No.",itemLedgerCheck."Item No.");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",itemLedgerCheck."Variant Code");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Unit of Measure Code",itemLedgerCheck."Unit of Measure Code");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,itemLedgerCheck.Quantity);
              itemLedgerCheck.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost",itemLedgerCheck."Cost Amount (Expected)"+itemLedgerCheck."Cost Amount (Actual)");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Commission,itemLedgerCheck.Commission);
              PurchaseLine.Box:=TRUE;
              PurchaseLine.MODIFY;
              CeateLine:=TRUE;
              COMMIT;
              PurchaseLine.AutoReserve;

            END;
          UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT=0;
        END;
        IF NOT CeateLine THEN BEGIN
          PurchaseHeader.DELETE(TRUE);
          PurchaseHeader.RESET;
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order");
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Vendor No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE(Status,PurchaseHeader.Status::Released);
          PurchaseHeader.SETFILTER("No.",'>%1','BRS0000099');
          //PurchaseHeader.CALCFIELDS("Completely Received");
          //PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Completely Received",TRUE);
          IF PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN
            BookPurchReturnOrder(PurchaseHeader);
        END ELSE
          IF CeateLine THEN
            BookPurchReturnOrder(PurchaseHeader);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrder@301510004();
    VAR
      PortfolioTransfer@301510000 : Record 50034;
      Vendor@301510001 : Record 23;
      PurchaseHeader@301510002 : Record 38;
      HeaderCreate@301510003 : Boolean;
      SystemValueLine@301510004 : Record 5105031;
      LineNo@301510005 : Integer;
      PurchaseLine@301510006 : Record 39;
      ReleasePurchDoc@301510007 : Codeunit 415;
      PTModify@301510008 : Record 50034;
      PortfolioTransfer1@301510009 : Record 50034;
      Location@301510010 : Record 14;
      CHNXAttributeMgt@301510011 : Codeunit 85020;
      TrackingSpecification@301510012 : Record 336;
      ItemTrackingLines@301510013 : Page 6510;
      unstr@301510014 : Boolean;
      POCheck@301510015 : Record 38;
      PurchPost@301510016 : Codeunit 90;
    BEGIN
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(61034,'CXT PURCHASING BV') AND SystemValueLine."Bool 2" THEN BEGIN
        Vendor.GET(SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        PortfolioTransfer1.SETRANGE(Input,FALSE);
        IF PortfolioTransfer1.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Document No.",PortfolioTransfer1."Document No.");
          IF PortfolioTransfer.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Vendor No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE(Status,PurchaseHeader.Status::Open);
              PurchaseHeader.CALCFIELDS("Completely Received");
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("complete received",FALSE);
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",PortfolioTransfer."Document No.");
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Location Code",PortfolioTransfer.Remarks);
              IF NOT PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                CLEAR(PurchaseHeader);
                PurchaseHeader.RESET;
                PurchaseHeader.INIT;
                PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
                PurchaseHeader.INSERT(TRUE);
                PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Buy-from Vendor No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
                PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Shipping Agent Code",Vendor."Shipping Agent Code");
                PurchaseHeader."Vendor Order No.":=PortfolioTransfer."Document No.";
                PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Location Code",PortfolioTransfer.Remarks);
                PurchaseHeader.Invoice:=TRUE;
                PurchaseHeader.Ship:=TRUE;
                PurchaseHeader.MODIFY;
                HeaderCreate:=TRUE;
              END ELSE
                HeaderCreate:=PurchaseHeader.FIND('-');
              PurchaseLine.RESET;
              PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
              PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
              IF PurchaseLine.FINDLAST THEN
                LineNo:=PurchaseLine."Line No."+1000
              ELSE
                LineNo:=1000;
              PurchaseLine.RESET;
              PurchaseLine.INIT;
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
              PurchaseLine."Line No." := LineNo;
              LineNo+=1000;
              PurchaseLine.INSERT(TRUE);
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("No.",PortfolioTransfer."Item No.");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code");
              //PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Unit of Measure Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Unit of Measure Code");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Location Code",PortfolioTransfer.Remarks);
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,PortfolioTransfer.Quantity);
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost",PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Price");
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Certificate,PortfolioTransfer.Certificate);
              PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",PortfolioTransfer."Diff. Tax");
              PurchaseLine.Box:=PortfolioTransfer.Box;
              PurchaseLine."Box Bin Code":=PortfolioTransfer."Box Bin Code";
              IF Location.GET(PortfolioTransfer.Remarks) THEN
              IF NOT Location."Directed Put-away and Pick" THEN BEGIN
                unstr:=TRUE;
                TrackingSpecification.InitFromPurchLine(PurchaseLine);
                CLEAR(ItemTrackingLines);
                ItemTrackingLines.SetFormRunMode(1);
                ItemTrackingLines.SetSourceSpec(TrackingSpecification,TODAY);
                ItemTrackingLines.SetInbound(TRUE);
                ItemTrackingLines.SetSerialNo(PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID");
                ItemTrackingLines.ToDosOnClosePage;
                IF PortfolioTransfer."Manufacturer Serial No." <> '' THEN
                  CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeManufacturerSerialNo(PortfolioTransfer."Item No.",PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code",PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID",PortfolioTransfer."Manufacturer Serial No.");
                IF PortfolioTransfer."Warranty Date" <> 0D THEN
                  CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeWarrantyDate(PortfolioTransfer."Item No.",PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code",PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID",PortfolioTransfer."Warranty Date");
              END;
              PurchaseLine.MODIFY;
              IF unstr AND PortfolioTransfer.Box THEN BEGIN
                LineNo+=1000;
                PurchaseLine.RESET;
                PurchaseLine.INIT;
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
                PurchaseLine."Line No." := LineNo;
                PurchaseLine.INSERT(TRUE);
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("No.",'Box');
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID");
                //PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Unit of Measure Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Unit of Measure Code");
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Location Code",PortfolioTransfer.Remarks);
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,PortfolioTransfer.Quantity);
                PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost",0);
                PurchaseLine.MODIFY;
              END;
              IF PTModify.GET(PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID",PortfolioTransfer."Document No.",PortfolioTransfer."Item No.",PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
                PTModify.Input:=TRUE;
                PTModify.LineNoPurch:=PurchaseLine."Line No.";
                PTModify.MODIFY(FALSE);
              END;
            COMMIT;
            UNTIL PortfolioTransfer.NEXT=0;

            IF NOT unstr THEN BEGIN
              ReleasePurchDoc.PerformManualRelease(PurchaseHeader);
              COMMIT;
              ShipPurchOrderReceive(PurchaseHeader,PortfolioTransfer);
            END;
          END;
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Vendor No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          PurchaseHeader.SETFILTER(Status,'%1|%2',PurchaseHeader.Status::Open,PurchaseHeader.Status::Released);
          //PurchaseHeader.CALCFIELDS("Completely Received");
          //PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Completely Received",FALSE);
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",PortfolioTransfer."Document No.");
          IF PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            ReleasePurchDoc.PerformManualRelease(PurchaseHeader);
            COMMIT;
            ShipPurchOrderReceive(PurchaseHeader,PortfolioTransfer);
          END;
        END;
        IF unstr THEN BEGIN

          PurchaseHeader."Vendor Invoice No.":=PortfolioTransfer."Document No.";
          PurchaseHeader.Invoice:=TRUE;
          PurchaseHeader."Posting Date":=TODAY;
          PurchaseHeader.MODIFY;
          COMMIT;
          PurchPost.RUN(PurchaseHeader);
          IF NOT POCheck.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type",PurchaseHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
            PTModify.RESET;
            PTModify.SETRANGE(Input,TRUE);
            PTModify.SETRANGE(Done,FALSE);
            PTModify.SETRANGE("Document No.",PortfolioTransfer."Document No.");
            IF PTModify.FINDSET THEN
              PTModify.MODIFYALL(Done,TRUE);
          END;
        END;

        PortfolioTransfer.RESET;
        PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE(Done,FALSE);
        PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE(Output,TRUE);
        IF PortfolioTransfer.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Vendor No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
            PurchaseHeader.SETFILTER(Status,'%1|%2',PurchaseHeader.Status::Open,PurchaseHeader.Status::Released);
            //PurchaseHeader.CALCFIELDS("Completely Received");
            //PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Completely Received",FALSE);
            PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",PortfolioTransfer."Document No.");
            PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
            IF PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              ReleasePurchDoc.PerformManualRelease(PurchaseHeader);
              COMMIT;
              ShipPurchOrderReceive(PurchaseHeader,PortfolioTransfer);
            END;
          UNTIL PortfolioTransfer.NEXT=0;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ShipWarehouseIntercompany@301490000(VAR PurchaseHeader@301510002 : Record 38);
    VAR
      WarehouseShipmentHeader@301490001 : Record 7320;
      WarehouseShipmentLine@301490002 : Record 7321;
      ReleaseWhseShipment@301490003 : Codeunit 7310;
      WarehouseActivityHeader@301490004 : Record 5766;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301490005 : Record 5767;
      WhseActRegisterYesNo@301490006 : Codeunit 7306;
      LogisticCreatePickSeries@301490007 : Codeunit 5104806;
      PackListLine@301490008 : Record 5104640;
      WarehouseActivityLineModify@301490009 : Record 5767;
      WhsePostShipmentYesNo@301490010 : Codeunit 5764;
      PackingListHeader@301490011 : Record 5104639;
      LogisticMgtShptChronext@301490012 : Codeunit 85201;
      WarehouseActivityLineM2@301490013 : Record 5767;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttributeValue@301510001 : Record 7501;
    BEGIN

      WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Type");
      WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
      WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETFILTER("Document Status",'<>%1',WarehouseShipmentHeader."Document Status"::"Completely Picked");
      IF WarehouseShipmentHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        IF WarehouseShipmentHeader.Status = WarehouseShipmentHeader.Status::Open THEN
          ReleaseWhseShipment.Release(WarehouseShipmentHeader);
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SETRANGE("No.",WarehouseShipmentHeader."No.");
          WarehouseShipmentLine.FINDSET();
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
          WarehouseShipmentLine.CreatePickDocDiVA(WarehouseShipmentLine,WarehouseShipmentHeader);
          COMMIT;
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source No.","Source Line No.","Source Subline No.","Unit of Measure Code","Action Type","Breakbulk No.","Original Breakbulk","Activity Type","Assemble to Order");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Whse. Document No.",WarehouseShipmentHeader."No.");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Activity Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Activity Type"::Pick);
          IF WarehouseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              //Bewegungsmenge fÅllen.
              WarehouseActivityLineM2:=WarehouseActivityLine;
              WarehouseActivityLine.AutofillQtyToHandle(WarehouseActivityLineM2);
              //Bewegungsmenge fÅllen.

            UNTIL WarehouseActivityLine.NEXT=0;
            COMMIT;
            WhseActRegisterYesNo.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
            WhseActRegisterYesNo.RUN(WarehouseActivityLine);
            COMMIT;
            PortfolioTransfer(PurchaseHeader);
            COMMIT;
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.SetInvoiceShip(TRUE,FALSE);
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.RUN(WarehouseShipmentLine);

          END ELSE BEGIN
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.SetInvoiceShip(TRUE,TRUE);
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.RUN(WarehouseShipmentLine);
          END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PortfolioTransfer(PurchaseHeader);
        WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Type");
        WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
        WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETFILTER("Document Status",'%1',WarehouseShipmentHeader."Document Status"::"Completely Picked");
        IF WarehouseShipmentHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SETRANGE("No.",WarehouseShipmentHeader."No.");
          WarehouseShipmentLine.FINDSET();
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
          WhsePostShipmentYesNo.SetInvoiceShip(TRUE,TRUE);
          WhsePostShipmentYesNo.RUN(WarehouseShipmentLine);
        END;
      END;

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PortfolioTransfer@301510000(VAR PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38);
    VAR
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine@301510001 : Record 5773;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 32;
      PortfolioTransfer@301510003 : Record 50034;
      CHNXChronextIDMgt@301510004 : Codeunit 85010;
      PurchaseLine@301510005 : Record 39;
    BEGIN
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Type",39);
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",5);
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Action Type"::Take);
      IF RegisteredWhseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          IF NOT PortfolioTransfer.GET(RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Serial No.",PurchaseHeader."No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
            IF RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No."<> 'BOX' THEN BEGIN
              PortfolioTransfer.INIT;
              PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Serial No.";
              PortfolioTransfer."Portfolio Date":=PurchaseHeader."Posting Date";
              PortfolioTransfer."Document No.":=PurchaseHeader."No.";
              PortfolioTransfer."Item No.":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No.";
              PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Variant Code";
              IF RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No."='BOX' THEN
                PortfolioTransfer."Box Bin Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Bin Code"
              ELSE
               PortfolioTransfer."Bin Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Bin Code";
              PortfolioTransfer.Quantity:=RegisteredWhseActivityLine.Quantity;
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Location Code","Reserved Quantity");
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Serial No.");
              IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
                PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Price":=ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)";
                IF PurchaseLine.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type",PurchaseHeader."No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Source Line No.") THEN BEGIN
                  PortfolioTransfer.Certificate:=PurchaseLine.Certificate;
                  PortfolioTransfer."Manufacturer Serial No.":=ItemLedgerEntry."Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.";//CHNXChronextIDMgt.GetSerialNoPurchaseLine(PurchaseLine);
                  PortfolioTransfer."Warranty Date":=ItemLedgerEntry."Warranty Date Attr.";
                  PortfolioTransfer.Box:=PurchaseLine.Box;
                  PortfolioTransfer."Diff. Tax":=ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
                  PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Order ID":=ItemLedgerEntry."Document No.";
                  PortfolioTransfer."Used good":=PurchaseLine."Used good";
                END;
              END;
              PortfolioTransfer.Output:=TRUE;
              PortfolioTransfer.INSERT;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Inventory ID",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Variant Code");
              PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
              IF PortfolioTransfer.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                PortfolioTransfer."Box Bin Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Bin Code";
                PortfolioTransfer.Box:=TRUE;
                PortfolioTransfer.MODIFY(FALSE);
              END;
            END;
          END;

        UNTIL RegisteredWhseActivityLine.NEXT=0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ShipPurchOrderReceive@301510007(PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38;PortfolioTransfer@301510001 : Record 50034);
    VAR
      WarehouseReceiptLine@301510002 : Record 7317;
      WarehouseReceiptHeader@301510003 : Record 7316;
      PortfolioTransferLoc@301510004 : Record 50034;
      WhsePostReceipt@301510005 : Codeunit 5760;
      CHNXAttributeMgt@301510006 : Codeunit 85020;
      Location@301510007 : Record 14;
    BEGIN

      WarehouseReceiptHeader.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
      IF WarehouseReceiptHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        PortfolioTransferLoc.SETRANGE(Input,TRUE);
        PortfolioTransferLoc.SETRANGE(Done,FALSE);
        PortfolioTransferLoc.SETRANGE("Document No.",PortfolioTransfer."Document No.");
        IF PortfolioTransferLoc.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            WarehouseReceiptLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source No.","Source Line No.");
            WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Type",39);
            WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
            WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PortfolioTransferLoc.LineNoPurch);
            WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("No.",WarehouseReceiptHeader."No.");
            IF WarehouseReceiptLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              WarehouseReceiptLine."IC SerialNo.":=PortfolioTransferLoc."Inventory ID";
              WarehouseReceiptLine."Warranty Date":=PortfolioTransferLoc."Warranty Date";
              WarehouseReceiptLine.MODIFY;
              WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE("Qty. in Stock",PortfolioTransferLoc.Quantity);
              WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE("Qty. to Receive",PortfolioTransferLoc.Quantity);
              WarehouseReceiptLine."Manufacturer SerialNo.":=PortfolioTransferLoc."Manufacturer Serial No.";
              WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE(Box,PortfolioTransferLoc.Box);
              WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE(Certificate,PortfolioTransferLoc.Certificate);
              WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE("Used good",PortfolioTransferLoc."Used good");
              WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE("Box Bin Code",PortfolioTransferLoc."Box Bin Code");

              WarehouseReceiptLine.MODIFY;
              COMMIT;

              IF PortfolioTransferLoc."Manufacturer Serial No." <> '' THEN
                CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeManufacturerSerialNo(PortfolioTransferLoc."Item No.",PortfolioTransferLoc."Variant Code",PortfolioTransferLoc."Inventory ID",PortfolioTransferLoc."Manufacturer Serial No.");
              IF PortfolioTransferLoc."Warranty Date" <> 0D THEN
                CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeWarrantyDate(PortfolioTransferLoc."Item No.",PortfolioTransferLoc."Variant Code",PortfolioTransferLoc."Inventory ID",PortfolioTransferLoc."Warranty Date");

            END;
          UNTIL PortfolioTransferLoc.NEXT=0;
          IF NOT WarehouseReceiptLine.ISEMPTY THEN
            WhsePostReceipt.RUN(WarehouseReceiptLine);
          COMMIT;
        END;
      END;

          PutAway(PurchaseHeader);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PutAway@301510005(PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38);
    VAR
      PortfolioTransferL@301510001 : Record 50034;
      PostedWhseReceiptLine@301510002 : Record 7319;
      PostedWhseReceiptHeader@301510003 : Record 7318;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301510004 : Record 5767;
      WhseActRegisterYesNo@301510005 : Codeunit 7306;
      POCheck@301510006 : Record 38;
      PTModify@301510007 : Record 50034;
      PurchPost@301510008 : Codeunit 90;
      PurchInvHeader@301510009 : Record 122;
      WHAModifyLine@301510010 : Record 5767;
    BEGIN
      PortfolioTransferL.SETRANGE(Input,TRUE);
      PortfolioTransferL.SETRANGE(Done,FALSE);
      IF PortfolioTransferL.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        //IF PurchaseHeader.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          PurchaseHeader.RESET;
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
          PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",PortfolioTransferL."Document No.");
          IF PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
            //Einlagerung erstellen
              PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source No.","Source Line No.","Posted Source Document","Posted Source No.");
              PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
              PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PortfolioTransferL.LineNoPurch);
              IF PostedWhseReceiptLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                PostedWhseReceiptLine.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
                PostedWhseReceiptHeader.GET(PostedWhseReceiptLine."No.");
                IF PostedWhseReceiptHeader."Document Status" <> PostedWhseReceiptHeader."Document Status"::"Completely Put Away" THEN BEGIN
                  //Einlagerung suchen registieren.
                  WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Line No.","Source Subline No.","Serial No.","Lot No.");
                  WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
                  WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PortfolioTransferL.LineNoPurch);
                  IF WarehouseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                    REPEAT
                     CLEAR(WarehouseActivityLine."Zone Code");
                     WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Qty. to Handle",WarehouseActivityLine.Quantity);
                      IF WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type" = WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place THEN
                        IF WarehouseActivityLine."Item No." = 'BOX' THEN
                          WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",PortfolioTransferL."Box Bin Code")
                        ELSE
                         WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",PortfolioTransferL."Bin Code");
                        IF WarehouseActivityLine."Movement Qty. (Base)" > 0 THEN
                          WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Movement Qty. (Base)",0);
                        WarehouseActivityLine.MODIFY;
                      COMMIT;
                    UNTIL WarehouseActivityLine.NEXT =0;
                    WhseActRegisterYesNo.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
                    WhseActRegisterYesNo.RUN(WarehouseActivityLine);
                  END ELSE BEGIN
                    //Einlagerung erstellen
                    PostedWhseReceiptLine.CreatePutAwayDoc(PostedWhseReceiptLine,PostedWhseReceiptHeader."Assigned User ID");
                    WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Line No.","Source Subline No.","Serial No.","Lot No.");
                    WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
                    WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PortfolioTransferL.LineNoPurch);
                    IF WarehouseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                      REPEAT
                        CLEAR(WarehouseActivityLine."Zone Code");
                        WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Qty. to Handle",WarehouseActivityLine.Quantity);
                        IF WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type" = WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place THEN
                          IF WarehouseActivityLine."Item No." = 'BOX' THEN
                            WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",PortfolioTransferL."Box Bin Code")
                          ELSE
                            WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",PortfolioTransferL."Bin Code");
                          IF WarehouseActivityLine."Movement Qty. (Base)" > 0 THEN
                            WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Movement Qty. (Base)",0);
                          WarehouseActivityLine.MODIFY;
                        COMMIT;
                      UNTIL WarehouseActivityLine.NEXT =0;
                      WhseActRegisterYesNo.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
                      WhseActRegisterYesNo.RUN(WarehouseActivityLine);
                    END;
                  END;
                END;
              END;
            UNTIL PortfolioTransferL.NEXT=0;
          //END;
        //END;
        //IF WarehouseActivityLine.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
      //    WarehouseActivityLine.RESET;
      //    WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Line No.","Source Subline No.","Serial No.","Lot No.");
      //    WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
      //    //WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.");
      //    IF WarehouseActivityLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
      //      REPEAT
      //        WhseActRegisterYesNo.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
      //        WhseActRegisterYesNo.RUN(WarehouseActivityLine);
      //      UNTIL WarehouseActivityLine.NEXT=0;
      //    END;
        //END;
          COMMIT;
          IF POCheck.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type",PurchaseHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
            PurchInvHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Vendor Order No.");
            PurchInvHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",PortfolioTransferL."Document No.");
            PurchInvHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Vendor No.",POCheck."Buy-from Vendor No.");
            IF NOT PurchInvHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
              POCheck."Vendor Invoice No.":=PortfolioTransferL."Document No."+'V1'
            ELSE
              POCheck."Vendor Invoice No.":=PortfolioTransferL."Document No.";
            POCheck.Invoice:=TRUE;
            POCheck."Posting Date":=TODAY;
            POCheck.MODIFY;
            PurchPost.RUN(POCheck);
          END;
          IF NOT POCheck.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type",PurchaseHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
            PTModify.SETRANGE(Input,TRUE);
            PTModify.SETRANGE(Done,FALSE);
            PTModify.SETRANGE("Document No.",PortfolioTransferL."Document No.");
            IF PTModify.FINDSET THEN
              PTModify.MODIFYALL(Done,TRUE);
          END;
        END;
       END;
    END;
