      //  PurchPost.RUN(PurchaseHeader);
        IF NOT POCheck.GET(POCheck."Document Type"::Order,PurchaseHeader) THEN BEGIN
          PTModify.SETRANGE(Input,TRUE);
          PTModify.SETRANGE(Done,FALSE);
          PTModify.SETRANGE("Document No.",PortfolioTransferL."Document No.");
          IF PTModify.FINDSET THEN
            PTModify.MODIFYALL(Done,TRUE);
        END;
      END;

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateReturnSalesOrder@301510006();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;
      SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@301510002 : Record 37;
      SystemValueLine@301510003 : Record 5105031;
      HeaderCreate@301510004 : Boolean;
      Customer@301510005 : Record 18;
      LineNo@301510006 : Integer;
      CeateLine@301510007 : Boolean;
      Item@301510008 : Record 27;
      ReleaseSalesDocument@301510009 : Codeunit 414;
      ERR01@301510010 : TextConst 'DEU=Bitte Parameter LOCATIONFILTER Lagerort Åbergeben!;ENU=Parameter LOCATIONFILTER set Locationcode!';
    BEGIN
      LocationFilter:='W';
      Diff:=FALSE;
      IF LocationFilter = '' THEN
        ERROR(ERR01);
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(61034,'CHRONEXT-GMBH') AND SystemValueLine."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN  //hier companyname
        Customer.GET(SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation",Diff);
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE(Status,SalesHeader.Status::Open);
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Location Code",LocationFilter);
        IF NOT SalesHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          CLEAR(SalesHeader);
          SalesHeader.RESET;
          SalesHeader.INIT;
          SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
          SalesHeader.INSERT(TRUE);
          SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Sell-to Customer No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Shipping Agent Code",'EIGEN-LOG.');
          SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Payment Method Code",'RG');
          SalesHeader.Invoice:=TRUE;
          SalesHeader.Ship:=TRUE;
          SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Shipping Charge free",TRUE);
          SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Must-Shipping Agent",TRUE);
          SalesHeader."Differential Taxation":=Diff;
          SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Location Code",LocationFilter);
          SalesHeader.MODIFY;
          HeaderCreate:=TRUE;
        END ELSE
          HeaderCreate:=SalesHeader.FIND('-');

        ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Location Code","Reserved Quantity");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",LocationFilter);
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
        //ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Completely Invoiced",TRUE);
        IF ItemFilter <> '' THEN BEGIN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",ItemFilter);
        END ELSE
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','BOX');
        IF Commis THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Commission,TRUE)
        ELSE
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Commission,FALSE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Blocked By Whse. Rcpt.");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Blocked By Whse. Rcpt.",FALSE);
        IF Diff THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation Purchase",TRUE)
        ELSE
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation Purchase",FALSE);
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine.RESET;
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          IF SalesLine.FINDLAST THEN
            LineNo:=SalesLine."Line No."+1000
          ELSE
            LineNo:=1000;
          REPEAT
            Item.GET(ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
            IF (Item.Commission = Commis) AND (CheckBrand(Item)=TRUE) AND (Item."Product Postings Group ID Code" <>'KWVOLL') THEN BEGIN
              SalesLine.RESET;
              SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
              SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
              SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
              SalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
              IF SalesLine.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
                SalesLine.RESET;
                SalesLine.INIT;
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
                SalesLine."Line No." := LineNo;
                LineNo+=1000;
                SalesLine.INSERT(TRUE);
                SalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit of Measure Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Unit of Measure Code");
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Location Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code");
                SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity);
                ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost",ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)");
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",((ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)"*ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity)*0.79));
                SalesLine.VALIDATE(Amount,((ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)")*0.79));
                //SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",((ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)"*ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity)));
                //SalesLine.VALIDATE(Amount,((ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)")));
                SalesLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase");
                SalesLine.MODIFY;
                CeateLine:=TRUE;
                COMMIT;
                //SalesLine.AutoReserve;
              END;
            END;
          UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT=0;
        END ELSE BEGIN
      //    SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      //    SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      //    IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
      //      SalesLine.DELETEALL(FALSE);
      //    SalesHeader.DELETE(FALSE);
        END;
        IF NOT CeateLine THEN BEGIN
          //SalesHeader.DELETE(FALSE);
          SalesHeader.RESET;
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE(Status,SalesHeader.Status::Released);
          //SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Completely Received");
          //SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Completely Received",TRUE);
          IF SalesHeader.FIND('-') THEN
            BookSalesOrderOrder(SalesHeader);
        END ELSE
          IF CeateLine THEN
            //ReleaseSalesDocument.ReleaseSalesHeader(SalesHeader,FALSE);
            BookSalesOrderOrder(SalesHeader);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE BookSalesOrderOrder@301510008(VAR SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      CHNXItemMatchStartMgt@301510002 : Codeunit 85102;
      DocumentValueManagement@301510003 : Codeunit 5295670;
      CustomerManagement@301510004 : Codeunit 87000;
      pRecordID@301510005 : RecordID;
      SalesLine@301510006 : Record 37;
      ReleaseDocument@301510007 : Codeunit 5105005;
      SLReserve@301510001 : Record 37;
      ProcessOk@301510008 : Boolean;
      pSerial@301510009 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      IF SalesHeader.Status=SalesHeader.Status::Open THEN BEGIN
      //  IF CHNXItemMatchStartMgt.StartMatchingSalesHeader(SalesHeader,TRUE) THEN BEGIN
      //    pRecordID := SalesHeader.RECORDID;
      //    CustomerManagement.ResetStatusOrder(SalesHeader);
      //    CustomerManagement.DeclineOrIgnoreAddressChange(pRecordID,SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.",TRUE);

      //    DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(pRecordID,SalesHeader.FIELDNO("Status Approve Order"),SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved);
      //    SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      //    SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      //    SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      //    IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN
      //      REPEAT
      //        SLReserve.GET(SalesLine."Document Type",SalesLine."Document No.",SalesLine."Line No.");
      //        SLReserve.AutoReserve;
      //        SLReserve.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
      //        IF SLReserve."Reserved Quantity" =0 THEN
      //          SLReserve.DELETE(FALSE);
      //      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
      //     ReleaseDocument.ReleaseSalesOrder(SalesHeader,FALSE);
          //COMMIT;
        //END ELSE BEGIN
          pRecordID := SalesHeader.RECORDID;
          CustomerManagement.ResetStatusOrder(SalesHeader);
          CustomerManagement.DeclineOrIgnoreAddressChange(pRecordID,SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.",TRUE);
          CustomerManagement.DoExportSalesOrderToExtInterface(SalesHeader."External Document No.",'UPDORDFILE');
          DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(pRecordID,SalesHeader.FIELDNO("Status Approve Order"),SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved);
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
          IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
              SLReserve.GET(SalesLine."Document Type",SalesLine."Document No.",SalesLine."Line No.");
              SLReserve.AutoReserve;
              SLReserve.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
              IF SLReserve."Reserved Quantity" =0 THEN
                SLReserve.DELETE(FALSE);
             GetSerialNo(SalesLine,pSerial);
            UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
           ReleaseDocument.ReleaseSalesOrder(SalesHeader,FALSE);
          COMMIT;
        END;
      //END;
      ProcessOk:=SalesHeader.Status=SalesHeader.Status::Released;
      IF ProcessOk THEN BEGIN
        IF autoBook THEN
          ShipWarehouseIntercompanySale(SalesHeader)
      //  ELSE
      //    PortfolioTransferSale(SalesHeader);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ShipWarehouseIntercompanySale@301510010(VAR SalesHeader@301510002 : Record 36);
    VAR
      WarehouseShipmentHeader@301490001 : Record 7320;
      WarehouseShipmentLine@301490002 : Record 7321;
      ReleaseWhseShipment@301490003 : Codeunit 7310;
      WarehouseActivityHeader@301490004 : Record 5766;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301490005 : Record 5767;
      WhseActRegisterYesNo@301490006 : Codeunit 7306;
      LogisticCreatePickSeries@301490007 : Codeunit 5104806;
      PackListLine@301490008 : Record 5104640;
      WarehouseActivityLineModify@301490009 : Record 5767;
      WhsePostShipmentYesNo@301490010 : Codeunit 5764;
      PackingListHeader@301490011 : Record 5104639;
      LogisticMgtShptChronext@301490012 : Codeunit 85201;
      WarehouseActivityLineM2@301490013 : Record 5767;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttributeValue@301510001 : Record 7501;
    BEGIN

      WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Type");
      WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETRANGE("Source No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETFILTER("Document Status",'<>%1',WarehouseShipmentHeader."Document Status"::"Completely Picked");
      IF WarehouseShipmentHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        IF WarehouseShipmentHeader.Status = WarehouseShipmentHeader.Status::Open THEN
          ReleaseWhseShipment.Release(WarehouseShipmentHeader);
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SETRANGE("No.",WarehouseShipmentHeader."No.");
          WarehouseShipmentLine.FINDSET();
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
          WarehouseShipmentLine.CreatePickDocDiVA(WarehouseShipmentLine,WarehouseShipmentHeader);
          COMMIT;
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source No.","Source Line No.","Source Subline No.","Unit of Measure Code","Action Type","Breakbulk No.","Original Breakbulk","Activity Type","Assemble to Order");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Whse. Document No.",WarehouseShipmentHeader."No.");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Activity Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Activity Type"::Pick);
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Take);
          IF WarehouseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              //Bewegungsmenge fÅllen.
              WarehouseActivityLineM2:=WarehouseActivityLine;
              WarehouseActivityLine.AutofillQtyToHandle(WarehouseActivityLineM2);
              //Bewegungsmenge fÅllen.
              //Paket anlegen
                WarehouseActivityHeader.GET(WarehouseActivityLine."Activity Type",WarehouseActivityLine."No.");
                //LogisticCreatePickSeries.CreateWhseActivPackingList(WarehouseActivityHeader,WarehouseActivityHeader."Shipping Agent Code",WarehouseActivityHeader."Shipping Agent Service Code",TRUE);
                //Paket anlegen
                PackingListHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PackListLine."Document Type"::WhseActiv);
                PackingListHeader.SETRANGE("Document No.",WarehouseActivityLine."No.");
                IF PackingListHeader.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
                  PackingListHeader.INIT;
                  PackingListHeader."Document Type":=PackingListHeader."Document Type"::WhseActiv;
                  PackingListHeader."Document No.":=WarehouseActivityLine."No.";
                  PackingListHeader."Line No.":=WarehouseActivityLine."Line No.";
                  PackingListHeader."Item Quantity":=WarehouseActivityLine.Quantity;
                  PackingListHeader."Shipping Agent Code":=WarehouseActivityHeader."Shipping Agent Code";
                  PackingListHeader."Shipping Agent Service Code":=WarehouseActivityHeader."Shipping Agent Service Code";
                  PackingListHeader."Package Entry No.":=1;
                  PackingListHeader."Filling Weight":=1.23;
                  PackingListHeader.INSERT;
                END;

                PackListLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PackListLine."Document Type"::WhseActiv);
                PackListLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",WarehouseActivityLine."No.");
                PackListLine.SETRANGE("Item No.",WarehouseActivityLine."Item No.");
                PackListLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",WarehouseActivityLine."Line No.");
                IF PackListLine.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
                   PackListLine.INIT;
                   PackListLine."Document Type":=PackListLine."Document Type"::WhseActiv;
                   PackListLine."Document No.":=WarehouseActivityLine."No.";
                   PackListLine."Line No.":=WarehouseActivityLine."Line No.";
                   PackListLine."Item No.":=WarehouseActivityLine."Item No.";
                   PackListLine."Item Quantity":=WarehouseActivityLine.Quantity;
                   PackListLine."Variant Code":=WarehouseActivityLine."Variant Code";
                   PackListLine."Entry No.":=1;
                   PackListLine.INSERT;
                 END;
              //Paket anlegen
            UNTIL WarehouseActivityLine.NEXT=0;
            COMMIT;
            WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type");
            WarehouseActivityLine.FINDSET();
            WhseActRegisterYesNo.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
            WhseActRegisterYesNo.RUN(WarehouseActivityLine);
            COMMIT;
            PortfolioTransferSale(SalesHeader);
            COMMIT;
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.SetInvoiceShip(TRUE,FALSE);
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.RUN(WarehouseShipmentLine);

          END ELSE BEGIN
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.SetInvoiceShip(TRUE,TRUE);
            WhsePostShipmentYesNo.RUN(WarehouseShipmentLine);
          END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PortfolioTransferSale(SalesHeader);
        WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Type");
        WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETRANGE("Source No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        WarehouseShipmentHeader.SETFILTER("Document Status",'%1',WarehouseShipmentHeader."Document Status"::"Completely Picked");
        IF WarehouseShipmentHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SETRANGE("No.",WarehouseShipmentHeader."No.");
          WarehouseShipmentLine.FINDSET();
          WarehouseShipmentLine.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
          WhsePostShipmentYesNo.SetInvoiceShip(TRUE,TRUE);
          WhsePostShipmentYesNo.RUN(WarehouseShipmentLine);
        END;
      END;

    END;

    PROCEDURE PortfolioTransferSale@301510011(VAR SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine@301510001 : Record 5773;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 32;
      PortfolioTransfer@301510003 : Record 50034;
      CHNXChronextIDMgt@301510004 : Codeunit 85010;
      SalesLine@301510005 : Record 37;
      Location@301510006 : Record 14;
      unstrc@301510007 : Boolean;
      pSerialNo@301510008 : Code[20];
      SalesPost@301510009 : Codeunit 80;
      ItemTrackingManagement@301510010 : Codeunit 6500;
      i@301510011 : Integer;
      Message01@301510012 : TextConst 'DEU=%1 IC - Zeilen wurden angelegt!;ENU=%1 IC - Lines are created!';
    BEGIN
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Type",37);
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",1);
      RegisteredWhseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Action Type"::Take);
      IF RegisteredWhseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          IF NOT PortfolioTransfer.GET(RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Serial No.",SalesHeader."No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
            IF RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No."<> 'BOX' THEN BEGIN
              PortfolioTransfer.INIT;
              PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Serial No.";
              PortfolioTransfer."Portfolio Date":=SalesHeader."Posting Date";
              PortfolioTransfer."Document No.":=SalesHeader."No.";
              PortfolioTransfer."Item No.":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No.";
              PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Variant Code";
              IF RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Item No."='BOX' THEN
                PortfolioTransfer."Box Bin Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Bin Code"
              ELSE
               PortfolioTransfer."Bin Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Bin Code";
              PortfolioTransfer.Quantity:=RegisteredWhseActivityLine.Quantity;
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Location Code","Reserved Quantity");
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Serial No.");
              IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
                PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Price":=ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)";
                IF SalesLine.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Source Line No.") THEN
                  SetPortfolioInfo(ItemLedgerEntry,PortfolioTransfer,SalesLine);

              END;
              PortfolioTransfer.Remarks:=SalesHeader."Location Code";
              PortfolioTransfer.Output:=TRUE;
              PortfolioTransfer.INSERT;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Inventory ID",RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Variant Code");
              PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
              IF PortfolioTransfer.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                PortfolioTransfer."Box Bin Code":=RegisteredWhseActivityLine."Bin Code";
                PortfolioTransfer.Box:=TRUE;
                PortfolioTransfer.MODIFY(FALSE);
              END;
            END;
          END;

        UNTIL RegisteredWhseActivityLine.NEXT=0;
      END ELSE BEGIN
      //unstrk. Lagerort
        SalesLine.RESET;
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
        IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN
          IF Location.GET(SalesLine."Location Code") THEN
            unstrc:=NOT Location."Directed Put-away and Pick";
          IF unstrc THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              IF NOT PortfolioTransfer.GET(GetSerialNo(SalesLine,pSerialNo),SalesHeader."No.",SalesLine."No.",SalesLine."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
                IF SalesLine."No."<> 'BOX' THEN BEGIN
                  PortfolioTransfer.INIT;
                  PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID":=pSerialNo;
                  PortfolioTransfer."Portfolio Date":=SalesHeader."Posting Date";
                  PortfolioTransfer."Document No.":=SalesHeader."No.";
                  PortfolioTransfer."Item No.":=SalesLine."No.";
                  PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code":=SalesLine."Variant Code";
                  PortfolioTransfer.Quantity:=SalesLine.Quantity;
                  ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Location Code","Reserved Quantity");
                  ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
                  ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
                  ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",Location.Code);
                  ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pSerialNo);
                  IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                    ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
                    PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Price":=ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)";
                    SetPortfolioInfo(ItemLedgerEntry,PortfolioTransfer,SalesLine);
                  END;
                  PortfolioTransfer.Remarks:=SalesLine."Location Code";
                  PortfolioTransfer.Output:=TRUE;
                  PortfolioTransfer.INSERT;
                  i+=1;
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Inventory ID",pSerialNo);
                  PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
                  IF PortfolioTransfer.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                    PortfolioTransfer.Box:=TRUE;
                    PortfolioTransfer.MODIFY(FALSE);
                  END;
                END;
              END;
            UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
            IF GUIALLOWED THEN
              MESSAGE(STRSUBSTNO(Message01,i));
            IF autoBook THEN
              SalesPost.RUN(SalesHeader);
          END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetPortfolioInfo@301510012(VAR ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;VAR PortfolioTransfer@301510001 : Record 50034;VAR SalesLine@301510011 : Record 37);
    VAR
      PostedWhseReceiptLine@301510010 : Record 7319;
      ReservationEntry@301510009 : Record 337;
      ReservationEntry1@301510008 : Record 337;
      BoxLoc@301510007 : Boolean;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510006 : Record 7505;
      Zust@301510005 : Boolean;
      Cert@301510004 : Boolean;
      gCHNXChronextIDMgt@301510003 : Codeunit 85010;
      LocSerialNo@301510002 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      PortfolioTransfer."Warranty Date":=ItemLedgerEntry."Warranty Date Attr.";
      PortfolioTransfer."Manufacturer Serial No.":=gCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetSerialNoSalesLine(SalesLine);
      PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Order ID":=ItemLedgerEntry."Document No.";
      PortfolioTransfer."Diff. Tax":=ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
      IF PostedWhseReceiptLine.GET(ItemLedgerEntry."Whse. Document No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Whse. Document Line No.") THEN BEGIN
        PortfolioTransfer.Box:=PostedWhseReceiptLine.Box;
        PortfolioTransfer.Certificate:=PostedWhseReceiptLine.Certificate;
        PortfolioTransfer."Used good":=PostedWhseReceiptLine."Used good";
        PortfolioTransfer."Manufacturer Serial No.":=gCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetSerialNoSalesLine(SalesLine);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        Zust:=FALSE;
        Cert:=FALSE;
        BoxLoc:=FALSE;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",5401);
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",SalesLine."No.");
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",10);
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'new' THEN
            Zust:=TRUE
          ELSE
            Zust:=FALSE;
        END;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",11);
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'ja' THEN
            BoxLoc:=TRUE
          ELSE
            BoxLoc:=FALSE;
        END;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",13);
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'ja' THEN
            Cert:=TRUE
          ELSE
            Cert:=FALSE;
        END;
        PortfolioTransfer.Box:=BoxLoc;
        PortfolioTransfer.Certificate:=Cert;
        PortfolioTransfer."Used good":=Zust;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckBrand@301510013(lItem@301510001 : Record 27) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      IF BrandFiltergl = '' THEN EXIT(TRUE);
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",27);
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",lItem."No.");
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",1);
      IF NOT lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);

      lItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Item Attribute Value Text",BrandFiltergl);
      IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN
        EXIT(TRUE)
      ELSE
        EXIT(FALSE)
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetSerialNo@301510016(VAR SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;VAR pSerialNo@301510002 : Code[20]) : Code[20];
    VAR
      ReservationEntry@301510001 : Record 337;
      ReservationEntry1@301510003 : Record 337;
      ItemTrackingManagement@301510004 : Codeunit 6500;
      ToTrackingSpecification@301510005 : Record 336;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510006 : Record 32;
      MissingExCostRevLink@301510007 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      ReservationEntry.RESET;

    PROCEDURE PGenerateICLinieVisible@301510015(SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SystemValueLine@301510001 : Record 5105031;
      ReturntoIC@301510002 : Record 50034;
    BEGIN
      IF COMPANYNAME <> 'Chronext Purchasing B.V.' THEN BEGIN
        IF SystemValueLine.GET(61034,COMPANYNAME) AND SystemValueLine."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" = SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No." THEN BEGIN
            ReturntoIC.RESET;
            ReturntoIC.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            IF ReturntoIC.ISEMPTY THEN
              EXIT(TRUE)
            ELSE
              EXIT(FALSE);
          END ELSE EXIT(FALSE);
        END ELSE EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,80,OnBeforePostSalesDoc)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE BeforeBookSH@301510018(VAR SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37;
      ReturntoIC@301510002 : Record 50034;
      Error01@301510003 : TextConst 'DEU=Anzahl Verkaufszeile ist ungleich IC Transfer, bitte IC Transfer lîschen und neu generieren!;ENU=Count of sales lines is not the same as IC transfer, please delete IC transfer and regenerate again!';
      SystemValueLine@301510004 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      IF COMPANYNAME <> 'Chronext Purchasing B.V.' THEN BEGIN
        IF SystemValueLine.GET(61034,COMPANYNAME) AND SystemValueLine."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" = SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No." THEN BEGIN
            ReturntoIC.RESET;
            ReturntoIC.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
            SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
            SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');

            IF SalesLine.COUNT <> ReturntoIC.COUNT THEN
              ERROR(FORMAT(SalesLine.COUNT),FORMAT(ReturntoIC.COUNT),'%1%2');
          END ELSE EXIT;
        END ELSE EXIT;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,5763,OnBeforeRun)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE BeforeBookWHSE@301510019(VAR WarehouseShipmentLine@301510000 : Record 7321);
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510003 : Record 37;
      ReturntoIC@301510002 : Record 50034;
      SystemValueLine@301510001 : Record 5105031;
      SalesHeader@301510004 : Record 36;
      Error01@301510005 : TextConst 'DEU=Anzahl Verkaufszeile ist ungleich IC Transfer, bitte IC Transfer lîschen und neu generieren!;ENU=Count of sales lines is not the same as IC transfer, please delete IC transfer and regenerate again!';
      Error02@301510006 : TextConst 'DEU=Betrag prÅfen!;ENU=Check amount!';
    BEGIN
      IF COMPANYNAME <> 'Chronext Purchasing B.V.' THEN BEGIN
      IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,WarehouseShipmentLine."Source No.") THEN BEGIN
        IF SystemValueLine.GET(61034,COMPANYNAME) AND SystemValueLine."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" = SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No." THEN BEGIN
            ReturntoIC.RESET;
            ReturntoIC.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            //09.04.24
            IF ReturntoIC.FINDSET THEN
              ReturntoIC.CALCSUMS("Purchase Price");
            SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
            SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
            SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
            IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
              SalesLine.CALCSUMS("Unit Price");
            IF SalesLine.COUNT <> ReturntoIC.COUNT THEN
              ERROR(Error01);
            IF ReturntoIC."Purchase Price" <> SalesLine."Unit Price" THEN BEGIN
              IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                REPEAT
                  ReturntoIC.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
                  ReturntoIC.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
                  IF ReturntoIC.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                    ReturntoIC."Purchase Price":=SalesLine."Unit Price";
                    ReturntoIC.MODIFY(FALSE);
                  END;
                UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
                ReturntoIC.CALCSUMS("Purchase Price");
                IF ReturntoIC."Purchase Price" <> SalesLine."Unit Price" THEN
                  ERROR(Error02);
              END;
            END;
          END ELSE EXIT;
        END ELSE EXIT;
      END ELSE EXIT;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE PortfolioTransferfromSalesInvoice@301510017(VAR SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 110);
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 32;
      PortfolioTransfer@301510003 : Record 50034;
      CHNXChronextIDMgt@301510004 : Codeunit 85010;
      SalesLine@301510005 : Record 111;
      Location@301510006 : Record 14;
      unstrc@301510007 : Boolean;
      pSerialNo@301510008 : Code[20];
      ItemTrackingManagement@301510010 : Codeunit 6500;
      i@301510011 : Integer;
      Message01@301510012 : TextConst 'DEU=%1 IC - Zeilen wurden angelegt!;ENU=%1 IC - Lines are created!';
      ReturntoIC@301510013 : Record 50034;
      ItemApplicationEntry@301510001 : Record 339;
      ItemLedgerEntry1@301510009 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      SalesHeader.TESTFIELD("Sell-to Customer No.",'CXT GMBH');
      ReturntoIC.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."Order No.");
      IF ReturntoIC.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        SalesLine.RESET;
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
        IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            IF SalesLine."No."<> 'BOX' THEN BEGIN
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Location Code","Reserved Quantity");
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,FALSE);
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,FALSE);
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",SalesLine."Location Code");
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
              ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
              IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                pSerialNo:=ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.";
                PortfolioTransfer.INIT;
                PortfolioTransfer."Inventory ID":=ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.";
                PortfolioTransfer."Portfolio Date":=SalesHeader."Posting Date";
                PortfolioTransfer."Document No.":=SalesHeader."Order No.";
                PortfolioTransfer."Item No.":=SalesLine."No.";
                PortfolioTransfer."Variant Code":=SalesLine."Variant Code";
                PortfolioTransfer.Quantity:=SalesLine.Quantity;
                ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
                PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Price":=ABS(ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)");
                ItemApplicationEntry.SETRANGE("Item Ledger Entry No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
                IF ItemApplicationEntry.FIND('-') THEN
                  ItemLedgerEntry1.GET(ItemApplicationEntry."Inbound Item Entry No.");
                SetPortfolioInfoexistDocument(ItemLedgerEntry,PortfolioTransfer,SalesLine,ItemLedgerEntry);
              END;
              PortfolioTransfer.Remarks:=SalesLine."Location Code";
              PortfolioTransfer.Output:=TRUE;
              PortfolioTransfer.INSERT;
              i+=1;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Inventory ID",pSerialNo);
            PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            IF PortfolioTransfer.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              PortfolioTransfer.Box:=TRUE;
              PortfolioTransfer.MODIFY(FALSE);
            END;
          END;
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
        IF GUIALLOWED THEN
          MESSAGE(STRSUBSTNO(Message01,i));

       END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetPortfolioInfoexistDocument@301510021(VAR ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;VAR PortfolioTransfer@301510001 : Record 50034;VAR SalesLine@301510011 : Record 111;VAR ItemLedgerEntry1@301510012 : Record 32);
    VAR
      PostedWhseReceiptLine@301510010 : Record 7319;
      ReservationEntry@301510009 : Record 337;
      ReservationEntry1@301510008 : Record 337;
      BoxLoc@301510007 : Boolean;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510006 : Record 7505;
      Zust@301510005 : Boolean;
      Cert@301510004 : Boolean;
      gCHNXChronextIDMgt@301510003 : Codeunit 85010;
      LocSerialNo@301510002 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      PortfolioTransfer."Warranty Date":=ItemLedgerEntry."Warranty Date Attr.";
      PortfolioTransfer."Manufacturer Serial No.":=ItemLedgerEntry1."Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.";
      PortfolioTransfer."Purchase Order ID":=ItemLedgerEntry."Document No.";
      PortfolioTransfer."Diff. Tax":=ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
      IF PostedWhseReceiptLine.GET(ItemLedgerEntry."Whse. Document No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Whse. Document Line No.") THEN BEGIN
        PortfolioTransfer.Box:=PostedWhseReceiptLine.Box;
        PortfolioTransfer.Certificate:=PostedWhseReceiptLine.Certificate;
        PortfolioTransfer."Used good":=PostedWhseReceiptLine."Used good";
      END ELSE BEGIN
        Zust:=FALSE;
        Cert:=FALSE;
        BoxLoc:=FALSE;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",5401);
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",SalesLine."No.");
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",10);
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'new' THEN
            Zust:=TRUE
          ELSE
            Zust:=FALSE;
        END;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",11);
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'ja' THEN
            BoxLoc:=TRUE
          ELSE
            BoxLoc:=FALSE;
        END;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",13);
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'ja' THEN
            Cert:=TRUE
          ELSE
            Cert:=FALSE;
        END;
        PortfolioTransfer.Box:=BoxLoc;
        PortfolioTransfer.Certificate:=Cert;
        PortfolioTransfer."Used good":=Zust;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindDiffMwStVKAuftrÑge@301510023();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntryEinkauf@301510000 : Record 32;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510001 : Record 112;
      PurchRcptLine@301510002 : Record 121;
      SystemValueLine@301510003 : Record 5105031;
      ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf@301510004 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      //55055
      ItemLedgerEntryEinkauf.SETRANGE("Source No.", '81859');
      ItemLedgerEntryEinkauf.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation Purchase", TRUE);
      //alle eingekauften Artikel
      IF ItemLedgerEntryEinkauf.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          //schon verkauft?
          ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf.SETRANGE("Entry Type", ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf."Entry Type"::Sale);
          //ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf.SETRange("Item Tracking", ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.");
          ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf.SETFILTER("Location Code", 'HL');
          ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf.SETFILTER("Serial No.", ItemLedgerEntryEinkauf."Serial No.");
          IF ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.", ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf."External Document No.");
              IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                IF NOT SystemValueLine.GET(55055,SalesInvoiceHeader."External Document No.") THEN BEGIN
                  SystemValueLine.INIT;
                  SystemValueLine."System Value No." := 55055;
                  SystemValueLine."System Code" := SalesInvoiceHeader."External Document No.";
                  SystemValueLine.INSERT;
                END;
                SystemValueLine."Calc Value 1" := ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf."Entry No.";
                SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" := ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf."Item No.";
                SystemValueLine."Code Value 2" := ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf."Variant Code";
                SystemValueLine."Text 1" := ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf."Serial No.";
                SystemValueLine.MODIFY;
              END;
            UNTIL ItemLedgerEntryVerkauf.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        UNTIL ItemLedgerEntryEinkauf.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSalesInvoice@301510022();
    VAR
      CopyDocMgt@301510000 : Codeunit 6620;
      SalesCrMemoHeader@301510001 : Record 114;
      SalesHeader@301510002 : Record 36;
      SalesSetup@301510003 : Record 311;
      DocType@301510004 : 'Quote,Blanket Order,Order,Invoice,Return Order,Credit Memo,Posted Shipment,Posted Invoice,Posted Return Receipt,Posted Credit Memo,Arch. Quote,Arch. Order,Arch. Blanket Order,Arch. Return Order';
      SalesHeader1@301510005 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@301510006 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      SalesSetup.GET;
      SalesCrMemoHeader.SETFILTER("User ID",'NKONACKI');
      //SalesCrMemoHeader.SETFILTER(Amount,'>%1',0);
      SalesCrMemoHeader.SETFILTER("No.",'>%1','GS0001562');
      IF SalesCrMemoHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          CLEAR(SalesHeader);
          SalesHeader.RESET;
          SalesHeader.INIT;
          SalesHeader."Document Type":=SalesHeader."Document Type"::Invoice;
          SalesHeader.INSERT(TRUE);
          CopyDocMgt.SetProperties(
            TRUE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,SalesSetup."Exact Cost Reversing Mandatory",FALSE);
          CopyDocMgt.SetArchDocVal(0,0);
          CopyDocMgt.CopySalesDoc(DocType::"Posted Credit Memo",SalesCrMemoHeader."No.",SalesHeader);
          SalesHeader1.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.");
          SalesHeader1."Location Code":='GS';
          SalesHeader1.MODIFY(FALSE);
        SalesLine.RESET;
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation",TRUE);
        IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",FALSE);
          SalesLine.MODIFY(FALSE);
        END;
        SalesLine.RESET;
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'%1','');
        IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine.DELETEALL;
        END;
          COMMIT;
        UNTIL SalesCrMemoHeader.NEXT=0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Search@301510000();
    VAR
      ImportFile@301510004 : File;
      ImportStream@301510003 : InStream;
      Buffer@301510002 : Text;
      ImportFilePath@301510001 : Text;
      Counter@301510000 : Integer;
      QuickSearchSerial@301510005 : Page 85200;
      WarehouseEntry@301510006 : Record 7312;
      ExportFile@301510007 : File;
      ExportStream@301510008 : OutStream;
      Buffer_out@301510009 : Integer;
      ExportFilePath@301510010 : Text;
      charend@301510011 : ARRAY [2] OF Char;
    BEGIN
      ImportFilePath := '\\172.30.50.8\Shared\Transfer\DEV\LACK\rep.txt';
      ExportFilePath := '\\172.30.50.8\Shared\Transfer\DEV\LACK\rep_new.txt';
      ExportFile.CREATE(ExportFilePath);
      ImportFile.OPEN(ImportFilePath);
      Counter := 0;
      charend[1] := 13;
      charend[2] := 10;
      ImportFile.CREATEINSTREAM(ImportStream);
      ExportFile.TEXTMODE(TRUE);
      ExportFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(ExportStream);
      WHILE NOT ImportStream.EOS DO BEGIN
        ImportStream.READTEXT(Buffer);
        ExportStream.WRITETEXT(Buffer);
        WarehouseEntry.RESET;
        WarehouseEntry.ASCENDING(FALSE);
        WarehouseEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",Buffer);
        WarehouseEntry.SETRANGE("Registering Date",TODAY -1);
        IF WarehouseEntry.FINDFIRST THEN
          IF (WarehouseEntry."Bin Code" = 'AUSGLEICHHL') AND (WarehouseEntry.Quantity = 1) THEN BEGIN
            WarehouseEntry.NEXT;
             ExportStream.WRITETEXT(';' + WarehouseEntry."Bin Code" + ';Vorrieger Lagerplatz');
          END
          ELSE IF (WarehouseEntry."Zone Code" = 'T') AND (WarehouseEntry.Quantity = 1) THEN
            ExportStream.WRITETEXT(';' + WarehouseEntry."Bin Code");

        ExportStream.WRITETEXT(FORMAT(charend[1]) + FORMAT(charend[2]));
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DoReserveItemLedgerEntryAndSalesLine_OnAfterPostTransferReceipt_C5705@301480015();
    VAR
      CHNXSalesStorePickupMgt@301480005 : Codeunit 85050;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301480004 : Record 32;
      SalesHeader@301480002 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@301480003 : Record 37;
      TransferReceiptLine@301480001 : Record 5747;
      SalesLineModify@301510000 : Record 37;
      TransferReceiptHeader@301510001 : Record 5746;
    BEGIN
      // LF 07.11.18 SLAN CHR-143 DoReserveItemLedgerEntryAndSalesLine_OnAfterPostTransferReceipt_C5705, Reservierung beim Buchen direkt wieder an VK hÑngen

      TransferReceiptHeader.RESET;
      TransferReceiptHeader.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'>=%1',130319D);

      IF TransferReceiptHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        REPEAT
          IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,TransferReceiptHeader."Transfer Order No.") THEN BEGIN
            IF (SalesHeader.Status = SalesHeader.Status::Open) AND (SalesHeader."Pickup Location Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
              MESSAGE(FORMAT(SalesHeader."No."));
              TransferReceiptLine.RESET;
              TransferReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",TransferReceiptHeader."No.");
              TransferReceiptLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>0');
              IF TransferReceiptLine.FIND('-') THEN
                REPEAT
                  IF SalesLine.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.",TransferReceiptLine."Line No.") THEN BEGIN
                    IF TransferReceiptLine."Item Rcpt. Entry No." <> 0 THEN
                      // bei 'normalen' µrtikeln ohne SN wird die Artikelpostennummer direkt in der Zeile gespeichert
                      SalesLine.AutoReserve
                    ELSE BEGIN
                      // Wenn nicht gefÅllt dann wird es mit S/N sein, dann tracking auswerten
                      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
                      ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Type","Document Line No.");
                      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",TransferReceiptLine."Document No.");
                      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",ItemLedgerEntry."Document Type"::"Transfer Receipt");
                      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Document Line No.",TransferReceiptLine."Line No.");
                      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",SalesHeader."Pickup Location Code");
                      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN
                        REPEAT
                          IF ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No." <> '' THEN
                            CHNXSalesStorePickupMgt.InsertReservationEntriesForItemLedgerEntryAndSalesLine(ItemLedgerEntry,SalesLine);
                        UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT = 0;
                    END;
                    SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type",SalesLine."Document No.",SalesLine."Line No.");
                    SalesLine.InitQtyToShip;
                    SalesLine.MODIFY;
                  END;
                UNTIL TransferReceiptLine.NEXT = 0;
              END;
            END;
          UNTIL TransferReceiptHeader.NEXT = 0;
      // LF 07.11.18 SLAN CHR-143 DoReserveItemLedgerEntryAndSalesLine_OnAfterPostTransferReceipt_C5705, Reservierung beim Buchen direkt wieder an VK hÑngen ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE RepairAusgleich@301170039(pEntryNo@301170000 : Integer);
    VAR

      EntryNo@301170002 : Integer;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillOptionStringSQL@301510002();
    VAR
      OptionStringSQL@301510002 : Record 50038;
      Object@301510000 : Record 2000000001;
      Field@301510001 : Record 2000000041;
      i@301510003 : Integer;
      CommaPos@301510007 : Integer;
      intCount@301510004 : Integer;
      Delimiter@301510005 : Text;
      TempText@301510006 : Text;
    BEGIN

      Field.RESET;
      Field.SETRANGE(Field.Type,Field.Type::Option);
      IF Field.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          intCount := 0;
          intCount := STRLEN(DELCHR(Field.OptionString, '=', DELCHR(Field.OptionString,'=', ',')));
          FOR i := 0 TO intCount  DO BEGIN
            CLEAR(OptionStringSQL);
            OptionStringSQL."Table Name" := Field.TableName;
            OptionStringSQL."Field Name" := Field.FieldName;
            OptionStringSQL."Option ID" := i;
            OptionStringSQL."Option String Value" := SELECTSTR(i+1,Field.OptionString);
            OptionStringSQL.INSERT;
          END;
        UNTIL Field.NEXT = 0;
      END;



    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Update_OrderStatus@301510004();
    VAR
      OrderStatusProtocol@301510000 : Record 5104695;
      OrderStatusProtocol_mod@301510004 : Record 5104695;
      i@301510001 : Integer;
      SalesStatisticLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 5104545;
      OrderStatusManagment@301510003 : Codeunit 5104688;
    BEGIN
      OrderStatusProtocol.RESET;
      OrderStatusProtocol.SETRANGE("Order No.",'X93564151282');
      IF OrderStatusProtocol.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
            SalesStatisticLedgerEntry.RESET;
            SalesStatisticLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",OrderStatusProtocol."Order No.");
            SalesStatisticLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Status,SalesStatisticLedgerEntry.Status::posted);
            SalesStatisticLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("No.",OrderStatusProtocol."Item No.");
            SalesStatisticLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",OrderStatusProtocol."Variant Code");
            IF SalesStatisticLedgerEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              CASE OrderStatusProtocol.Status OF
                0,1,2,3,4,8,9,10,11 :  OrderStatusManagment.SetSalesOrderStatus_Done(SalesStatisticLedgerEntry);

                5,6,7 : BEGIN
                  OrderStatusManagment.SetSalesOrderStatus_Done(SalesStatisticLedgerEntry);
                  OrderStatusProtocol_mod.GET(OrderStatusProtocol."Order No.",OrderStatusProtocol."Line No.");
                  IF (OrderStatusProtocol_mod.Status = OrderStatusProtocol_mod.Status::sent) AND (OrderStatusProtocol_mod."Return Quantity" <> 0) THEN BEGIN
                    OrderStatusProtocol_mod."Return Quantity" := 0;
                    OrderStatusProtocol_mod.ReturnCode := '';

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Check_FreshSales@301510005();
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301510001 : Record 5275378;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2@301510000 : Record 5275378;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile3@301510002 : Record 5275378;
    BEGIN
      {

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.RESET;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'UPDFRSFILE');
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETFILTER(Filename,'%1','X*');
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::error);
      IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.RESET;
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.SETRANGE("Message Code",'UPDFRSFILE');
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.SETRANGE(Filename,ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename);
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::processed);
          IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Sub Code" := 'Retry';
            ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.MODIFY;
          END;
        UNTIL ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.RESET;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'UPDFRSFILE');
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETFILTER("Message Sub Code",'RETRY');
      IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
        ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::error;
        ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.MODIFY;
        UNTIL ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.RESET;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'UPDFRSFILE');
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETFILTER("Message Sub Code",'RETRY');
      IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.FINDSET(TRUE) THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.RESET;
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.SETRANGE("Message Code",'UPDFRSFILE');
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.SETRANGE(Filename,ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename);
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.SETFILTER("Entry No.",'<>%1',ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Entry No.");
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.Status::error);
          IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile2.MODIFYALL("Message Sub Code",'');
          END;
        UNTIL ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      }


      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.RESET;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'UPDFRSFILE');
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::canceled);
      IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.FINDSET(TRUE) THEN BEGIN

      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE TextExportToFile@301510008(soapbody@301510000 : Text);
    VAR
      FileHandler@301510001 : File;
      OutStream@301510002 : OutStream;
      FileName@301510003 : Text;
      FolderPath@301510004 : Text;
      InStream@301510005 : InStream;
      TempFile@301510006 : File;
      DownloadFileName@301510007 : Text;
    BEGIN
      //EXIT;
      // Create a temporary file name
      FileName := TEMPORARYPATH + 'soapbody_temp.txt';

      // Create temporary file and write content
      TempFile.CREATE(FileName);
      TempFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(OutStream);
      OutStream.WRITETEXT(soapbody);
      TempFile.CLOSE;

      // Open the file for download/viewing
      TempFile.OPEN(FileName);
      TempFile.CREATEINSTREAM(InStream);
      DownloadFileName := 'soapbody.txt';
      DOWNLOADFROMSTREAM(InStream, 'View SOAP Body', '', 'Text Files (*.txt)|*.txt', DownloadFileName);
      TempFile.CLOSE;

      // Clean up - delete the temporary file
      IF EXISTS(FileName) THEN
        ERASE(FileName);
    END;

    VAR
      PortfolioTransfer@301510010 : Record 50003;

      ItemVariant_New@301510002 : Record 5401;

      //2025 = 213707
      //2026 = 224867

      //SW 2025 = 208172
      //SW 2026 = 208173

      i := 1;
      PortfolioTransfer.RESET;
      //PortfolioTransfer.SETRANGE(Certificate,FALSE);
      IF PortfolioTransfer.FINDSET(TRUE) THEN BEGIN
        //Progressbar.OPEN('Deleting variants... @1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@');

                ItemAttributeValueMapping_New."Item Variant Code" := ItemVariant_New.Code;

                  ItemAttributeValueMapping_New."Item Attribute Value ID" := 224867;

        UNTIL (PortfolioTransfer.NEXT = 0) OR (i = 100);

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FixJewelleryAttribute@301510021();
    VAR
      ItemVariant@301510000 : Record 5401;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510001 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping2@301510002 : Record 7505;
      TempValue@301510003 : Integer;
      ExportGatewayItemVariant@301510004 : Codeunit 82004;

        REPEAT
          {
          TempValue := 0;

          IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Jewellery Stone" <> '' THEN BEGIN
            ItemAttributeValue.RESET;

            ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(Value,ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Jewellery Stone");

              TempValue := ItemAttributeValue.ID

              CLEAR(ItemAttributeValue);

              ItemAttributeValue.VALIDATE(Value,ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Jewellery Stone");

            CLEAR(ItemAttributeValueMapping2);
            ItemAttributeValueMapping2."Table ID" := 5401;
            ItemAttributeValueMapping2."No." := ItemVariant."Item No.";
            ItemAttributeValueMapping2."Item Variant Code" := ItemVariant.Code;
            ItemAttributeValueMapping2."Item Attribute ID" := 103;
            ItemAttributeValueMapping2."Item Attribute Value ID" := TempValue;
            ItemAttributeValueMapping2.INSERT;
           }
            ExportGatewayItemVariant.CreateExternalInterfaceMessage(ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,STRSUBSTNO('P%1_MOD',PAGE::"Item Variants"));
          //END;
        UNTIL ItemVariant.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CopyBLOB@301510023();
    VAR
      SourceLayoutLine@301510000 : Record 5104925;
      TargetLayoutLine@301510001 : Record 5104925;
      Instr@301510002 : InStream;
      OutStr@301510003 : OutStream;
    BEGIN



      // Get source record
      IF SourceLayoutLine.GET('CHRONEXT LABEL',4897) THEN BEGIN

          // Make sure BLOB is loaded
          SourceLayoutLine.CALCFIELDS("External Graphic");
          IF SourceLayoutLine."External Graphic".HASVALUE THEN
            MESSAGE('Var');

          // Get target record
          IF TargetLayoutLine.GET('CHRONEXT LABEL',4905) THEN BEGIN

              // Create streams
              SourceLayoutLine."External Graphic".CREATEINSTREAM(Instr);
              TargetLayoutLine."External Graphic".CREATEOUTSTREAM(OutStr);

              // Copy content
              COPYSTREAM(OutStr, Instr);

              // Save target
              TargetLayoutLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
      END;

      TargetLayoutLine.GET('CHRONEXT LABEL',4905);
      TargetLayoutLine.CALCFIELDS("External Graphic");
      IF TargetLayoutLine."External Graphic".HASVALUE THEN
        MESSAGE('1')
      ELSE
        MESSAGE('2');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindSellType@301510029(SalesHeader@301510007 : Record 36;SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37) : Text;
    VAR
      txtSKU@301510006 : Text;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510005 : Record 50030;
      SellWatchVendorInfo@301510004 : Record 50012;
      WatchCost@301510003 : Decimal;
      ILE@301510002 : Record 32;
      WatchCostIncVAT@301510000 : Decimal;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510008 : Record 50029;
    BEGIN
      SellType:='';
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(SalesLine."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
          ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor ID");
          ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.CALCFIELDS("Buy-from Vendor Name");
          ILE.RESET;
          ILE.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
          ILE.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
          ILE.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
          ILE.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
          IF ILE.ISEMPTY THEN
            SellType := 'Large Vendor(' + ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name" + ')'
          ELSE
            SellType := 'Large Vendor On Stock';

          EXIT(SellType);
      END;

      txtSKU := SalesLine."No." + '_' + SalesLine."Variant Code";
      SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
      SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE(SellWatchVendorInfo.SKU,txtSKU);
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDFIRST THEN
          EXIT(SellType);

      ILE.RESET;
      ILE.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code");
      ILE.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
      ILE.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
      ILE.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      IF ILE.ISEMPTY THEN
          EXIT('OnDemand')
      ELSE
          EXIT('Stock');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE WriteSellType@301510030();
    VAR
      UnpostedDocumentValue@301510000 : Record 5295670;
      SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36;
      i@301510002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDLAST;
      i := UnpostedDocumentValue.ID + 1;

      SalesHeader.RESET;
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("No.",'X76179198884');
      IF SalesHeader.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          UnpostedDocumentValue.RESET;
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE(Key,'#F85058#');
          IF NOT UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            CLEAR(UnpostedDocumentValue);
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Type" := 36;
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Subtype" := 1;
            UnpostedDocumentValue.ID := i;
            i += 1;
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Source No." := SalesHeader."No.";
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Entry No." := 1;
            UnpostedDocumentValue.Identifier := '#FIELDNO#';
            UnpostedDocumentValue.Key := '#F85058#';
            UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueText := SellTypeLines(SalesHeader);
            UnpostedDocumentValue.INSERT(TRUE);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            UnpostedDocumentValue.DELETE;
            CLEAR(UnpostedDocumentValue);
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Type" := 36;
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Subtype" := 1;
            UnpostedDocumentValue.ID := i;
            i += 1;
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Source No." := SalesHeader."No.";
            UnpostedDocumentValue."Entry No." := 1;
            UnpostedDocumentValue.Identifier := '#FIELDNO#';
            UnpostedDocumentValue.Key := '#F85058#';
            UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueText := SellTypeLines(SalesHeader);
            UnpostedDocumentValue.INSERT(TRUE);
          END;
        UNTIL SalesHeader.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SellTypeLines@301510035(SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36) : Text;
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;
      SellType@301510002 : Text;
    BEGIN
      SalesLine.RESET;
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      SalesLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        SellType := '';
        REPEAT
          IF SellType = '' THEN
            SellType := FindSellType(SalesHeader,SalesLine)
          ELSE
            SellType := SellType + '_' + FindSellType(SalesHeader,SalesLine);
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;
        EXIT(SellType);
      END;
    END;

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE LogistikBuch@301490000();
    VAR
      WarehouseJournalLine@301490000 : Record 7311;
      LineNo@301490001 : Integer;
      ItemVariant@301490002 : Record 5401;
      ItemVariant1@301490003 : Record 5401;
      Bin@301490004 : Record 7354;
      WhseItemTrackingLine@301490005 : Record 6550;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301490006 : Record 32;
      ReservationEntry@301490007 : Record 337;
      BinContent@301510000 : Record 7302;
      BinContent1@301510001 : Record 7302;
      SaveBin@301510002 : Code[10];
      SavBinBox@301510003 : Code[10];
      l_recSystemValueL@301490008 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      // 01 11.03.21 VMO <<
      l_recSystemValueL.RESET;
      IF NOT l_recSystemValueL.GET(60010,USERID) THEN BEGIN
         ERROR('Please set your UserID in System Value No. 60010.');
      END;
      // 01 11.03.21 VMO >>

      EFGBestand.RESET;
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(LogBuch,FALSE);
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(CompanyNameIM,COMPANYNAME);
      IF EFGBestand.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        LineNo:=20010;
        REPEAT
          CLEAR(SaveBin);
          CLEAR(SavBinBox);
          IF NOT BinContent.GET('HL',EFGBestand.Lagerplatz,EFGBestand.Artikel,EFGBestand.Variant,'STCK') THEN BEGIN
            BinContent1.RESET;
            BinContent1.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
            BinContent1.SETRANGE("Item No.",EFGBestand.Artikel);
            BinContent1.SETRANGE("Variant Code",EFGBestand.Variant);
            IF BinContent1.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              EFGBestand.Lagerplatz:=BinContent1."Bin Code";
              SaveBin:=BinContent1."Bin Code";
              EFGBestand.MODIFY;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              EFGBestand.BoxSerial:='x';
              EFGBestand.MODIFY;
            END;
          END;
            ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code",Positive,Open);
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",EFGBestand.Artikel);
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",EFGBestand.Variant);
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",EFGBestand.InventorID);
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
            IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              ReservationEntry.RESET;
              ReservationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Reservation Status","Item No.","Variant Code",Positive);

                      WarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,-1);
                      //WarehouseJournalLine."Entry Type":=WarehouseJournalLine."Entry Type"::"Negative Adjmt.";

                      WarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",SaveBin)
                    ELSE
                     WarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",EFGBestand.Lagerplatz);
                    IF NOT EFGBestand.Negative THEN
                      WarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("Serial No.",EFGBestand.InventorID);
                    WarehouseJournalLine."Reason Code":='0';
                    IF NOT EFGBestand.Negative THEN BEGIN
                      WarehouseJournalLine."From Zone Code":='AUSGLEICH';
                      WarehouseJournalLine."From Bin Code":='AUSGLEICHHL';
                    END;
                    WarehouseJournalLine.INSERT;

                      WhseItemTrackingLine."Qty. per Unit of Measure":=1;
                      WhseItemTrackingLine."Qty. to Handle (Base)":=1;
                      WhseItemTrackingLine.INSERT;
                    END;



                    IF EFGBestand."Lagerplatz Box" <> '0' THEN BEGIN
                      LineNo+=1;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ArtikelBuch@301490001();
    VAR
      ItemJournalLine@301490000 : Record 83;
      CHNXAttributeMgt@301490001 : Codeunit 85020;
    BEGIN


      EFGBestand.RESET;
      EFGBestand.SETCURRENTKEY(InventorID); // 01 31.05.21 VMO ERP-187
      EFGBestand.SETASCENDING(InventorID,FALSE); // 01 31.05.21 VMO ERP-187
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(LogBuch,TRUE);
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ArtikBuch,FALSE);
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(CompanyNameIM,COMPANYNAME);
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ItemLedyEntry,FALSE);
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ReserveEntry,FALSE);
      IF EFGBestand.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",'ARTIKEL');
          ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",'STANDARD');
          ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Item No.",EFGBestand.Artikel);
          ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",EFGBestand.Variant);
          ItemJournalLine.SETFILTER("External Document No.",'<>%1','Inventory Import');
          //ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("External Document No.",'');

          IF ItemJournalLine.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
           // IF EFGBestand.Value <> ItemJournalLine.Amount THEN BEGIN
              ItemJournalLine."External Document No.":='Inventory Import';
              ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,EFGBestand.Value);
             {
              IF NOT EFGBestand.Negative THEN BEGIN
                ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost",EFGBestand.Value);
                ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,EFGBestand.Value);
              END;
              }
              ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation Purchase",EFGBestand.DiffBes);
              ItemJournalLine."Warranty Date":=EFGBestand.GarantieDate;
              ItemJournalLine.MODIFY;
              IF EFGBestand.Negative THEN BEGIN
                EFGBestand."Amount Journal":=ItemJournalLine."Unit Cost";
                IF EFGBestand.Value <>  ItemJournalLine."Unit Cost" THEN
                  EFGBestand."Diff.Amount":=TRUE;
              END;
              EFGBestand.ArtikBuch:=TRUE;
              EFGBestand.MODIFY;
            END;
          //END;
        UNTIL EFGBestand.NEXT=0;
        MESSAGE('ArtikelBuch Done.');
      END
      ELSE BEGIN
        EFGBestand.RESET;
        EFGBestand.SETCURRENTKEY(InventorID); // 01 31.05.21 VMO ERP-187
        EFGBestand.SETASCENDING(InventorID,FALSE); // 01 31.05.21 VMO ERP-187
        EFGBestand.SETRANGE(LogBuch,TRUE);
        EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ArtikBuch,TRUE);
        EFGBestand.SETRANGE(LogBuchPos,TRUE);
        EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ArtikBuchPos,FALSE);
        EFGBestand.SETFILTER(CompanyNameIM,'<>%1',COMPANYNAME);
        EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ItemLedyEntry,FALSE);
        EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ReserveEntry,FALSE);
        IF EFGBestand.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",'ARTIKEL');
            ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",'STANDARD');
            ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Item No.",EFGBestand.Artikel);
            ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",EFGBestand.Variant);
            ItemJournalLine.SETFILTER("External Document No.",'<>%1','Inventory Import');
            //ItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("External Document No.",'');

            IF ItemJournalLine.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
           // IF EFGBestand.Value <> ItemJournalLine.Amount THEN BEGIN
              ItemJournalLine."External Document No.":='Inventory Import';
             // ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,EFGBestand.Value);
              ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost",EFGBestand."Amount Journal");
              ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,EFGBestand."Amount Journal");
              ItemJournalLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation Purchase",EFGBestand.DiffBes);
              ItemJournalLine."Warranty Date":=EFGBestand.GarantieDate;
              ItemJournalLine.MODIFY;
              EFGBestand.ArtikBuchPos:=TRUE;
              EFGBestand.MODIFY;
            END;
          //END;
         UNTIL EFGBestand.NEXT=0;
         MESSAGE('ArtikelBuch Done.');
        END
      END;
    END;

          WhseItemTrackingLine."Qty. per Unit of Measure":=1;
          WhseItemTrackingLine."Qty. to Handle (Base)":=1;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Afterbook@301490003();
    VAR
      CHNXAttributeMgt@301490000 : Codeunit 85020;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301490001 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN

      EFGBestand.RESET;
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(LogBuch,TRUE);
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ItemLedyEntry,FALSE);
      EFGBestand.SETRANGE(ReserveEntry,FALSE);
      IF EFGBestand.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          IF (EFGBestand.SerialNo <> '') AND (EFGBestand.SerialNo <> 'NULL')  THEN
            CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeManufacturerSerialNo(EFGBestand.Artikel,EFGBestand.Variant,EFGBestand.InventorID,EFGBestand.SerialNo);
          IF EFGBestand.GarantieDate <> 0D THEN
            CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeWarrantyDate(EFGBestand.Artikel,EFGBestand.Variant,EFGBestand.InventorID,EFGBestand.GarantieDate);
          IF EFGBestand.Certificat THEN BEGIN
            IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(5401,EFGBestand.Artikel,13,EFGBestand.Variant,'') THEN BEGIN
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.INIT;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID"      :=5401;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping."No.":=EFGBestand.Artikel;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID":=13;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID":=18160;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code":=EFGBestand.Variant;
              ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text":='ja';
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT;
            END;

          END;
        UNTIL EFGBestand.NEXT =0;
        MESSAGE('Afterbook Done.');
      END
      ELSE BEGIN
        MESSAGE('Afterbook could not be run.');
      END;
    END;

    }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckCustomerName@301510011(InputName@301510003 : Text[50];VAR Name@301510000 : Text[30];VAR Name2@301510001 : Text[30]);
    VAR
      Text000@301510002 : TextConst 'DEU=Nicht mîglich;ENU=Not Possible';
      i@301510009 : Integer;
      SpaceCount@301510010 : Integer;
      SpacePosition@301510011 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF STRLEN(InputName)<= 30  THEN
        EXIT;

      IF STRPOS(InputName,' ')=0 THEN BEGIN
        Name  :=  COPYSTR(InputName,1,30);
        Name2 :=  COPYSTR(InputName,31,30);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        FOR i:=1 TO 30 DO BEGIN
          IF COPYSTR(InputName,i,1) = ' ' THEN BEGIN
            SpaceCount+=1;
            SpacePosition:=i;
          END;
        END;
        Name  :=  COPYSTR(InputName,1,SpacePosition-1);
        Name2 :=  COPYSTR(InputName,SpacePosition+1,30);
      END;

      IF ((SpacePosition+1) - STRLEN(InputName))>30 THEN
         ERROR(Text000 + ' EmpfÑnger : '+ InputName);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckShipingAgentCodeOnWareHouseShipment@301510007(VAR WarehouseShipmentHeader@301510001 : Record 7320);
    VAR
      OrderAmt@301510003 : Decimal;
      Text000@301510004 : TextConst 'DEU=Der Bestellwert ist %1, bitte Ñndern Sie den %2 in EIGEN-LOG.;ENU=The order value is %1, Please change %2 to EIGEN-LOG.';
    BEGIN
      IF NOT ((WarehouseShipmentHeader."Shipping Agent Code"  = 'DGT') OR (WarehouseShipmentHeader."Shipping Agent Code"  = 'FEDEX')) THEN
        EXIT;

      OrderAmt  := GetOrderValue(WarehouseShipmentHeader);

      IF (WarehouseShipmentHeader."Shipping Agent Code"  = 'DGT') AND (OrderAmt >=  50000) THEN
          ERROR(Text000,OrderAmt,WarehouseShipmentHeader.FIELDCAPTION("Shipping Agent Code"));

      IF (WarehouseShipmentHeader."Shipping Agent Code"  = 'FEDEX') AND (OrderAmt >=  40000) THEN
          ERROR(Text000,OrderAmt,WarehouseShipmentHeader.FIELDCAPTION("Shipping Agent Code"));
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetOrderValue@301510005(WarehouseShipmentHeader@301510002 : Record 7320) OrderValue : Decimal;
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      SalesLine.RESET;
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",WarehouseShipmentHeader."Source No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Processing Status",SalesLine."Processing Status"::" ");
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        OrderValue  :=  OrderValue  + SalesLine."Amount Including VAT";
      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;

      EXIT(OrderValue);
    END;

      DoWebServiceCall(TempContact,ResponseBlob,SalesHeader);
      lastQuoteEntryNo := ProcessCreditRanking(ResponseBlob,Contact,pDocType,pDocNo,0,inquiryFor::"Sell-To");
      IF gCreditRankingSetup."Check Address" THEN
        ProcessAddressCheck(ResponseBlob,Contact,SalesHeader.RECORDID,TRUE);

      IF SalesHeader.ShipToAddressEqualsSellToAddress THEN
        EXIT;

      // 01 06.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Abweichende Lieferadresse: PrÅfen ob Land im Produkt enthalten ist
      IF GetProductNumber(SalesHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code") = '' THEN
        EXIT;
      // 01 06.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Abweichende Lieferadresse: ENDE


      // Ship-To
      IF (SalesHeader."Ship-to Contact No." <> '') AND (SalesHeader."Ship-to Contact No." <> SalesHeader."Sell-to Contact No.") THEN
        Contact.GET(SalesHeader."Ship-to Contact No.");

      ResponseBlob.RESET;
      IF ResponseBlob.FINDSET THEN
        ResponseBlob.DELETEALL;

      PrepareShipToAddress(Contact,SalesHeader,TempContact);
      DoWebServiceCall(TempContact,ResponseBlob,SalesHeader);
      ProcessCreditRanking(ResponseBlob,TempContact,pDocType,pDocNo,lastQuoteEntryNo,inquiryFor::"Ship-To");
      IF gCreditRankingSetup."Check Address" THEN
        ProcessAddressCheck(ResponseBlob,TempContact,SalesHeader.RECORDID,FALSE);
    END;

    VAR
      CreditRankingSetup@610800003 : Record 5229122;
      ResponseBlob@610800002 : Record 99008535;

      DoWebServiceCall(pContact,ResponseBlob,SalesHeader); // empty SalesHeader

        ProcessAddressCheck(ResponseBlob,pContact,pContact.RECORDID,TRUE);
    END;
