    LOCAL PROCEDURE DoWebServiceCall@610800006(pContact@610800005 : Record 5050;VAR pResponseBlob@610800004 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;pSalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36) : Boolean;
    VAR
      TempBlob@610800008 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;
      SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt@610800000 : Codeunit 1290;
      TypeHelper@610800010 : Codeunit 10;
      DocumentValueManagement@301510000 : Codeunit 5295670;
      requestInStream@610800003 : InStream;
      responseInStream@610800006 : InStream;
      responseOutStream@610800011 : OutStream;
      errorText@610800002 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      soapBody@610800001 : Text;
      "---------------"@301510002 : Integer;
      StreamReader@301510004 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.IO.StreamReader";
      Encoding@301510003 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Text.Encoding";
      HttpResponse@301510006 : Text;
      HttpStatusCode@301510005 : Code[10];
      WebshopManagement@301510007 : Codeunit 5104532;
      DotNetExceptionHandler@301510008 : Codeunit 1291;
      errorText1@301510009 : Text;
      XMLBufferWriter@301510010 : Codeunit 1235;
      XMLBuffer@301510011 : Record 1235;
      mokt@301510012 : Codeunit 50005;
    BEGIN
      //ERROR('SGA');

      CheckMandatoryFields(pContact);
      //soapBody := TranslateSoapBodyTemplate(GetSoapBodyTemplate,pContact);
      soapBody    := CreateEnvelope_buergel(pContact);
      gRequestText :=  soapBody;
      LogActivity(pContact,'Request (Body Only)',soapBody,0); // 0 = Success

      CLEARLASTERROR;
      {
      GetRequestInBlob(soapBody,TempBlob);

      TempBlob.Blob.CREATEINSTREAM(requestInStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);

      SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt.SetGlobals(requestInStream,GetWebServiceUrl,gCreditRankingSetup.Username,gCreditRankingSetup.Password);
      SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt.SetRequestFromCreditRanking(TRUE);// this is not required bcz not working
      IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN
        SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt.DisableProgressDialog;
      SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt.SetTimeout(30000);

      IF NOT SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt.SendRequestToWebService THEN BEGIN
        errorText := SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt.ProcessFaultResponseNoError('',pResponseBlob);
        LogActivityWithDetail(pContact,pResponseBlob,'Response',errorText.Replace('\',TypeHelper.NewLine),1); // 1 = Failure
        IF GUIALLOWED THEN
          ERROR(errorText)
        ELSE BEGIN
          IF pSalesHeader."No." <> '' THEN
            DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(pSalesHeader.RECORDID,pSalesHeader.FIELDNO("Status Address Check"),pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Error);
          EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;

      SOAPWebServiceRequestMgt.GetResponseContent(responseInStream);
      pResponseBlob.Blob.CREATEOUTSTREAM(responseOutStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      COPYSTREAM(responseOutStream,responseInStream);
      LogActivityWithDetail(pContact,pResponseBlob,'Response','Ok',0); // 0 = Success
      EXIT(TRUE);
      }

      {
      IF pSalesHeader."No." = 'X48455684286' THEN
        mokt.TextExportToFile(soapBody);
      }

      CLEAR(HttpResponse);

      IF NOT WebshopManagement.SendWebRequest('','','',GetWebServiceUrl,'POST',
              soapBody,'',HttpStatusCode,HttpResponse)
      THEN BEGIN
        DotNetExceptionHandler.Collect;
        errorText1 := COPYSTR(DotNetExceptionHandler.GetMessage,1,MAXSTRLEN(errorText1));
        IF GUIALLOWED THEN
          ERROR(errorText1)
        ELSE BEGIN
          IF pSalesHeader."No." <> '' THEN
            DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(pSalesHeader.RECORDID,pSalesHeader.FIELDNO("Status Address Check"),pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Error);
          EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
        ERROR(errorText1);
      END;

      {

      pResponseBlob.Blob.CREATEOUTSTREAM(responseOutStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      responseOutStream.WRITE(soapBody);
      //XMLBufferWriter.GenerateStructure(XMLBuffer,responseOutStream);
      //XMLBuffer.Load(responseOutStream);
      }

      pResponseBlob.Blob.CREATEOUTSTREAM(responseOutStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      responseOutStream.WRITE(HttpResponse);
      //COPYSTREAM(responseOutStream,responseInStream);

      LogActivityWithDetail(pContact,pResponseBlob,'Response','Ok',0); // 0 = Success
      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessCreditRanking@610800015(VAR pTempBlob@610800002 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;pContact@610800001 : Record 5050;pDocType@610800007 : 'Quote,Order';pDocNo@610800006 : Code[20];pLastQuoteEntryNo@610800011 : Integer;pInquiryFor@610800012 : 'Contact,Sell-To,Ship-To') : Integer;
    VAR
      CreditRankingEntry@610800000 : Record 5229124;
      LastCreditRankingEntry@610800010 : Record 5229124;
      CreditRankingManagement@610800008 : Codeunit 5229122;
      xmlNode@610800009 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlNode";
      xPath@610800003 : Text;
      scoreValueText@610800004 : Text;
      XMLDoc@301510000 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlDocument";
    BEGIN
      // 01 12.03.19 MKLE CHR-475 GetTextValueFromNode: Added Parameter pContactNo
      // 01 12.03.19 MKLE CHR-475 GetTextValueFromNode: Added Parameter pXelementName
      GetResponseXML(pTempBlob,XMLDoc);

      xPath := '/ns2:concheckResponse/concheckOut/decision/';

      WITH CreditRankingEntry DO BEGIN
        Contact := pContact."No.";
        TransactionID := CREATEGUID;
        "File Number" := pDocNo;
        //sga

      {
        xmlNode:=XMLDoc.DocumentElement;
        MESSAGE('%1',xmlNode);
      }

        {
        scoreValueText := GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'score',0,pContact."No.");
        ERROR('%1',scoreValueText);
        }
        //scoreValueText := GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'score',0,pContact."No.");
        scoreValueText := GetScoreValueFromXMLDOC(XMLDoc,'score',0,pContact."No.");

        //Attribute := GetCreditRankingCode(GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'text',MAXSTRLEN(Description),pContact."No."));
        Attribute :=  GetCreditRankingCodeValueFromXMLDOC(XMLDoc,MAXSTRLEN(Description),pContact."No.");
        IF Attribute = '' THEN
          Attribute := 'XX-XX';

        IF scoreValueText <> '' THEN BEGIN
          EVALUATE("Score Value Decimal",scoreValueText,9);
          "Score Value" := ROUND("Score Value Decimal",1);  // No decimal places
        END;
        "Score Type" := 'BöRGEL';
        "Date of Quote" := TODAY;
        {
        "Ext. Information" := GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'addressOrigin/text',MAXSTRLEN("Ext. Information"),pContact."No.");
        "Ext. Information" += STRSUBSTNO(' (Code: %1)',GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'addressOrigin/code',MAXSTRLEN("Ext. Information"),pContact."No."));
        }
        "Ext. Information" := GetAddressOriginValueFromXMLDOC(XMLDoc,0,pContact."No.");

        Status := Status::"Inspection completed";

        LastCreditRankingEntry.RESET;
        IF pLastQuoteEntryNo <> 0 THEN
          LastCreditRankingEntry.SETRANGE("Quote Entry No.",pLastQuoteEntryNo);
        LastCreditRankingEntry.SETRANGE(Contact,pContact."No.");
        IF LastCreditRankingEntry.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
          "Quote Entry No." := LastCreditRankingEntry."Quote Entry No." + 1;
          "Line No." += 10000;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          "Quote Entry No." := 1;
          "Line No." := 10000;
        END;

        CASE pInquiryFor OF
          pInquiryFor::Contact: "Inquiry String" := 'Contact';
          pInquiryFor::"Sell-To": "Inquiry String" := 'Sell-To';
          pInquiryFor::"Ship-To": "Inquiry String" := 'Ship-To';
        END;

        INSERT(TRUE);
      END;

      CreditRankingManagement."Set Customer Blocks"(CreditRankingEntry.Attribute,pContact."No.");
      EXIT(CreditRankingEntry."Quote Entry No.");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessAddressCheck@610800019(VAR pTempBlob@610800011 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;pContact@610800002 : Record 5050;pChangeTriggerdByRecordID@610800012 : RecordID;pIsBillToAddress@610800009 : Boolean);

      xPath@610800000 : Text;

      isoCountryCode@610800008 : Text;
      dateOfBirth@610800010 : Text;
      hasAddressChanged@301480000 : Boolean;

      XMLNodeList@301510003 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlNodeList";
      i@301510002 : Integer;

      SalesHeader@301510004 : Record 36;

    BEGIN

      // 01 12.03.19 MKLE CHR-475 GetTextValueFromNode: Added Parameter pXelementName
      //GetResponseXML(pTempBlob,xmlNode);
      GetResponseXML(pTempBlob,XMLDoc);

      //hasAddressChanged := GetAddressChangedStatus(XMLDoc);
      hasAddressChanged := GetAddressChangedStatusfromXMLDOC(XMLDoc);


      OnBeforeProcessAddressCheck(pContact,hasAddressChanged,pChangeTriggerdByRecordID,pIsBillToAddress);

      SetStatusAddressCheckOnBeforeProcessAddressCheck(pContact,hasAddressChanged,pChangeTriggerdByRecordID,pIsBillToAddress); //from cust mngt cu
      IF NOT hasAddressChanged  THEN
        EXIT;

      WITH TempContact DO BEGIN
        INIT;
        "No." := pContact."No.";

        // Person
        xPath := '/ns2:concheckResponse/concheckOut/address/person/';
        //"First Name" := GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'firstname',MAXSTRLEN("First Name"),pContact."No.");
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('firstname');


        RecRef.GET(pChangeTriggerdByRecordID);
        RecFieidRef := RecRef.FIELD(3);

        IF XMLNodeList.Count = 1 THEN BEGIN
            //ERROR(gNoXmlValueFoundErr,'firstname'); //SGA
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(0);
          "First Name" := CurrNode.InnerText;
          LogWebservice(FORMAT(RecFieidRef.VALUE),gRequestText,XMLDoc.InnerXml,'firstname'); //ERP-649
        END ELSE BEGIN
          IF XMLNodeList.Count = 2 THEN BEGIN
            //ERROR(gNoXmlValueFoundErr,'firstname');
            CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(1);
            "First Name" := CurrNode.InnerText;
          END;
        END;

        //Surname := GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'lastname',MAXSTRLEN(Surname),pContact."No.");
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('lastname');
        IF XMLNodeList.Count =  1 THEN BEGIN
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(0);
          Surname :=  CurrNode.InnerText;
          Name := "First Name" + ' ' + Surname;
        END ELSE
          LogWebservice(FORMAT(RecFieidRef.VALUE),gRequestText,XMLDoc.InnerXml,'lastname'); //ERP-649

        //dateOfBirth := GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'dateOfBirth',0,pContact."No.");
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('dateOfBirth');
        IF XMLNodeList.Count > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(0);
          dateOfBirth := CurrNode.InnerText;
        END;
        IF dateOfBirth <> '' THEN
          EVALUATE(Birthday,dateOfBirth,9);

        // Address
        xPath := '/ns2:concheckResponse/concheckOut/address/location/';
        //Street :=  GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'street',MAXSTRLEN(Street),pContact."No.");
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('street');
        IF XMLNodeList.Count > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(1);
          Street := CurrNode.InnerText;
        END;
        //"Post Code" :=  GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'postalCode',MAXSTRLEN("Post Code"),pContact."No.");
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('zip');
        IF XMLNodeList.Count > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(1);
          "Post Code" := CurrNode.InnerText;
        END;
        //City :=  GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'city',MAXSTRLEN(City),pContact."No.");
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('city');
        IF XMLNodeList.Count > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(1);
          City := CurrNode.InnerText;
        END;
        {
        //isoCountryCode :=GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'country/code',MAXSTRLEN("Country/Region Code"),pContact."No.");
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('code');
        IF XMLNodeList.Count > 0 THEN BEGIN
          //CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(3);
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(2);
          isoCountryCode := CurrNode.InnerText;
        END;
        }

        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('country');
        CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(1);
        XMLNodeList:= CurrNode.ChildNodes;
        IF XMLNodeList.Count > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(0);
           isoCountryCode := CurrNode.InnerText;
        END;

        "Country/Region Code" :=  GetCountryCodeFromIsoCode(isoCountryCode);
        //VALIDATE("House No.",GetTextValueFromNode(xmlNode,xPath,'houseNumber',MAXSTRLEN("House No."),pContact."No."));
        XMLNodeList := XMLDoc.GetElementsByTagName('house');
        IF XMLNodeList.Count > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CurrNode := XMLNodeList.Item(1);
          VALIDATE("House No.",CurrNode.InnerText);
        END;
      END;

      IF ChangeAddressExists(TempContact,pChangeTriggerdByRecordID,pIsBillToAddress) THEN
        EXIT;

      CreditRankingManagement.SetChangeTriggeredBy('BöRGEL',pChangeTriggerdByRecordID);
      CreditRankingManagement.UpdateAddress(TempContact,pIsBillToAddress);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetRequestInBlob@610800012(pRequest@610800000 : Text;VAR pTempBlob@610800004 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535);
    VAR
      TempBlob@610800001 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;
      oStream@610800002 : OutStream;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetCountryIsoCode@610800013(pCountryCode@610800000 : Code[10]) : Code[3];
    VAR
      CountryRegion@610800001 : Record 9;
      UnknownCountryCodeErr@610800002 : TextConst 'DEU=Code %1 ist in Tabelle %2 unbekannt.;ENU=Could not found code %1 in table %2';
      IsoCountryCodeIsEmptyErr@610800003 : TextConst 'DEU=Iso LÑndercode ist leer fÅr Code %1 in Tabelle %2;ENU=Iso country code is empty for code %1 in table %2';
    BEGIN
      IF NOT CountryRegion.GET(pCountryCode) THEN
        ERROR(UnknownCountryCodeErr,pCountryCode,CountryRegion.TABLECAPTION);

      IF CountryRegion."ISO 3166 Country Code (Num)" = '' THEN
        ERROR(IsoCountryCodeIsEmptyErr,pCountryCode,CountryRegion.TABLECAPTION);

      EXIT(CountryRegion."ISO 3166 Country Code (Num)");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetCountryCodeFromIsoCode@610800033(pCountryIsoCode@610800000 : Code[3]) : Code[10];
    VAR
      CountryRegion@610800001 : Record 9;
      UnknownCountryIsoCodeErr@610800002 : TextConst 'DEU=ISO Code %1 ist in Tabelle %2 unbekannt.;ENU=Could not found code %1 in table %2';
      SystemValueLine@301480000 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      IF pCountryIsoCode = 'DEU' THEN
        EXIT('DE');

      IF pCountryIsoCode = 'AUT' THEN
        EXIT('AT');

      IF pCountryIsoCode = 'CHE' THEN
        EXIT('CH');

      IF pCountryIsoCode = 'DE' THEN
        EXIT('DEU');

      IF pCountryIsoCode = 'AT' THEN
        EXIT('AUT');

      IF pCountryIsoCode = 'CH' THEN
        EXIT('CHE');

      {
      CountryRegion.RESET;
      CountryRegion.SETRANGE("ISO 3166 Country Code (Num)",pCountryIsoCode);
      // 01 10.01.19 CZIE CHR-311 BÅrgel liefert falscher ISO Code
      //IF NOT CountryRegion.FINDFIRST THEN
      //  ERROR(UnknownCountryIsoCodeErr,pCountryIsoCode,CountryRegion.TABLECAPTION);
      IF NOT CountryRegion.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        SystemValueLine.RESET;
        SystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Value No.",82003);
        SystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Code",pCountryIsoCode);
        IF SystemValueLine.FINDFIRST THEN
          CountryRegion.Code := SystemValueLine."Code Value 1"
        ELSE
          ERROR(UnknownCountryIsoCodeErr,pCountryIsoCode,CountryRegion.TABLECAPTION);
      END;
      // 01 10.01.19 CZIE CHR-311 BÅrgel liefert falscher ISO Code ENDE

      EXIT(CountryRegion.Code);
      }
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InitCreditRankingCode@610800005();
    VAR
      TxtAddressOrigin0@610800001 : TextConst 'DEU=Ausgabedaten entsprechen Eingabe';
      TxtAddressOrigin1@610800002 : TextConst 'DEU=Angefragte Person/Adresse in Datenbank gefunden';
      TxtAddressOrigin2@610800003 : TextConst 'DEU=Eingabe in Historie gefunden, Ausgabedaten aktualisiert';
      TxtAddressOrigin3@610800004 : TextConst 'DEU=Personendaten aus Eingabe, Anschrift korrigiert';
      TxtAddressOrigin4@610800005 : TextConst 'DEU=Eingabedaten nach Korrektur in Datenbank gefunden';
      TxtN0@610800006 : TextConst 'DEU=Person unbekannt';
      TxtNw@610800007 : TextConst 'DEU=Person unbekannt/Anschrift bekannt';
      TxtN1@610800008 : TextConst 'DEU=Person und Anschrift bekannt';
      TxtN2@610800009 : TextConst 'DEU=Person/Anschrift abweichend';
      TxtN3@610800010 : TextConst 'DEU=Mehrere Personen bekannt';
      TxtB0@610800011 : TextConst 'DEU=EinschÑtzung des Ausfallrisikos nicht mîglich';
      TxtB1@610800012 : TextConst 'DEU=Wir schÑtzen das Ausfallrisiko sehr niedrig ein';
      TxtB2@610800013 : TextConst 'DEU=Wir schÑtzen das Ausfallrisiko niedrig ein';
      TxtB3@610800014 : TextConst 'DEU=Wir schÑtzen das Ausfallrisiko mittel ein';
      TxtB4@610800015 : TextConst 'DEU=Wir schÑtzen das Ausfallrisiko hoch ein';
      TxtB5@610800016 : TextConst 'DEU=Uns liegen Negativmerkmale vor';
      TxtB6@610800017 : TextConst 'DEU=Uns liegen Negativmerkmale zu allen Personen vor';
      TxtB7@610800018 : TextConst 'DEU=Uns liegen Negativmerkmale zu einigen Personen vor';
      TxtB8@610800019 : TextConst 'DEU=Statistisches Ausfallrisiko: Sehr niedrig';
      TxtB9@610800020 : TextConst 'DEU=Statistisches Ausfallrisiko: Niedrig';
      TxtB10@610800021 : TextConst 'DEU=Statistisches Ausfallrisiko: Durchschn.';
      TxtB11@610800022 : TextConst 'DEU=Statistisches Ausfallrisiko: Mittel';
      TxtB12@610800023 : TextConst 'DEU=Wir schÑtzen das Ausfallrisiko Åberdurchschn. ein';
      NameValueBufferAddressCode@610800026 : TEMPORARY Record 823;
      NameValueBufferNCode@610800024 : TEMPORARY Record 823;
      NameValueBufferBCode@610800025 : TEMPORARY Record 823;
      UnknownCode@610800027 : TextConst 'DEU=Code ist unbekannt.;ENU=Unknown Code.';
      CreditRankingCode_CXT@301510000 : Record 50014;
    BEGIN
      // CODES -> ADDRESS ORIGIN
      NameValueBufferAddressCode.AddNewEntry('00',TxtAddressOrigin0);
      NameValueBufferAddressCode.AddNewEntry('01',TxtAddressOrigin1);
      NameValueBufferAddressCode.AddNewEntry('02',TxtAddressOrigin2);
      //NameValueBufferAddressCode.AddNewEntry('3',TxtAddressOrigin3);
      NameValueBufferAddressCode.AddNewEntry('04',TxtAddressOrigin4);
      NameValueBufferAddressCode.AddNewEntry('XX-XX',UnknownCode);

      NameValueBufferAddressCode.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
        CLEAR(CreditRankingCode_CXT);
        WITH CreditRankingCode_CXT DO BEGIN
          "Service Provider" := "Service Provider"::Buergel;
          Code := NameValueBufferAddressCode.Name;
          Description := NameValueBufferAddressCode.Value;
          DoRegisterCode();
        END;
      UNTIL NameValueBufferAddressCode.NEXT = 0;

      // CODES -> DECISION SCORE TEXT
      NameValueBufferNCode.AddNewEntry('N0',TxtN0);
      NameValueBufferNCode.AddNewEntry('NW',TxtNw);
      NameValueBufferNCode.AddNewEntry('N1',TxtN1);
      NameValueBufferNCode.AddNewEntry('N2',TxtN2);
      //NameValueBufferNCode.AddNewEntry('N3',TxtN3);

      NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B0',TxtB0);
      // NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B1',TxtB1);
      // NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B2',TxtB2);
      // NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B3',TxtB3);
      NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B4',TxtB4);
      NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B5',TxtB5);
      // NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B6',TxtB6);
      // NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B7',TxtB7);
      NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B8',TxtB8);
      NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B9',TxtB9);
      NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B10',TxtB10);
      NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B11',TxtB11);
      // NameValueBufferBCode.AddNewEntry('B12',TxtB12);


      // Code mÅssen zusammengesetz werden
      NameValueBufferNCode.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
        NameValueBufferBCode.FINDSET;
        REPEAT
          CLEAR(CreditRankingCode_CXT);
          WITH CreditRankingCode_CXT DO BEGIN
           "Service Provider" := "Service Provider"::Buergel;
           Code := STRSUBSTNO('%1-%2',NameValueBufferNCode.Name,NameValueBufferBCode.Name);
           Description := STRSUBSTNO('%1; %2',NameValueBufferNCode.Value,NameValueBufferBCode.Value);
           DoRegisterCode();
          END;
        UNTIL NameValueBufferBCode.NEXT = 0;
      UNTIL NameValueBufferNCode.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetCreditRankingSetupDefaultValues@610800016();
    VAR
      CreditRankingSetup@610800000 : Record 5229122;
      doModify@610800001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT CreditRankingSetup.GET THEN
        CreditRankingSetup.INSERT;

      IF CreditRankingSetup."Executing Check by" <> CreditRankingSetup."Executing Check by"::Buergel THEN BEGIN
        CreditRankingSetup."Executing Check by" := CreditRankingSetup."Executing Check by"::Buergel;
        doModify := TRUE;
      END;

      IF CreditRankingSetup."Check Mode" <> CreditRankingSetup."Check Mode"::Online THEN BEGIN
        CreditRankingSetup."Check Mode" := CreditRankingSetup."Check Mode"::Online;
        doModify := TRUE;
      END;

      IF CreditRankingSetup.Type <> CreditRankingSetup.Type::Person THEN BEGIN
        CreditRankingSetup.Type := CreditRankingSetup.Type::Person;
        doModify := TRUE;
      END;

      // 01 28.09.18 CZIE CHR-56 Sichere Zahlungsformen trotzdem ÅberprÅfen
      IF NOT CreditRankingSetup."Ignore Secure Payment Check" THEN BEGIN
        CreditRankingSetup."Ignore Secure Payment Check" := TRUE;
        doModify := TRUE;
      END;
      // 01 28.09.18 CZIE CHR-56 Sichere Zahlungsformen trotzdem ÅberprÅfen ENDE

      IF doModify THEN
        CreditRankingSetup.MODIFY;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessError@301490000(pXpath@301490002 : Text;pXelementName@301490006 : Text;VAR vResultText@301490003 : Text;pMaxStrLen@301490001 : Integer;pContactNo@301490004 : Code[20]) rIsErrorHandled : Boolean;
    VAR
      lProcessTable@301490000 : Record 5104999;
      lSessionId@301490005 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // LF 12.03.19 MKLE CHR-475 ProcessError
      lProcessTable.SETRANGE("Message Code",'BUERGEL');
      lProcessTable.SETRANGE("Message Sub Code",'ERROR');
      lProcessTable.SETRANGE("Ref.-Code",pContactNo);
      lProcessTable.SETRANGE("Longtext 1",pXpath);
      lProcessTable.SETRANGE("Longtext 2",pXelementName);
      IF lProcessTable.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        lProcessTable.INIT;
        lProcessTable."Message Code" := 'BUERGEL';
        lProcessTable."Message Sub Code" := 'ERROR';
        lProcessTable."Ref.-Code" := pContactNo;
        lProcessTable."Longtext 1" := pXpath;
        lProcessTable."Longtext 2" := pXelementName;
        lProcessTable."Longtext 3" := vResultText;
        lProcessTable."Integer 1" := pMaxStrLen;
        lProcessTable."Code 1" := 'INSERT';
        STARTSESSION(lSessionId,CODEUNIT::"Credit Ranking Buergel_CXT",COMPANYNAME,lProcessTable);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        lProcessTable.FINDLAST;
        IF STRLEN(lProcessTable."Longtext 3") <= lProcessTable."Integer 1" THEN
          rIsErrorHandled := TRUE;
        vResultText := lProcessTable."Longtext 3";
        IF rIsErrorHandled THEN BEGIN
          lProcessTable."Code 1" := 'DELETE';
          STARTSESSION(lSessionId,CODEUNIT::"Credit Ranking Buergel_CXT",COMPANYNAME,lProcessTable);
        END;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,5229131,OnBeforeProcessAddressCheck)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetStatusAddressCheckOnBeforeProcessAddressCheck@301510039(pContact@301480000 : Record 5050;pHasAddressChanged@301480001 : Boolean;pChangeTriggerdByRecordID@301480002 : RecordID;pIsBillToAddress@301480003 : Boolean);
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301480005 : Record 36;
      DocumentValueManagement@301480006 : Codeunit 5295670;
      hasEntry@301480004 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // NF 10.08.18 CZIE CHR-56 SetStatusAddressCheckOnBeforeProcessAddressCheck
      IF pChangeTriggerdByRecordID.TABLENO <> DATABASE::"Sales Header" THEN
       EXIT;

      IF NOT SalesHeader.GET(pChangeTriggerdByRecordID) THEN
        EXIT;

      SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Address Check");
      IF SalesHeader."Status Address Check" IN [SalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"Waiting for Approval",SalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Ignore] THEN
        EXIT;

      IF pHasAddressChanged THEN
        DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(SalesHeader.RECORDID,SalesHeader.FIELDNO("Status Address Check"),SalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"Waiting for Approval")
      ELSE
        DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(SalesHeader.RECORDID,SalesHeader.FIELDNO("Status Address Check"),SalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"No Differences");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE LogWebservice@301510017(OrderNo@301510002 : Code[20];RequestText@301510003 : Text;ResponseText@630510003 : Text;CommentText@301510001 : Text);
    VAR
      WebServiceEntryNo@630510002 : Integer;
      OStream@630510004 : OutStream;
      CXTWebServiceLog@301510000 : Record 50016;
      RequestTempBlob@301510005 : Record 99008535;
      ResponseTempBlob@301510004 : Record 99008535;
      ResponseXMLDoc@301510007 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlDocument";
      RequestXMLDoc@301510006 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlDocument";
      locOutStr@301510008 : OutStream;
    BEGIN
      //ERP-649

      //Request
      IF ISNULL(RequestXMLDoc) THEN
        RequestXMLDoc := RequestXMLDoc.XmlDocument;
      RequestXMLDoc.LoadXml(RequestText);

      CLEAR(ResponseTempBlob);
      RequestTempBlob.Blob.CREATEOUTSTREAM(locOutStr);
      RequestXMLDoc.Save(locOutStr);

      //Response
      IF ISNULL(ResponseXMLDoc) THEN
        ResponseXMLDoc := ResponseXMLDoc.XmlDocument;
      ResponseXMLDoc.LoadXml(ResponseText);

      CLEAR(ResponseTempBlob);
      ResponseTempBlob.Blob.CREATEOUTSTREAM(locOutStr);
      ResponseXMLDoc.Save(locOutStr);

      IF CXTWebServiceLog.FINDLAST THEN
        WebServiceEntryNo := CXTWebServiceLog."Entry No." +1
      ELSE
        WebServiceEntryNo := 1;
      CXTWebServiceLog.INIT;
      CXTWebServiceLog."Entry No." := WebServiceEntryNo;
      CXTWebServiceLog."Source Type" := CXTWebServiceLog."Source Type"::"CRIF BÅrgel";
      CXTWebServiceLog."Reference Code" := OrderNo;
      CXTWebServiceLog."Log Date" := TODAY;
      CXTWebServiceLog."Log Time" := TIME;
      CXTWebServiceLog.Request  :=  RequestTempBlob.Blob;
      CXTWebServiceLog.Response :=  ResponseTempBlob.Blob;
      CXTWebServiceLog.Comment := CommentText;
      CXTWebServiceLog.INSERT();
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 01.08.18 CZIE CHR-56 Anbindung BÅrgel
      // 01 28.09.18 CZIE CHR-56 Sichere Zahlungsformen trotzdem ÅberprÅfen
      // 01 04.11.18 CZIE CHR-144 Trim Name
      // 01 06.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Abweichende Lieferadresse: PrÅfen ob Land im Produkt enthalten ist
      // 01 06.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 NameBreakdown steuern
      // 01 10.01.19 CZIE CHR-311 BÅrgel liefert falscher ISO Code

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.TESTFIELD("Item No.",'');

      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");

      B2B2CMarketPlaceSetup1.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId);

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.OPEN('Processing lines             #2######\');

      CreateItem(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems);

      CreateItemVariant(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems);

      //CreateItemVendor(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems);

      CreateAttributeMapping(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems);

      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.":=ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.";
      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Created" :=  TRUE;
      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.MODIFY;

      CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnInsertItem(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
      CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnInsertItemvariant(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.CLOSE;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateItem@301510015(VAR ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510000 : Record 50030);
    VAR
      ItemAttributeImport@301510006 : Record 50030;
      Item@301510005 : Record 27;
      ItemVariant@301510004 : Record 5401;
      B2B2CMarketPlaceSetup1@301510003 : Record 50029;
      ItemVendor@301510002 : Record 99;
      ConvertedDateformula@301510001 : DateFormula;
      i@301510009 : Integer;
      FldRef@301510008 : FieldRef;
      RecRef@301510007 : RecordRef;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510010 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttribute@301510011 : Record 7500;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No." =  '') THEN
        EXIT;
      {
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'full' THEN
        ERROR('Taxation is full');
      }

      B2B2CMarketPlaceSetup1.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId);

      Item.INIT;
      IF Item.INSERT(TRUE) THEN BEGIN
        IF STRLEN(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Brand + ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Model) > 49 THEN
          Item.Description  :=  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Brand
        ELSE
          Item.Description  :=  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Brand +' '+ ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Model;

        Item.VALIDATE("Vendor No.",B2B2CMarketPlaceSetup1."Buy-from Vendor No.");
        Item.VALIDATE("Vendor Item No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor Item Id");
        //Item.VALIDATE("Item Tracking Code",'');
        //Item.VALIDATE("Serial Nos.",'');
        Item.MODIFY(TRUE);
        ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No."  :=  Item."No.";
        //ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.MODIFY;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateItemVariant@301510017(VAR ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510000 : Record 50030);

    PROCEDURE CreateAttributeMapping@301510018(VAR ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510000 : Record 50030);
    VAR
      ItemAttributeImport@301510006 : Record 50030;
      Item@301510005 : Record 27;
      ItemVariant@301510004 : Record 5401;
      B2B2CMarketPlaceSetup1@301510003 : Record 50029;
      ItemVendor@301510002 : Record 99;
      ConvertedDateformula@301510001 : DateFormula;
      i@301510009 : Integer;
      FldRef@301510008 : FieldRef;
      RecRef@301510007 : RecordRef;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510010 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttribute@301510011 : Record 7500;
      ItemAttributeValueID@301510012 : Integer;
      ValueTemp@301510013 : Text;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510014 : Record 50029;
    BEGIN
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId);
      RecRef.GETTABLE(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems);

      FOR i := 2 TO 83 DO BEGIN  //till Attr 102
        IF i <> 73 THEN BEGIN
          FldRef := RecRef.FIELDINDEX(i);
            ValueTemp :='';
            ValueTemp :=  FORMAT(FldRef.VALUE);
            IF FldRef.NUMBER IN [11,13,40] THEN BEGIN
              IF ValueTemp = 'Yes' THEN
                ValueTemp := 'ja';
              IF ValueTemp = 'No' THEN
                ValueTemp := 'nein';
            END;
            IF FldRef.NUMBER IN [8,18,19,39,81,83,84,87,89] THEN BEGIN
              IF ValueTemp = '0' THEN
                ValueTemp := '';
            END;
            IF FldRef.NUMBER = 39 THEN BEGIN
              ValueTemp := FORMAT(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Standard delivery time");
            END;
            IF FldRef.NUMBER = 40 THEN BEGIN
              IF ValueTemp  = '' THEN
                ValueTemp := 'nein' //need to remove
            END;
            IF FldRef.NUMBER = 41 THEN BEGIN
              IF ValueTemp  = '' THEN
                ValueTemp := 'sichtbar'
            END;

          //MESSAGE('%1,%2: %3',FldRef.NUMBER,FldRef.NAME,ValueTemp);
          IF FldRef.NUMBER = 102 THEN
            ItemAttribute.GET(103)
          ELSE ItemAttribute.GET(FldRef.NUMBER);
          IF ValueTemp <>'' THEN BEGIN
            ItemAttributeValueID  :=  FindAttributeValue(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems,FldRef.NUMBER,ValueTemp);
            ItemAttributeValueMapping.INIT;
            IF ItemAttribute."Category Type"  = ItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Item Variant" THEN BEGIN
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Item Variant");
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Item Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
            END ELSE BEGIN
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Table ID",DATABASE::Item);
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Item Variant Code",'');
            END;
            ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
            ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Item Attribute ID",FldRef.NUMBER);
            ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Item Attribute Value ID",ItemAttributeValueID); //get it from sql if requires
            IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT(TRUE) THEN
              ItemAttributeValueMapping.MODIFY;
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateAttributeValue@301510028(VAR ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510014 : Record 50030;Id@301510000 : Integer;Valuetxt@301510013 : Text) : Integer;
    VAR
      ItemAttributeImport@301510006 : Record 50030;

    PROCEDURE UpdateStandarddeliverytime@301510051(VendId@301510001 : Code[10];Standarddeliverytime@301510002 : Integer;ShowWindow@301510006 : Boolean);
    VAR
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510003 : Record 50030;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttributeValueId@301510004 : Integer;
      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510005 : Record 50029;
      Window@301510007 : Dialog;
    BEGIN
      // 01 17.04.23 SGA ITBO-842 Update Standard Delivery Time for LV Watches
      CheckOpenItemEntryExist(VendId);

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.OPEN('Processing lines             #2######\');

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.SETRANGE(VendorId,VendId);
      //ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.SETRANGE("Variant Code",'V00300601','V00300605');
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        ItemAttributeValueId  :=  FindAttributeValue(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems,39,FORMAT(Standarddeliverytime));
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",5401);
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",39);
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" :=  ItemAttributeValueId;
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.MODIFY(TRUE);
          CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnInsertItemvariant(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
        END ELSE BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.INIT;
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Item Variant");
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Item Attribute ID",39);
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Item Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
          //MESSAGE('%1, %2',FORMAT(FldRef.NUMBER),ValueTemp);
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.VALIDATE("Item Attribute Value ID",ItemAttributeValueId); //get it from sql
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT(TRUE);
          CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnInsertItemvariant(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
        END;
      UNTIL ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.NEXT=0;

      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(VendId);
      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Standarddeliverytime Updated":=FALSE;
      UpdateConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.MODIFY;

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.CLOSE;

      //MESSAGE(Text000);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetItemAttributeValueIDFromSQL@301510012(AttributeID@301510002 : Text;AttributeValueInTxt@301510003 : Text) AttributeValueID : Integer;
    VAR

      Addchar@301510004 : Text;
    BEGIN
      lSQLServerManagement.Set3Parameter(AttributeID,AttributeValueInTxt,'');

    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckNewAttributeValues@301510023();
    VAR
      ItemAttributeImport@301510006 : Record 50030;
      Item@301510005 : Record 27;
      ItemVariant@301510004 : Record 5401;
      B2B2CMarketPlaceSetup1@301510003 : Record 50029;
      ItemVendor@301510002 : Record 99;
      ConvertedDateformula@301510001 : DateFormula;
      i@301510009 : Integer;
      FldRef@301510008 : FieldRef;
      RecRef@301510007 : RecordRef;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510010 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttribute@301510011 : Record 7500;
      ItemAttributeValue@301510012 : Record 7501;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510000 : Record 50030;
      ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets@301510013 : Record 50027;
      window@301510014 : Dialog;
      Count@301510015 : Integer;
      ValueTemp@301510016 : Text;
    BEGIN

      window.OPEN('Processing lines #1######\ #2######');


      //ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.SETRANGE("Variant Code",'V00102316');
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.FINDSET;
      window.UPDATE(1,ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.COUNT);
      REPEAT
        Count+=1;
        window.UPDATE(1,Count);

        CLEAR(RecRef);
        RecRef.GETTABLE(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems);

        FOR i := 2 TO 74 DO BEGIN  //FOR i := 2 TO 74 DO BEGIN

          FldRef := RecRef.FIELDINDEX(i);
          //MESSAGE('%1,%2: %3',FldRef.NUMBER,FldRef.NAME,FORMAT(FldRef.VALUE));
          ValueTemp :=  FORMAT(FldRef.VALUE);
          IF FldRef.NUMBER IN [11,13] THEN BEGIN
            IF ValueTemp = 'Yes' THEN
              ValueTemp := 'ja';
            IF ValueTemp = 'No' THEN
              ValueTemp := 'nein';
          END;
          IF FldRef.NUMBER IN [8,18,19,39,81,83,84,87,89] THEN BEGIN
            IF ValueTemp = '0' THEN
              ValueTemp := '';
          END;

          IF FldRef.NUMBER = 89 THEN
            ValueTemp := 'NONE';


          ItemAttribute.GET(FldRef.NUMBER);
          IF ValueTemp <>'' THEN BEGIN
            ItemAttributeValue.SETCURRENTKEY(Value);
            ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(Value,ValueTemp);
            ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",FldRef.NUMBER);
            IF NOT ItemAttributeValue.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets.INIT;
              ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets.VendorId:=ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId;
              ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets."Variant Code":=ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code";
              ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets."Item Attribute ID":=FldRef.NUMBER;
              ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets."Vendor Item Id":=ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor Item Id";
              ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets."Temp Item Attribute Text" :=  ValueTemp;
              ConMrktPlaceItemAttribuets.INSERT;
            END;
          END;
        END;

      UNTIL ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.NEXT=0;
      window.CLOSE;

      {
      ItemAttributeValue.SETCURRENTKEY(Value);
      ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(Value,'Rolex');
      ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",1);
      IF ItemAttributeValue.FINDFIRST THEN
        MESSAGE('%1',ItemAttributeValue.ID)
      ELSE
      MESSAGE('Not found');
      }
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,50028,OnBeforeInsertEvent)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE T50028_OnBeforeInsertEvent_CheckStockEntry@301510006(VAR Rec@301510000 : Record 50028;RunTrigger@301510001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceStockEntry@301510002 : Record 50028;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510003 : Record 50030;
      QuickSalesLine@301510004 : Record 5104607;
    BEGIN
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY() THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT (Rec.Qty IN [0,1]) THEN
        ERROR('Quantity is limited to 0 or 1');

      //MOKT Closed for deleted Items from Marketplace Item Table V003* Replace the control within the API Page
      //IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(Rec."Variant Code") THEN
        //ERROR('Variant Code:%1 does not exist',Rec."Variant Code");
      //MOKT Closed for deleted Items from Marketplace Item Table V003* Replace the control within the API Page

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(Rec."Variant Code");
      IF NOT (Rec.VendorId = ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId) THEN
        ERROR('VendorID:%1 is not matching',Rec.VendorId);

      IF NOT (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor Item Id" = Rec."Vendor Item Id") THEN
        ERROR('vendorItemId: %1 does not matching',Rec."Vendor Item Id");

      ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Rec."Variant Code");
      ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.SETRANGE(Processed,FALSE);
      ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.SETRANGE(Qty,Rec.Qty);
      IF NOT ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
        ERROR('Stock entry is already in progress, new stock entry is not allowed');

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.CALCFIELDS(Inventory);

      IF Rec.Qty =  1 THEN BEGIN
        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Inventory <> 0 THEN
          ERROR('Stock entry already exist, new stock entry is not allowed')
      END ELSE
        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Inventory = 0 THEN
          //IF COPYSTR(Rec.Remarks,1,2)  <> 'SO' THEN
          IF STRPOS(Rec.Remarks,'SO No')  = 0 THEN
            ERROR('Fake stock does not exist');

      { need to ask AT
      //###########################################################
      //###########################################################
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,QuickSalesLine.Type::Item);
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
      IF QuickSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('There is a open order: %1',QuickSalesLine."Document No.");
      //###########################################################
      //###########################################################
      }
    END;

        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = Rec.Status THEN
          ERROR('You already %1 the request',ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status);
        IF NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Processed THEN BEGIN
          ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status:=Rec.Status;
          ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.MODIFY;
          EXIT;
        END;
      END;
      }

      QuickSalesHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("External Document No.");
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",Rec."Order No.");
      IF NOT QuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('Order Number:%1 does not exist',Rec."Order No.");

      QuickSalesHeader.TESTFIELD(Workflow,QuickSalesHeader.Workflow::Postprocessing);

      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,QuickSalesLine.Type::Item);
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
      IF NOT QuickSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('The variant does not match the order : %1',QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");

      IF NOT QuickSalesLine.IsEXStockSale THEN
        ERROR('The watch is not on EXStock, Approval is not required');

      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("No.",Rec."Order No.");
      IF NOT SalesHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
        ERROR('We have already processed the order: %1',Rec."Order No.");

      IF NOT (Rec.Status IN [Rec.Status::Approved,Rec.Status::Rejected]) THEN
        ERROR('Status:%1 does not exist',Rec.Status);

      {
      IF NOT Rec.Processed THEN
        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.GET(Rec."Order No.",Rec."Variant Code") THEN
          ERROR('You already %1 the request',ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status);
      }
      {
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.SETRANGE("Order No.",Rec."Order No.");
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Rec."Variant Code");
      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Processed THEN
          ERROR('Not allowed, Entry has been processed');
        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Invoice Received" THEN
          ERROR('Not allowed, Entry has been processed');
        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Inserted Date" = TODAY THEN
          EXIT;
        {
        IF (ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Inserted Date" = TODAY-1) THEN BEGIN
          IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Inserted Time" > TIME THEN
            EXIT
          ELSE
            ERROR('Request can not be processed after 24 hours');
        END ELSE BEGIN
          ERROR('Request can not be processed after 24 hours');
        END;
        }

      END;
      }
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckCarrierEntry@301510056(VAR Rec@301510000 : Record 50024);
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceStockEntry@301510002 : Record 50028;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510003 : Record 50030;
      QuickSalesHeader@301510004 : Record 5104606;
      ConMrktPlaceCarrierEntry@301510005 : Record 50024;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSetup@301510006 : Record 50029;
      SalesHeader@301510007 : Record 36;
      QuickSalesLine@301510008 : Record 5104607;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510009 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      // 01 13.04.23 SGA ITBO-757
      IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(Rec."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
        ERROR('Variant Code:%1 does not exist',Rec."Variant Code");
      END;

      IF NOT (Rec.VendorId = ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId) THEN
        ERROR('VendorID:%1 is not matching',Rec.VendorId);

      ConMrktPlaceCarrierEntry.SETRANGE("Order No.",Rec."Order No.");
      ConMrktPlaceCarrierEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Rec."Variant Code");
      ConMrktPlaceCarrierEntry.SETRANGE("Carrier Tracking No.",Rec."Carrier Tracking No.");
      IF NOT ConMrktPlaceCarrierEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
        ERROR('Carrier Entry already exist');

      QuickSalesHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("External Document No.");
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",Rec."Order No.");
      IF NOT QuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('Order Number:%1 does not exist',Rec."Order No.");

      //QuickSalesHeader.TESTFIELD(Workflow,QuickSalesHeader.Workflow::Postprocessing);//ITBO-1066

      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,QuickSalesLine.Type::Item);
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
      IF NOT QuickSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('The variant does not match the order : %1',QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");

      IF NOT QuickSalesLine.IsEXStockSale THEN
        ERROR('The watch is not on EXStock, Approval is not required');

      {
      //ITBO-1066
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("No.",Rec."Order No.");
      IF NOT SalesHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
        ERROR('We have already processed the order: %1',Rec."Order No.");
      }

      IF NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.GET(Rec."Order No.",Rec."Variant Code") THEN
        ERROR('Order is not approved');

      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status= ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected THEN
        ERROR('The Order has been Rejected');
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,5104607,OnAfterInsertEvent)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE T5104607_OnAfterInsertEvent_MarkConsignmentOrder@301510008(VAR Rec@301510000 : Record 5104607;RunTrigger@301510001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceStockEntry@301510002 : Record 50028;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510003 : Record 50030;
      QuickSalesHeader@301510004 : Record 5104606;
      ConMrktPlaceApprovalEntry@301510005 : Record 50027;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510006 : Record 50029;
      ConsignmentAPIManagement@301510007 : Codeunit 50036;
    BEGIN
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY() THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Rec.Type <> Rec.Type::Item THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(Rec."Variant Code") THEN
        EXIT;

      Rec.IsConsignment := TRUE;

      QuickSalesHeader.GET(Rec."Document No.");
      IF NOT QuickSalesHeader.IsConsignment  THEN BEGIN
        QuickSalesHeader.IsConsignment  :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;  //need to text this bcz backend is sending request with header and line
      END;
      //RemoveFakestockOnquickSalesCreation(Rec."No.",Rec."Variant Code");
      //InsertApprovalEntry(Rec."Document No.",Rec."Variant Code");
      {
      QuickSalesHeader.GET(Rec."Document No.");
      CreateStockEntry(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor Item Id",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId,0,QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");

      QuickSalesHeader.IsConsignment  :=  TRUE;
      QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;  //need to text this bcz backend is sending request with header and line

      CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnQuickSalesInsert(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems,'StockCheck');
      }
      {
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.CALCFIELDS("Inventory Non EXSTOCK");
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Inventory Non EXSTOCK" > 0 THEN BEGIN
        QuickSalesHeader.GET(Rec."Document No.");
        QuickSalesHeader.IsConsignment  :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        QuickSalesHeader.GET(Rec."Document No.");
        CreateStockEntry(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor Item Id",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId,0,QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
        QuickSalesHeader.IsConsignment  :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesHeader.IsEXStockSale  :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;  //need to text this bcz backfront is sending request with header and line
        CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnQuickSalesInsert(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems,'StockCheck');
      END;
      }
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.CALCFIELDS("Inventory EXSTOCK");
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Inventory EXSTOCK" = 0 THEN
        Rec.IsEXStockSale :=  FALSE
      ELSE BEGIN
        Rec.VendorId      :=  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId; // 01 13.04.23 SGA ITBO-757
        Rec.IsEXStockSale :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;
        CreateStockEntry(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor Item Id",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId,0,QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
        CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnQuickSalesInsert(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems,'StockCheck');
      END;

      ConsignmentAPIManagement.CheckQuickSales(Rec); //MOKT

      InsertDefaultEmailEntry(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckPostProcessing@301480049(VAR vSalesHeader@301480007 : Record 36;VAR vPostProcessingEntryTEMP@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 5104950);
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@301480008 : Record 5105031;
      PostProcessingManagement@301480005 : Codeunit 5104950;
      SystemValueNo@301480002 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@301480001 : Code[10];
      IsEUOrder@301480003 : Boolean;
      LTextPostProcDesc@301480004 : TextConst 'DEU=Auftrag hat Zollrelevanz;ENU=Order has customs relevancy';
      PostProcessingEntry@301480009 : Record 5104950;
      CountryRegion@301480006 : Record 9;
      WasOpenBefore@301480010 : Boolean;
      SetupGet@301510000 : Codeunit 5105007;
      SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37;
      IsExStock@301510002 : Boolean;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510003 : Record 50030;
    BEGIN
      SystemValueCode := 'EXSTOCK';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;

      IF NOT PostProcessingManagement.UsePostProcessingCode(vSalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT SetupGet."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT;

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(SalesLine."No.") THEN
        IsExStock := TRUE;
      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;

      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code", SystemValueCode);
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE(Open, FALSE);
      WasOpenBefore := NOT vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.ISEMPTY;

      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;

      IF NOT IsExStock AND NOT WasOpenBefore THEN BEGIN
        PostProcessingManagement.InsertPostProcessingEntry(vSalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'','Consignment Stock (External Vendor Stock)!!! wait for 100 years',TRUE,FALSE);
        PostProcessingManagement.GetPostProcessEntryTemp(vPostProcessingEntryTEMP);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",SystemValueCode);
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
        IF vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.VALIDATE(Open,FALSE);
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.MODIFY(TRUE);
        UNTIL vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.NEXT = 0;
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateStockEntry@301510011(VariantCode@301510000 : Code[10];VendorItemId@301510001 : Code[20];VendorId@301510003 : Code[10];Qty@301510004 : Decimal;OrderNo@301510005 : Code[20]);

    PROCEDURE ProcessStockEntry@301510000(VAR ConMrktPlaceStockEntry@301510007 : Record 50028;ShowWindow@301510010 : Boolean);
    VAR
      WarehouseJournalLine@301510006 : Record 7311;
      Lineno@301510005 : Integer;
      WhseItemTrackingLine@301510004 : Record 6550;
      WhseItemTrackingLine1@301510003 : Record 6550;
      LogisticMgt@301510000 : Codeunit 5104803;
      DocNo@301510001 : Code[20];
      ItemJnlLine@301510008 : Record 83;
      ItemJnlPostLine@301510002 : Codeunit 22;
      Window@301510009 : Dialog;
      LastEntryNo@301510011 : Integer;
      TrackingSpecification@301510012 : Record 336;
      UpdateConMrktPlaceStockEntry@301510013 : Record 50028;
      DiVAItemTrackingMgt@301510014 : Codeunit 5104818;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510015 : Record 50030;
    BEGIN
      IF ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.Processed THEN
        EXIT;

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Variant Code");

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.OPEN('Processing lines             #2######\');

      DocNo:=COPYSTR(FORMAT(TODAY),1,2)+COPYSTR(FORMAT(TODAY),4,2)+COPYSTR(FORMAT(TODAY),7,2);

      ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.CALCFIELDS("Item No.");


      //MESSAGE('%1',ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Item No.");
      ItemJnlLine.INIT;
      ItemJnlLine."Journal Template Name"   := 'ARTIKEL';
      ItemJnlLine."Journal Batch Name"      := 'EXSTOCK';
      ItemJnlLine."Line No." := 1;
      ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Posting Date",TODAY);
      IF  ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.Qty  = 1 THEN
        ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Entry Type",ItemJnlLine."Entry Type"::"Positive Adjmt.")
      ELSE
        ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Entry Type",ItemJnlLine."Entry Type"::"Negative Adjmt.");
      ItemJnlLine."Document No."     := DocNo;
      ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Item No.",ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Item No.");
      ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Variant Code");
      ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Location Code",'EXSTOCK');
      ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,1);
      ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Unit of Measure Code",'STCK');
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'diff' THEN
        ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation Purchase",TRUE);
      //ItemJnlLine.VALIDATE("Serial No.",ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Variant Code");
      //ItemJnlLine.INSERT;

      DiVAItemTrackingMgt.CreateItemTrgkItemJnl(ItemJnlLine,ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Variant Code",'',ItemJnlLine."Expiration Date",ItemJnlLine."Quantity (Base)");

      ItemJnlPostLine.RunWithCheck(ItemJnlLine);
      //ItemJnlLine.DELETE;

      UpdateConMrktPlaceStockEntry.GET(ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.EntryNo);
      {
      IF  ConMrktPlaceStockEntry.Qty  = 1 THEN
        AddItemStockEntry(ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Variant Code")
      ELSE
        DeleteItemStockEntry(ConMrktPlaceStockEntry."Variant Code");
      }
      UpdateConMrktPlaceStockEntry.Processed:=  TRUE;
      UpdateConMrktPlaceStockEntry.MODIFY(TRUE);

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.CLOSE;
    END;

    PROCEDURE AddItemStockEntry@301510035(VariantCode@301510001 : Code[10]);

        "Transfer Order Line No." := 0;

        // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 >>

      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertRejectionEmailEntry@301510048(OrderNo@301510002 : Code[20];VariantCode@301510001 : Code[10]);
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceApprovalEntry@301510000 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      IF ConMrktPlaceApprovalEntry.GET(OrderNo,VariantCode) THEN BEGIN
        ConMrktPlaceApprovalEntry.INIT;

    PROCEDURE ProcessEmailEntry@301510031(VAR ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510000 : Record 50026;ShowWindow@301510005 : Boolean);
    VAR
      QuickSalesHeader@301510001 : Record 5104606;
      QuickSalesCreateOrderCU@301510002 : Codeunit 5104608;
      ReleaseSalesOrder@301510003 : Report 5104650;
      SalesHeader@301510004 : Record 36;
      Window@301510006 : Dialog;
      UpdateConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510007 : Record 50026;
      "Protocol Entry"@301510008 : Record 5105024;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry1@301510009 : Record 50026;
      QuickSalesLine@301510010 : Record 5104607;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510011 : Record 50030;
      FinalApproval@301510012 : Boolean;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510013 : Record 50029;
      CHXTEmailManagement@301510014 : Codeunit 50039;
      VendorItemID@301510015 : Text;
    BEGIN
      UpdateConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.GET(ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Order No.",ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Variant Code");
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Variant Code");
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor ID");
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.Prepayment THEN
        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status= ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Approved THEN
          EXIT;

      QuickSalesHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("External Document No.");
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Order No.");
      IF QuickSalesHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
        EXIT;

      QuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST;

      IF QuickSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No." = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.OPEN('Processing lines             #2######\');

      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Approved THEN BEGIN
        QuickSalesHeader."marge checked"  :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"   :=  QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"::Accept;
        QuickSalesHeader."Change from" := USERID;
        QuickSalesHeader."Change Date":= TODAY;
        QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;
      END;

      {//need to check this code for multiple item lines
      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Approved THEN BEGIN
        FinalApproval :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
        QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,QuickSalesLine.Type::Item);
        QuickSalesLine.SETFILTER("Variant Code",'<>%1',ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Variant Code");
        IF QuickSalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(QuickSalesLine."Variant Code") THEN
            IF NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry1.GET(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",QuickSalesLine."Variant Code")THEN
              FinalApproval :=  FALSE
            ELSE
              IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry1.Status = ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry1.Status::Rejected THEN
                FinalApproval :=  FALSE
        UNTIL QuickSalesLine.NEXT=0;

        IF FinalApproval THEN BEGIN
          QuickSalesHeader."marge checked"  :=  TRUE;
          QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"   :=  QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"::Accept;
          QuickSalesHeader."Change from" := USERID;
          QuickSalesHeader."Change Date":= TODAY;
          QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;
        END;
      END;
      }

      {
      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected THEN BEGIN
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
        IF SalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
          SalesHeader.DELETE(TRUE);

        //QuickSalesHeader."marge checked"  :=  TRUE;
        QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"   :=  QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"::Reject;
        QuickSalesHeader.Workflow         :=  QuickSalesHeader.Workflow::"Document checked";
        QuickSalesHeader."Change from" := USERID;
        QuickSalesHeader."Change Date":= TODAY;
        QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;
        "Protocol Entry".SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Date");
        "Protocol Entry".SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
        "Protocol Entry".SETRANGE("Document Date",QuickSalesHeader."Order Date");
        IF "Protocol Entry".FINDSET THEN
          "Protocol Entry".DELETEALL;
      END;
      }

      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected THEN BEGIN
        CHXTEmailManagement.RefundNotification(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No."); //MOKT 01.04.26
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
        IF SalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SalesHeader."Cancelling Reason Code" := '026';
          SalesHeader.MODIFY(FALSE);
          SalesHeader.DELETE(TRUE);
        END ELSE BEGIN
          //QuickSalesHeader."marge checked"  :=  TRUE;
          QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"   :=  QuickSalesHeader."Order Status"::Reject;
          QuickSalesHeader.Workflow         :=  QuickSalesHeader.Workflow::"Document checked";
          QuickSalesHeader."Change from" := USERID;
          QuickSalesHeader."Change Date":= TODAY;
          QuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;
          QuickSalesCreateOrderCU.RUN(QuickSalesHeader);
          "Protocol Entry".SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Date");
          "Protocol Entry".SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
          "Protocol Entry".SETRANGE("Document Date",QuickSalesHeader."Order Date");
          IF "Protocol Entry".FINDSET THEN
            "Protocol Entry".DELETEALL;

          SalesHeader.RESET;
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
          IF SalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            SalesHeader."Cancelling Reason Code" := '026';
            SalesHeader.MODIFY(FALSE);
            SalesHeader.DELETE(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;


      UpdateConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Processed:=TRUE;
      UpdateConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Processed Date":=TODAY;
      UpdateConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Processed Time":=TIME;
      UpdateConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Processed From":=USERID;
      UpdateConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.MODIFY;

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.CLOSE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnInsertItem@301480001(ItemNo@301510003 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      SetupGet@301510000 : Codeunit 5105007;
      CustomerSetup@301510001 : Record 87000;
      ExportGatewayItem@301510002 : Codeunit 82003;
      Item@301510004 : Record 27;
    BEGIN
      IF (ItemNo = '') THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Item.GET(ItemNo) THEN BEGIN
        SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
        CASE CustomerSetup."ExtInterf Item Changes" OF
          CustomerSetup."ExtInterf Item Changes"::File:
            ExportGatewayItem.CreateExternalInterfaceFile(Item);
          CustomerSetup."ExtInterf Item Changes"::"Message (And File)":
            ExportGatewayItem.CreateExternalInterfaceMessage(Item."No.",STRSUBSTNO('P%1_INS',PAGE::"Item Card"));
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnInsertItemvariant@301510013(ItemNo@301510001 : Code[20];ItemVariantCode@301510000 : Code[10]);

      ItemVariant@301510004 : Record 5401;
      CustomerSetup@301510003 : Record 87000;
      SetupGet@301510002 : Codeunit 5105007;
      ExportGatewayItemVariant@301510005 : Codeunit 82004;
    BEGIN
      IF (ItemNo = '') AND (ItemVariantCode = '') THEN

            ExportGatewayItemVariant.CreateExternalInterfaceMessage(ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,STRSUBSTNO('P%1_INS',PAGE::"Item Attribute Value List"));
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE PropagateOnInsert_EmailEntry@301510057(VAR pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510003 : Record 50026);
    VAR
      lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510002 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      // 01 13.04.23 SGA ITBO-757
      IF pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.GET(pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Order No.",pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Variant Code") THEN
        IF lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status THEN
          ERROR('You already %1 the request',lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status);

      CheckEmailEntry(pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry);

      lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.SETRANGE("Order No.",pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Order No.");
      lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Variant Code");
      IF NOT lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.TRANSFERFIELDS(pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry);
        lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.INSERT(TRUE);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        lConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status                :=  pConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status;

    PROCEDURE PropagateOnInsert_CarrierEntry@15(VAR pConMrktPlaceCarrierEntry@301510000 : Record 50024);

    PROCEDURE UpdateSalesPriceTemp@301510034(VariantCode@301510008 : Code[10];ShowWindow@301510015 : Boolean);
    VAR
      Window@301510013 : Dialog;
      TempSalesPrice@301510000 : TEMPORARY Record 7002;
      GeneralLedgerSetup@301510001 : Record 98;
      SalesPriceCountryRef@301510002 : Record 7002;
      Country@301510003 : Record 9;
      CurrencyExchangeRate@301510004 : Record 330;
      ExchangeRateDate@301510005 : Date;
      ExchangeRateAmt@301510006 : Decimal;
      ExportGatewaySalesPrice@301510007 : Codeunit 82001;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510010 : Record 50030;
      PriceBasedOnCurrency@301510011 : Decimal;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510009 : Record 50029;
      MarkUpPrice@301510012 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(VariantCode) THEN
        EXIT;

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.TESTFIELD("Sales Price Created",FALSE);

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId);

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.TESTFIELD(Active,TRUE);

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.OPEN('Processing lines             #2######\');

      MESSAGE('%1',TIME);

      Country.RESET;
      Country.SETFILTER(Code,'%1|%2','AE','DE');
      Country.SETRANGE("Sales Price Activated",TRUE);
      IF Country.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        //IF Country.Code <> 'DE' THEN BEGIN
          //TempSalesPrice.LOCKTABLE;
          TempSalesPrice.INIT;
          TempSalesPrice."Sales Type"   := TempSalesPrice."Sales Type"::"All Customers";
          TempSalesPrice."Sales Code"   := '';
          TempSalesPrice."Item No."     :=  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.";
          TempSalesPrice."Variant Code" := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code";
          TempSalesPrice."Country/Region Code"  :=  Country.Code;

          TempSalesPrice."Promotion Medium No." := '';
          TempSalesPrice."Prom.Med.Tar.Grp.No." := '';
          TempSalesPrice."Set No." := '';

          TempSalesPrice."Minimum Quantity" := 0;

          TempSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Currency Code",Country."Sales Price Currency Code");
          IF TempSalesPrice."Currency Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
            CurrencyExchangeRate.RESET;
            CurrencyExchangeRate.SETRANGE("Currency Code",Country."Sales Price Currency Code");
            IF CurrencyExchangeRate.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
              ExchangeRateAmt:=0;
              CurrencyExchangeRate.GetLastestExchangeRate(Country."Sales Price Currency Code",ExchangeRateDate,ExchangeRateAmt);
              {
              g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
              g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Recom. Retail Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Recom. Retail Price" * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
              g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Strike Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Strike Price" * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
              g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Exchange Rate Amount" := 1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt;
              g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Exchange Rate Date" := g_dateExchangeRateDate;
              }
              MarkUpPrice :=  0;
              MarkUpPrice :=  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price + (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * (ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Additional Sales Price %"/100));
              PriceBasedOnCurrency:=0;
              PriceBasedOnCurrency  := ROUND((MarkUpPrice * (1 / ExchangeRateAmt)),10,'>');
              //ROUND(g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price",10,'>')
              //PriceBasedOnCurrency  := 3890 * (1 / ExchangeRateAmt);
              TempSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Unit Price",PriceBasedOnCurrency);
              {
              TempSalesPrice."Non Stock Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price";
              TempSalesPrice."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Recom. Retail Price";
              TempSalesPrice."Strike-Price incl. VAT" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Strike Price";
              }
            END;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            {
            g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price";
            g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Recom. Retail Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Recom. Retail Price";
            g_recTempSalesPriceCheck2."Strike Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Strike Price";
            }
            //TempSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Unit Price",3890);
            MarkUpPrice :=  0;
            MarkUpPrice :=  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price + (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * (ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Additional Sales Price %"/100));
            TempSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Unit Price",ROUND(MarkUpPrice,10,'>'));
            {
            TempSalesPrice."Non Stock Price" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price";
            TempSalesPrice."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Recom. Retail Price";
            TempSalesPrice."Strike-Price incl. VAT" := g_recTempSalesPriceCheck."Strike Price";
            }
          END;
          TempSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Starting Date",TODAY);

          IF NOT TempSalesPrice.INSERT THEN BEGIN
              TempSalesPrice.MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
          ExportGatewaySalesPrice.CreateExternalInterfaceFile(TempSalesPrice);
        //END;
      UNTIL Country.NEXT = 0;

      MESSAGE('%1',TIME);
      //ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Sales Price Created":=TRUE;
      //ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.MODIFY;

      IF ShowWindow THEN
        Window.CLOSE;
    END;
