    PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrder@301510058(QuickSalesHeader@301510010 : Record 5104606);
    VAR
      QuickSalesLine@301510009 : Record 5104607;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510008 : Record 50030;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510007 : Record 50029;
      PurchaseHeader@301510006 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301510005 : Record 39;
      lineNo@301510004 : Integer;
      CostAmt@301510003 : Decimal;
      ReleasePurchaseDocument@301510002 : Codeunit 415;
      IsHandled@301510001 : Boolean;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510000 : Record 50026;
      CHXTEmailManagement@301510012 : Codeunit 50039;
    BEGIN
      //need to change logic with Status Approve Order from sales header
      IF NOT QuickSalesHeader.IsConsignment THEN
        EXIT;

      OnBefore_ExecuteAfterQuickSalesCreateOrder_CreatePurchaseOrder(QuickSalesHeader,IsHandled);
      IF IsHandled THEN
        EXIT;

      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,QuickSalesLine.Type::Item);
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(IsConsignment,TRUE);
      IF QuickSalesLine.COUNT > 1 THEN    //Funtionality limit TO 1 LV item
        EXIT;

      QuickSalesLine.FINDFIRST;

      IF NOT QuickSalesLine.IsEXStockSale THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(QuickSalesLine."Variant Code") THEN
        EXIT;

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId);

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.TESTFIELD(Active,TRUE);


      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.GET(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",QuickSalesLine."Variant Code") THEN
        IF (ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected) AND (NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Invoice Received") THEN
          EXIT;


      PurchaseHeader.INIT;

      PurchaseHeader.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
      //MakeSpecificPurchHeaderChanges(PurchaseHeader,pBufPurchHeader);

      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseHeader.INSERT(TRUE);

      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Buy-from Vendor No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor No.");
      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Vendor Order No.",QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Order Date",TODAY);
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Expected Receipt Date",pBufPurchHeader."Expected Receipt Date"); //need to decide

      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Location Code",'HL'); //need to decide
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Currency Code",pBufPurchHeader."Currency Code"); //need to decide
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Currency Factor",pBufPurchHeader."Currency Factor");
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Payment Method Code",pBufPurchHeader."Payment Method Code"); //need to decide
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Payment Terms Code",pBufPurchHeader."Payment Terms Code"); //need to decide
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Prices Including VAT",pBufPurchHeader."Prices Including VAT"); //need to decide
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Purchaser Code",pBufPurchHeader."Purchaser Code"); //need to decide
      // PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Document Date",Today); //need to decide
      PurchaseHeader.MODIFY(TRUE);
      lineNo += 10000;
      CostAmt:=0;

      PurchaseLine.INIT;

      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Line No.",lineNo);

      PurchaseLine.Type := PurchaseLine.Type::Item;
      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Location Code",PurchaseHeader."Location Code");  //need to decide
      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,1);

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'diff' THEN
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",TRUE);

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'full' THEN
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",FALSE);

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'diff' THEN
        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %"  <> 0 THEN
          CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price *  (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") /100))
        ELSE
          CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price;

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'full' THEN BEGIN
        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %"  <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  /(1+(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Seller Country Tax%" / 100));
          CostAmt :=  CostAmt - (CostAmt  * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %")  / 100));
        END ELSE BEGIN
          CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  /(1+(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Seller Country Tax%" / 100));
        END;
      END;

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V005' THEN BEGIN
        IF  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price" <> 0 THEN
          CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price";
      END;

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V014' THEN BEGIN
          IF  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
            CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price";
            CostAmt := CostAmt - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price" * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") / 100));
          END;
      END;

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V006' THEN BEGIN
        CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  + (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price *  (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") /100));
        CostAmt := ROUND(CostAmt,10,'>');
        CostAmt :=  CostAmt - (CostAmt  * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %")  / 100));
      END;

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V018' THEN BEGIN
        CostAmt := (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * 100) / (100 + ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Seller Country Tax%");
        CostAmt := CostAmt - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") / 100));
        CostAmt := ROUND(CostAmt,0.01);
          PurchaseLine."Gen. Prod. Posting Group" := 'HADE1900';
          PurchaseLine."VAT Bus. Posting Group" := 'EU-ID';
          PurchaseLine."VAT Calculation Type" := PurchaseLine."VAT Calculation Type"::"Reverse Charge VAT";
          PurchaseLine."VAT Prod. Posting Group" := 'MDE1900';
          PurchaseLine."VAT Identifier" := 'MWST19';
          PurchaseLine."VAT %" := 0;
      END;


      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V018' THEN BEGIN
        CostAmt := (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * 100) / (100 + ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Seller Country Tax%");
        CostAmt := CostAmt - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") / 100));
        CostAmt := ROUND(CostAmt,0.01);
      END;

      CostAmt := ROUND(CostAmt,1,'>');

      IF CostAmt  = 0 THEN
        ERROR('Cost Amount is zero');
      PurchaseLine."Used good":= TRUE;//SKU
      PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost",CostAmt);
      PurchaseLine.InitQtyToReceive;
      PurchaseLine.INSERT(TRUE);

      ReleasePurchaseDocument.SetDiVARelease(TRUE);
      ReleasePurchaseDocument.SetHideDialog(TRUE);
      ReleasePurchaseDocument.RUN(PurchaseHeader);

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V006' THEN
        CHXTEmailManagement.SendPOVendorEmail(PurchaseHeader);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrder2@301510060(QuickSalesHeader@301510010 : Record 5104606);
    VAR
      QuickSalesLine@301510009 : Record 5104607;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510008 : Record 50030;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510007 : Record 50029;
      PurchaseHeader@301510006 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301510005 : Record 39;
      lineNo@301510004 : Integer;
      CostAmt@301510003 : Decimal;
      ReleasePurchaseDocument@301510002 : Codeunit 415;
      IsHandled@301510001 : Boolean;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510000 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      //need to change logic with Status Approve Order from sales header
      IF NOT QuickSalesHeader.IsConsignment THEN
        EXIT;

      OnBefore_ExecuteAfterQuickSalesCreateOrder_CreatePurchaseOrder(QuickSalesHeader,IsHandled);
      IF IsHandled THEN
        EXIT;

      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,QuickSalesLine.Type::Item);
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(IsConsignment,TRUE);
      //QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(VendorId,'V005');
      QuickSalesLine.FINDSET;

      IF NOT QuickSalesLine.IsEXStockSale THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(QuickSalesLine."Variant Code") THEN
        EXIT;

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.VendorId);

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.TESTFIELD(Active,TRUE);

      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.GET(QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",QuickSalesLine."Variant Code") THEN
        IF (ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status  = ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected) AND (NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Invoice Received") THEN
          EXIT;


      PurchaseHeader.INIT;

      PurchaseHeader.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);

      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseHeader.INSERT(TRUE);

      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Buy-from Vendor No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor No.");
      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Vendor Order No.",QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Order Date",TODAY);

      PurchaseHeader.VALIDATE("Location Code",'HL'); //need to decide

      PurchaseHeader.MODIFY(TRUE);
      lineNo += 10000;
      CostAmt:=0;

      REPEAT
        ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(QuickSalesLine."Variant Code");
        PurchaseLine.INIT;

        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Line No.",lineNo);

        PurchaseLine.Type := PurchaseLine.Type::Item;
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.");
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Location Code",PurchaseHeader."Location Code");  //need to decide
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,1);

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'diff' THEN
          PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",TRUE);

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'full' THEN
          PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",FALSE);

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'diff' THEN
          IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %"  <> 0 THEN
            CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price *  (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") /100))
          ELSE
            CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price;

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Taxation = 'full' THEN BEGIN
          IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %"  <> 0 THEN BEGIN
            CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  /(1+(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Seller Country Tax%" / 100));
            CostAmt :=  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %")  / 100));
          END ELSE BEGIN
            CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  /(1+(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Seller Country Tax%" / 100));
          END;
        END;

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V005' THEN BEGIN
          IF  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price" <> 0 THEN
            CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price";
        END;

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V014' THEN BEGIN
            IF  ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
              CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price";
              CostAmt := CostAmt - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Original Price" * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") / 100));
            END;
        END;

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V006' THEN BEGIN
          CostAmt := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price  + (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price *  (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") /100));
          CostAmt := ROUND(CostAmt,10,'>');
          CostAmt :=  CostAmt - (CostAmt  * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %")  / 100));
        END;

        CostAmt := ROUND(CostAmt,1,'>');

        IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.VendorId = 'V018' THEN BEGIN
          CostAmt := (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * 100) / (100 + ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Seller Country Tax%");
          CostAmt := CostAmt - (ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price * (ABS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Actual Cost %") / 100));
          CostAmt := ROUND(CostAmt,0.01);

          PurchaseLine."Gen. Prod. Posting Group" := 'HADE1900';
          PurchaseLine."VAT Bus. Posting Group" := 'EU-ID';
          PurchaseLine."VAT Calculation Type" := PurchaseLine."VAT Calculation Type"::"Reverse Charge VAT";
          PurchaseLine."VAT Prod. Posting Group" := 'MDE1900';
          PurchaseLine."VAT Identifier" := 'MWST19';
          PurchaseLine."VAT %" := 0;
        END;



        IF CostAmt  = 0 THEN
          ERROR('Cost Amount is zero');
        PurchaseLine."Used good":= TRUE;//SKU
        PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost",CostAmt);
        PurchaseLine.InitQtyToReceive;
        PurchaseLine.INSERT(TRUE);
        lineNo += 10000;
      UNTIL QuickSalesLine.NEXT = 0;

      ReleasePurchaseDocument.SetDiVARelease(TRUE);
      ReleasePurchaseDocument.SetHideDialog(TRUE);
      ReleasePurchaseDocument.RUN(PurchaseHeader);
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,50010,OnBeforeValidateEvent,"Order Status")]

      ELSE BEGIN

          IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'ZAVER' THEN BEGIN
            IF SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order,SalesHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
              IF SalesPSPCard."Status Code" = 'CANCELLED' THEN

            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
      }
    END;

              IF MagicPath[i] = '\' THEN BEGIN

            FileVar.CREATE('c:\Temp\OnServer.txt');
            FileVar.CREATEOUTSTREAM(OStream);
            COPYSTREAM(ostream,istream);
            FileVar.CLOSE;
            }

            // Specify that TempFile is opened as a binary file.

            // Specify that you can write to TempFile.
            TempFile.WRITEMODE(TRUE);
            Name := 'C:\Temp\TempReport.xls';

            // Close TempFile so that the SAVEASEXCEL function can write to it.
            TempFile.CLOSE;

            TempFile.OPEN(Name);
            TempFile.CREATEINSTREAM(NewStream);
            ToFile := 'Report.xls';

            // Transfer the content from the temporary file on Microsoft Dynamics NAV

            ReturnValue := DOWNLOADFROMSTREAM(

    LOCAL PROCEDURE saveProformaInv@301510001();
    BEGIN
      //only for non-EU countries
      g_recCountry.RESET;
      g_recCountry.SETFILTER("EU Country/Region Code",'<>%1','');
      IF g_recCountry.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
         REPEAT
           IF g_txtEUCountry <> '' THEN
              g_txtEUCountry := g_txtEUCountry+'&<>'+g_recCountry.Code
           ELSE
              g_txtEUCountry := g_recCountry.Code;
         UNTIL g_recCountry.NEXT = 0;
         g_txtEUCountry := '<>'+g_txtEUCountry;
      END;

      g_recSH.RESET;
      g_recSH.SETRANGE("Document Type",g_recSH."Document Type"::Order);
      g_recSH.SETRANGE(Status,g_recSH.Status::Released);
      g_recSH.SETRANGE("Archive Proforma Invoice",FALSE);
      g_recSH.SETFILTER("Sell-to Country/Region Code",g_txtEUCountry);
      IF g_recSH.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
         IF createPDFProformaInv(g_recSH."No.",g_recSH) = TRUE THEN BEGIN
            g_recSH2.RESET;
            g_recSH2.SETRANGE("Document Type",g_recSH2."Document Type"::Order);
            g_recSH2.SETRANGE("No.",g_recSH."No.");
            IF g_recSH2.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
               g_recSH2."Archive Proforma Invoice" := TRUE;
               g_recSH2.MODIFY;
            END;
         END;
      END;
    END;

OBJECT Codeunit 50012 Actindo Orders Management
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=12.11.18;
    Time=21:59:04;

    Version List=CHNX Order DöB;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=VAR
            Text000@1000000004 : TextConst '@@@=User Personalization User1 already exists.;DEU=%1 %2 ist bereits vorhanden.;ENU=%1 %2 already exists.';
          BEGIN
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      DocumentValueManagement@301480000 : Codeunit 5295670;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,414,OnBeforeReleaseSalesDoc)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE IsActindoOrderOnBeforeReleaseSalesDoc@301480000(VAR SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36;PreviewMode@1000000001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      ActindoOrders@301480002 : Record 50000;
    BEGIN
      IF SalesHeader.ISTEMPORARY OR PreviewMode THEN
        EXIT;

      ActindoOrders.SETRANGE(ExternalDocumentNo,SalesHeader."External Document No.");
      IF NOT ActindoOrders.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT;

      IF ActindoOrders."order done" THEN
       EXIT;

      CASE ActindoOrders.fraud_state OF
        'Approved - No fraud expected':
          BEGIN
           ApproveTSStatus(SalesHeader);
           ActindoOrders."fraud_state done" := TRUE;
           ActindoOrders.MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
        'Other - See text box for further specification',
        'Pending - Already seen but not in progress',
        'Action Required - Request for Personal Identification',
        'Action Required - Complete missing data',
        'Action Required - Change payment method',
        'Action Required - Delivery only at specific address',
        'Potential Fraud - High evidence on fraud':
          BEGIN
            PendingTSStatus(SalesHeader);
            ActindoOrders."fraud_state done" := TRUE;
            ActindoOrders.MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
        ELSE
          BEGIN
            ActindoOrders."fraud_state done" := TRUE;
            ActindoOrders.MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
      END;

      CASE ActindoOrders.dispatch_status OF
        'allow-dispatch':
          BEGIN
            IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" IN ['FINETRADE','KK_CONCARD','PAYPAL'] THEN BEGIN
              ApproveGenPayment(SalesHeader);
              ActindoOrders."dispatch_status done" := TRUE;
              ActindoOrders.MODIFY(TRUE);
            END;
            IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'VORAUS' THEN BEGIN
              SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" := 'RG';
              SalesHeader.MODIFY;
              ActindoOrders."dispatch_status done" := TRUE;
              ActindoOrders.MODIFY(TRUE);
            END;
          END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ApproveGenPayment@301480004(pSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      SalesPSPCard@301480003 : Record 5227625;
      PSPExtendedSetup@301480004 : Record 5227633;
      PSPLog@301480005 : Record 5227626;
      CustomerManagement@301480002 : Codeunit 87000;

        PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_OrderID,pSalesHeader."No.");

    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdatePaypalTransactionID@301490000(VAR pQuickSalesHeader@301490000 : Record 5104606;pWithModify@1000000000 : Boolean) : Boolean;
    VAR
      PayPalSetup@301490005 : Record 5275420;
      SearchResponse@301490003 : TEMPORARY Record 5275422;
      ActindoOrders@301490006 : Record 50000;
      CheckActindoOrders@301480001 : Record 50000;
      PayPalManagement@301480000 : Codeunit 5275337;
    BEGIN
      IF pQuickSalesHeader."Payment Method Code" <> 'PAYPAL' THEN
        EXIT;

      IF pQuickSalesHeader."Promotion Medium No." = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      IF pQuickSalesHeader."PayPal Transaction ID" <> '' THEN
        EXIT;

      CheckActindoOrders.SETRANGE(ExternalDocumentNo,pQuickSalesHeader."External Document No.");
      IF NOT CheckActindoOrders.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT;

      IF CheckActindoOrders."order done" THEN
        EXIT;

      PayPalSetup.GET(PayPalManagement.GetPPalSetupByPromMed(pQuickSalesHeader."Promotion Medium No."));

      SearchPaypalTransaction(SearchResponse,pQuickSalesHeader."Sell-to E-Mail",pQuickSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer First Name",pQuickSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer Surname",pQuickSalesHeader.Amount,PayPalSetup);
      IF NOT SearchResponse.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        SearchPaypalTransaction(SearchResponse,'',pQuickSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer First Name",pQuickSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer Surname",pQuickSalesHeader.Amount,PayPalSetup);
        IF NOT SearchResponse.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SearchPaypalTransaction(SearchResponse,pQuickSalesHeader."Sell-to E-Mail",'','',pQuickSalesHeader.Amount,PayPalSetup);
          IF NOT SearchResponse.FINDFIRST THEN
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;

      IF SearchResponse.TRANSACTIONID = '' THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      pQuickSalesHeader."PayPal Transaction ID" := SearchResponse.TRANSACTIONID;
      IF pWithModify THEN
        pQuickSalesHeader.MODIFY;
      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SearchPaypalTransaction@301490002(VAR SearchResponse@301490000 : TEMPORARY Record 5275422;email@301490001 : Text;firstname@301490002 : Text;surname@301490003 : Text;amount@301490004 : Decimal;PayPalSetup@301490008 : Record 5275420);
    VAR
      PayPalManagement@301490005 : Codeunit 5275337;
      smessage@301490007 : Text;
      lmessage@301490006 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT SearchResponse.ISEMPTY THEN
        SearchResponse.DELETEALL;

      PayPalManagement.SearchTransactionByFields(
        SearchResponse,
        CALCDATE('<-1Y>',TODAY),                  //Par_FROMDate
        CALCDATE('<+1D>',TODAY),                    //Par_ToDATE
        email,                     //Par_EMAIL
        '',                  //Par_RECEIVER
        '',                    //Par_INVNUM
        '',                      //Par_ACCT
        firstname,                 //Par_FIRSTNAME
        '',                //Par_MIDDLENAME
        surname,                  //Par_LASTNAME
        '',          //Par_TRANSACTIONCLASS
        amount,                       //Par_AMT
        '',                    //Par_STATUS
        TRUE,
        smessage,
          // 01 17.01.13 KMAR 10010014 PayPal Multi-Account
            //LMessage
          lmessage,
          PayPalSetup."Primary Key"
          // 01 17.01.13 KMAR 10010014 PayPal Multi-Account Ende
        );
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE HasToGenerateDemandForSalesLine@301480047(pSalesLine@301480000 : Record 37) : Text;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301480001 : Record 32;
      PurchaseLine@301480002 : Record 39;
      SalesLine@301480003 : Record 37;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480004 : Record 5275378;
      PostProcessingEntry@301490000 : Record 5104950;
      CustomerSetup@301490002 : Record 87000;
      Location@301480005 : Record 14;
      SetupGet@301490001 : Codeunit 5105007;
      result@1000000000 : Text;
      boolresult@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // LF 18.10.18 CZIE CHR-138 HasToGenerateDemandForSalesLine
      IF pSalesLine.Type <> pSalesLine.Type::Item THEN
        boolresult := FALSE;

      pSalesLine.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
      IF (pSalesLine."Reserved Quantity" <> 0) OR (pSalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" = 0) THEN
        boolresult := FALSE;

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'');
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE(Filename,FORMAT(pSalesLine.RECORDID,0,9));
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETFILTER(Status,'<>%1',ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::canceled);
      IF NOT ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.ISEMPTY THEN
        boolresult := FALSE;

      SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      IF CustomerSetup."Exclude Demand PP Filter" = '' THEN
        boolresult := FALSE;

      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",pSalesLine."Document No.");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesLine."Document Type");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",CustomerSetup."Exclude Demand PP Filter");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      IF NOT PostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
        boolresult := FALSE;

      IF CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter" = '' THEN
       boolresult := FALSE;

      Location.SETFILTER(Code,CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter");
      IF NOT Location.FINDSET THEN
        boolresult := FALSE;

      Location.RESET;
      Location.SETRANGE(Code,pSalesLine."Location Code");
      IF Location.ISEMPTY THEN
        boolresult := FALSE;

      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pSalesLine."No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDSET THEN
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCSUMS(Quantity);

      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",pSalesLine."No.");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
      PurchaseLine.SETFILTER("Outstanding Qty. (Base)",'<>0');
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDSET THEN
        PurchaseLine.CALCSUMS("Outstanding Qty. (Base)");

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",pSalesLine."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("Outstanding Qty. (Base)",'<>0');
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("Reserved Quantity",'0');
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        SalesLine.CALCSUMS("Outstanding Qty. (Base)");

      IF ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity + PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" - SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" < 0 THEN
        boolresult := TRUE;


      result := STRSUBSTNO('ArtikelPosten: %1\EK-Zeilen: %2\VK-Zeilen: %3\Ergebnis: %4 (%5)',
                            ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity,
                            PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)",
                            SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)",
                            ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity + PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" - SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)",
                            boolresult);
      EXIT(result);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SendDeclineRequestToSupplier@301480045(VAR Rec@301480000 : Record 37);
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301510001 : Record 5275378;
      CustomerManagement@301510000 : Codeunit 87000;
    BEGIN
      // NF 12.10.18 CZIE CHR-69 SendDeclineRequestToSupplierBeforeDeleteSalesLine
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFileEntryExistsForSalesLine('REQSUPFILE',Rec) THEN BEGIN
        CreateSupplierRequestInExtInterface(Rec,'DECSUPFILE',GUIALLOWED);

        ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'REQSUPFILE');
        ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE(Filename,FORMAT(Rec.RECORDID,0,9));
        IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename += '-DECLINED';
          ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.MODIFY;
        END;
        MESSAGE('done');
      END;
    END;

    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateSupplierRequestInExtInterface@301480017(pSalesLine@301480000 : Record 37;pExtMessageCode@301480005 : Code[10];pWithDialog@301480006 : Boolean) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480003 : Record 5275378;
      JSONManagement@301480001 : Codeunit 5459;
      JsonObject@301480002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      oStream@301480004 : OutStream;
      EntryExistsMsg@301480007 : TextConst 'DEU=Eintrag fÅr Message Code %1 bereits erstellt!';
    BEGIN
      // NF 14.09.18 CZIE CHR-99 CreateSupplierRequestInExtInterface
      IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFileEntryExistsForSalesLine(pExtMessageCode,pSalesLine) THEN BEGIN
        IF pWithDialog AND GUIALLOWED THEN
          MESSAGE(EntryExistsMsg,pExtMessageCode);

        EXIT;
      END;

      JsonObject := JsonObject.JObject;
      JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(JsonObject,'OrderNo',pSalesLine."Document No.");
      JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(JsonObject,'LineNo',pSalesLine."Line No.");
      JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(JsonObject,'ItemNo',pSalesLine."No.");
      JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(JsonObject,'VariantCode',pSalesLine."Variant Code");
      JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(JsonObject,'UnitPrice',pSalesLine."Unit Price");
      JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(JsonObject,'DiffTaxPossible',pSalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible");

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(oStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      oStream.WRITE(JsonObject.ToString());

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Code" := pExtMessageCode;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename := FORMAT(pSalesLine.RECORDID,0,9);
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::"to process";
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE);
      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetOrdersOverview@301510000();
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;
      SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36;
      NameValueBuffer@301510002 : TEMPORARY Record 823;
      TempBlob@301510007 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;
      PostProcessingEntry@301510009 : Record 5104950;
      FileManagement@301510003 : Codeunit 419;
      TypeHelper@301510005 : Codeunit 10;
      SalesInfoPaneManagement@301510006 : Codeunit 7171;
      string@301510004 : Text;
      oStream@301510008 : OutStream;
      ppEntry@301510010 : Text;
    BEGIN
      SalesLine.SETAUTOCALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>BOX');
      SalesLine.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
        IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesLine."Document Type",SalesLine."Document No.") THEN
          IF SalesHeader.Status = SalesHeader.Status::Open THEN BEGIN
      //      IF SalesLine."Reserved Quantity" = 0 THEN BEGIN // Add 0 Quantity
      //        NameValueBuffer.SETRANGE(Name,SalesLine."Document No.");
      //        IF NameValueBuffer.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
      //
      //          NameValueBuffer.AddNewEntry(SalesLine."Document No.",STRSUBSTNO('ZeroQTY;%1;',SalesInfoPaneManagement.CalcAvailableInventory(SalesLine)));
      //        END;
      //      END ELSE BEGIN
              NameValueBuffer.SETRANGE(Name,SalesLine."Document No.");
              IF NameValueBuffer.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
                IF SalesHeader."Post Processing" THEN BEGIN
                  ppEntry := '';
                  PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
                  PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
                  PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
                  IF PostProcessingEntry.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
                    ppEntry += PostProcessingEntry."Post Processing Code" +'|';
                  UNTIL PostProcessingEntry.NEXT = 0;
                  ppEntry := DELCHR(ppEntry,'>','|');
                  NameValueBuffer.AddNewEntry(SalesLine."Document No.",STRSUBSTNO('%1;%2;',ppEntry,SalesInfoPaneManagement.CalcAvailableInventory(SalesLine)));
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  NameValueBuffer.AddNewEntry(SalesLine."Document No.",STRSUBSTNO('%1;%2;','',SalesInfoPaneManagement.CalcAvailableInventory(SalesLine)));
                END;
              END;
          END;
      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;

      IF NameValueBuffer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        string := 'OrderNo.;Reason;ItemOnStock;' + TypeHelper.NewLine;
        REPEAT
          string += STRSUBSTNO('%1;%2%3',NameValueBuffer.Name,NameValueBuffer.Value,TypeHelper.NewLine);

        UNTIL NameValueBuffer.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      IF string <> '' THEN BEGIN
        TempBlob.Blob.CREATEOUTSTREAM(oStream);
        oStream.WRITE(string);

        FileManagement.BLOBExportWithEncoding(TempBlob,'diva.csv',TRUE,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
        EXIT;
      END;
      MESSAGE('empty');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE TsOpenButReserved@301510001();
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37;
      orders@301510002 : Text;
    BEGIN
      SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Approve Order");
      SalesHeader.SETFILTER("Status Approve Order",'<>%1',SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved);
      IF SalesHeader.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          SalesLine.SETAUTOCALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          SalesLine.SETFILTER("Reserved Quantity",'<>0');
          IF NOT SalesLine.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            orders += SalesHeader."No." + '|';
          END;

        UNTIL SalesHeader.NEXT = 0;

      IF orders <> '' THEN
        MESSAGE(orders);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DuplicatedPSPLogs@301510003();
    VAR
      PSPLog@301510000 : Record 5227626;
      pspLogDuplicate@301510001 : Record 5227626;
      TypeHelper@301510003 : Codeunit 10;
      currValues@301510002 : Text;
    BEGIN

      //PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_OrderID,'S2000508758');
      PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function,'CAPTURE');
      PSPLog.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
        pspLogDuplicate.SETFILTER("Entry No.",'<>%1',PSPLog."Entry No.");
        pspLogDuplicate.SETRANGE("Log Entry",PSPLog."Log Entry");
        pspLogDuplicate.SETRANGE(O_Function,PSPLog.O_Function);
        pspLogDuplicate.SETRANGE(O_Amount,PSPLog.O_Amount);
        pspLogDuplicate.SETRANGE("Transaction OK",PSPLog."Transaction OK");
        pspLogDuplicate.SETRANGE(O_OrderID,PSPLog.O_OrderID);
        IF NOT pspLogDuplicate.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          currValues += PSPLog.O_OrderID + '\' + TypeHelper.NewLine;
        END;
      UNTIL PSPLog.NEXT = 0;

      MESSAGE(currValues);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // Codeunit lÑuft auch als JOB, deswegen die PrÅfung GUIALLOWED
    }
    END.
  }
}

OBJECT Codeunit 50015 Delete Documents
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=03.03.22;
    Time=07:36:23;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=CNX.01;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=BEGIN
            SetVariables;

            CASE UPPERCASE(FunctionName) OF
              UPPERCASE('PURCHASEORDER') : DeletePurchaseOrders;
            END;
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      FunctionName@301510000 : Text;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetVariables@3();
    VAR
      "Batch Job Wizard Management"@1000000001 : Codeunit 5139828;
    BEGIN
      "Batch Job Wizard Management".ReadVariable('FUNCTION',FunctionName);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DeletePurchaseOrders@301510000();
    VAR
      PurchaseHeader@301510004 : Record 38;
    BEGIN
      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      //PurchaseHeader.SETFILTER("No.",'%1',FilterString);
      //PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Date",0D,CALCDATE('<-6m>',TODAY));
      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE(Receive,FALSE);
      IF PurchaseHeader.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        IF PrepaymentNotFound(PurchaseHeader."No.") THEN
          IF ExpectedReceiptOrQtyReceivedNotFound(PurchaseHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
          //IF TRUE THEN BEGIN //uncomment this line to skip checking expected receipt date if deletion manually (comment above  line)
            DisableConfirmationOnWhseRecptLines(PurchaseHeader."No.");
            ReOpenPurchaseDoc(PurchaseHeader);
            DisableAuditCheck(PurchaseHeader."No.");
            DeleteItemTrgkLine(PurchaseHeader."No.");
            PurchaseHeader.DELETE(TRUE);
          END;
      UNTIL PurchaseHeader.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PrepaymentNotFound@301510003(OrderNo@301510000 : Code[20]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      PurchInvHeader@301510001 : Record 122;
      PurchCrMemoHdr@301510004 : Record 124;
      PrePaymentInvoiceAmt@301510002 : Decimal;
      PrePaymentCreditMemoAmt@301510003 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      PurchInvHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Prepayment Order No.","Prepayment Invoice");
      PurchInvHeader.SETRANGE("Prepayment Order No.",OrderNo);
      IF PurchInvHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
        EXIT(TRUE)
      ELSE BEGIN
        PrePaymentInvoiceAmt    :=  0;
        PrePaymentCreditMemoAmt :=  0;
        PurchInvHeader.FINDSET;
        REPEAT
          PurchInvHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
          PrePaymentInvoiceAmt  +=  PurchInvHeader."Amount Including VAT";
        UNTIL PurchInvHeader.NEXT=0;

        PurchCrMemoHdr.SETCURRENTKEY("Prepayment Order No.");
        PurchCrMemoHdr.SETRANGE("Prepayment Order No.",OrderNo);
        IF PurchCrMemoHdr.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          PurchCrMemoHdr.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
          PrePaymentCreditMemoAmt  +=  PurchCrMemoHdr."Amount Including VAT";
        UNTIL PurchCrMemoHdr.NEXT=0;

        IF (PrePaymentInvoiceAmt + PrePaymentCreditMemoAmt)  = 0 THEN
          EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ExpectedReceiptOrQtyReceivedNotFound@301510005(OrderNo@301510002 : Code[20]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      PurchaseLine@301510000 : Record 39;
      QtyReceived@301510001 : Boolean;
      ExpectedReceiptExist@301510003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      QtyReceived :=  FALSE;
      ExpectedReceiptExist := FALSE;

      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",OrderNo);
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        IF (QtyReceived  = FALSE) AND (ExpectedReceiptExist =  FALSE) THEN BEGIN
          IF NOT (PurchaseLine."Quantity Received" = 0) THEN
            QtyReceived :=  TRUE;
          IF (ExpectedReceiptExist =  FALSE) THEN BEGIN
            IF (PurchaseLine."Expected Receipt Date" >= CALCDATE('-6M',TODAY)) THEN
              ExpectedReceiptExist  :=  TRUE;
          END;
        END;
      UNTIL PurchaseLine.NEXT = 0;

      IF ExpectedReceiptExist OR QtyReceived THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ReOpenPurchaseDoc@301510010(VAR PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38);
    VAR
      ReleasePurchDoc@301510001 : Codeunit 415;
    BEGIN
      IF (PurchaseHeader.Status =  PurchaseHeader.Status::Released) THEN
          ReleasePurchDoc.PerformManualReopen(PurchaseHeader);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DisableAuditCheck@301510006(OrderNo@301510001 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      PurchaseLine@301510000 : Record 39;
    BEGIN
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",OrderNo);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE(Audit,TRUE);
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        PurchaseLine.Audit  :=  FALSE;
        PurchaseLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
      UNTIL PurchaseLine.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE DeleteItemTrgkLine@1119439005(OrderNo@301510000 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      ReservationEntry@1119439001 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      ReservationEntry.RESET;
      ReservationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source ID");
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",39);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",1);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID",OrderNo);
      IF NOT ReservationEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
        ReservationEntry.DELETEALL;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DisableConfirmationOnWhseRecptLines@301510001(OrderNo@301510001 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      WarehouseReceiptLine@301510002 : Record 7317;
    BEGIN
      WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Type",39);
      WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",1);
      WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",OrderNo);
      WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE(Confirmed,TRUE);
      IF WarehouseReceiptLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE(Confirmed,FALSE);
        WarehouseReceiptLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
      UNTIL WarehouseReceiptLine.NEXT=0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillVarinat@301510009();
    VAR
      Top50listNAV@301510001 : Record 50037;
      ProcessWindow@301510000 : Dialog;
      QuickSalesLine@301510002 : Record 5104607;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT CONFIRM('Do you want to get the data?',FALSE) THEN
        EXIT;

      ProcessWindow.OPEN('Updating #1############');
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Order Date",010923D,311223D);
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",QuickSalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      QuickSalesLine.SETFILTER(Workflow,'<>%1',QuickSalesLine.Workflow::Canceled);
      QuickSalesLine.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
      ProcessWindow.UPDATE(1,QuickSalesLine."Variant Code");

      IF NOT Top50listNAV.GET(QuickSalesLine."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
        Top50listNAV.INIT;
        Top50listNAV.VarinatCode:=QuickSalesLine."Variant Code";
        Top50listNAV.QuickSales:=QuickSalesLine.Quantity;
        Top50listNAV.INSERT;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        Top50listNAV.QuickSales:=Top50listNAV.QuickSales+1;
        Top50listNAV.MODIFY;
      END;
      UNTIL QuickSalesLine.NEXT=0;
      ProcessWindow.CLOSE;

      MESSAGE('done');
    END;

OBJECT Codeunit 50017 Post Processing Chronext
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=30.01.26;
    Time=14:41:06;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=VAR
            SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;
            PostProcessingManagement@301510001 : Codeunit 5104950;
            QuickSalesHeader@301510002 : Record 5104606;
          BEGIN

            SalesHeader.GET(1,'X13767261115');
            PostProcessingManagement.RUN(SalesHeader);
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      Step4Value@301510000 : Decimal;
      Step3Value@301510001 : Decimal;
      Step2Value@301510002 : Decimal;
      Step1Value@301510003 : Decimal;

    PROCEDURE CheckDB1@301510001(ItemNo@301510000 : Code[20];Variant@301510001 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510004 : Decimal) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 32;
      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510003 : Record 311;
      ValueItemLedger@301510005 : Decimal;
      SystemValueLine@301510006 : Record 5105031;
      Item@301510007 : Record 27;
    BEGIN
      //1. Wenn Ware im Bestand ist, soll geprÅft werden, ob der DB% > einem bestimmten Wert ist (konfigurierbar)
      Clearvariables;
      IF Item.GET(ItemNo) THEN BEGIN
        Item.CALCFIELDS(Inventory);
        IF Item.Inventory = 0 THEN
          EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
      SalesReceivablesSetup.GET();
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(SalesReceivablesSetup."Setup for check on Quick SH",1) THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code","Location Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-');
          ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS(ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)",ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)");
          ValueItemLedger:=(((ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)")/ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity)/100)*(SystemValueLine."Calc Value 1"+100);
          IF UnitPrice < ValueItemLedger THEN BEGIN
            Step1Value:=ValueItemLedger;
            //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
            IF CheckDB1BV(ItemNo,Variant,UnitPrice) THEN
            //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
              EXIT(TRUE)
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInv2@301510002(ItemNo@301510001 : Code[20];Variant@301510000 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510005 : Decimal) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510002 : Record 311;
      SystemValueLine@301510003 : Record 5105031;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510004 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      //2. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK > 10.000 Euro,  dann soll der Auftrag ausgesteuert werden
      Clearvariables;
      SalesReceivablesSetup.GET();
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(SalesReceivablesSetup."Setup for check on Quick SH",2) THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code","Location Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
          IF UnitPrice > SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2" THEN BEGIN
            Step2Value:=SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2";
            //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
            IF CheckInv2BV(ItemNo,Variant,UnitPrice) THEN
            //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
             EXIT(TRUE)
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInv3@301510003(ItemNo@301510001 : Code[20];Variant@301510000 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510007 : Decimal) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510002 : Record 311;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510003 : Record 32;
      SystemValueLine@301510004 : Record 5105031;
      ItemLedgerEntry1@301510005 : Record 32;
      StarDate@301510006 : Date;
    BEGIN
      //3. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK < 10.000 Euro und kein EK < 3 Monate verfÅgbar, dann soll der Auftrag ausgesteuert werden
      Clearvariables;
      SalesReceivablesSetup.GET();
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(SalesReceivablesSetup."Setup for check on Quick SH",3) THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          StarDate:=CALCDATE('<-'+SystemValueLine."Code Value 2"+'>',TODAY);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code",Positive,"Entry Type","Posting Date","Location Code");
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Entry Type",'%1|%2|%3|%4',ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Purchase,ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::"Positive Adjmt.",ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Sale,ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Transfer);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'%1..%2',StarDate,TODAY);
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
            ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          IF ItemLedgerEntry1.ISEMPTY THEN
            IF UnitPrice < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2" THEN BEGIN
              Step3Value:=SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2";
              //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
              IF CheckInv3BV(ItemNo,Variant,UnitPrice) THEN
              //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
                EXIT(TRUE)
            END
            ELSE
              EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInv4@301510004(ItemNo@301510001 : Code[20];Variant@301510000 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510002 : Decimal) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510003 : Record 311;
      SystemValueLine@301510004 : Record 5105031;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510005 : Record 32;
      StarDate@301510006 : Date;
      ItemLedgerEntry1@301510007 : Record 32;
      Marge@301510008 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      //4. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK < 10.000 Euro und ein EK < 3 Monate verfÅgbar, dann soll geprÅft werden, ob der DB% > einem bestimmten Wert ist, verglichen zum hîchsten EK in den letzten 3 Monaten
      Clearvariables;
      SalesReceivablesSetup.GET();
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(SalesReceivablesSetup."Setup for check on Quick SH",4) THEN BEGIN
         ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          StarDate:=CALCDATE('<-'+SystemValueLine."Code Value 2"+'>',TODAY);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code",Positive,"Entry Type","Posting Date","Location Code");
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Entry Type",'%1|%2|%3|%4',ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Purchase,ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::"Positive Adjmt.",ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Sale,ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Transfer);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'%1..%2',StarDate,TODAY);
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
            ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry1.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            IF UnitPrice < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2" THEN BEGIN
              IF ItemLedgerEntry1.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                ItemLedgerEntry1.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
                ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Cost Amount (Actual)");
                IF ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)" > 0 THEN BEGIN
                  Marge:=((UnitPrice- ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)")/(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)"/100));
                  IF Marge < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3" THEN BEGIN
                    Step4Value:=(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)"/100)*(100+SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3");
                    //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
                    IF CheckInv4BV(ItemNo,Variant,UnitPrice) THEN
                    //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
                      EXIT(TRUE);
                  END;
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  ItemLedgerEntry1.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)");
                  ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Cost Amount (Expected)");
                  IF ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)" > 0 THEN BEGIN
                    Marge:=((UnitPrice- ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)")/(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)"/100));
                    IF Marge < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3" THEN BEGIN
                      Step4Value:=(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)"/100)*(100+SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3");
                      //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
                      IF CheckInv4BV(ItemNo,Variant,UnitPrice) THEN
                      //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
                        EXIT(TRUE);
                    END;
                  END;
                END;
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckDB1BV@301510012(ItemNo@301510000 : Code[20];Variant@301510001 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510004 : Decimal) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 32;
      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510003 : Record 311;
      ValueItemLedger@301510005 : Decimal;
      SystemValueLine@301510006 : Record 5105031;
      Item@301510007 : Record 27;
    BEGIN
      //1. Wenn Ware im Bestand ist, soll geprÅft werden, ob der DB% > einem bestimmten Wert ist (konfigurierbar)
      //29.04.22 NKON BV soll auch geprÅft werden
      Item.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      SalesReceivablesSetup.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      ItemLedgerEntry.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      //SystemValueLine.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');

      //Clearvariables;
      IF Item.GET(ItemNo) THEN BEGIN
        Item.CALCFIELDS(Inventory);
        IF Item.Inventory = 0 THEN
          EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
      SalesReceivablesSetup.GET();
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(SalesReceivablesSetup."Setup for check on Quick SH",1) THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code","Location Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-');
          ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS(ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)",ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)");
          ValueItemLedger:=(((ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)")/ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity)/100)*(SystemValueLine."Calc Value 1"+100);
          IF UnitPrice < ValueItemLedger THEN BEGIN
            Step1Value:=ValueItemLedger;
            EXIT(TRUE)
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInv2BV@301510011(ItemNo@301510001 : Code[20];Variant@301510000 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510005 : Decimal) : Boolean;

      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510002 : Record 311;

            Step2Value:=SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2";
            EXIT(TRUE)
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInv3BV@301510010(ItemNo@301510001 : Code[20];Variant@301510000 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510007 : Decimal) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510002 : Record 311;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510003 : Record 32;
      SystemValueLine@301510004 : Record 5105031;
      ItemLedgerEntry1@301510005 : Record 32;
      StarDate@301510006 : Date;
    BEGIN
      //3. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK < 10.000 Euro und kein EK < 3 Monate verfÅgbar, dann soll der Auftrag ausgesteuert werden
      SalesReceivablesSetup.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');

      //SystemValueLine.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');

      //Clearvariables;
      SalesReceivablesSetup.GET();
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(SalesReceivablesSetup."Setup for check on Quick SH",3) THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          StarDate:=CALCDATE('<-'+SystemValueLine."Code Value 2"+'>',TODAY);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code",Positive,"Entry Type","Posting Date","Location Code");
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);

          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'%1..%2',StarDate,TODAY);
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
            ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          IF ItemLedgerEntry1.ISEMPTY THEN
            IF UnitPrice < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2" THEN BEGIN
              Step3Value:=SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2";
              EXIT(TRUE)
            END
            ELSE
              EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInv4BV@301510009(ItemNo@301510001 : Code[20];Variant@301510000 : Code[20];UnitPrice@301510002 : Decimal) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesReceivablesSetup@301510003 : Record 311;
      SystemValueLine@301510004 : Record 5105031;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510005 : Record 32;
      StarDate@301510006 : Date;
      ItemLedgerEntry1@301510007 : Record 32;
      Marge@301510008 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      //4. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK < 10.000 Euro und ein EK < 3 Monate verfÅgbar, dann soll geprÅft werden, ob der DB% > einem bestimmten Wert ist, verglichen zum hîchsten EK in den letzten 3 Monaten
      SalesReceivablesSetup.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      ItemLedgerEntry.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      //SystemValueLine.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      ItemLedgerEntry1.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      //Clearvariables;
      SalesReceivablesSetup.GET();
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(SalesReceivablesSetup."Setup for check on Quick SH",4) THEN BEGIN
         ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,Positive,"Item No.","Variant Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          StarDate:=CALCDATE('<-'+SystemValueLine."Code Value 2"+'>',TODAY);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code",Positive,"Entry Type","Posting Date","Location Code");
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE("Variant Code",Variant);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Entry Type",'%1|%2|%3|%4',ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Purchase,ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::"Positive Adjmt.",ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Sale,ItemLedgerEntry1."Entry Type"::Transfer);
          ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'%1..%2',StarDate,TODAY);
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <>'' THEN
            ItemLedgerEntry1.SETFILTER("Location Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry1.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            IF UnitPrice < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 2" THEN BEGIN
              IF ItemLedgerEntry1.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                ItemLedgerEntry1.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
                ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Cost Amount (Actual)");
                IF ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)" > 0 THEN BEGIN
                  Marge:=((UnitPrice- ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)")/(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)"/100));
                  IF Marge < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3" THEN BEGIN
                    Step4Value:=(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Actual)"/100)*(100+SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3");
                    EXIT(TRUE);
                  END;
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  ItemLedgerEntry1.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)");
                  ItemLedgerEntry1.SETCURRENTKEY("Cost Amount (Expected)");
                  IF ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)" > 0 THEN BEGIN
                    Marge:=((UnitPrice- ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)")/(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)"/100));
                    IF Marge < SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3" THEN BEGIN
                      Step4Value:=(ItemLedgerEntry1."Cost Amount (Expected)"/100)*(100+SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3");
                      EXIT(TRUE);
                    END;
                  END;
                END;
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      BV//00 CHRON-9 01.02.22 NKON Nachbearbeitung Schnellauftrag



      1. Wenn Ware im Bestand ist, soll geprÅft werden, ob der DB% > einem bestimmten Wert ist (konfigurierbar)
      2. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK > 10.000 Euro,  dann soll der Auftrag ausgesteuert werden
      3. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK < 10.000 Euro und kein EK < 3 Monate verfÅgbar, dann soll der Auftrag ausgesteuert werden
      4. Ist keine Ware im Haus und der VK < 10.000 Euro und ein EK < 3 Monate verfÅgbar, dann soll geprÅft werden, ob der DB% > einem bestimmten Wert ist, verglichen zum hîchsten EK in den letzten 3 Monaten
      //29.04.22 NKON B.V soll auch geprÅft werden
    }
    END.
  }
}

    PROCEDURE OrderSelection@1000000010(VAR "Sales Header"@1000000000 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1000000006 : Record 5105031;

      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'ASELEKTION';

        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
      //IF NOT "System Value Line".GET(SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF ExternalCall THEN
        PostProcessingEntry2TempEntry("Sales Header",SystemValueCode);

      ValueOK := TRUE;

      "Setup Get"."Load SystemValueLines"("TempSystem Value Line1","System Value Line"."Ref. System Value No.");

      "TempSystem Value Line1".RESET;
      "TempSystem Value Line1".SETCURRENTKEY("System Value No.","Calc Value 1");
      "TempSystem Value Line1".SETRANGE("System Value No.","System Value Line"."Ref. System Value No.");

      // 01 05.05.09 KKAA
      IF ExternalCall AND (SelectionFilter <> '') THEN
        "TempSystem Value Line1".SETFILTER("System Code",SelectionFilter);
      // 01 05.05.09 KKAA Ende

      // 01 19.11.14 BREI 10050926 Leere Selektionscodes in A-Selektionsliste nicht beachten
      IF NOT ExternalCall OR (SelectionFilter = '') THEN
        "TempSystem Value Line1".SETFILTER("System Code",'<>%1','');
      // 01 19.11.14 BREI 10050926 Leere Selektionscodes in A-Selektionsliste nicht beachten ENDE

      IF "TempSystem Value Line1".FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          IF NOT "TempSystem Value Line1"."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN
            SelectionOK := TRUE;

            IF "Selection Header".GET("TempSystem Value Line1"."System Code") THEN BEGIN

    PROCEDURE ShippingControl@1001050015(VAR SalesHeader@1003 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      SystemManagementSetup@1001050003 : Record 5105000;
      SystemValueLine@1002 : Record 5105031;
      SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode@1000000000 : Record 5105031;
      PostProcessingEntry@1001050006 : Record 5104950;
      CurrencyExchangeRate@1001050002 : Record 330;
      TempItemVariant@610800000 : TEMPORARY Record 5401;
      SystemValueManagement@1001050004 : Codeunit 5105030;
      ShippingControlManagement@1001050005 : Codeunit 5105026;
      SystemValueNo@1001 : Integer;
      OrderAmount@1001050000 : Decimal;
      SystemValueCode@1000 : Code[10];
      Description@1000000001 : Text[80];
      StopCheck@1001050001 : Boolean;
      AllItemsReserved@1001060000 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // 01 12.09.17 KMAR MPD-91 Lieferkontrolle
      IF SalesHeader."Document Type" <> SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);

      SystemValueCode := 'LIEFERKONT';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"(SystemValueLine,SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // Steuerungscode (Code 1) enthÑlt AussteuerungsgrÅnde, die eine Lieferkontrolle ÅberflÅssig machen
      // D.h. ist der Auftrags bereits mit einem dieser AussteuerungsgrÅnden ausgesteuert, findet keine Lieferkontrolle mehr statt
      PostProcessingEntry.RESET;
      IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 1" <> '' THEN BEGIN
        PostProcessingEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Type","Post Processing Code","Post Processing Area","Entry Type",Open,Visible);
        PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
        PostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",PostProcessingEntry."Entry Type"::Sale);
        PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        IF NOT PostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
          EXIT(ValueOK);

        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Type","Post Processing Code","Post Processing Area","Entry Type",Open,Visible);
        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Entry Type",PostProcessingEntryTEMP."Entry Type"::Sale);
        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        IF NOT PostProcessingEntryTEMP.ISEMPTY THEN
          EXIT(ValueOK);
      END;

      // Alte Aussteuerung fÅr Liefrtkontrolle lîschen
      CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'');
      PostProcessingEntry.RESET;
      PostProcessingEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Type","Post Processing Code","Post Processing Area","Entry Type",Open,Visible);
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",SystemValueLine."System Code");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",PostProcessingEntry."Entry Type"::Sale);
      IF NOT PostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        PostProcessingEntry.FINDSET;
        PostProcessingEntry.DELETEALL;
      END;
      // 01 14.03.18 KMAR STD-1067 Aussteuerung wird bei erneuter Freigabe geschlossen
      PostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;
      PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Type","Post Processing Code","Post Processing Area","Entry Type",Open,Visible);
      PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",SystemValueLine."System Code");
      PostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Entry Type",PostProcessingEntryTEMP."Entry Type"::Sale);
      IF NOT PostProcessingEntryTEMP.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.FINDSET;
        PostProcessingEntryTEMP.DELETEALL;
      END;
      // 01 14.03.18 KMAR STD-1067 Aussteuerung wird bei erneuter Freigabe geschlossen Ende

      // 01 13.03.18 KMAR STD-1059 BugFix Lieferkontrolle, keine Lieferkontrolle wenn alles geliefert werden kann
      AllItemsReserved := TRUE;
      SalesLineTemp.RESET;

      SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0);
      SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::PresentVoucher);
      SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
      IF SalesLineTemp.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          SalesLineTemp.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
          IF SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity" <> SalesLineTemp.Quantity THEN
            AllItemsReserved := FALSE;
        UNTIL (SalesLineTemp.NEXT = 0) OR (NOT AllItemsReserved);
      END;
      SalesLineTemp.RESET;

      IF AllItemsReserved THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);
      // 01 13.03.18 KMAR STD-1059 BugFix Lieferkontrolle, keine Lieferkontrolle wenn alles geliefert werden kann Ende

      SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode.SETCURRENTKEY("System Value No.","Calc Value 1");
      SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode.SETRANGE("System Value No.",SystemValueLine."Ref. System Value No.");  // Referenz Systemwert
      SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode.SETRANGE("Bool 1",TRUE);                                                   // aktiv
      IF SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        SystemManagementSetup.GET;
        REPEAT
          Description := SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode.Description;
          CASE SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode."System Code" OF
            // PrÅfungen zur Lieferkontrolle
            // 01 12.09.17 KMAR MPD-95 Lieferart - Teillieferung erzwingen
            'VERFöGBAR' :
              BEGIN
                IF ShippingControlManagement.CheckPartialShipping(SalesHeader,SalesLineTemp,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp) THEN BEGIN
                  StopCheck:= TRUE;

                  SalesLineTemp.RESET;
                  SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
                  SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
                  SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
                  SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0);
                  SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::PresentVoucher);
                  ValueOK := SalesLineTemp.FINDSET;
                  IF NOT ValueOK THEN
                    InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode."System Code",Description,TRUE,FALSE)
                  ELSE
                    CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'');
                  SalesLineTemp.RESET;
                END;
              END;
            // 01 12.09.17 KMAR MPD-95 Lieferart - Teillieferung erzwingen Ende
            // 01 15.09.17 KMAR MPD-99 Lieferkontrolle - Komplettlieferung
            'KOMPLETT' :
              BEGIN
                IF SalesHeader."Shipping Advice" = SalesHeader."Shipping Advice"::Complete THEN BEGIN
                  // Komplettlieferung
                  StopCheck:= TRUE;
                END;
              END;
            // 01 15.09.17 KMAR MPD-99 Lieferkontrolle - Komplettlieferung Ende
            // 01 15.09.17 KMAR MPD-100 Lieferkontrolle - Teillieferung ab Auftragswert
            'AB_WERT' :
              BEGIN
                OrderAmount := 0;
                SalesLineTemp.RESET;
                SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
                SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
                SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0);
                SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::PresentVoucher);
                SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
                IF SalesLineTemp.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                  REPEAT
                    SalesLineTemp.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
                    IF SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                      // 01 29.05.18 KMAR STD-1224 LieferabhÑngigkeiten
                      IF ShippingControlManagement.OrderShippingDependencyOK(SalesLineTemp,TempItemVariant) THEN
                      // 01 29.05.18 KMAR STD-1224 LieferabhÑngigkeiten Ende
                        OrderAmount += SalesLineTemp."Amount Including VAT" / SalesLineTemp.Quantity * SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity";
                    END;
                  UNTIL SalesLineTemp.NEXT = 0;
                END;
                SalesLineTemp.RESET;
                IF (OrderAmount >= SystemManagementSetup."Force Part. Shipm. from Amount") AND
                   (SystemManagementSetup."Force Part. Shipm. from Amount" > 0)
                THEN BEGIN
                  // Teillieferung ab Auftragswert
                  StopCheck:= TRUE;
                END;
              END;
            // 01 15.09.17 KMAR MPD-100 Lieferkontrolle - Teillieferung ab Auftragswert Ende
            // 01 18.09.17 KMAR MPD-101 Lieferkontrolle - Teillieferung
            'TEILLIEFER' :
              BEGIN
                SystemManagementSetup.TESTFIELD("Control Code Partial Shipping");
                IF SalesHeader."Shipping Mode" <> '' THEN
                  IF SystemValueManagement.CheckControlCode(62020,SalesHeader."Shipping Mode",SystemManagementSetup."Control Code Partial Shipping") THEN
                    // Teillieferung ist gefordert
                    StopCheck:= TRUE;
              END;
            // 01 18.09.17 KMAR MPD-101 Lieferkontrolle - Teillieferung Ende
            // 01 18.09.17 KMAR MPD-102 Lieferkontrolle - Saisonende erreicht
            'SAISONENDE' :
              BEGIN
                SalesLineTemp.RESET;
                SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
                SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
                SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
                SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0);
                SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::PresentVoucher);
                IF SalesLineTemp.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                  REPEAT
                    SalesLineTemp.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
                    IF SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity" <> 0 THEN
                      // 01 29.05.18 KMAR STD-1224 LieferabhÑngigkeiten
                      IF ShippingControlManagement.OrderShippingDependencyOK(SalesLineTemp,TempItemVariant) THEN
                      // 01 29.05.18 KMAR STD-1224 LieferabhÑngigkeiten Ende
                        StopCheck:= ShippingControlManagement.CheckEndOfItemSeason(SalesHeader."Order Date",SalesLineTemp."No.");
                  UNTIL (SalesLineTemp.NEXT = 0) OR (StopCheck);
                END;
              END;
            // 01 18.09.17 KMAR MPD-102 Lieferkontrolle - Saisonende erreicht Ende
            // 01 27.09.17 KMAR MPD-103 Lieferkontrolle - % Lieferwert/-menge
            'LIEFERWERT' :
              BEGIN
                StopCheck:= ShippingControlManagement.CheckShippingValue(SalesHeader,SalesLineTemp,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp);
              END;
            // 01 27.09.17 KMAR MPD-103 Lieferkontrolle - % Lieferwert/-menge Ende
            // 01 28.09.17 KMAR MPD-106 Lieferkontrolle - SaisonÅberschneidung
            'SAISONöBERLAPPUNG' :
              BEGIN
                StopCheck := ShippingControlManagement.CheckSeasons(SalesHeader,SalesLineTemp,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp);
                ValueOK := NOT StopCheck;
                IF NOT ValueOK THEN
                  InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode."System Code",Description,TRUE,FALSE)
                ELSE
                  CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'');
              END;
            // 01 28.09.17 KMAR MPD-106 Lieferkontrolle - SaisonÅberschneidung Ende
            // 01 29.09.17 KMAR MPD-109 Lieferkontrolle - Wartefrist 1
            'WARTEFRIST 1' :
              BEGIN
                StopCheck := ShippingControlManagement.CheckWaiting1(SalesHeader,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp);
                ValueOK := NOT StopCheck;
                IF NOT ValueOK THEN
                  InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode."System Code",Description,TRUE,FALSE)
                ELSE
                  CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'');
              END;
            // 01 29.09.17 KMAR MPD-109 Lieferkontrolle - Wartefrist 1 Ende
            // 01 02.10.17 KMAR MPD-111 Lieferkontrolle - Wartefrist 2
            'WARTEFRIST 2' :
              BEGIN
                StopCheck := ShippingControlManagement.CheckWaiting2(SalesHeader,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp);
                ValueOK := NOT StopCheck;
                IF NOT ValueOK THEN
                  InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode."System Code",Description,TRUE,FALSE)
                ELSE
                  CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'');
              END;
            // 01 02.10.17 KMAR MPD-111 Lieferkontrolle - Wartefrist 2 Ende
            // 01 02.10.17 KMAR MPD-110 Lieferkontrolle - Wartefrist 3
            'WARTEFRIST 3' :
              BEGIN
                StopCheck := ShippingControlManagement.CheckWaiting3(SalesHeader,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp);
              END;
            // 01 02.10.17 KMAR MPD-110 Lieferkontrolle - Wartefrist 3 Ende
            // 01 05.10.17 KMAR MPD-112 Lieferkontrolle - Teilliefergrenze
            'TEILLIEFERGRENZE' :
              BEGIN
                StopCheck := ShippingControlManagement.CheckShippingLimit(SalesHeader,SalesLineTemp,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp);
              END;
            // 01 05.10.17 KMAR MPD-112 Lieferkontrolle - Teilliefergrenze Ende
            // 01 05.10.17 KMAR MPD-113 Lieferkontrolle - Geschenklieferung
            'GESCHENKLIEFERUNG' :
              BEGIN
                StopCheck := ShippingControlManagement.CheckGiftItem(SalesHeader,GSalesLinecomplOrderTemp,ValueOK);
                IF NOT ValueOK THEN
                  InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode."System Code",Description,TRUE,FALSE)
                ELSE
                  CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'');
              END;
            // 01 05.10.17 KMAR MPD-113 Lieferkontrolle - Geschenklieferung Ende
            'AUSSTEUERUNG' :
              BEGIN
                ValueOK := FALSE;
                InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode,SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode."System Code",Description,TRUE,FALSE);
              END;
          END;
        UNTIL (SystemValueLineCheckShippingMode.NEXT = 0) OR (NOT ValueOK) OR StopCheck;
      END;

      EXIT(ValueOK);
      // 01 12.09.17 KMAR MPD-91 Lieferkontrolle Ende
    END;
