    PROCEDURE "Save found Values to Salesline"@1000000038();
    VAR
      "Sales Line"@1000000000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // 01 09.07.09 HBIE VBS000236 neue Teillieferungslogik
      //gefundene Werte in Verkaufszeilen zurÅckschreiben
      tempSalesLine.RESET;
      IF tempSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN REPEAT
        "Sales Line".GET(tempSalesLine."Document Type",tempSalesLine."Document No.",tempSalesLine."Line No.");
        IF ("Sales Line"."Next Delivery Date (found)" <> tempSalesLine."Next Delivery Date (found)") OR
          // 01 15.12.14 SLAN 10053317 ReDesign 'TEILLIEF'
          // ("Sales Line"."Reserved Quantity (found)" <> tempSalesLine."Reserved Quantity (found)") OR
          // 01 15.12.14 SLAN 10053317 ReDesign 'TEILLIEF' ENDE
           ("Sales Line"."Delivery Status (found)" <> tempSalesLine."Delivery Status (found)")
        THEN BEGIN
          "Sales Line"."Next Delivery Date (found)" := tempSalesLine."Next Delivery Date (found)";
          // 01 15.12.14 SLAN 10053317 ReDesign 'TEILLIEF'
          //"Sales Line"."Reserved Quantity (found)" := tempSalesLine."Reserved Quantity (found)";
          // 01 15.12.14 SLAN 10053317 ReDesign 'TEILLIEF' ENDE
          "Sales Line"."Delivery Status (found)" := tempSalesLine."Delivery Status (found)";
          "Sales Line".MODIFY;
        END;
      UNTIL tempSalesLine.NEXT = 0;
      // 01 09.07.09 HBIE VBS000236 neue Teillieferungslogik Ende
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalcShptAmtAndSubsShptAmt@1140006(SalesHeader@1140000 : Record 36;VAR ShipmentAmount@1140001 : Decimal;VAR SubsShipmentAmount@1140002 : Decimal;VAR LatestNextWI@1140004 : Integer;DeliveryStatusFilter@1000000000 : Text[30]);
    VAR
      SalesLine@1140003 : Record 37;
      NextWI@1140005 : Date;
      AmountNextDelivery@1000000001 : Decimal;
      UnitPrice@1000000002 : Decimal;
      CentralLogisticManagement@1119439000 : Codeunit 5104510;
      SysCompMgt@1119439001 : Codeunit 5105009;
      Item@1000000004 : Record 27;
      SetupGet@1000000005 : Codeunit 5105007;
      CentralLogsiticSetup@1000000006 : Record 5104520;
      UseMCLogistic@1000000007 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // 01 16.05.08 MMUS VBS000011 PrÅfung auf Teillieferung

      // 01 30.06.09 KKOE SUPP00615 Nur reservierte Zeilen prÅfen
      SetupGet."Get Central Logistic Setup"(CentralLogsiticSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      // 01 22.06.15 KKOE Umbau zentr. Logistik
      //UseMCLogistic := (CentralLogsiticSetup."Reservation in Maincompany" AND (CentralLogsiticSetup.Maincompany <> COMPANYNAME));
      // 01 22.06.15 KKOE Umbau zentr. Logistik


      NextWI := 0D;
      ShipmentAmount := 0;
      SubsShipmentAmount := 0;

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.", SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type, SalesLine.Type::Item);

      // 01 20.01.09 DPET VBS000015 Lieferstatus berÅcksichtigen
      // tbd, DPET 28.01.09
      //SalesLine.SETFILTER("Delivery Status",DeliveryStatusFilter);
      // 01 20.01.09 DPET VBS000015 ENDE

      IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN
        REPEAT
          AmountNextDelivery := 0;
          SalesLine.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity","Next WI");

          // 01 26.11.09 KKOE ELE000040
          IF UseMCLogistic THEN
            CentralLogisticManagement."CalcSalesLineReservedQty(Base)"(SalesLine);
          // 01 26.11.09 KKOE ELE000040


          // 01 20.05.09 DPET SUPP00474 VK-Preis aus Fremdmandant ermitteln
          UnitPrice := SysCompMgt.CalcSalesPriceSalesCompany(SalesLine);
          // 01 20.05.09 DPET SUPP00474 VK-Preis aus Fremdmandant ermitteln ENDE

          ShipmentAmount += SalesLine."Reserved Quantity" * UnitPrice;
          AmountNextDelivery := (SalesLine."Outstanding Quantity" - SalesLine."Reserved Quantity") * UnitPrice;
          SubsShipmentAmount += AmountNextDelivery;
          IF (AmountNextDelivery > 0) AND (SalesLine."Next WI" > NextWI) THEN
            NextWI := SalesLine."Next WI";

          IF Item.GET(SalesLine."No.") THEN
            IF (Item.AvailableQuantity + Item.AvailableQuantitySet) >= SalesLine."Outstanding Quantity" THEN
              NextWI := TODAY;

        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;

      IF (NextWI <> 0D) THEN
        LatestNextWI := NextWI - TODAY
      ELSE
        LatestNextWI := 9999;

      // 01 16.05.08 MMUS VBS000011 PrÅfung auf Teillieferung ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE SendMail@1140017(VAR SalesHeader@1140000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      Von@1000000012 : Record 91;
      SalesLine@1119439001 : Record 37;
      Customer@1119439000 : Record 18;
      "Mail Send E-Mail"@1000000000 : Codeunit 5275362;
      From@1000000008 : Text[80];
      Receiver@1000000007 : ARRAY [3,10] OF Text[80];
      Subject@1000000006 : Text[250];
      Attachements@1000000005 : ARRAY [10] OF Text[250];
      TextValues@1000000004 : ARRAY [250] OF Text[250];
      "Send as HTML"@1000000003 : Boolean;
      Action@1000000002 : 'Send,Release';
      "Delete Attachments after sent"@1000000001 : Boolean;
      i@1000000009 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // 01 16.05.08 MMUS VBS000011 PrÅfung auf Teillieferung

      Von.GET(USERID);
      From := Von."E-Mail";
      Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      IF Customer."E-Mail" <> '' THEN
        //Receiver[1][1] := Customer."E-Mail"
        Receiver[1][1] := Von."E-Mail"
      ELSE
        Receiver[1][1] := Von."E-Mail";

      Subject := STRSUBSTNO('Ihr Auftrag Nr.: %1', SalesHeader."No.");

      TextValues[1] := 'Ihr Auftrag wird verschickt. Folgende Artikel kînnen wir leider nicht mehr liefern:';
      "Send as HTML" := FALSE;
      Action := Action::Send;
      "Delete Attachments after sent" := FALSE;
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.", SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type, SalesLine.Type::Item);
      i := 2;
      IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN REPEAT
        SalesLine.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
        IF (SalesLine."Outstanding Quantity" - SalesLine."Reserved Quantity" > 0) THEN BEGIN
          i += 1;
          TextValues[i] := STRSUBSTNO('Artikel: %1 %2 Menge: %3',SalesLine."No.", SalesLine.Description,
            (SalesLine."Outstanding Quantity" - SalesLine."Reserved Quantity"));
        END;
      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;

      "Mail Send E-Mail"."Create & Send MailText"(
        From,Receiver,Subject,Attachements,TextValues,"Send as HTML",Action,"Delete Attachments after sent");
      // 01 16.05.08 MMUS VBS000011 PrÅfung auf Teillieferung ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckFreshnessDelivery@1119439011(VAR SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;

      SystemValueCode := 'FRISCHE';
      ValueOK := FALSE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode("Sales Header",SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      //IF NOT SystemValueLine.GET(SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode) THEN

                                                      "Sales Line"."Freshness Mode"::Premium);

          IF NOT "Calendar Management".CheckDateStatus("System Management Setup"."Base Cal. Code Freshn. Shipm.",
                                                                            CALCDATE('<+1D>',WORKDATE),TmpDescription) THEN
          // 01 30.04.10 BREI GOUR0015 Basiskalendercode aus Systemeinrichtung ENDE
            ValueOK := TRUE
        END;

      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'')
      ELSE
        ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'',Text001L,FALSE,TRUE));

      EXIT(NOT ValueOK);
      // 01 15.03.10 BREI GOUR0015 Frischeartikel, Keine Lieferung vor Sonn- und Feiertagen ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE "CheckNewCustomer(Web only)"@1119439000(VAR SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      SystemValueLine@1000000004 : Record 5105031;
      Sales@1119439001 : Record 36;
      Customer@1119439002 : Record 18;
      SystemValueNo@1000000003 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1000000002 : Code[10];
      Text001L@1119439003 : TextConst 'DEU=Neuer Kunde aus einem Webshopauftrag.';
    BEGIN
      // 01 25.08.10 DRAA ELE000062 Neukundenaussteuerung WebauftrÑge
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'NEUKUNDE';

      IF SalesHeader."Order Type" <> SalesHeader."Order Type"::WebShop THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode("Sales Header",SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT;

      // 01 10.11.10 KKOE ELE000221 Performance
      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"(SystemValueLine,SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
      //IF NOT SystemValueLine.GET(SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT;


      // Hat der Kunde bereits eine Rechnung erhalten, ist er kein Neukunde mehr
      Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      Customer.CALCFIELDS("No. of Pstd. Invoices");
      IF Customer."No. of Pstd. Invoices" > 0 THEN
        EXIT;

      // Hat der Kunde bereits einen Nichtwebauftrag, ist er kein Neukunde mehr
      Sales.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type", "Sell-to Customer No.", "No.");
      Sales.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHeader."Document Type");
      Sales.SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.", SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      Sales.SETFILTER("Order Type", '<>%1', Sales."Order Type"::WebShop);
      IF NOT Sales.ISEMPTY() THEN
        EXIT;

      // Hat der Kunde bereits einen freigegebenen Webauftrag, ist er kein Neukunde mehr
      Sales.RESET();
      Sales.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type", "Sell-to Customer No.", "No.");
      Sales.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHeader."Document Type");
      Sales.SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.", SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      Sales.SETRANGE("Order Type", Sales."Order Type"::WebShop);
      Sales.SETFILTER(Status, '>%1', Sales.Status::Open);
      IF NOT Sales.ISEMPTY() THEN
        EXIT;

      InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'',Text001L,FALSE,FALSE);
      // 01 25.08.10 DRAA ELE000062 Neukundenaussteuerung WebauftrÑge ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckExpireDate@1119439012(VAR SalesHeader@1119439000 : Record 36) ValueOk : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1119439005 : Record 5105031;
      ReservationEntry@1119439004 : Record 337;
      ReservationEntry2@1119439007 : Record 337;
      ItemLedgerEntry@1119439008 : Record 32;
      DiVAItemTrackingMgt@1119439006 : Codeunit 5104818;
      SystemValueNo@1119439003 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1119439002 : Code[10];
      ValueHeaderOK@1119439001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // 01 02.03.11 SLAN GOUR Erneute PrÅfung auf MHD bei Freigabe
      // PrÅfung des MHD
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'MHD';
      ValueOk := TRUE;
      ValueHeaderOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOk);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
      //IF NOT "System Value Line".GET(SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOk);

      WITH SalesHeader DO BEGIN
        SalesLineTemp.RESET;
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","No.");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
        IF SalesLineTemp.FIND('-') THEN
          REPEAT
            ReservationEntry.RESET;
            ReservationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source ID","Source Ref. No.");
            ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Sales Line");
            ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",SalesLineTemp."Document Type");
            ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID",SalesLineTemp."Document No.");
            ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.",SalesLineTemp."Line No.");
            IF ReservationEntry.FIND('-') THEN
              REPEAT
                ReservationEntry2.RESET;
                ReservationEntry2.SETRANGE("Entry No.",ReservationEntry."Entry No.");
                ReservationEntry2.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
                IF ReservationEntry2.FIND('-') THEN
                  REPEAT
                    ItemLedgerEntry.GET(ReservationEntry2."Source Ref. No.");
                    IF ItemLedgerEntry."Expiration Date" <> 0D THEN
                      IF ItemLedgerEntry."Expiration Date" <= DiVAItemTrackingMgt.CalcItemDateExpInvTolDate(ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.",
                          ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code",COMPANYNAME) THEN
                        ValueOk := FALSE;
                  UNTIL ReservationEntry2.NEXT = 0;
              UNTIL ReservationEntry.NEXT = 0;
          UNTIL (SalesLineTemp.NEXT = 0) OR (NOT ValueOk);
      END;
      IF ValueOk THEN
        CloseExistPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",SalesLineTemp."Line No.","System Value Line",'')
      ELSE
        ValueOk := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(
                "Sales Header",SalesLineTemp."Line No.","System Value Line",'',"System Value Line".Description,FALSE,FALSE));

      EXIT(NOT ValueOk)
      // 01 02.03.11 SLAN GOUR Erneute PrÅfung auf MHD bei Freigabe ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckDropShptQuantity@1119439013(VAR SalesHeader@1119439000 : Record 36) ValueOk : Boolean;
    VAR
      "Extra Order Setup"@1119439006 : Record 5104715;
      "System Value Line"@1119439005 : Record 5105031;
      Item@1119439004 : Record 27;
      SystemValueNo@1119439003 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1119439002 : Code[10];
      ValueHeaderOK@1119439001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // 01 07.06.11 BREI PLU1A0014 BestandsprÅfung fÅr Direktlieferungsartikel
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'DROPSHPQTY';
      ValueOk := TRUE;
      ValueHeaderOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get ExtraOrder Setup"("Extra Order Setup",FALSE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOk);
      IF NOT "Extra Order Setup"."Inventory Mgt. Drop Shipment" THEN
        EXIT(ValueOk);

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOk);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOk);

      WITH SalesHeader DO BEGIN
        SalesLineTemp.RESET;
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","No.");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Drop Shipment",TRUE);               // Direktlieferungsartikelzeilen
        IF SalesLineTemp.FIND('-') THEN
          REPEAT
            Item.GET(SalesLineTemp."No.");
            IF Item."Inventory Mgt. Drop Shipment" THEN BEGIN     // BestandsfÅhrung aktiv?
              Item.CALCFIELDS("Inventory Drop Shipment");
              IF SalesLineTemp.Quantity > Item."Inventory Drop Shipment" THEN
                ValueOk := FALSE;
            END;

    PROCEDURE CheckAmazonViaComputop@1000000029(VAR SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1000000004 : Record 5105031;
      PaymentMethod@1000000005 : Record 289;
      SalesPSPCard@1000000003 : Record 5227625;
      SalesLine@1000000006 : Record 37;
      QuickSalesHeader@1119439000 : Record 5104606;
      PSPItemList@1000000007 : Record 5227634;
      SysMgtMgt@1000000011 : Codeunit 5105000;
      SystemValueCode@1000000001 : Code[10];
      SystemValueNo@1000000002 : Integer;
      ItemListAmount@1000000009 : Decimal;
      AmountOrder@1119439003 : Decimal;
      ItemListError@1000000008 : Boolean;
      AmountError@1000000010 : Boolean;
      LText001@1000000012 : TextConst 'DEU=Artikelliste ist abweichend.;ENU=" Item List ist different."';
      LText002@1000000013 : TextConst 'DEU=Auftragsbetrag %1 Åberschreitet Betrag aus Artikelliste %2.;ENU=Orderamount %1 is different from Item List Amount %2.';
      LText003@1119439001 : TextConst 'DEU=Artikelliste Ursprungsdaten nicht gefunden.;ENU=Item List origin data not found.';
      SourceDataError@1119439002 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // 01 21.11.12 KMAR NAV130037 MOD00002.2.00 PSP Handling
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'AMAZON';
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      // Aussteuerungskennzeichen Aktiv?
      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);
      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF PaymentMethod.GET(SalesHeader."Payment Method Code") AND
         // 01 27.11.12 KMAR NAV130037 MOD00002.2.00 PSP "Payment Type Code" Ablîsung Optionsfeld
           //(PaymentMethod."Payment Type" = PaymentMethod."Payment Type"::"Amazon via Computop")
         (PaymentMethod."Payment Type Code" = 'AMAZON VIA COMPUTOP')
         // 01 27.11.12 KMAR NAV130037 MOD00002.2.00 PSP "Payment Type Code" Ablîsung Optionsfeld Ende
      THEN BEGIN
        ValueOK := SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.") AND
                   (SalesPSPCard."Payment Method Status" <> SalesPSPCard."Payment Method Status"::Declined);

        IF SalesPSPCard."Payment Method Status" = SalesPSPCard."Payment Method Status"::Pending THEN
          EXIT(TRUE);

        IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN
          // BetragsprÅfung zwischen Auftrag und Artikelliste
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
          IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
            QuickSalesHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.");
            QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            IF QuickSalesHeader.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
              ItemListAmount += QuickSalesHeader."Shipping Charge Amount";
              PSPItemList.SETCURRENTKEY("Log No.","Order Line No.");
              REPEAT
                PSPItemList.SETRANGE("Log No.",SalesPSPCard."Log No.");
                PSPItemList.SETRANGE("Order Line No.",SalesLine."Line No.");
                IF NOT PSPItemList.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                  ItemListError := TRUE;
                  ValueOK := FALSE;
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  IF (SalesLine.Quantity > PSPItemList.Quantity ) OR
                     (SalesLine."Unit Price" > PSPItemList.Price)
                  THEN BEGIN
                    ItemListError := TRUE;
                    ValueOK := FALSE;
                  END;
                  ItemListAmount += PSPItemList.Quantity * PSPItemList.Price;
                END;
              UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              SourceDataError := TRUE;
              ValueOK := FALSE;
            END;
          END;
          IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN
            AmountOrder := SysMgtMgt."CalcPre-PayAmount(expected)"(SalesHeader,FALSE);
            IF AmountOrder > ItemListAmount THEN BEGIN
              AmountError := TRUE;
              ValueOK := FALSE;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      IF SourceDataError THEN
        "System Value Line".Description := LText003;
      IF AmountError THEN
        "System Value Line".Description :=
          STRSUBSTNO(LText002,FORMAT(AmountOrder,0,'<Integer Thousand><Decimals,3>'),
                              FORMAT(ItemListAmount,0,'<Integer Thousand><Decimals,3>'));
      IF ItemListError THEN
        "System Value Line".Description := LText001;

      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'')
      ELSE
        ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(
          SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',"System Value Line".Description,FALSE,FALSE));

      IF TempEntries2Database(SalesHeader,'',TRUE) THEN ;
      EXIT(ValueOK)
      // 01 21.11.12 KMAR NAV130037 MOD00002.2.00 PSP Handling Ende
    END;

    PROCEDURE OrderThresholdViolation@1119439015(VAR SalesHeader@1003 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1002 : Record 5105031;
      SystemValueNo@1001 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1000 : Code[10];
      Country@1000000000 : Record 9;
      InfoText@1000000001 : Text[100];
      CustomerManagement@301480000 : Codeunit 87000;
    BEGIN
      // 01 23.05.12 LENS00088 LieferschwellenÅberschreitung

      SystemValueCode := 'LIEFERSCHW';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      ValueOK := FALSE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      CASE TRUE OF
        SalesHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code" = '':
          // Inland, keine Lieferschwelle
          BEGIN
            ValueOK := TRUE;
            InfoText := '';
          END;
        NOT "Setup Get"."Get Country"(Country,SalesHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code",TRUE,FALSE):
          BEGIN
            ValueOK := FALSE;
            InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text044,SalesHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code");
          END;
        NOT Country."Val. Order Threshold Violation":
          // Land soll nicht ausgewertet werden
          BEGIN
            ValueOK := TRUE;
            InfoText := '';
          END;
        Country."VAT Bus.Post.Group (Ord.Thres)" = '':
          // Lieferschwelle kann nicht ermittelt werden, weil "MWSt. GeschÑftsbuchungsgruppe" nicht gefÅllt ist
          BEGIN
            ValueOK := FALSE;
            InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text045,Country.FIELDCAPTION("VAT Bus.Post.Group (Ord.Thres)"),Country.TABLECAPTION);
          END;
        Country."Order Threshold (FCY)" = 0:
          // Lieferschwelle gilt als "immer Åberschritten"
          BEGIN
            ValueOK := FALSE;
            InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text043,Country.Name);
          END;
        ELSE BEGIN
          Country.SETFILTER("Date Filter",'%1..%2',DMY2DATE(1,1),DMY2DATE(31,12));
          Country.CALCFIELDS("VAT Base");
          // wg. Performance wird der Wert aller AuftrÑge (inkl. aktuellem Auftrag) nicht berÅcksichtigt
          Country.VALIDATE("Order Threshold (FCY)");
          // 01 17.08.18 MBLA CHR-52 Lieferschwellen - Aussteuerung des Auftrages
          //ValueOK := (ROUND(Country.GetOrderThresholdLCY) > Country."VAT Base");
          ValueOK := CustomerManagement.CalcVATAmountThreshold(SalesHeader,Country);
          // 01 17.08.18 MBLA CHR-52 Lieferschwellen - Aussteuerung des Auftrages ENDE
          IF NOT ValueOK THEN
            InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text043,Country.Name);
        END;
      END;

      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'')
      ELSE
        ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',InfoText,TRUE,FALSE));

      EXIT(ValueOK);
      // 01 23.05.12 LENS00088 ende
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckInventoryOtherLocation@1000000040(VAR "Sales Header"@1000000000 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1000000006 : Record 5105031;
      Item@1000000005 : Record 27;
      SystemValueNo@1000000004 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1000000003 : Code[10];
      Discription@1000000002 : Text[250];
      ValueHeaderOK@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // LF 21.06.12 KKAA BJOE00038 CheckInventoryOtherLocation
      // Aussteuerung wenn nicht reservierter Bestand in einem anderen Lagerort verfÅgbar ist.
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'LAGERBEST';
      ValueOK := FALSE;
      ValueHeaderOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode("Sales Header",SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      //** Hier Bedingung einfÅgen Anfang **//

      // Wenn PrÅfung OK, dann ValueOK true setzen;
      WITH "Sales Header" DO BEGIN
        SalesLineTemp.RESET;
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","No.");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
        SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'%1|%2',
          SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::Item,SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::Component);
        SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0);
        IF SalesLineTemp.FIND('-') THEN
          REPEAT
            SalesLineTemp.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
            ValueOK := (SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity" >= SalesLineTemp."Outstanding Quantity");
            IF NOT ValueOK THEN BEGIN
              Item.GET(SalesLineTemp."No.");
              Item.SETFILTER("Location Filter",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Location Code");
              IF SalesLineTemp."Variant Code" <> '' THEN
                Item.SETRANGE("Variant Filter",SalesLineTemp."Variant Code");
              ValueOK := Item.AvailableQuantity = 0;
            END;
            IF ValueOK THEN
              CloseExistPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",SalesLineTemp."Line No.","System Value Line",'')
            ELSE
              ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(
                "Sales Header",SalesLineTemp."Line No.","System Value Line",'',"System Value Line".Description,FALSE,FALSE));
            ValueHeaderOK := ValueHeaderOK AND ValueOK;
          UNTIL SalesLineTemp.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      EXIT(NOT ValueOK)
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckRFMR@1000000042(VAR ParSalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36) : Boolean;
    VAR
      Customer@1000000005 : Record 18;
      PaymentMethod@1000000008 : Record 289;
      RFMRScoringEntry@1000000015 : Record 5275414;
      RFMRScoringResultLine@1000000014 : Record 5275413;
      RFMRScoringHeader@1000000013 : Record 5275411;
      RFMRSetup@1000000007 : Record 5275410;
      RFMRSetupBase@1000000017 : Record 5275410;
      SystemValueLine@1000000004 : Record 5105031;
      RFMRMgt@1000000012 : Codeunit 5275330;
      SystemValueCode@1000000001 : Code[10];
      AllowedTakeOverDate@1000000016 : Date;
      SystemValueNo@1000000002 : Integer;
      Anz15@1000000009 : Integer;
      Anz0@1000000010 : Integer;
      ValueOK@1000000003 : Boolean;
      InfoText@1000000011 : Text[100];
    BEGIN

      // 01 03.12.12 GWUL BFS00020 Integration Aussteuerung RFMR vs. Zahlungsform
      SystemValueCode := 'RFMR';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      ValueOK := FALSE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(ParSalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // Get "System Value Line"
      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"(SystemValueLine,SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // 01 06.02.17 MHEL 10053348 Aussteuerung nach RFMR-Klasse
      // Get Customer
      IF NOT Customer.GET(ParSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.") THEN
        InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text051,ParSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.")
      ELSE
        IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 2" <> '' THEN BEGIN
          IF SystemValueLine."Code Value 2" = Customer."RFMR Scoring Class" THEN BEGIN
            InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text057,Customer."RFMR Scoring Class");
            ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(ParSalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'',InfoText,TRUE,SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3" <> 0));
            EXIT(ValueOK);
          END ELSE
            ValueOK := TRUE;
        END;
      // 01 06.02.17 MHEL 10053348 Aussteuerung nach RFMR-Klasse Ende

      // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben
        //// Get "Customer Setup"
        //IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        //  EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get RFMR Setup"(RFMRSetupBase,RFMRSetupBase."Scoring Type"::Setup,'',TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);
      // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben Ende

      IF ParSalesHeader."Payment Method Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN

        // Get "RFMR Scoring Header"
        // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben
          //IF RFMRScoringHeader.GET(CustomerSetup."PayMethodCheck RFMR Set No.") THEN BEGIN
        IF RFMRScoringHeader.GET(RFMRSetupBase."PayMethodCheck RFMR Set No.") THEN BEGIN
        // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben Ende

          // 01 06.02.17 MHEL 10053348 Aussteuerung nach RFMR-Klasse
          //// Get Customer
          //IF NOT Customer.GET(ParSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.") THEN
          //  InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text051,ParSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
          // 01 06.02.17 MHEL 10053348 Aussteuerung nach RFMR-Klasse Ende

          // Gibt es einen aktuellen Eintrag?
          // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben
            //AllowedTakeOverDate := CALCDATE(STRSUBSTNO('-%1',CustomerSetup.MaxAge_RFMRClass),WORKDATE);
          AllowedTakeOverDate := CALCDATE(STRSUBSTNO('-%1',RFMRSetupBase.MaxAge_RFMRClass),WORKDATE);
          // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben Ende
          RFMRScoringEntry.RESET;
          RFMRScoringEntry.SETRANGE("Scoring Type",RFMRScoringEntry."Scoring Type"::"0");
          RFMRScoringEntry.SETRANGE("No.",Customer."No.");
          RFMRScoringEntry.SETFILTER("Take Over Date",'%1..',AllowedTakeOverDate);
          IF RFMRScoringEntry.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
            IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get RFMR Setup"(RFMRSetup,RFMRSetup."Scoring Type"::"0",RFMRScoringEntry."RFMR Scoring Class",TRUE,FALSE) THEN
              EXIT(ValueOK);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            // Wenn es keinen aktuellen Eintrag gibt, dann Customer scoren

            RFMRMgt.HideDialog(TRUE);
            RFMRMgt."xRFMR ScoringCustomer"(Customer,RFMRScoringHeader);
            // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben
              //IF NOT RFMRScoringResultLine.GET(CustomerSetup."PayMethodCheck RFMR Set No.",Customer."No.") THEN
            IF NOT RFMRScoringResultLine.GET(RFMRSetupBase."PayMethodCheck RFMR Set No.",Customer."No.") THEN
            // 01 11.12.14 KMAR MAC000429 Felder 5275410,5275411,5275412,5275416 aus T87000 in T5275410 verschoben Ende
              EXIT(ValueOK);

            RFMRMgt.HideDialog(TRUE);
            RFMRMgt.TakeOverCustomer(RFMRScoringHeader,
              RFMRScoringResultLine."No.",
              RFMRScoringResultLine.Points,
              RFMRScoringResultLine."Base Date");

            IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get RFMR Setup"(RFMRSetup,RFMRSetup."Scoring Type"::"0",RFMRScoringResultLine."Score Class Code",TRUE,FALSE) THEN
              EXIT(ValueOK);
          END;

          PaymentMethod.RESET;
          PaymentMethod.FILTERGROUP(15);
          PaymentMethod.SETFILTER(Code,ParSalesHeader."Payment Method Code");
          PaymentMethod.FILTERGROUP(16);
          PaymentMethod.SETFILTER(Code,RFMRSetup.PayMethFilter);
          IF PaymentMethod.ISEMPTY THEN
            InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text050,RFMRScoringResultLine."Score Class Code",RFMRSetup.PayMethFilter)
          ELSE BEGIN
            // Bei Zahlart Rechnung den Kreditlimitbetrag kontrollieren
            PaymentMethod.FINDFIRST;
            IF PaymentMethod."Payment Type Code" <> 'INVOICE' THEN
              ValueOK := TRUE
            ELSE BEGIN
              ParSalesHeader.CALCFIELDS(Amount);
              IF ParSalesHeader.Amount > RFMRSetup.CreditLimitAmount THEN
                InfoText := STRSUBSTNO(Text053,RFMRSetup.CreditLimitAmount,ParSalesHeader.Amount-RFMRSetup.CreditLimitAmount,RFMRSetup.Code)
              ELSE
                ValueOK := TRUE;
            END;
          END;
        END ELSE
          ValueOK := TRUE;
      END;

      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(ParSalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'')
      ELSE
        ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(ParSalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine,'',InfoText,TRUE,SystemValueLine."Calc Value 3" <> 0));

      EXIT(ValueOK);
      // 01 03.12.12 GWUL BFS00020 Integration Aussteuerung RFMR vs. Zahlungsform Ende
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckQSH@1000000043(VAR SalesHeader@1000 : Record 36;Discription@1007 : Text[250];SetValueOK@1006 : Boolean) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1005 : Record 5105031;
      SystemValueNo@1002 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1001 : Code[10];
    BEGIN
      // GF 17.04.13 KKAA MAC000322 CheckQSH
      // Funktion wird von "au·en" aufgerufen, da die Versandkostenermittlung nichtas prÅfbares verÑndert
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'QSH';
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      // Aussteuerungskennzeichen Aktiv?
      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // Funktionen wird von au·en aufgerufen werden, darf nicht temp. arbeiten
      // SetValueOK von au·en immer false
      IF NOT SetValueOK THEN
        PostProcessingEntry2TempEntry(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode);

      ValueOK := SetValueOK;

      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcEntryDescrip(SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',Discription)
      ELSE
        ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(
          SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',Discription,FALSE,FALSE));

      IF NOT SetValueOK THEN
        TempEntries2Database(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode,FALSE);
      EXIT(ValueOK)
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckChargebackPayCo@1000000045(VAR SalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesPSPCard@1000000001 : Record 5227625;
      "System Value Line"@1000000004 : Record 5105031;
      SystemValueNo@1000000003 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1000000002 : Code[10];
      PayCoHandling@1000000005 : Codeunit 5227637;
    BEGIN
      // 01 04.09.13 OZEM BDC00016 Integration PayCo Aussteuerung Zahlung vom Kunden zurÅck gezogen
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      SystemValueCode := 'CBPAYCO';
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      // Aussteurungskennezeichen Aktiv?
      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(SalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // Ist es ein PayCo Auftrag?
      IF NOT PayCoHandling.IsPayCoOrder(SalesHeader."Payment Method Code")THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // PrÅfen, ob in der Beschreibung der Sales PSP Card "CHARGEBACK" steht, dann aussteuern
      IF SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order,SalesHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
        IF UPPERCASE(SalesPSPCard."Status Description") = 'CHARGEBACK' THEN
          ValueOK := FALSE;
      END;

      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcEntryDescrip(SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',"System Value Line".Description)
      ELSE
        ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry(
          SalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',"System Value Line".Description,FALSE,FALSE));

      // 01 04.09.13 OZEM BDC00016 Integration PayCo Aussteuerung Zahlung vom Kunden zurÅck gezogen ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetWorkingType@1000000046(NewWorkingType@1000000001 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      // GF 21.01.14 KKAA MAC000336 SetWorkingType, Aussteueurng Versandkosten EK
      IF (WorkingType > 0) AND (NewWorkingType = 0) THEN
        EXIT;
      WorkingType := NewWorkingType;
      IF WorkingType = 0 THEN
        WorkingType := DATABASE::"Sales Header";
      CASE WorkingType OF
        DATABASE::"Purchase Header",DATABASE::"Purchase Line": WorkingEntryType := WorkingEntryType::Purchase;
        DATABASE::"Transfer Header",DATABASE::"Transfer Line": WorkingEntryType := WorkingEntryType::Transfer;
        ELSE
          WorkingEntryType := WorkingEntryType::Sales;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE TotalShipmentPayCo@1000000048(VAR "Sales Header"@1000 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1004 : Record 5105031;
      "Voucher Setup"@1000000004 : Record 5104620;
      SalesPSPCard@1000000005 : Record 5227625;
      "Set Item Management"@1000000000 : Codeunit 5104800;
      PayCoHandling@1000000006 : Codeunit 5227637;
      SystemValueNo@1003 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1002 : Code[10];
      DispoLineExists@1000000001 : Boolean;
      CountDispoLineExists@1140000 : Integer;
      AnythingToHandle@1000000002 : Boolean;
      EntryDescription@1000000003 : Text[80];
    BEGIN
      // Gesamtlieferung
      // GF 05.06.14 OZEM 10049689 Aussteueren wenn keine Teillieferung bei PayCo zugelassen ist vom Anbieter
      SystemValueCode := 'VERS_PAYCO';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode("Sales Header",SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT PayCoHandling.IsPayCoOrder("Sales Header"."Payment Method Code")THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT SalesPSPCard.GET("Sales Header"."Document Type","Sales Header"."No.") THEN BEGIN
        EXIT(ValueOK);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF SalesPSPCard."Partial Capture" = SalesPSPCard."Partial Capture"::Yes THEN
          EXIT(ValueOK);
      END;

      // Nur Sachkontozeilen
      SalesLineTemp.RESET;
      SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Sales Header"."Document Type");
      SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","Sales Header"."No.");
      SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
      SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::Set);
      SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0.0);
      IF SalesLineTemp.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        SalesLineTemp.RESET;
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Sales Header"."Document Type");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","Sales Header"."No.");
        SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER(Type,'<>%1',SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
        SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0.0);
        IF NOT SalesLineTemp.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          EXIT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;

      // Reine GutscheinauftrÑge dÅrfen wegen Versandanweisung nicht ausgesteuert werden
      "Setup Get"."Get Voucher Setup"("Voucher Setup",FALSE, FALSE);
      IF "Voucher Setup"."Present Voucher Process" > "Voucher Setup"."Present Voucher Process"::" " THEN BEGIN
        SalesLineTemp.RESET;
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Sales Header"."Document Type");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","Sales Header"."No.");
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
        SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0.0);
        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Item used as",SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::PresentVoucher);
        IF NOT SalesLineTemp.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          SalesLineTemp.RESET;
          SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Sales Header"."Document Type");
          SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","Sales Header"."No.");
          SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0.0);
          SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::PresentVoucher);
          IF SalesLineTemp.ISEMPTY THEN
            EXIT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;

      // 01 14.07.16 JLIN 10060749 Anpassung (Bereinigung & saubere Integration 10047349)
      //// keine offnene Menge (BillPay)
      //SalesLineTemp.RESET;
      //SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document Type","Sales Header"."Document Type");
      //SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Document No.","Sales Header"."No.");
      //SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0);
      //IF SalesLineTemp.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
      //  EXIT(TRUE);
      //END;
      // 01 14.07.16 JLIN 10060749 Anpassung (Bereinigung & saubere Integration 10047349) Ende

      "Sales Header".SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
      "Sales Header".VALIDATE("Shipping Mode");
      "Sales Header".SetHideValidationDialog(FALSE);

      CountDispoLineExists := 0;

      // 01 26.02.18 KAND STD-977 Field 5295850 'Subscription No.' in Flowfield geÑndert und in Document Values verlagert.
      "Sales Header".CALCFIELDS("Subscription No.");
      // 01 26.02.18 KAND STD-977 Field 5295850 'Subscription No.' in Flowfield geÑndert und in Document Values verlagert. ENDE

      // 01 26.02.18 KAND STD-977 Field 5295851 'Subscription Code' in Flowfield geÑndert und in Document Values verlagert.
      "Sales Header".CALCFIELDS("Subscription Code");
      // 01 26.02.18 KAND STD-977 Field 5295851 'Subscription Code' in Flowfield geÑndert und in Document Values verlagert. ENDE

      IF ("Sales Header"."Order Type" = "Sales Header"."Order Type"::Subscription) AND
         ("Sales Header"."Subscription No." <> '') AND
         ("Sales Header"."Subscription Code" <> '')
      THEN BEGIN
        ValueOK := TRUE;
        IF ValueOK THEN
          CloseExistPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'');
        EXIT(ValueOK);
      END;

      IF "Sales Header"."Shipping Advice" = "Sales Header"."Shipping Advice"::Complete THEN BEGIN
        SalesLineTemp.RESET;

        SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::Set);

        SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);

        IF SalesLineTemp.FIND('-') THEN
          REPEAT
            SalesLineTemp.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
            SalesLineTemp.CALCFIELDS("Disposition Status");
            ValueOK :=
               (SalesLineTemp."Outstanding Quantity" = SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity") OR
               (STRPOS("System Value Line"."Code Value 1",SalesLineTemp."Disposition Status") <> 0) OR
               (NOT (SalesLineTemp."Item used as" IN [SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::Item,SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::Component]));

            DispoLineExists :=
              DispoLineExists OR
                ((STRPOS("System Value Line"."Code Value 1",SalesLineTemp."Disposition Status") <> 0) AND
                 (SalesLineTemp."Outstanding Quantity" <> SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity"));

            IF (STRPOS("System Value Line"."Code Value 1",SalesLineTemp."Disposition Status") <> 0) THEN
              IF (SalesLineTemp."Outstanding Quantity" <> SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity") THEN
                CountDispoLineExists += 1;


            IF (NOT AnythingToHandle) THEN
              AnythingToHandle := SalesLineTemp."Reserved Quantity" > 0;
          UNTIL (SalesLineTemp.NEXT = 0) OR NOT ValueOK;

        // Hier: SplittauftrÑge KKOE
        IF ValueOK AND DispoLineExists THEN BEGIN
          "Sales Header".SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
          "Sales Header".VALIDATE("Shipping Advice","Sales Header"."Shipping Advice"::Partial);
          "Sales Header".SetHideValidationDialog(FALSE);
        END;

        IF NOT ValueOK THEN BEGIN
          "Sales Header".SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
          "Sales Header".VALIDATE("Shipping Mode");
          "Sales Header".SetHideValidationDialog(FALSE);
          ValueOK := "Sales Header"."Shipping Advice" = "Sales Header"."Shipping Advice"::Partial;
        END;

        IF ValueOK AND (SalesLineTemp.COUNT > 0) THEN
          ValueOK := SalesLineTemp.COUNT > CountDispoLineExists;

        EntryDescription := STRSUBSTNO(Text017,
          FORMAT("Sales Header"."Document Type"),
          "Sales Header"."No.",
          "Sales Header".FIELDCAPTION("Shipping Advice"),
          "Sales Header"."Shipping Advice");
        IF ValueOK AND NOT AnythingToHandle THEN BEGIN
          CLEAR(ValueOK);
          EntryDescription := Text018;
        END;

        IF ValueOK THEN
            CloseExistPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'')
        ELSE
          ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'',EntryDescription,FALSE,FALSE));
      END ELSE BEGIN
        ValueOK := "Set Item Management".CalcQtyToHandle
          (DATABASE::"Sales Line","Sales Header"."Document Type","Sales Header"."No.",0,'');

        IF NOT ValueOK THEN BEGIN
          SalesLineTemp.RESET;
          SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Item used as",'<>%1',SalesLineTemp."Item used as"::Set);
          SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLineTemp.Type::Item);
          SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Drop Shipment",TRUE);
          IF  SalesLineTemp.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Drop Shipment",FALSE);
            SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'<>%1',0);
            SalesLineTemp.SETFILTER("Reserved Quantity",'<>%1',0);
            IF SalesLineTemp.FIND('-') THEN
              ValueOK := TRUE
            ELSE BEGIN
              SalesLineTemp.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity");
              ValueOK := NOT SalesLineTemp.FIND('-');
            END;
          END;
        END;

        IF ValueOK THEN
          CloseExistPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'')
        ELSE
          ValueOK := NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'',Text018 + ' ' +
            STRSUBSTNO(Text017,FORMAT("Sales Header"."Document Type"),"Sales Header"."No.",
            "Sales Header".FIELDCAPTION("Shipping Advice"),"Sales Header"."Shipping Advice"),
            FALSE,FALSE));
      END;

      EXIT(ValueOK);
    END;

    PROCEDURE PayMethodPayCo@1000000049(VAR "Sales Header"@1003 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1002 : Record 5105031;
      "System Value Line1"@1000000000 : Record 5105031;
      CustomerBankAccount@1000000009 : Record 287;
      DocumentClearing@1000000010 : Record 5104912;
      SalesPSPCard@1000000012 : Record 5227625;
      QuickSalesCheckOrder@1000000002 : Codeunit 5104607;
      "PayPal Management"@1000000003 : Codeunit 5275337;
      DiVALicenceManagement@1000000008 : Codeunit 5105099;
      DiVAFinanceManagement@1000000007 : Codeunit 5104900;
      PayCoHandling@1000000011 : Codeunit 5227637;
      LicensePermission@1000000005 : Record 2000000043;
      PaymentMethod@1000000006 : Record 289;
      eBankSetup@1000000004 : Record 5275415;
      SystemValueNo@1001 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1000 : Code[10];
      Description@1000000001 : Text[80];
    BEGIN
      // GF 11.06.14 OZEM 10049689 Aussteueren bei Voraus von PayCo, wenn Betrag nicht stimmt
      SystemValueCode := 'VOR_PAYCO';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode("Sales Header",SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT PayCoHandling.IsPayCoOrder("Sales Header"."Payment Method Code")THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT SalesPSPCard.GET("Sales Header"."Document Type","Sales Header"."No.") THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF (PaymentMethod.GET("Sales Header"."Payment Method Code") AND NOT (PaymentMethod."Payment Type Code" IN ['PREPAY VIA PAYCO'])) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF "Sales Header"."Payment Method Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN

        // Aussteuerung ZLGFORM: BerÅcksichtigung "Immer Aussteuern" (SysVal 63810) bei allen Zahlungsformen
        IF "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line1",
          "System Value Line"."Ref. System Value No.","Sales Header"."Payment Method Code",TRUE,FALSE) THEN BEGIN
          ValueOK := NOT ("System Value Line1"."Bool 1");
          Description := Text049;
        END ELSE
          "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"(
             "System Value Line1","System Value Line"."Ref. System Value No.",'<NOTSPECIFIED>',FALSE,FALSE);

        IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN

        // Aussteuerung ZLGFORM erweitert, Zahlungsform lÑnderabhÑngig
        ValueOK :=
          // 01 09.05.16 KMAR 10055403 PrÅfung Zahlungsform
            // QuickSalesCheckOrder.CheckPaymentMethodCountry(
            //  "Sales Header"."Payment Method Code","Sales Header"."Bill-to Country/Region Code",FALSE,'');
          PaymentMethod.PaymentMethodLookup("Sales Header"."Payment Method Code","Sales Header"."Bill-to Country/Region Code","Sales Header"."Bill-to Customer No.","Sales Header"."Prom.Med.No.",TRUE);
        // 01 09.05.16 KMAR 10055403 PrÅfung Zahlungsform Ende
        IF ValueOK THEN
          Description := Text019
        ELSE
          Description := STRSUBSTNO(Text031 ,
            "Sales Header".FIELDCAPTION("Payment Method Code"),
            "Sales Header"."Payment Method Code",
            "Sales Header".FIELDCAPTION("Bill-to Country/Region Code"),
            "Sales Header"."Bill-to Country/Region Code");
        END;

        // Bankdaten fÅr Zahlungsformen mit Zahlart Bankeinzug prÅfen
        IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN
          IF ("Sales Header"."Payment Method Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
            "Setup Get"."Get PaymentMethod"(PaymentMethod,"Sales Header"."Payment Method Code",FALSE,FALSE);
            IF (PaymentMethod."Payment Type Code" = 'BANK COLLECTION' ) THEN BEGIN
              // Debitor abgrenzen
              CustomerBankAccount.SETRANGE("Customer No.","Sales Header"."Bill-to Customer No.");
              ValueOK := TRUE;
              IF DiVALicenceManagement.CheckLic_eBank(TRUE,TRUE) THEN BEGIN
                "Setup Get"."Get eBank Setup"(eBankSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
                CASE eBankSetup."gen. Cust. Bank Acc. (ebank)" OF
                  eBankSetup."gen. Cust. Bank Acc. (ebank)"::"no auto- Generation",
                  eBankSetup."gen. Cust. Bank Acc. (ebank)"::"Cust. Clearing-Bank-Acc. auto-gen.",
                  eBankSetup."gen. Cust. Bank Acc. (ebank)"::"Cust. Bank-Acc. (Clearing=No) auto-gen.":
                    BEGIN
                      CustomerBankAccount.SETRANGE("akq Clearing",TRUE);
                    END;
                  eBankSetup."gen. Cust. Bank Acc. (ebank)"::"Cust. Clearing Bank-Acc. and Document-Link auto-gen.":
                    BEGIN
                      DocumentClearing.RESET;
                      DocumentClearing.SETCURRENTKEY("Customer No.","Document Type","Document No.","Document Clearing");
                      DocumentClearing.SETRANGE("Customer No.","Sales Header"."Bill-to Customer No.");
                      DocumentClearing.SETRANGE("Document Type","Sales Header"."Document Type");
                      DocumentClearing.SETRANGE("Document No.","Sales Header"."No.");

      END ELSE

    PROCEDURE ReturnOrderPaypalRefund@1000000099(VAR PSalesHeader@1000000000 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      LText001@1000000001 : TextConst 'DEU=Der gutzuschreibende Betrag %1 ist grî·er als der Restbetrag von %2!';
      LSalesCreditMemoHeader@1000000008 : Record 114;
      LSalesLine@1000000006 : Record 37;
      LSystemValueLine@1000000004 : Record 5105031;
      LTempVatAmtLine@1000000005 : TEMPORARY Record 290;
      LPaypalMgmt@1000000007 : Codeunit 5275337;
      LVoucherMgmt@1000000011 : Codeunit 5104620;
      LSystemValueNo@1000000003 : Integer;
      LRemainingAmt@1000000009 : Decimal;
      LReturnOrderAmt@1000000010 : Decimal;
      LSystemValueCode@1000000002 : Code[10];
    BEGIN

      // 01 29.04.16 AVOS 10058627 Paypal Modul: Unkontrollierte Erstellung von DoRefund Paypal Posten aus T36 / OnDelete (10051631 nachgezogen)
      // 01 04.11.14 JLIN 10051631 Aussteuerung Reklamation bei zu hohen ErstattungsbetrÑgen

      // PrÅfung Erstattungsbetrag gegen bereits erfolgte Paypal-Refunds

      LSystemValueNo := 63800;
      LSystemValueCode := 'RETAMT_PP';
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      // Nur Reklamationen beachten
      IF PSalesHeader."Document Type" <> PSalesHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order" THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // PrÅfen, ob Aussteuerungskennzeichen angelegt ist und verwendet wird
      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"(LSystemValueLine,LSystemValueNo,LSystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);
      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode(PSalesHeader,LSystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // Nur Zahlungsform Paypal mit Transaktions-ID beachten
      IF NOT LPaypalMgmt.IsPayPalOrder(PSalesHeader)
      OR (PSalesHeader."PayPal Transaction ID" = '') THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      // Ermittlung des nach bisherigen Refunds beim HÑndler verbliebenen Betrags
      CLEAR(LSalesCreditMemoHeader);
      LSalesCreditMemoHeader.TRANSFERFIELDS(PSalesHeader);
      LRemainingAmt := LPaypalMgmt."GetRem.Inv.Amt.To.Cre.Memo"(LSalesCreditMemoHeader);

      // Ermittlung des Betrags der Reklamation
      CLEAR(LVoucherMgmt);
      //IF PSalesHeader.Invoice THEN BEGIN
      PSalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Voucher applied");
      IF PSalesHeader."Voucher applied" THEN BEGIN
        // 01 19.10.15 AVOS PLUS00048 Parameter erweitert
        // AVOS OLD LReturnOrderAmt := -ABS(LVoucherMgmt."Calc. + store Voucher Amt. V2"(PSalesHeader)); // LCY
        LReturnOrderAmt := -ABS(LVoucherMgmt."Calc. + store Voucher Amt. V2"(PSalesHeader,'')); // LCY
        // 01 19.10.15 AVOS PLUS00048 Parameter erweitert
        LReturnOrderAmt += ABS(LVoucherMgmt.GetLastDocumentAmountLCY);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        //LReturnOrderAmt := ABS(LVoucherMgmt.CalcSalesHeaderAmount(PSalesHeader,TRUE));
        CLEAR(LSalesLine);
        LSalesLine.CalcVATAmountLines(0,PSalesHeader,LSalesLine,LTempVatAmtLine);
        LReturnOrderAmt := LTempVatAmtLine.GetTotalAmountInclVAT();
      END;
      //END;

      // PrÅfung der errechneten BetrÑge
      ValueOK := LRemainingAmt >= LReturnOrderAmt;

      // Handling Nachbearbeitungsposten
      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcessingEntry(PSalesHeader,0,LSystemValueLine,'')
      ELSE
        InsertPostProcessingEntry(
          PSalesHeader,0,LSystemValueLine,'',STRSUBSTNO(LText001,LReturnOrderAmt,LRemainingAmt),FALSE,FALSE);

      EXIT(ValueOK);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalcAmountInInvoice@1001050008(ParInvoiceNo@1001050002 : Code[20];PosNo@1001050001 : Integer;ItemNo@1001050000 : Code[20];pInvoiceLineNo@301490000 : Integer) Amount : Decimal;
    VAR
      SalesInvoiceLine@1001050003 : Record 113;
    BEGIN
      // 01 13.03.17 AJAS STD-194 Zeilbetrag in der Reklamation PrÅfen
      SalesInvoiceLine.RESET;
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",ParInvoiceNo);
      // 01 14.07.20 MKLE DEVOPS-4087 SYSTEMRET orig. Rechnungszeile wird nicht gefunden
      IF (pInvoiceLineNo > 0) THEN
        SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",pInvoiceLineNo)
      ELSE
      // 01 14.07.20 MKLE DEVOPS-4087 SYSTEMRET orig. Rechnungszeile wird nicht gefunden ENDE
        SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Pos. No.",PosNo);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("No.",ItemNo);
      IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDSET THEN
         REPEAT
          Amount := Amount + SalesInvoiceLine."Line Amount";
         UNTIL  SalesInvoiceLine.NEXT=0;
      EXIT(Amount);

    PROCEDURE SendMailsByFilter@1001050012(PPostProcessingCodeFilter@1001050006 : Code[20];PPostProcessingAreaFilter@1001050005 : Code[20];PPostProcessingDateFilter@1001050000 : Text[250]);
    VAR
      LPostProcessingOrder@1001050001 : Query 5104951;
      LTempSalesHeader@1001050002 : TEMPORARY Record 36;
      LBackupType@1001050003 : Integer;
      LBackupNo@1001050004 : Code[20];

      LMailautomationEMailCode@1001050018 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      // 01 10.07.17 MJEP MPD-31 Automatische Kommunikation bei AussteuerungsgrÅnden

      IF NOT LTempSalesHeader.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        ERROR(LText000, LTempSalesHeader.TABLECAPTION);

      // MailautomationEMail.Code auswÑhlen
      LMailautomationEMail.RESET;

      IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(5275380, LMailautomationEMail) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
        LMailautomationEMailCode := LMailautomationEMail.Code;

      CLEAR(LPostProcessingOrder);

      LPostProcessingOrder.SETFILTER(LPostProcessingOrder.Post_Processing_Area, PPostProcessingAreaFilter);
      LPostProcessingOrder.SETFILTER(LPostProcessingOrder.Insert_Date,PPostProcessingDateFilter);

      LPostProcessingOrder.OPEN;
      LOrderFilter := '';
      WHILE LPostProcessingOrder.READ DO BEGIN
        IF((LBackupType <> LPostProcessingOrder.Document_Type) OR (LBackupNo <> LPostProcessingOrder.No)) THEN BEGIN
          AddSalesHeaderObjectByFilter(LTempSalesHeader, LOrderFilter, LBackupType, LPostProcessingOrder.Document_Type, LPostProcessingOrder.No, FALSE);
        END;
        LBackupNo := LPostProcessingOrder.No;
        LBackupType := LPostProcessingOrder.Document_Type;
      END;
      AddSalesHeaderObjectByFilter(LTempSalesHeader, LOrderFilter, LBackupType, 0, '', TRUE);
      LPostProcessingOrder.CLOSE();

      // Mails versenden
      IF LTempSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          // Mehrfachversenden der gleichen Mail verhindern.
          // --------------------------------------------------
          // Im Mailtemplate kann das Flag Status::Request on multiple Send gesetzt werden. Dies fÅhrt bei der
          // AusfÅhrung mit GUIDALLOWED zu einer Abfrage, ohne GUIDALLOWED wird die Mail nicht erneut versandt.
          LMailCreateautomEMail.SalesHeaderMail(LMailautomationEMailCode, LTempSalesHeader, USERID, FALSE);

      //  LMailHead.RESET;

      //  LMailHead.SETRANGE("Source Table",36);
      //  LMailHead.SETRANGE("Source No", LTempSalesHeader."No.");
      //  IF LMailHead.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
      //    LMailCreateautomEMail.SalesHeaderMail(LMailautomationEMailCode, LTempSalesHeader, USERID, FALSE);
      //  END;
        UNTIL LTempSalesHeader.NEXT = 0;
      END

      // 01 10.07.17 MJEP MPD-31 Automatische Kommunikation bei AussteuerungsgrÅnden end
    END;

    PROCEDURE AddSalesHeaderObjectByFilter@1001050011(VAR PTempSalesHeader@1001050000 : TEMPORARY Record 36;VAR orderFilter@1001050001 : Text;backupType@1001050002 : Integer;currentType@1001050003 : Integer;currentOrderNo@1001050004 : Code[20];forceDoNow@1001050005 : Boolean);
    VAR
      SalesHeader@1001050006 : Record 36;
      hasAdded@1001050007 : Boolean;
      LText000@1001050008 : TextConst 'DEU=Die lokale verwendete Variable des Record ''%1'' muss temporÑr sein!;ENU=The local used variable of the record ''%1'' has to be temporary!';
    BEGIN
      // 01 14.07.17 MJEP MPD-31 Funktion umbenannt und verschoben (ehemals PAGE."Post Processing".addObjectByFilter)
      IF NOT PTempSalesHeader.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        ERROR(LText000, PTempSalesHeader.TABLECAPTION);

      hasAdded := FALSE;
      IF (currentType = backupType) AND (currentOrderNo <> '') THEN BEGIN
        orderFilter := orderFilter + '|' + currentOrderNo;
        hasAdded := TRUE;
      END;

      IF (currentType <> backupType) OR (forceDoNow) OR (STRLEN(orderFilter) + 21 > MAXSTRLEN(orderFilter)) THEN BEGIN
        IF(orderFilter <> '') THEN  BEGIN
          orderFilter := DELCHR(orderFilter, '<>','|');
          CLEAR(SalesHeader);
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type", backupType);
          SalesHeader.SETFILTER("No.", orderFilter);
          IF SalesHeader.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            PTempSalesHeader.INIT();
            PTempSalesHeader.TRANSFERFIELDS(SalesHeader, TRUE);
            PTempSalesHeader.INSERT(FALSE);
          UNTIL SalesHeader.NEXT = 0;
          orderFilter := '';
        END;
      END;

      IF NOT hasAdded AND (currentOrderNo <> '') THEN
        orderFilter := orderFilter + '|' + currentOrderNo;
      // 01 14.07.17 MJEP MPD-31 Funktion umbenannt und verschoben (ehemals PAGE."Post Processing".addObjectByFilter) end
    END;

    PROCEDURE OrderAmount@1000000008(VAR "Sales Header"@1003 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@1002 : Record 5105031;
      "Sales Order Statistics"@1000000001 : Codeunit 5105008;

      //IF NOT "System Value Line".GET(SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode) THEN

      CLEAR("Sales Order Statistics");
      "Sales Order Statistics".GetTotalAmounts("Sales Header",TotalAmount1,TotalAmount2,TotalSalesLine1,TotalSalesLine2);

      // TotalAmount1[1] => EnthÑlt den Rechnungsbetrag exkl. MwSt (netto) in Beleg-WÑhrung
      // TotalAmount2[1] => EnthÑlt den Rechnungsbetrag inkl. MwSt (brutto) in Beleg-WÑhrung
      // TotalSalesLine1[1] => EnthÑlt den Rechnungsbetrag exkl. MwSt (netto) in MW
      // TotalSalesLine2[1] => EnthÑlt den Rechnungsbetrag inkl. MwSt (brutto) in MW
      // "System Value Line"."Calc Value 1" => EnthÑlt den minimalen Auftragswert
      // "System Value Line"."Calc Value 2" => EnthÑlt den maximalen Auftragswert

      ValueOK := NOT ((TotalSalesLine2[1].Amount < "System Value Line"."Calc Value 1") OR

                       ("System Value Line"."Calc Value 2" <> 0);

            STRSUBSTNO(

            TRUE,FALSE));

      EXIT(ValueOK);
      // 01 10.05.04 DPET SUPP00093 ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckIfExchangeOrder@611000000(pSalesHeader@611000000 : Record 36) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lSalesLine@611000001 : Record 37;
      CentralLogisticResRequest@301800000 : Codeunit 5104510;
    BEGIN
      // LF 28.07.20 ORUS DEVOPS-5386 neue lokale Funktion 'CheckIfExchangeOrder'

      IF pSalesHeader."Document Type" <> pSalesHeader."Document Type"::Order THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",lSalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",pSalesHeader."No.");
      IF lSalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        BEGIN
          lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Return Exchange",FALSE);
          EXIT(NOT lSalesLine.FINDSET);
        END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckForExpirationDate@611000001(pSalesPSPCard@611000001 : Record 5227625) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lPSPLog@611000003 : Record 5227626;
      lPSPExtendedSetup@611000006 : Record 5227633;
      lPspHdlgManagement@611000005 : Codeunit 5227622;
      lSkipCheck@611000002 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // LF 01.09.20 VKRO DEVOPS-6103 CheckForExpirationDate - ReservierungsgÅltigkeit bezogen auf angeforderte Zahlungsformen
      lSkipCheck := FALSE;

      // Zahlungform in Liste von angeforderten Zahlungsformen vom PSP extended Setup?
      IF lPspHdlgManagement."Get PSPExt.Setup"(lPSPExtendedSetup,pSalesPSPCard,FALSE) THEN
        IF lPSPExtendedSetup."Transaction Import Status" = lPSPExtendedSetup."Transaction Import Status"::Captured THEN
          EXIT(lSkipCheck);

      // vollstÑndig gecaptured?
      lSkipCheck := (pSalesPSPCard."Initial Reserv. Amount" = pSalesPSPCard."Status Amount Capture"); // Wenn die Werte Åbereinstimmen > Skip
      IF NOT lSkipCheck THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);

      // erfolgreicher PSP Log-Eintrag vorhanden?
      lPSPLog.RESET;
      lPSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry",pSalesPSPCard."Log No.");
      lPSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function,'CAPTURE');
      lPSPLog.SETRANGE("I_Error Code",'COMPLETED');
      lPSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Amount,(pSalesPSPCard."Status Amount Capture" * 100));
      lPSPLog.SETRANGE("Transaction OK",TRUE);
      lSkipCheck := NOT lPSPLog.ISEMPTY;
      IF NOT lSkipCheck THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);

      EXIT(NOT lSkipCheck);
    END;

    PROCEDURE Compliance@301510002(VAR "Sales Header"@1003 : Record 36) ValueOK : Boolean;
    VAR
      Customer@1006 : Record 18;
      "System Value Line"@1002 : Record 5105031;
      SystemValueNo@1001 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@1000 : Code[10];
      SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;
      LocSerial@301510001 : Text;
      lCHNXChronextIDMgt@301510002 : Codeunit 85010;
      PurchLineFound@301510003 : Boolean;
      PurchaseLine@301510004 : Record 39;
      TextCompliance@301510005 : TextConst 'DEU=Preis EK-Bestellung %1 nicht bestÑtigt!;ENU=Price Purchase Order %1 not confirmed!';
      lItemLedgerEntry@301510006 : Record 32;
      TextCompliance1@301510007 : TextConst 'DEU="Reservierung/Seriennr. prÅfen ";ENU=Reservation/Seialno. Check';
    BEGIN
      // Compliance Chron-22 NKON 06.04.22
      SystemValueCode := 'COMPLIANCE';  // in 68000
      SystemValueNo := 63800;        // code hier Reminder Terms Code (Mahnmethodencode)
      ValueOK := TRUE;



      IF NOT UsePostProcessingCode("Sales Header",SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT "Setup Get"."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(NOT ValueOK);

      Customer.GET("Sales Header"."Bill-to Customer No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type","Sales Header"."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.","Sales Header"."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Res. in Purchase Order No.",'');
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("Posting Group",'%1','KOMM*');
      IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          LocSerial:=FoundCorrectItemLedger(SalesLine);
          IF LocSerial <> '' THEN BEGIN
            lCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetPurchaseLineSerialNo(LocSerial,PurchaseLine,PurchLineFound);
            IF PurchLineFound THEN BEGIN
              ValueOK:=PurchaseLine."Price approved";
              IF NOT ValueOK THEN BEGIN
                 ValueOK:=(InsertPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'',STRSUBSTNO(
                      TextCompliance,PurchaseLine."Document No.","Sales Header"."Sell-to Customer No.",
                      "System Value Line"."Calc Value 1"),FALSE,FALSE));
                EXIT(ValueOK);
              END;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.");
              lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",LocSerial);
              //lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type", lItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase);
              lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item Tracking", lItemLedgerEntry."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.");
              lItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Entry Type",'<>%1',lItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase);
              lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
              IF NOT lItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
                EXIT(ValueOK);
            END;
          END ELSE
            ValueOK:=TRUE;
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Res. in Purchase Order No.");
        IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN
          IF SalesLine."Res. in Purchase Order No." <> '' THEN  BEGIN
            IF PurchaseLine.GET(PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order,SalesLine."Res. in Purchase Order No.",SalesLine."Res. in Purch. Order Line No.") THEN
              ValueOK:=PurchaseLine."Price approved";
            IF NOT ValueOK THEN BEGIN
                ValueOK:=(InsertPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'',STRSUBSTNO(
                    TextCompliance,PurchaseLine."Document No.","Sales Header"."Sell-to Customer No.",
                    "System Value Line"."Calc Value 1"),FALSE,FALSE));
              EXIT(ValueOK);
            END;
          END;

      END;
      IF ValueOK THEN
        CloseExistPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'')
      ELSE
        ValueOK :=
          NOT(InsertPostProcessingEntry("Sales Header",0,"System Value Line",'',STRSUBSTNO(
                    TextCompliance1,"Sales Header"."No.",
                    "System Value Line"."Calc Value 1"),FALSE,FALSE));

      EXIT(NOT ValueOK)
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalcMDFive@301510000();
    VAR
      ObjectInformation@301510000 : Record 5295565;
      ObjectVersioning@301510001 : Codeunit 5295563;
    BEGIN
      ObjectInformation.RESET;
      ObjectInformation.SETFILTER(MD5,'=%1','NEU');
      //ObjectInformation.SETFILTER(MD5,'3C-EE-F4-F1-16-F4-6D-45-57-BB-60-09-C6-53-2C-13');
      //ObjectInformation.SETRANGE(lastUpdateBy,'');
      ObjectInformation.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
        ObjectVersioning.UpdateInternalMD5FromFile(ObjectInformation."Object Type",ObjectInformation."Object ID");
      UNTIL ObjectInformation.NEXT = 0;
      //MESSAGE(FORMAT(ObjectInformation.COUNT));
      MESSAGE('durch');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckPrinterConnection@301510001();
    VAR
      ZPLViewerMgt@301510000 : Codeunit 5104848;
      FTPPrinter@301510001 : Record 5104853;
      LText001@301510002 : TextConst 'DEU=Verbindung zum Drucker %1 mit der IP %2 erfolgreich.';
      LText002@301510003 : TextConst 'DEU=Keine Verbindung zum Drucker %1 mit der IP %2 mîglich.';
      lBatchJobWizardManagement@301510005 : Codeunit 5139828;
      lPrinterFilter@301510004 : Text;
      Errormessage@301510006 : Text;
      CR@301510009 : Char;
      LF@301510008 : Char;
      CRLF@301510007 : Text[2];
    BEGIN
      CR := 13;
      LF := 10;
      CRLF := FORMAT(CR)+FORMAT(LF);
      lBatchJobWizardManagement.ReadVariable('PRINTERFILTER',lPrinterFilter);
      FTPPrinter.RESET;
      IF lPrinterFilter <> '' THEN
        FTPPrinter.SETFILTER("Printer ID",lPrinterFilter);
      FTPPrinter.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
        ZPLViewerMgt.SetPrinterID(FTPPrinter."Printer ID");
        IF NOT ZPLViewerMgt.PingPrinter(FTPPrinter."Printer ID",FALSE) THEN BEGIN
          Errormessage += STRSUBSTNO(LText002,FTPPrinter."Printer ID",ZPLViewerMgt.GetPrinterIP);
          Errormessage += CRLF;
          ZPLViewerMgt.SetPrinterID('');
        END;
        // END ELSE
        //  MESSAGE(STRSUBSTNO(LText001,FTPPrinter."Printer ID",ZPLViewerMgt.GetPrinterIP));
      UNTIL FTPPrinter.NEXT = 0;
      IF Errormessage <>'' THEN
        ERROR(Errormessage);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE JobLike@301510002();
    VAR
      lBatchJobWizardManagement@301510001 : Codeunit 5139828;
      lFunction@301510000 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF lBatchJobWizardManagement.ActivJob THEN BEGIN
        lBatchJobWizardManagement.ReadVariable('FUNKTION',lFunction);
        IF UPPERCASE(lFunction) = 'CHECKPRINTER' THEN
          CheckPrinterConnection;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      //00 09.06.23 KEGG MSD-23374 Problem with Label printer
    }
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ValidateAndCreateVendor@301510002();
    BEGIN
      SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE(Created,FALSE);
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
      VendorRec.RESET;
      VendorRec.SETRANGE(Name,SellWatchVendorInfo."Vendor Name");
      VendorRec.SETRANGE(Address,SellWatchVendorInfo.Address);
      VendorRec.SETRANGE("Phone No.",SellWatchVendorInfo.PhoneNo);
      VendorRec.SETRANGE("E-Mail",SellWatchVendorInfo.Email);
      IF NOT VendorRec.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        VendorRec.INIT;
        VendorRec."No.":='';
        VendorRec.Name:=SellWatchVendorInfo."Vendor Name";
      //  IF SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToAddress <> '' THEN BEGIN
      //    VendorRec.Address:=  SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToAddress;
      //    VendorRec.Street:= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToAddress;
      //    VendorRec.City:= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToCity;
      //    VendorRec.County:= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToCounty;
      //    VendorRec."Country/Region Code":= COPYSTR(SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToCountryCode,1,2);
      //    VendorRec."Post Code":= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToPostCode;
      //  END ELSE BEGIN
      //    VendorRec.Address:=  SellWatchVendorInfo.Address;
      //    VendorRec."Address 2":= SellWatchVendorInfo."Address 2";
      //    VendorRec.Street:= SellWatchVendorInfo.Address;
      //    VendorRec.City:= SellWatchVendorInfo.City;
      //    VendorRec.County:= SellWatchVendorInfo.County;
      //    VendorRec."Country/Region Code":= COPYSTR(SellWatchVendorInfo.CountryCode,1,2);
      //    VendorRec."Post Code":= SellWatchVendorInfo."Post Code";
      //  END;
          VendorRec.Address:=  SellWatchVendorInfo.Address;
          VendorRec."Address 2":= SellWatchVendorInfo."Address 2";
          VendorRec.Street:= SellWatchVendorInfo.Address;
          VendorRec.City:= SellWatchVendorInfo.City;
          VendorRec.County:= SellWatchVendorInfo.County;
          VendorRec."Country/Region Code":= COPYSTR(SellWatchVendorInfo.CountryCode,1,2);
          VendorRec."Post Code":= SellWatchVendorInfo."Post Code";

        VendorRec."Phone No.":= SellWatchVendorInfo.PhoneNo;
        VendorRec."E-Mail":= SellWatchVendorInfo.Email;
        //VendorRec.Blocked:= VendorRec.Blocked::All;
        VendorRec.SetPostingGroups;
        IF SellWatchVendorInfo.CurrencyCode<>'EUR' THEN
         VendorRec."Currency Code":=SellWatchVendorInfo.CurrencyCode;
        IF SellWatchVendorInfo."Offer Type"='commission' THEN
          VendorRec."Payment Method Code":= 'C2C'
        ELSE
          VendorRec."Payment Method Code":= 'RG';
        VendorRec.GetnewNoSeries(TRUE);
        VendorRec.INSERT(TRUE);
        VendorBank.INIT;
        VendorBank."Vendor No.":= VendorRec."No.";
        //IF SellWatchVendorInfo.IBAN <> '' THEN
          VendorBank.Code:= COPYSTR(SellWatchVendorInfo.IBAN,STRLEN(SellWatchVendorInfo.IBAN)-3,4)+' '+ SellWatchVendorInfo.CurrencyCode;
        VendorBank.IBAN:=SellWatchVendorInfo.IBAN;
        VendorBank."akq IBAN / SWIFT approved":= TRUE;
        VendorBank.INSERT(TRUE);
      END;
      CreatePurchaseOrder;
      UNTIL SellWatchVendorInfo.NEXT=0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrder@301510000();
    BEGIN
      IF (SellWatchVendorInfo."PO Number"='')OR (SellWatchVendorInfo."PO Number"='0') THEN BEGIN
      PHRec.INIT;
      PHRec."No.":='';
      PHRec."Document Type":= PHRec."Document Type"::Order;
      PHRec.INSERT(TRUE);
      PHRec.VALIDATE("Buy-from Vendor No.",VendorRec."No.");
      PHRec."Vendor Order No.":= SellWatchVendorInfo.SRid;
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToName<>'' THEN BEGIN
        PHRec."Pay-to Name":= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToName;
        PHRec."Pay-to Address":= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToAddress;
        PHRec."Pay-to City":= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToCity;
        PHRec."Pay-to Post Code":= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToPostCode;
        PHRec."Pay-to Country/Region Code":= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToCountryCode;
        PHRec."Pay-to County":= SellWatchVendorInfo.BillToCounty;
      END;
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo."Offer Type"='commission' THEN
        PHRec."Payment Method Code":= 'C2C'
      ELSE
        PHRec."Payment Method Code":= 'RG';
      PHRec.MODIFY;
      PLRec.INIT;
      PLRec."Document No.":= PHRec."No.";
      PLRec."Document Type":= PHRec."Document Type";
      PLRec."Line No.":= 10000;
      PLRec.VALIDATE(Type,PLRec.Type::Item);
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo."Offer Type"= 'commission' THEN BEGIN
      PLRec.VALIDATE("No.",'C2C-SW');
      PLRec."Variant Code":= 'C2C-SW';
      END;
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo."Offer Type"= 'direct' THEN BEGIN
      PLRec.VALIDATE("No.",'CPST-SW');
      PLRec."Variant Code":= 'CPST-SW';
      END;
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo."Offer Type"= 'exchange' THEN BEGIN
      PLRec.VALIDATE("No.",'TI-SW');
      PLRec."Variant Code":= 'TI-SW';
      END;
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo.Taxation= 'diff' THEN
        PLRec.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation", TRUE);
      PLRec.VALIDATE(Quantity,1);
      PLRec."Used good":= TRUE;
      PLRec.Amount:= SellWatchVendorInfo."Final Offer Price";
      PLRec.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost", SellWatchVendorInfo."Final Offer Price");
      PLRec.INSERT;
      ReleasePurchDoc.PerformManualRelease(PHRec);
      SellWatchVendorInfo."PO Number":= PHRec."No.";
      SellWatchVendorInfo.Created:= TRUE;
      SellWatchVendorInfo.VendorNo:= VendorRec."No.";
      SellWatchVendorInfo.MODIFY;
      CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnPurchaseRequest(PHRec);
      IF GUIALLOWED THEN
        MESSAGE('Vendor and PO created');
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrderinBV@301510001();
    BEGIN
      SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
      SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE(CreatePOinBV,TRUE);
      SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE("PO Number",'');
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF SellWatchVendorInfo.VendorNo <>'' THEN
          VendorRec.GET(SellWatchVendorInfo.VendorNo);
          CreatePurchaseOrder;
        UNTIL SellWatchVendorInfo.NEXT=0
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrderinGmBH@301510003();
    BEGIN
      IF (SellWatchVendorInfo."Offer Type"='commission') OR (SellWatchVendorInfo."Offer Type"='exchange') THEN
       CreatePurchaseOrder
      ELSE BEGIN
      SellWatchVendorInfo.CreatePOinBV:= TRUE;
      SellWatchVendorInfo.VendorNo:= VendorRec."No.";
      SellWatchVendorInfo.MODIFY;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnPurchaseRequest@301510045(PurchaseHeader@301510003 : Record 38);
    VAR
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480009 : Record 5275378;
      lExtInterfaceSetup@301510000 : Record 5275373;
      ExportSalesOrderGateway@301480004 : Codeunit 82013;
      IOStream@301480002 : OutStream;
      NotImplemented@301510001 : TextConst 'DEU=Externes Interface ist nicht implementiert;ENU=External Interface is not implemented';
      PurchaseLine@301510002 : Record 39;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT lExtInterfaceSetup.GET('SW') THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT lExtInterfaceSetup.Active THEN
          EXIT;

      IF PurchaseHeader."Document Type" <> PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order THEN
        EXIT;

      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INIT;
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::"to process";
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Code" := 'SWFILE';
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename := PurchaseHeader."No.";
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.User := USERID;
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(IOStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      IOStream.WRITE(CreateSourceFilePurchaseRequest(PurchaseHeader));
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;
