OBJECT Codeunit 50022 Auto Post PO C2C
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=17.05.24;
    Time=10:56:54;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=CNX.01;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=BEGIN
            SetVariables;

            CASE UPPERCASE(FunctionName) OF
              UPPERCASE('AUTOPOSTPO') : autoPostPO;
            END;


          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      g_recPH@301510000 : Record 38;
      g_recPL@301510001 : Record 39;
      g_cuPurchPost@301510002 : Codeunit 90;
      g_booC2C@301510003 : Boolean;
      g_date15Days@301510004 : Date;
      FunctionName@301510005 : Text;
      SalesLine@301510006 : Record 37;
      ReturnOrderFound@301510007 : Boolean;
      LastVendor@301510008 : Code[30];
      I@301510009 : Integer;
      SellWatchMgt@301510011 : Codeunit 50021;
      VendInfo@301510010 : Record 50012;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetVariables@3();
    VAR
      "Batch Job Wizard Management"@1000000001 : Codeunit 5139828;
    BEGIN

      "Batch Job Wizard Management".ReadVariable('FUNCTION',FunctionName);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE autoPostPO@301510000();
    BEGIN
      I:=1;
      g_recPH.RESET;
      g_recPH.SETRANGE("Document Type",g_recPH."Document Type"::Order);
      g_recPH.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','');
      //g_recPH.SETFILTER("No.",'%1..%2','BES0008041','BES0008960');
      g_recPH.SETFILTER("Buy-from Vendor No.",'%1..%2|%3..%4|%5','10000','29999','40000','41999','SW*');
      //g_recPH.SETFILTER("Buy-from Vendor No.",'%1..%2','10000','29999');
      IF g_recPH.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
         REPEAT
            g_booC2C := FALSE;
            ReturnOrderFound:=FALSE;
            CLEAR(g_date15Days);
            g_recPL.RESET;
            g_recPL.SETRANGE("Document Type",g_recPL."Document Type"::Order);
            g_recPL.SETRANGE("Document No.",g_recPH."No.");
            g_recPL.SETRANGE(Type,g_recPL.Type::Item);
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("Quantity Received",'>%1',0);
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("Quantity Invoiced",'%1',0);
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("Gen. Prod. Posting Group",'%1','KW*');
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("C2C Sold at",'<>%1',0D);
            IF g_recPL.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
              REPEAT
                g_date15Days := CALCDATE('<18D>',g_recPL."C2C Sold at");
                IF TODAY >= g_date15Days THEN
                   g_booC2C := TRUE;
                SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::"Return Order");
                SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",g_recPL."No.");
                SalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",g_recPL."Variant Code");
                IF SalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                  ReturnOrderFound:= TRUE;
                  g_recPL."C2C Sold at":= 0D;
                  g_recPL.MODIFY;
                END;
              UNTIL g_recPL.NEXT = 0;
            END;

            IF g_booC2C = TRUE AND NOT ReturnOrderFound THEN BEGIN
               g_recPH.Invoice := TRUE;
              IF LastVendor <> g_recPH."Buy-from Vendor No." THEN BEGIN
               g_recPH."Vendor Invoice No.":= FORMAT(TODAY,0,'<Year4><Month,2><Day,2>');
                I:=1;
              END ELSE BEGIN
                g_recPH."Vendor Invoice No.":= FORMAT(TODAY,0,'<Year4><Month,2><Day,2>')+'-'+FORMAT(I);
                I:= I+1;
              END;
               g_recPH."Posting Date" := TODAY;
               g_recPH.MODIFY;
               LastVendor:= g_recPH."Buy-from Vendor No.";
               g_cuPurchPost.RUN(g_recPH);
               NotifySoldToVendor(g_recPH);//SKU
               //MESSAGE('a %1',g_recPH."No.");
            END
         UNTIL g_recPH.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      g_recPH.RESET;
      g_recPH.SETRANGE("Document Type",g_recPH."Document Type"::Order);
      g_recPH.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','');
      //g_recPH.SETFILTER("No.",'%1..%2','BES0008041','BES0008960');
      g_recPH.SETFILTER("Buy-from Vendor No.",'<%1|>%2','10000','29999');
      g_recPH.SETFILTER("Vendor Invoice No.",'<>%1','');
      IF g_recPH.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
         REPEAT
            g_booC2C := FALSE;
            CLEAR(g_date15Days);
            g_recPL.RESET;
            g_recPL.SETRANGE("Document Type",g_recPL."Document Type"::Order);
            g_recPL.SETRANGE("Document No.",g_recPH."No.");
            g_recPL.SETRANGE(Type,g_recPL.Type::Item);
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("Quantity Received",'>%1',0);
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("Quantity Invoiced",'%1',0);
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("Gen. Prod. Posting Group",'%1','KW*');
            g_recPL.SETFILTER("C2C Sold at",'<>%1',0D);
            IF g_recPL.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
              REPEAT
                g_date15Days := CALCDATE('<15D>',g_recPL."C2C Sold at");
                IF TODAY >= g_date15Days THEN
                   g_booC2C := TRUE;
              UNTIL g_recPL.NEXT = 0;
            END;
            IF g_booC2C = TRUE THEN BEGIN
               g_recPH.Invoice := TRUE;
               g_recPH."Posting Date" := TODAY;
               g_recPH.MODIFY;
               g_cuPurchPost.RUN(g_recPH);
               //MESSAGE('b %1',g_recPH."No.");
            END;
         UNTIL g_recPH.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE NotifySoldToVendor@301510001(PH@301510000 : Record 38);
    BEGIN
      VendInfo.SETRANGE("PO Number",PH."No.");
      IF VendInfo.FINDFIRST THEN
      SellWatchMgt.CreateExternalInterfaceFileOnOrderStatusSE(VendInfo,4);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 01 21.06.22 VMO ERP-604 auto post C2C purch order
    }
    END.
  }
}

    PROCEDURE ReturnProduct@301510025(VAR pPspLog@301510001 : Record 5227626;VAR pSalesPspCard@301510000 : Record 5227625) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510004 : Record 36;
      LDOMResponseXML@301510006 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlDocument";
      successfull@301510002 : Boolean;
      LogItemsAmount@301510003 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      GetCreditPlusSetup(pSalesPspCard);
      InitPspLog(pPspLog, pSalesPspCard, 'returnProduct');
      InitXMLDoc();
      // Add Header & Body to Envelope (global)
      AddHeaderToEnvelope(GPspExtSetup."Account ID", GPspExtSetup."Account Password");
      IF NOT SalesHeader.GET(pSalesPspCard."Document Type", pSalesPspCard."No.") THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);
      // Check if it's a Credit Memo or Return Order Otherwise do not Refund
      IF NOT (SalesHeader."Document Type" IN [SalesHeader."Document Type"::"Credit Memo", SalesHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order"]) THEN BEGIN
        UpdatePspLog(pPspLog, pSalesPspCard, FALSE, TRUE);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
      SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
      AddReturnBodyToEnvelope(pSalesPspCard."Transaction Identifier", SalesHeader."Amount Including VAT", SalesHeader."No.", USERID, pSalesPspCard."Card Reference ID", SalesHeader."Posting Date");
      DOMDoc.AppendChild(DOMEnvelope);

      // Request/Response
      successfull := SendHttpWebRequest(pSalesPspCard, 'returnProduct');
      UpdatePspLog(pPspLog, pSalesPspCard, successfull, FALSE);

      //EXIT(pPspLog."Transaction OK");
      EXIT(successfull);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetCreditPlusSetup@301510004(pSalesPSPCard@301510002 : Record 5227625);
    VAR
      PspHdlgMgmt@301510001 : Codeunit 5227622;
      LHttpWebRequestMgt@301510000 : Codeunit 1297;
    BEGIN
      // PSP Einrichtung laden und prÅfen
      PspHdlgMgmt."Get PSPSetup"(GPspSetup, GSalesPSPCard."Payment handling with"::CreditPlus, 'CREDITPLUS');
      PspHdlgMgmt."Get PSPExt.Setup"(GPspExtSetup, pSalesPSPCard, FALSE);

      IF NOT GPspExtSetup."PSP Bool 1" THEN BEGIN     // Authorize only via Header Key/Value
        GPspExtSetup.TESTFIELD("Account ID");         // Username
        GPspExtSetup.TESTFIELD("Account Password");   // Password
      END ELSE BEGIN
        GPspExtSetup.TESTFIELD("PSP Text 1");         // Auth. Header Key
        GPspExtSetup.TESTFIELD("PSP Text 2");         // Auth. Header Value
      END;

      GPspExtSetup.TESTFIELD("URL 1");                // Server URL (API)

      // PrÅfung auf HttpS
      LHttpWebRequestMgt.CheckUrl(GPspExtSetup."URL 1");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InitXMLDoc@301510006();
    VAR
      DOMProcessingInstruction@301510000 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlProcessingInstruction";

      DOMEnvelope := DOMDoc.CreateElement('soapenv', 'Envelope', 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InitPspLog@301510010(PspLog@301510000 : Record 5227626;VAR SalesPSPCard@301510004 : Record 5227625;SOAPMethod@301510001 : Text);
    VAR
      PspLogInsert@301510002 : Record 5227626;
      PspLog2@301510003 : Record 5227626;
      PspLog1@301510005 : Record 5227626;
    BEGIN
      GSalesPSPCard := SalesPSPCard;
      // Create new PspLog for Cancel and Return
      IF (GPspLog."Log Entry" = 0) AND (SOAPMethod IN ['commitDelivery', 'cancelOrder', 'returnProduct']) THEN BEGIN
        PspLog1.RESET();
        PspLog1.SETRANGE("Log Entry", GSalesPSPCard."Log No.");
        PspLog1.SETRANGE("Payment handling with", GSalesPSPCard."Payment handling with");
        PspLog1.SETRANGE(O_Function,'RESERVE');
        PspLog1.SETRANGE("Transaction OK",TRUE);
        IF PspLog1.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          PspLogInsert.INIT;
          PspLogInsert.TRANSFERFIELDS(PspLog1);
          PspLogInsert."Log Entry" := GSalesPSPCard."Log No.";
          PspLogInsert."Payment handling with" := GSalesPSPCard."Payment handling with";
          // Find Next Entry No.
          PspLog2.SETRANGE("Log Entry",GSalesPSPCard."Log No.");
          IF PspLog2.FINDLAST THEN
            PspLogInsert."Entry No." := PspLog2."Entry No." + 1
          ELSE
            PspLogInsert."Entry No." := 1;
          PspLogInsert.O_OrderID := GSalesPSPCard."No.";

          CASE SOAPMethod OF
            'commitDelivery':
              PspLogInsert.O_Function := 'CAPTURE';
            //'changeOrder':
            //  PspLogInsert.O_Function := 'CHANGE';
            'cancelOrder':
              PspLogInsert.O_Function := 'CANCEL';
            'returnProduct':
              PspLogInsert.O_Function := 'REFUND';
          END;
          PspLogInsert."Transaction OK":=FALSE;
          PspLogInsert."I_Error Code":='';
          PspLogInsert."I_Error Text":='';
          PspLogInsert.INSERT(TRUE);
          GPspLog := PspLogInsert;
        END;
      END ELSE
        GPspLog := PspLog;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SendHttpWebRequest@301510008(pSalesPspCard@301510001 : Record 5227625;SOAPMethod@301510003 : Text) : Boolean;
    VAR
      RequestTempBlob@301510014 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;
      ResponseTempBlob@301510013 : TEMPORARY Record 99008535;
      LHttpWebRequestMgt@301510012 : Codeunit 1297;
      ActivityLogManagement@301510011 : Codeunit 5295551;
      HttpStatusCode@301510010 : DotNet "'System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.HttpStatusCode";
      ResponseHeaders@301510009 : DotNet "'System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Specialized.NameValueCollection";
      ResponseInStream@301510008 : InStream;
      RequestInStream@301510007 : InStream;
      LUrl@301510006 : Text;
      LResultText@301510005 : Text;
      statusResponse@301510004 : 'Success,Failed';
    BEGIN
      LUrl := GPspExtSetup."URL 1";
      //LUrl := 'https://eo90g4omlfpsmxl.m.pipedream.net';

      LHttpWebRequestMgt.Initialize(LUrl);
      LHttpWebRequestMgt.SetMethod('POST');
      LHttpWebRequestMgt.SetContentType('text/xml;charset=UTF-8');

      IF (GPspExtSetup."Account ID" = '') OR (GPspExtSetup."Account Password" = '') THEN
        ERROR(NoCredentialsErr);

      IF (GPspExtSetup."PSP Text 1" <> '') AND (GPspExtSetup."PSP Text 2" <> '') THEN
        LHttpWebRequestMgt.AddHeader(GPspExtSetup."PSP Text 1", GPspExtSetup."PSP Text 2");

      LHttpWebRequestMgt.AddBodyAsText(DOMDoc.OuterXml());

      // View XML Request
      //MESSAGE(DOMDoc.OuterXml());

      ResponseTempBlob.INIT;
      ResponseTempBlob.Blob.CREATEINSTREAM(ResponseInStream);

      statusResponse := statusResponse::Success;
      // Activity Log
      RequestTempBlob.WriteAsText(DOMDoc.OuterXml(), TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      RequestTempBlob.Blob.CREATEINSTREAM(RequestInStream);
      ActivityLogManagement.SetDetailInfo(RequestInStream);
      ActivityLogManagement.LogActivity(GPspLog, statusResponse, pSalesPspCard."Payment Method Code", FORMAT(pSalesPspCard."Payment handling with"), STRSUBSTNO('Request %1', GPspLog.O_Function)); // -> Transaktionssicher

      CLEARLASTERROR;
      IF NOT LHttpWebRequestMgt.GetResponse(ResponseInStream, HttpStatusCode, ResponseHeaders) THEN BEGIN
        IF LHttpWebRequestMgt.ProcessFaultResponse('') THEN; // IF-Anweisung um Error Message zu umgehen

        // Create ErrorResponse manualy
        LResultText := CreateErrorResponse(SOAPMethod, pSalesPspCard."Transaction Identifier", '999', COPYSTR(GETLASTERRORTEXT, STRLEN(InternalErr)));
        ResponseTempBlob.WriteAsText(GETLASTERRORTEXT, TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
        statusResponse := statusResponse::Failed;
      END ELSE IF HttpStatusCode.ToString() <> HttpStatusCode.OK.ToString() THEN BEGIN
        statusResponse := statusResponse::Failed;
        //LResultText := ResponseTempBlob.ReadAsText('',TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      END;

      IF statusResponse = statusResponse::Failed THEN
        ActivityLogManagement.SetDetailInfo(ResponseInStream);

      // Read ResponseStream and Save into XML
      LResultText := ResponseTempBlob.ReadAsText('',TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      DOMResponseXML := DOMResponseXML.XmlDocument();
      DOMResponseXML.LoadXml(LResultText);
      //MESSAGE(pDOMResponseXML.OuterXml());

      // If Status = OK check ResponseXml if really successful
      IF HttpStatusCode.ToString() = HttpStatusCode.OK.ToString() THEN BEGIN
        IF (SOAPMethod = 'getContracts') OR IsSucceed(SOAPMethod) THEN
          statusResponse := statusResponse::Success
        ELSE
          statusResponse := statusResponse::Failed;
      END;

      ActivityLogManagement.LogActivity(GPspLog, statusResponse, pSalesPspCard."Payment Method Code", FORMAT(pSalesPspCard."Payment handling with"), STRSUBSTNO('Response %1', GPspLog.O_Function)); // -> Transaktionssicher

      EXIT(statusResponse = statusResponse::Success);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE UpdatePspLog@301510009(VAR pPspLog@301510003 : Record 5227626;VAR pSalesPspCard@301510002 : Record 5227625;pSuccessfull@301510000 : Boolean;pReadState@301510008 : Boolean);
    VAR
      errorCode@301510005 : Variant;
      errorMessage@301510004 : Variant;
      XmlElement@301510006 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlElement";
      XmlNode@301510007 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlNode";
    BEGIN
      IF pSuccessfull THEN BEGIN
        GPspLog.I_Function := GPspLog.O_Function;
        GPspLog."Transaction OK" := TRUE;
        GPspLog.I_Amount := GPspLog.O_Amount;
        GPspLog.I_Valuta := GPspLog.O_Valuta;
        GPspLog."I_Error Code" := '200';
        GPspLog."I_Error Text" := 'OK';
        pSalesPspCard."Status Description" := '';
        //pSalesPspCard."Transaction Identifier" := GPspLog.I_TID;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF pReadState THEN
          GetStateFromConfirmResponse(errorCode, errorMessage)
        ELSE
          GetErrorFromXmlResponse(errorCode, errorMessage);

        GPspLog.I_Function := GPspLog.O_Function;
        GPspLog."I_Error Code" := FORMAT(errorCode);
        GPspLog."I_Error Text" := COPYSTR(FORMAT(errorMessage), 1, MAXSTRLEN(GPspLog."I_Error Text"));

        pSalesPspCard."Status Description" := COPYSTR(FORMAT(errorMessage), 1, MAXSTRLEN(pSalesPspCard."Status Description"));
      END;

      GPspLog."Psp Comm. Log Entry No." := -1;
      GPspHdlgManagement.gDoPspLog(GPspLog, GTriggerType::Modify);
      pSalesPspCard."Status Code" := GPspLog.I_Function;
      pSalesPspCard.MODIFY(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE IsSucceed@301510018(SOAPMethod@301510001 : Text) IsSucceed : Boolean;
    VAR
      XmlNode@301510003 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlNode";
    BEGIN
      {
      <soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
         <soap:Body>

            <ns2:changeOrderResponse xmlns:ns2="http://service.v2.webshop.creditplus.de/">
            <ns2:cancelOrderResponse xmlns:ns2="http://service.v2.webshop.creditplus.de/">
            <ns2:commitDeliveryResponse xmlns:ns2="http://service.v2.webshop.creditplus.de/">
            <ns2:returnProductResponse xmlns:ns2="http://service.v2.webshop.creditplus.de/">

               <confirmation>
                  <confirmationItems>
                     <dealerOrderNumber>123456789</dealerOrderNumber>
                     <errorCode>1</errorCode>
                     <errorMessage>Keinen Auftrag gefunden</errorMessage>
                     <succeed>false</succeed>
                  </confirmationItems>
                  <isSucceed>false</isSucceed>
               </confirmation>
            </ns2:changeOrderResponse>
         </soap:Body>
      </soap:Envelope>
      }
      IsSucceed := FALSE;
      XmlNode := DOMResponseXML.SelectSingleNode('//isSucceed');
      IF NOT ISNULL(XmlNode) THEN
        EVALUATE(IsSucceed, XmlNode.InnerText());

      IF IsSucceed THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);

      XmlNode := DOMResponseXML.SelectSingleNode('//errorCode');
      IF ISNULL(XmlNode) THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      CASE SOAPMethod OF
        'getContracts':
          BEGIN

          END;
        'commitDelivery':
          BEGIN
            // 11 = Delivery already confirmed
            IF XmlNode.InnerText() IN ['11'] THEN
              EXIT(TRUE);
          END;
        'cancelOrder':
          BEGIN
            // 16 = Order declined - cancellation not possible
            // 17 = Order already cancelled
            IF XmlNode.InnerText() IN ['17', '16'] THEN
              EXIT(TRUE);
          END;
        'changeOrder':
          BEGIN

          END;
        'returnProduct':
          BEGIN
          // 12 = The sum of all credit notes is higher than the amount disbursed
          IF XmlNode.InnerText() IN ['12'] THEN
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END;
      END;

      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateErrorResponse@301510020(Action@301510009 : Text;DealerOrderNumber@301510003 : Text;ErrorCode@301510001 : Text;ErrorMsg@301510000 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      XmlText@301510002 : Text;
    BEGIN

      XmlText := STRSUBSTNO('<ns2:%1 xmlns:ns2="http://service.v2.webshop.creditplus.de/">', Action + 'Response');

      XmlText += STRSUBSTNO('<isSucceed>false</isSucceed></confirmation>%1</soap:Body></soap:Envelope>', '</ns2:' + Action +'Response>');

      EXIT(XmlText);
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,39,OnAfterValidateEvent,"Direct Unit Cost")]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE OnAfterValidateDirectUnitCost_AlignValueEntries@301510001(VAR Rec@301510000 : Record 39;VAR xRec@301510001 : Record 39;CurrFieldNo@301510002 : Integer);
    VAR
      PurchRcptLine@301510004 : Record 121;
      PurchHeader@301510005 : Record 38;
      InvtSetup@301510003 : Record 313;
    BEGIN
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;
      IF NOT ((Rec.Type = Rec.Type::Item) AND (Rec."No." <> '')) THEN
        EXIT;
      IF Rec."Direct Unit Cost" = xRec."Direct Unit Cost" THEN
        EXIT;
      IF Rec."Qty. Rcd. Not Invoiced" = 0 THEN
        EXIT;
      IF Rec.Quantity <> 1 THEN
        EXIT;

      InvtSetup.GET();
      IF NOT InvtSetup."Cost Adj. on changes in Price" THEN
        EXIT;

      // Find all Rcpt. Lines where Quantity > Quantity Invoiced
      PurchRcptLine.SETRANGE("Order No.", Rec."Document No.");
      PurchRcptLine.SETRANGE("Order Line No.", Rec."Line No.");
      IF PurchRcptLine.FINDSET() THEN
        REPEAT
          //
          IF PurchRcptLine.Quantity > PurchRcptLine."Quantity Invoiced" THEN BEGIN
            //CreateUpdateValueEntries(PurchRcptLine, Rec."Direct Unit Cost",Rec."Currency Code");
            //fÅr Ermittlung des Bestellkopf-WÑhrungswechselcodes
            PurchHeader.GET(Rec."Document Type",Rec."Document No.");
            CreateUpdateValueEntries(PurchRcptLine, Rec."Direct Unit Cost",PurchHeader);
          END;
        UNTIL PurchRcptLine.NEXT() = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateUpdateValueEntries@301510004(PurchRcptLine@301510001 : Record 121;NewCost@301510004 : Decimal;PurchHead@301510012 : Record 38);
    VAR
      ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802;
      NewValueEntry@301510002 : Record 5802;
      InvtSetup@301510005 : Record 313;
      CurrExchRate@301510008 : Record 330;
      ItemRegister@301510010 : Record 46;
      InvtPostingToGL@301510006 : Codeunit 5802;
      CostDiff@301510003 : Decimal;
      OldCost@301510007 : Decimal;
      NextItemRegisterNo@301510011 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      //NewCost in MandantenwÑhrung umrechnen, Aufrufparameter "CurrCode" ergÑnzt
      //IF CurrCode <> '' THEN
      //  mit tagesaktuellem WÑhrungswechselkurs wÑre:
      //  NewCost := CurrExchRate.ExchangeAmtFCYToLCY(TODAY,CurrCode,NewCost,CurrExchRate.ExchangeRate(TODAY,CurrCode));
      //aber der Wechselkurs des Bestellkopfes soll verwendet werden, daher:
      IF (PurchHead."Currency Code" <> '') AND (PurchHead."Currency Factor" > 0) THEN
        NewCost := CurrExchRate.ExchangeAmtFCYToLCY(TODAY,PurchHead."Currency Code",NewCost,PurchHead."Currency Factor");

      ValueEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.", PurchRcptLine."Document No.");
      ValueEntry.SETRANGE("Document Line No.", PurchRcptLine."Line No.");
      IF ValueEntry.CALCSUMS("Cost Amount (Expected)") THEN
        OldCost := ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)";

      // Get the original Purchase Price Entry
      ValueEntry.FINDFIRST();

      ValueEntry.LOCKTABLE();
      NewValueEntry.INIT();
      NewValueEntry.TRANSFERFIELDS(ValueEntry);

      NewValueEntry."Entry No." := GetNextValueEntryNo();
      NewValueEntry."Entry Type" := NewValueEntry."Entry Type"::Revaluation;
      IF NewValueEntry."Posting Date" < TODAY THEN
        NewValueEntry."Posting Date" := TODAY;
      NewValueEntry."Valuation Date" := TODAY;

      CostDiff := NewCost - OldCost;
      NewValueEntry."Purchase Amount (Expected)" := CostDiff;
      NewValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)" := CostDiff;
      NewValueEntry."Expected Cost Posted to G/L" := CostDiff;
      NewValueEntry."Cost per Unit" := CostDiff;
      NewValueEntry.Description := 'EK-PreisÑnderung';

      // Clear Fields
      NewValueEntry."Expected Cost Posted to G/L" := 0;
      NewValueEntry."Exp. Cost Posted to G/L (ACY)" := 0;
      NewValueEntry."Cost Posted to G/L" := 0;
      NewValueEntry."Cost Posted to G/L (ACY)" := 0;
      NewValueEntry."Item Ledger Entry Quantity" := 0;

      NewValueEntry."User ID" := USERID;
      NewValueEntry.INSERT();

      //Artikeljournal ergÑnzen
      ItemRegister.RESET;
      ItemRegister.FIND('+');
      NextItemRegisterNo := ItemRegister."No." + 1;
      ItemRegister.INIT;
      ItemRegister."No." := NextItemRegisterNo;
      ItemRegister."Creation Date" := TODAY;
      ItemRegister."User ID" := USERID;
      ItemRegister."From Value Entry No." := NewValueEntry."Entry No.";
      ItemRegister."To Value Entry No." := NewValueEntry."Entry No.";
      ItemRegister."Source Code" := 'NEUBW';
      ItemRegister.INSERT;

      // Automatic Cost Posting
      InvtSetup.GET();
      IF InvtSetup."Automatic Cost Posting" THEN BEGIN
        IF InvtPostingToGL.BufferInvtPosting(NewValueEntry) THEN BEGIN
          InvtPostingToGL.Initialize(FALSE);
          InvtPostingToGL.RUN(NewValueEntry);
        END;
      END ELSE
        // 01 12.07.23 HBIE Chron-21 Korr.
        //falsche Datensatz-Variable
        //InsertPostValueEntryToGL(ValueEntry);
        InsertPostValueEntryToGL(NewValueEntry);
        // 01 12.07.23 HBIE Chron-21 Korr. Ende
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetNextValueEntryNo@301510006() ValueEntryNo : Integer;
    VAR
      ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802;
    BEGIN
      IF ValueEntryNo > 0 THEN
        EXIT;
      ValueEntry.LOCKTABLE;
      IF ValueEntry.FINDLAST THEN
        ValueEntryNo := ValueEntry."Entry No." + 1;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertPostValueEntryToGL@301510007(ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802);
    VAR
      PostValueEntryToGL@301510001 : Record 5811;
    BEGIN
      IF IsPostToGL(ValueEntry) THEN BEGIN
        PostValueEntryToGL.INIT;
        PostValueEntryToGL."Value Entry No." := ValueEntry."Entry No.";
        PostValueEntryToGL."Item No." := ValueEntry."Item No.";
        PostValueEntryToGL."Posting Date" := ValueEntry."Posting Date";
        PostValueEntryToGL.INSERT;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE IsPostToGL@301510003(ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802) : Boolean;
    VAR
      InvtSetup@301510001 : Record 313;
    BEGIN
      InvtSetup.GET();
      EXIT(ValueEntry.Inventoriable AND NOT InvtSetup."Automatic Cost Posting" AND
          (((NOT ValueEntry."Expected Cost") AND ((ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)" <> 0) OR (ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Actual) (ACY)" <> 0)))
          OR (InvtSetup."Expected Cost Posting to G/L" AND ((ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)" <> 0) OR (ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected) (ACY)" <> 0)))));
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,39,OnAfterValidateEvent,"Price approved")]
    PROCEDURE OnAfterValidatePriceApproved@301490000(VAR Rec@301490000 : Record 39;VAR xRec@301490001 : Record 39;CurrFieldNo@301490002 : Integer);
    VAR
      lTrackingSpecification@301490005 : Record 336;
      lCHNXChronextIDMgt@301490003 : Codeunit 85010;

      lSalesCrMemoHeader@301490011 : Record 114;
      Err001@301490012 : TextConst 'DEU=Artikel in %1 %2 vorhanden, %3 kann nicht geÑndert werden.';
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
      CustomerSetup@301510001 : Record 87000;
      lSalesReturnHeader@301510002 : Record 36;
      SalesLineFound@301510003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // 01 03.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 OnAfterValidatePriceApproved
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN

      IF Rec."Price approved" = xRec."Price approved" THEN
        EXIT;

      GetCustomerSetup;

      lSerialNo := lCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetSerialNoPurchaseLine(Rec);           // Hersteller-Seriennummer holen
      //Chronex-Seriennummer dazu suchen:
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID", gCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value Text", lSerialNo);
      IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT;

      lSerialNo := ItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No.";                    //Chronex-Seriennummer

      // Auftrag vorhanden
      lCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetSalesLineSerialNo(lSerialNo,lSalesLine,SalesLineFound);          // Verkaufszeile zu Seriennummer holen

      IF (NOT Rec."Price approved") AND xRec."Price approved" THEN BEGIN        // von true auf false
        // Auftrag freigegeben

        IF lSalesHeader.GET(lSalesLine."Document Type",lSalesLine."Document No.") AND (lSalesHeader.Status = lSalesHeader.Status::Released) THEN
          ERROR(Err001, lSalesHeader.TABLECAPTION, lSalesLine."Document No.", Rec.FIELDCAPTION("Price approved"));

        // VK-Rechnung ohne VK-Gutschrift
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.","Entry Type");
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",lSerialNo);
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type", lItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Sale);    // VK-Lieferung vorhanden
        IF lItemLedgerEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          lSalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",lItemLedgerEntry."External Document No.");   // VK-Rechnung dazu suchen
          IF lSalesInvoiceHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            //28.03.23 NKON zuerst geb. Gutschrift prÅfen
            lSalesCrMemoHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("External Document No.");
            lSalesCrMemoHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",lItemLedgerEntry."External Document No.");
            IF lSalesCrMemoHeader.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            //28.03.23 NKON zuerst geb. Gutschrift prÅfen
              lSalesReturnHeader.SETRANGE("Applies-to Doc. Type", lSalesReturnHeader."Applies-to Doc. Type"::Invoice);
              lSalesReturnHeader.SETRANGE("Applies-to Doc. No.", lSalesInvoiceHeader."No.");
              IF lSalesReturnHeader.ISEMPTY THEN                                              // keine VK-Gutschrift vorhanden
                ERROR(Err001, lSalesInvoiceHeader.TABLECAPTION, lSalesInvoiceHeader."No.", Rec.FIELDCAPTION("Price approved"));
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END ELSE IF Rec."Price approved"  AND (NOT xRec."Price approved") THEN BEGIN    //von false auf true
        IF lSalesLine."Document Type" = lSalesLine."Document Type"::Order THEN BEGIN
          lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost (LCY)",Rec."Direct Unit Cost");          // Einkaufspreis in VK-Zeile neu setzen
          lSalesLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
          COMMIT;
        END;
      END;
      // 01 03.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 OnAfterValidatePriceApproved ENDE
    END;

        lSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(gCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
        gCustomerSetupRead := TRUE;
      END;
    END;

      END;
    END;

      // 01 03.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 - OnAfterValidatePriceApproved

    }
    END.

    [EventSubscriber(Table,337,OnAfterInsertEvent)]

        EXIT;
      //28.03.23 NKON
      //IF (Rec."Source Type" = 37) AND (Rec."Item Tracking" = Rec."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.") AND (Rec."Serial No." <> '') THEN BEGIN
      IF (Rec."Source Type" = 32) AND (Rec."Item Tracking" = Rec."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.") AND (Rec."Serial No." <> '') THEN BEGIN

            IF lSalesLine.GET(lSalesLine."Document Type"::Order,ReservationEntry."Source ID", ReservationEntry."Source Ref. No.") THEN BEGIN

              lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Res. in Purch. Order Line No.", lPurchaseLine."Line No.");

              //Sperre wenn Item matching nicht gesetzt werden kann. Resv. Posten werden fÅr T37 erstellt nicht fÅr T32
              //kînnen anschlie·end nicht gelîscht werden deshalb commit
              COMMIT;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF (Rec."Source Type" = 37) AND (Rec."Item Tracking" = Rec."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.") AND (Rec."Serial No." <> '') THEN BEGIN
          //28.03.23 NKON VK-Zeile hat noch keine Seriennr.
          IF ReservationEntry.GET(Rec."Entry No.",TRUE) AND (ReservationEntry."Source Type" = 32) THEN BEGIN
            lCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetPurchaseLineSerialNo(Rec."Serial No.",lPurchaseLine,PurchLineFound);
            IF PurchLineFound THEN BEGIN
              IF lSalesLine.GET(lSalesLine."Document Type"::Order,ReservationEntry."Source ID", ReservationEntry."Source Ref. No.") THEN BEGIN
                lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Res. in Purchase Order No.", lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
                lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Res. in Purch. Order Line No.", lPurchaseLine."Line No.");
                lSalesLine.MODIFY;
                //Sperre wenn Item matching nicht gesetzt werden kann. Resv. Posten werden fÅr T37 erstellt nicht fÅr T32
                //kînnen anschlie·end nicht gelîscht werden deshalb commit
                COMMIT;
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      // 01 13.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 ENDE
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,337,OnAfterModifyEvent)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE OnAfterModifyReservationEntry@301510001(VAR Rec@301510000 : Record 337;VAR xRec@301510001 : Record 337;RunTrigger@301510002 : Boolean);

      ReservationEntry@301510003 : Record 337;

      IF (Rec."Source Type" = 32) AND (Rec."Item Tracking" = Rec."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.") AND (Rec."Serial No." <> '') THEN BEGIN

          lCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetPurchaseLineSerialNo(Rec."Serial No.",lPurchaseLine,PurchLineFound);

      END;

    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,337,OnAfterDeleteEvent)]

      PurchLineFound@301510006 : Boolean;
      PostProcessingManagement@301510007 : Codeunit 5104950;
      SalesHeader@301510008 : Record 36;
      SystemValueLine@301510009 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      // 01 13.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF (Rec."Source Type" = 32) AND (Rec."Item Tracking" = Rec."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.") AND (Rec."Serial No." <> '') THEN BEGIN
        //28.03.23 NKON VK-Zeile hat noch keine Seriennr.
        IF ReservationEntry.GET(Rec."Entry No.",FALSE) AND (ReservationEntry."Source Type" = 37) THEN BEGIN
          lCHNXChronextIDMgt.GetPurchaseLineSerialNo(Rec."Serial No.",lPurchaseLine,PurchLineFound);

             IF lSalesLine.GET(lSalesLine."Document Type"::Order,ReservationEntry."Source ID", ReservationEntry."Source Ref. No.") THEN BEGIN
                CLEAR(lSalesLine."Res. in Purchase Order No.");
                CLEAR(lSalesLine."Res. in Purch. Order Line No.");
                lSalesLine.MODIFY;
                IF SalesHeader.GET(lSalesLine."Document Type",lSalesLine."Document No.") THEN
                    ClosePostEntry(SalesHeader);
            END;
          END;

        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ClosePostEntry@301510005(SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36);

      PostProcessingEntry@301510001 : Record 5104950;
    BEGIN
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",PostProcessingEntry."Entry Type"::Sale);

      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");

      IF PostProcessingEntry.FIND('-') THEN

          PostProcessingEntry.VALIDATE(Open,FALSE);
          PostProcessingEntry.MODIFY;
        END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE WriteSellType@301510030(SalesHeader@301510003 : Record 36);
    VAR
      UnpostedDocumentValue@301510000 : Record 5295670;
      i@301510002 : Integer;
      SellType@301510001 : Text;
      SellCode@301510004 : Code[10];
    BEGIN

      UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDLAST;
      i := UnpostedDocumentValue.ID + 1;

      CLEAR(UnpostedDocumentValue);
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Type" := 36;
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Subtype" := 1;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.ID := i;
      i += 1;
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Source No." := SalesHeader."No.";
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Entry No." := 1;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.Identifier := '#FIELDNO#';
      UnpostedDocumentValue.Key := '#F85058#';
      SellTypeLines(SalesHeader,SellType,SellCode);
      UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueText := SellType;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueCode := SellCode;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SellTypeLines@301510035(SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36;VAR SellType@301510004 : Text;VAR SellCode@301510005 : Code[10]);
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      SalesLine.RESET;
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      SalesLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        SellType := '';
        REPEAT
          IF SellType = '' THEN BEGIN
            FindSellType(SalesHeader,SalesLine,SellType,SellCode);
            WriteSellTypeLine(SalesLine,SellType,SellCode);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            FindSellType(SalesHeader,SalesLine,SellType,SellCode);
            SellType := SellType + '_' + SellType;
          END;
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindSellType@301510029(SalesHeader@301510007 : Record 36;SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37;VAR SellType@301510011 : Text;VAR SellCode@301510012 : Code[10]);
    VAR
      txtSKU@301510006 : Text;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510005 : Record 50030;
      SellWatchVendorInfo@301510004 : Record 50012;
      WatchCost@301510003 : Decimal;
      ILE@301510002 : Record 32;
      WatchCostIncVAT@301510000 : Decimal;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510009 : Record 50029;
      Vendor@301510010 : Record 23;
      PurchaseLine@301510008 : Record 39;
    BEGIN
      SellType := '';
      SellCode := '';

      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(SalesLine."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN

        ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(COPYSTR(SalesLine."Variant Code",1,4));
        ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.CALCFIELDS("Buy-from Vendor Name");
        ILE.RESET;
        ILE.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
        ILE.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
        ILE.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
        ILE.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        IF ILE.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          SellType := 'Large Vendor(' + ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name" + ')';
          SellCode := 'LV';
        END ELSE BEGIN
          SellType := 'Large Vendor On Stock';
          SellCode := 'LVS';
        END;
      END;
      IF SellType <> '' THEN
        EXIT;

      txtSKU := SalesLine."No." + '_' + SalesLine."Variant Code";
      SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
      SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE(SellWatchVendorInfo.SKU,txtSKU);
      IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SellType := 'C2C';
          SellCode := 'C2C';
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PurchaseLine.RESET;
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",SalesLine."No.");
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
        IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
          SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE("PO Number",PurchaseLine."Document No.");
          IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            SellType := 'C2C';
            SellCode := 'C2C';
          END;
        END;
      END;
      IF SellType <> '' THEN
        EXIT;

      ILE.RESET;
      ILE.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code");
      ILE.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
      ILE.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
      ILE.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      IF ILE.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        SellType := 'OnDemand';
        SellCode := 'OD';
        EXIT;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        SellType := 'Stock';
        SellCode := 'ST';
        EXIT;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE WriteSellTypeLine@301510007(SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;SellType@301510001 : Text;SellCode@301510004 : Code[10]);
    VAR
      UnpostedDocumentValue@301510002 : Record 5295670;
      i@301510003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      UnpostedDocumentValue.RESET;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",SalesLine."Document No.");
      UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",SalesLine."Line No.");
      UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE(Key,'#F85058#');
      IF UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDSET THEN
        UnpostedDocumentValue.DELETEALL;

      UnpostedDocumentValue.RESET;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDLAST;
      i := UnpostedDocumentValue.ID + 1;
      CLEAR(UnpostedDocumentValue);
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Type" := 36;
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Subtype" := 1;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.ID :=i;
      i += 1;
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Source No." := SalesLine."Document No.";
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Line No." := SalesLine."Line No.";
      UnpostedDocumentValue."Entry No." := i;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.Identifier := '#FIELDNO#';
      UnpostedDocumentValue.Key := '#F85058#';
      UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueText := SellType;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueCode := SellCode;
      UnpostedDocumentValue.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE TempBatch@301510011();
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37;
      SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36;
      SellType@301510002 : Text;
      UnpostedDocumentValue@301510003 : Record 5295670;
      SellWatchVendorInfo@301510004 : Record 50012;
      PurchaseLine@301510005 : Record 39;
      UnpostedDocumentValue2@301510006 : Record 5295670;
      i@301510007 : Integer;
      y@301510008 : Integer;
      z@301510009 : Integer;
      PurchInvLine@301510010 : Record 123;
      PurchInvHeader@301510011 : Record 122;
      SellCode@301510012 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      SalesHeader.RESET;
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      //SalesHeader.SETFILTER("External Document No.",'<>%1','');
      SalesHeader.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'>=%1',010725D);
      IF SalesHeader.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          UnpostedDocumentValue.RESET;
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE(UnpostedDocumentValue.Key,'#F85058#');
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source Type",36);
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",SalesHeader."External Document No.");
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE(ValueText,'Stock');
          IF UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDSET(TRUE) THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              IF SalesLine.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.",UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Line No.") THEN BEGIN

              //IF SalesLine.GET(SalesHeader."No.",UnpostedDocumentValue."Source Line No.") THEN BEGIN
                i += 1;
                PurchaseLine.RESET;
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",SalesLine."No.");
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
                IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                  y += 1;
                  SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
                  SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE("PO Number",PurchaseLine."Document No.");
                  IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                    z += 1;
                    UnpostedDocumentValue2 := UnpostedDocumentValue;
                    UnpostedDocumentValue2.ValueCode := 'C2C';
                    UnpostedDocumentValue2.ValueText := 'C2C';
                    UnpostedDocumentValue2.MODIFY;
                  END;
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  PurchInvLine.RESET;
                  PurchInvLine.SETRANGE("No.",SalesLine."No.");
                  PurchInvLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
                  IF PurchInvLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                    PurchInvHeader.GET(PurchInvLine."Document No.");
                    y += 1;
                    SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
                    SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE("PO Number",PurchInvHeader."Order No.");
                    IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                      z += 1;
                      UnpostedDocumentValue2 := UnpostedDocumentValue;
                      UnpostedDocumentValue2.ValueCode := 'C2C';
                      UnpostedDocumentValue2.ValueText := 'C2C';
                      UnpostedDocumentValue2.MODIFY;
                    END;
                  END;
                END;

                //FindSellType(SalesHeader,SalesLine,SellType,SellCode);
                //WriteSellTypeLine(SalesLine,SellType,SellCode);
              END;
            UNTIL UnpostedDocumentValue.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        UNTIL SalesHeader.NEXT = 0;

    END;

    }
    END.

      {

      ResponseText := StreamReader.ReadToEnd();
      MESSAGE(ResponseText);
      }
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE OPC_GetXMLContent@301510005(WarehouseActivityHeader@301510003 : Record 5766) : Text;
    VAR
      CountryRegion@301510005 : Record 9;
      Customer@301510006 : Record 18;
      Vendor@301510007 : Record 23;
      SalesHeader@301510008 : Record 36;
      PurchaseHeader@301510009 : Record 38;
      lBody@301510000 : Text;
      NewLine@301510001 : Text;
      EndLine@301510004 : ARRAY [2] OF Char;
      txtVar@301510002 : ARRAY [50] OF Text;
    BEGIN
      EndLine[1] := 13;
      EndLine[2] := 10;
      NewLine := FORMAT(EndLine[1]) + FORMAT(EndLine[2]);
      CountryRegion.GET(g_CompanyInformation."Country/Region Code");

      CASE WarehouseActivityHeader."Destination Type" OF
        WarehouseActivityHeader."Destination Type"::Customer : BEGIN
          SalesHeader.GET(WarehouseActivityHeader."Source Subtype",WarehouseActivityHeader."Source No.");
          Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
          CountryRegion.GET(SalesHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code");
          varText[1] := Customer.Name;
          varText[2] := SalesHeader."Ship-to Address" + ' ' + SalesHeader."Ship-to Address 2";
          varText[3] := SalesHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code";
          varText[4] := SalesHeader."Ship-to Post Code";

        WarehouseActivityHeader."Destination Type"::Vendor : BEGIN

          Vendor.GET(PurchaseHeader."Buy-from Vendor No.");

          varText[1] := Vendor.Name;
          varText[2] := PurchaseHeader."Ship-to Address" + ' ' + PurchaseHeader."Ship-to Address 2";
          varText[3] := PurchaseHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code";
          varText[4] := PurchaseHeader."Ship-to Post Code";
          varText[5] := PurchaseHeader."Ship-to City";
        END;
        WarehouseActivityHeader."Destination Type"::Location : BEGIN
        END;
      END;

      txtVar[1] := '<Firma>' + g_CompanyInformation.Name + '</Firma>';
      txtVar[2] := '<Strasse>'+ g_CompanyInformation.Address +'</Strasse>';
      txtVar[3] := '<Land>' + CountryRegion.Code + '</Land>';

      //txtVar[6] := '<BestEmail>'+'mert.oktay@chronext.com'+'</BestEmail>';

      txtVar[7] := '<EmpfFirma>'+ varText[1]+'</EmpfFirma>';
      txtVar[8] := '<EmpfStrasse>'+varText[2]+'</EmpfStrasse>';
      txtVar[9] := '<EmpfLand>'+varText[3]+'</EmpfLand>';
      txtVar[10] := '<EmpfPlz>'+varText[4]+'</EmpfPlz>';
      txtVar[11] := '<EmpfStadt>'+varText[5]+'</EmpfStadt>';

      lBody := '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' + NewLine +
      '<versand>' + NewLine +
      '<vsVersion>2.1</vsVersion>' + NewLine +
      '<mbsVersandschein>' + NewLine +
      '<grp_Absender>' + NewLine +
      txtVar[1] + NewLine +
      txtVar[2] + NewLine +
      txtVar[3] + NewLine +
      txtVar[4] + NewLine +
      txtVar[5] + NewLine +
      txtVar[6] + NewLine +

            ELSE
              JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(LineJObject,'box','ja');
            IF NOT SellWatchVendorInfo."Paper Available" THEN
              JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(LineJObject,'certificate','nein')
            ELSE
              JSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(LineJObject,'certificate','ja');

    LOCAL PROCEDURE "Tempto movetotable50021"@301510002(VAR Rec@301510000 : Record 50021;RunTrigger@301510001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510002 : Record 36;
      PurchaseHeader@301510003 : Record 38;
      SalesLine@301510004 : Record 37;
      PurchaseLine@301510005 : Record 39;
      SystemValueLine@301510006 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      EXIT;

      IF Rec."Document Type"=Rec."Document Type"::PurchaseOrder THEN BEGIN
        IF NOT PurchaseLine.GET(PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order, Rec."OrderNo.",Rec."Line No.") THEN
          ERROR('Watch Line %1, %2 does not exist',Rec."OrderNo.",Rec."Line No.");

        IF Rec."ItemNo." <> PurchaseLine."No." THEN

        IF Rec."Variant Code" <> PurchaseLine."Variant Code" THEN
          ERROR('"variantCode %1 not macthing with the order',Rec."Variant Code");
      END;

      IF Rec."Document Type"=Rec."Document Type"::SalesReturnOrder THEN BEGIN
        IF NOT SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order, Rec."OrderNo.",Rec."Line No.") THEN
          ERROR('Watch Line %1, %2 does not exist',Rec."OrderNo.",Rec."Line No.");

        IF Rec."ItemNo." <> SalesLine."No." THEN
          ERROR('"ItemNo %1 not macthing with the order',Rec."ItemNo.");

        IF Rec."Variant Code" <> SalesLine."Variant Code" THEN
          ERROR('"variantCode %1 not macthing with the order',Rec."Variant Code");
      END;

      IF NOT SystemValueLine.GET(55000,Rec.ServiceType) THEN
        ERROR('"serviceType %1 doen not exist',Rec.ServiceType);

      IF Rec.Price <=0 THEN
        ERROR('Price is missing',Rec.ServiceType);

      IF Rec.ServiceId <=0 THEN
        ERROR('ServiceId is missing',Rec.ServiceType);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CREATEFRESHDESKTICKET@301510001(order@301510001 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;
    BEGIN
      FreshDeskSetup.GET;
      IF NOT FreshDeskSetup.Active THEN
        EXIT;
      //SalesHeader.SETRANGE(SalesHeader."Order Date",TODAY-365,TODAY-1);
      IF order<>'' THEN
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("No.",order);
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      //SalesHeader.SETRANGE(Status,SalesHeader.Status::Open);
      IF SalesHeader.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Approve Order");
          IF SalesHeader."Status Approve Order" =SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Cancelled THEN BEGIN
          InsertFreshDeskEntry(SalesHeader,1);
          END ELSE BEGIN
          IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'VORAUS' THEN
            IF SalesHeader."Pre-Pay Amount (expected)" <> SalesHeader."Pre-Pay Amount (found)" THEN BEGIN
              IF (ABS(SalesHeader."Order Date"-(TODAY-1))) > FreshDeskSetup."Banck Transfer Payment Days" THEN
                InsertFreshDeskEntry(SalesHeader,2)
              END ELSE
                IF DeliveryPending(SalesHeader) THEN
                  InsertFreshDeskEntry(SalesHeader,3);
        END;
      UNTIL SalesHeader.NEXT=0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PROCESSFRESHDESKENTRIES@301510006();
    VAR
      FreshDesckEntries@301510000 : Record 50019;
      UpreshDesckEntries@301510001 : Record 50019;
      lExtInterfaceSetup@301510002 : Record 5275373;
      SalesHeader@301510003 : Record 36;
    BEGIN
      FreshDeskSetup.GET;
      IF NOT FreshDeskSetup.Active THEN
        EXIT;
      IF NOT lExtInterfaceSetup.GET('UPDFRD') THEN
        EXIT;
      IF NOT lExtInterfaceSetup.Active THEN
        EXIT;
      FreshDesckEntries.SETRANGE(Processed,FALSE);
      IF FreshDesckEntries.FINDSET THEN
       REPEAT
        IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,FreshDesckEntries."No.") THEN BEGIN
          CreateExternalInterfaceFile(FreshDesckEntries);
          UpreshDesckEntries.GET(FreshDesckEntries."No.",FreshDesckEntries.Type);
          UpreshDesckEntries.Processed:=TRUE;
          UpreshDesckEntries.MODIFY;
        END;
      UNTIL FreshDesckEntries.NEXT=0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertFreshDeskEntry@301510002(SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;Type@301510001 : Integer);
    VAR
      FreshDesckEntries@301510002 : Record 50019;
      TempFreshDesckEntries@301510003 : TEMPORARY Record 50019;
    BEGIN

      TempFreshDesckEntries.INIT;
      TempFreshDesckEntries."No.":=SalesHeader."No.";
      IF Type = 1 THEN
        TempFreshDesckEntries.Type:=TempFreshDesckEntries.Type::TS;
      IF Type = 2 THEN
        TempFreshDesckEntries.Type:=TempFreshDesckEntries.Type::Payment;
      IF Type = 3 THEN
        TempFreshDesckEntries.Type:=TempFreshDesckEntries.Type::Delivery;
      TempFreshDesckEntries.INSERT;
      IF NOT FreshDesckEntries.GET(TempFreshDesckEntries."No.",TempFreshDesckEntries.Type) THEN BEGIN
        FreshDesckEntries.INIT;
        FreshDesckEntries:=TempFreshDesckEntries;
        FreshDesckEntries.INSERT;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckUserLevelRestriction@301510000();
    BEGIN
      IF NOT ((USERID = 'SGALLIPELLI') OR (USERID = 'ATRINCZEK')) THEN
        ERROR('Not allowed');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DeliveryPending@301510003(SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT
          IF SalesLine."Promised Delivery Date" <> 0D THEN
        IF (SalesLine."Promised Delivery Date"-TODAY) <= FreshDeskSetup."Delivery Days" THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
          IF SalesLine."Reserved Quantity" < 1 THEN
            EXIT(TRUE)
        END;
      UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }

OBJECT Codeunit 50030 Check Bank Transfer
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=03.07.24;
    Time=15:53:46;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=VAR
            refDate@301510000 : Date;
          BEGIN
            FromDate:= CALCDATE('<-12M>',TODAY);
            SO.RESET;
            SO.SETRANGE("Document Type",SO."Document Type"::Order);
            SO.SETRANGE("Payment Method Code",'VORAUS');

            SO.SETRANGE("Order Date",FromDate,TODAY);
            IF SO.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            //  CLE.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SO."Sell-to Customer No.");
            //  CLE.SETRANGE("Document Type",CLE."Document Type"::Payment);
            //  CLE.SETRANGE("External Document No.",SO."No.");
            //  IF CLE.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              IF SO."Pre-Pay Amount (expected)"= SO."Pre-Pay Amount (found)" THEN BEGIN
                OSL.RESET;
                OSL.SETRANGE("Order No",SO."No.");
                OSL.SETRANGE("Order Status",OSL."Order Status"::"Payment Received and Packing");
                IF NOT OSL.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
                  CLEAR(OSL1);
                  OSL1.INIT;
                  OSL1."Order No":= SO."No.";
                  OSL1."Current Status":= 'Payment Received';
                  OSL1."User ID":= USERID;
                  OSL1."Log Created at":= CURRENTDATETIME;
                  OSL1.VALIDATE("Order Status", OSL."Order Status"::"Payment Received and Packing");
                  OSL1.INSERT;
                  COMMIT;
                  FreshSalesMgnt.InsertFreshDeskEntry(5,SO."No.",0);  //ITBO-127
                END;
              END ELSE BEGIN  //ITP-99
                IF SO."Pre-Pay Amount (expected)" > SO."Pre-Pay Amount (found)" THEN BEGIN
                  refDate:=0D;
                  OSL2.RESET;
                  OSL2.SETRANGE("Order No",SO."No.");
                  OSL2.SETRANGE("Order Status",OSL."Order Status"::"Order Confirmed");
                  IF OSL2.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                    refDate:=DT2DATE(OSL2."Log Created at");
                    IF  (TODAY - refDate) > 3 THEN BEGIN
                      OSL.RESET;
                      OSL.SETRANGE("Order No",SO."No.");
                      OSL.SETRANGE("Order Status",OSL."Order Status"::"Payment Delayed");
                      IF NOT OSL.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
                        CLEAR(OSL1);
                        OSL1.INIT;
                        OSL1."Order No":= SO."No.";
                        OSL1."Current Status":= 'Payment Delayed';
                        OSL1."User ID":= USERID;
                        OSL1."Log Created at":= CURRENTDATETIME;
                        OSL1.VALIDATE("Order Status", OSL."Order Status"::"Payment Delayed");
                        OSL1.INSERT;
                        COMMIT;
                        FreshSalesMgnt.InsertFreshDeskEntry(7,SO."No.",0);  //SKU
                      END;
                    END;
                END;
                END;
              END;
            UNTIL SO.NEXT=0;

          END;

  }

    PROCEDURE InsertRecordFromGMBH@301510001();
    VAR
      Inventory@301510002 : Record 50015;
      SalesPrice@301510000 : Record 7002;
      PurchasePrice@301510001 : Record 7012;
    BEGIN

      ILE.CHANGECOMPANY('CHRONEXT-GmbH');
      ILE.RESET;
      ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
      ILE.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      ILE.SETFILTER("Remaining Quantity",'>=%1',1);
      IF ILE.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT
        Inventory.INIT;
        Inventory."Entry No":= GetLastEntryNo+1;
        Inventory."Item No":= ILE."Item No.";
        Inventory."Variant code":= ILE."Variant Code";
        Inventory."Location code":=ILE."Location Code";
        Inventory."Company Name":= 'CHRONEXT-GmbH';
        Inventory.Qty:= ILE."Remaining Quantity";
        Inventory.SerialNo:= ILE."Serial No.";
        Inventory."Entry Type":= ILE."Entry Type";
        Inventory."Vendor No.":= ILE."Source No.";
        Inventory."Differential Taxation Purchase":=ILE."Differential Taxation Purchase";
        ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
        Inventory."Purchase Price":= ILE."Cost Amount (Actual)";
        IF Inventory."Purchase Price"=0.0 THEN BEGIN
          Inventory."Purchase Price Expected":= ILE."Cost Amount (Expected)";
        END;
        ILE2.RESET;
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Serial No.",ILE."Serial No.");
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Entry Type",ILE2."Entry Type"::Purchase);
        IF ILE2.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ILE2.CALCFIELDS("Purchase Order No.");
          Inventory."Purchase Order No":= ILE2."Purchase Order No.";
        END;
        Inventory.Brand := GetAttributevalue(27,ILE."Item No.",'',1);
        Inventory.Model := GetAttributevalue(27,ILE."Item No.",'',2);
        Inventory.Reference := COPYSTR(GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",5),1,50);
        Inventory."Variant Category" := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",37);
        Inventory.Condition := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",10);
        Inventory.Visibility:= GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",41);
        Inventory.Year := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",8);
        Inventory.Box := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",11);
        Inventory.Paper := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",13);
        IF ItemRec.GET(ILE."Item No.") THEN
          Inventory."Product Posting Group":= ItemRec."Gen. Prod. Posting Group";
        SalesPrice.RESET;
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Item No.",ILE."Item No.");
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ILE."Variant Code");
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Country/Region Code",'DE');
        IF SalesPrice.FINDLAST THEN
          Inventory."Sales Price":= SalesPrice."Unit Price";
        Inventory.INSERT;
      UNTIL ILE.NEXT=0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetPurchaselineunitcost@301510003();
    BEGIN
      // 01 13.09.22 SKU ERP-683 ++
      InventoryRec.RESET;
      InventoryRec.SETFILTER("Purchase Order No",'<>%1','');
      IF InventoryRec.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",InventoryRec."Purchase Order No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",InventoryRec."Item No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",InventoryRec."Variant code");
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          InventoryRec."Unit Cost from Purchase Line":= PurchaseLine."Unit Cost";
        IF PurchaseLine."Currency Code"='' THEN
          InventoryRec."Purchase Line Currency":= 'EUR'
        ELSE
          InventoryRec."Purchase Line Currency":= PurchaseLine."Currency Code";
          InventoryRec.MODIFY;
       END;
      UNTIL InventoryRec.NEXT=0;
      PurchaseLine.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      InventoryRec.RESET;
      InventoryRec.SETFILTER("Purchase Order No",'<>%1','');
      IF InventoryRec.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",InventoryRec."Purchase Order No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",InventoryRec."Item No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",InventoryRec."Variant code");
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          InventoryRec."Unit Cost from Purchase Line":= PurchaseLine."Unit Cost";
         IF PurchaseLine."Currency Code"='' THEN
          InventoryRec."Purchase Line Currency":= 'EUR'
         ELSE
          InventoryRec."Purchase Line Currency":= PurchaseLine."Currency Code";
          InventoryRec.MODIFY;
       END;
      UNTIL InventoryRec.NEXT=0;
      // 01 13.09.22 SKU ERP-683 ++
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetPurchasePrice@301510006(SN@301510000 : Code[10];CompanyName@301510001 : Text) Price : Decimal;
    VAR
      ItemLedEntry@301510002 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
        ItemLedEntry.RESET;
        ItemLedEntry.CHANGECOMPANY(CompanyName);

          END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalculateReceiptDate@301510005();
    VAR
      InvRec@301510002 : Record 50015;
      ItemLedEntry@301510001 : Record 32;
      ReserveEnatry@301510000 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      InvRec.RESET;

      IF InvRec.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
      REPEAT
        ItemLedEntry.RESET;
        ItemLedEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.","Posting Date");
        ItemLedEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",InvRec.SerialNo);
        ItemLedEntry.SETFILTER("Entry Type",'%1|%2',ItemLedEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase,ItemLedEntry."Entry Type"::"Positive Adjmt.");
        IF ItemLedEntry.FINDLAST THEN
         InvRec."Entry Date In GMBH":= ItemLedEntry."Posting Date";
        ReserveEnatry.RESET;
        ReserveEnatry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",InvRec.SerialNo);
        IF ReserveEnatry.FINDFIRST THEN
          InvRec.Remark:= FORMAT(ReserveEnatry."Reservation Status")+' '+'For'+' '+ReserveEnatry."Source ID";
         InvRec.MODIFY;
      UNTIL InvRec.NEXT=0;
      END;
      ItemLedEntry.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      InvRec.RESET;

      IF InvRec.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
      REPEAT
        ItemLedEntry.RESET;
        ItemLedEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.","Posting Date");
        ItemLedEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",InvRec.SerialNo);
        ItemLedEntry.SETFILTER("Entry Type",'%1|%2',ItemLedEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase,ItemLedEntry."Entry Type"::"Positive Adjmt.");
        IF ItemLedEntry.FINDLAST THEN
         InvRec."Entry Date in BV":= ItemLedEntry."Posting Date";

         IF InvRec."Entry Date In GMBH"=0D THEN BEGIN
            InvRec."First receipt date at CXT":=  InvRec."Entry Date in BV";
         InvRec."first receipt Company":= 'Chronext Purchasing B.V.';
         InvRec."Initial purchase price":= GetPurchasePrice(InvRec.SerialNo,'Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      END;
         IF InvRec."Entry Date in BV"=0D THEN BEGIN
            InvRec."First receipt date at CXT":=  InvRec."Entry Date In GMBH";
         InvRec."first receipt Company":= COMPANYNAME;
           InvRec."Initial purchase price":= GetPurchasePrice(InvRec.SerialNo,COMPANYNAME);
      END;
      IF (InvRec."Entry Date In GMBH"<> 0D) AND (InvRec."Entry Date in BV"<>0D) THEN BEGIN
         IF InvRec."Entry Date In GMBH">= InvRec."Entry Date in BV" THEN BEGIN
           InvRec."First receipt date at CXT":= InvRec."Entry Date in BV";
          InvRec."first receipt Company":= 'Chronext Purchasing B.V.';
          InvRec."Initial purchase price":= GetPurchasePrice(InvRec.SerialNo,'Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
         END ELSE BEGIN
           InvRec."First receipt date at CXT":= InvRec."Entry Date In GMBH";
           InvRec."first receipt Company":= COMPANYNAME;
           InvRec."Initial purchase price":= GetPurchasePrice(InvRec.SerialNo,COMPANYNAME);
          END;
      END;
         InvRec.MODIFY;
      UNTIL InvRec.NEXT=0;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE FetchBincode@301510007();
    BEGIN
      InventoryRec.RESET;
      InventoryRec.SETRANGE("Location code",'HL');
      InventoryRec.SETRANGE("Company Name",'CHRONEXT-GmbH');
      IF InventoryRec.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
      REPEAT
            BinContent.RESET;
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Location Code",InventoryRec."Location code");
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Item No.",InventoryRec."Item No");
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Variant Code",InventoryRec."Variant code");

          BinContent.SETFILTER("Serial No. Filter",InventoryRec.SerialNo);
          BinContent.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
        IF BinContent.FINDFIRST THEN
          InventoryRec.BinCode:= BinContent."Bin Code";
        InventoryRec.MODIFY;
        UNTIL InventoryRec.NEXT=0;
      END;
      BinContent.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      InventoryRec.RESET;
      InventoryRec.SETRANGE("Location code",'HL');
      InventoryRec.SETRANGE("Company Name",'Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      IF InventoryRec.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
      REPEAT
            BinContent.RESET;
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Location Code",InventoryRec."Location code");
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Item No.",InventoryRec."Item No");
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Variant Code",InventoryRec."Variant code");

          BinContent.SETFILTER("Serial No. Filter",InventoryRec.SerialNo);
          BinContent.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
        IF BinContent.FINDFIRST THEN
          InventoryRec.BinCode:= BinContent."Bin Code";
        InventoryRec.MODIFY;
        UNTIL InventoryRec.NEXT=0;
      END;
      BinContent.CHANGECOMPANY('Prod-CXT GmbH');
      InventoryRec.RESET;
      InventoryRec.SETRANGE("Location code",'HL');
      InventoryRec.SETRANGE("Company Name",'Prod-CXT GmbH');
      IF InventoryRec.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
      REPEAT
            BinContent.RESET;
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Location Code",InventoryRec."Location code");
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Item No.",InventoryRec."Item No");
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Variant Code",InventoryRec."Variant code");

          BinContent.SETFILTER("Serial No. Filter",InventoryRec.SerialNo);
          BinContent.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
        IF BinContent.FINDFIRST THEN
          InventoryRec.BinCode:= BinContent."Bin Code";
        InventoryRec.MODIFY;
        UNTIL InventoryRec.NEXT=0;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertFreshDeskEntry@301510003(Step@301510004 : Integer;OrderNo@301510000 : Code[20];Lineno@301510001 : Integer);
    VAR
      FreshSalesEntries@301510002 : Record 50033;
      TempFreshSalesEntries@301510003 : TEMPORARY Record 50033;
      QuickSalesLine@301510005 : Record 5104607;
      QuickSalesHeader@301510007 : Record 5104606;
      ItemAttributeCollection@301510006 : Record 85011;
      SalesLine@301510008 : Record 37;
      SalesHeader@301510009 : Record 36;
      Customer@301510010 : Record 18;
      SalesShiptoFieldsHandling@301510011 : Codeunit 5104640;
      SalesHeaderArchive@301510012 : Record 5107;
      SalesLineArchive@301510013 : Record 5108;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510014 : Record 112;
      SalesInvoiceLine@301510015 : Record 113;
    BEGIN
      //TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
      IF Step = 2 THEN    //SUPPORT-2018
        EXIT;

      IF Step =1 THEN BEGIN
        QuickSalesLine.GET(OrderNo,Lineno);
        QuickSalesHeader.GET(OrderNo);
        ItemAttributeCollection.GET(QuickSalesLine."No.",QuickSalesLine."Variant Code");
        //Customer.GET(QuickSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
        TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=QuickSalesHeader."External Document No.";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=Lineno;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Order Created";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Brand:=ItemAttributeCollection.Marke;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Variant Code":=QuickSalesLine."Variant Code";
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Order Date":=QuickSalesHeader."Order Date";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Price:=QuickSalesLine."Unit Price";
        IF QuickSalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":='EUR'
        ELSE
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":=QuickSalesHeader."Currency Code";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.CustomerEmail := QuickSalesHeader."Sell-to E-Mail";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.INSERT;
      END;

      IF Step =2 THEN BEGIN
        IF SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo,Lineno) THEN BEGIN
        SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo);
        ItemAttributeCollection.GET(SalesLine."No.",SalesLine."Variant Code");
        //Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
        TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=SalesHeader."No.";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=Lineno;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Order Confirmed";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Brand:=ItemAttributeCollection.Marke;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Variant Code":=SalesLine."Variant Code";
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Order Date":=SalesHeader."Order Date";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Price:=SalesLine."Unit Price";
        IF SalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":='EUR'
        ELSE
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":=SalesHeader."Currency Code";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.CustomerEmail := SalesShiptoFieldsHandling.Get_ShipToEMail(SalesHeader.RECORDID,SalesHeader);
        IF TempFreshSalesEntries.INSERT THEN;
        END;
      END;

      IF Step =3 THEN BEGIN //order Invoice
        {
        SalesInvoiceLine.GET(OrderNo,Lineno);
        SalesInvoiceHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo);
        //Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
        }
        SalesInvoiceLine.GET(OrderNo,Lineno);
        SalesInvoiceHeader.GET(OrderNo);

        ItemAttributeCollection.GET(SalesInvoiceLine."No.",SalesInvoiceLine."Variant Code");

        TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=SalesInvoiceHeader."Order No.";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=Lineno;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Order Invoiced";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Brand:=ItemAttributeCollection.Marke;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Variant Code":=SalesInvoiceLine."Variant Code";
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Order Date":=SalesInvoiceHeader."Order Date";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Price:=SalesInvoiceLine."Unit Price";
        IF QuickSalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":='EUR'
        ELSE
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":=SalesInvoiceHeader."Currency Code";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.CustomerEmail := SalesShiptoFieldsHandling.Get_ShipToEMail(SalesInvoiceHeader.RECORDID,SalesInvoiceHeader);
        TempFreshSalesEntries.INSERT;
      END;

      IF Step =4 THEN BEGIN //order Invoice

        SalesLineArchive.SETRANGE(SalesLineArchive."Document Type",SalesLineArchive."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesLineArchive.SETRANGE(SalesLineArchive."Document No.",OrderNo);
        SalesLineArchive.SETRANGE(SalesLineArchive."Line No.",Lineno);
        IF SalesLineArchive.FINDLAST THEN
          SalesHeaderArchive.GET(SalesLineArchive."Document Type",SalesLineArchive."Document No.",SalesLineArchive."Doc. No. Occurrence",SalesLineArchive."Version No.");

        //Customer.GET(SalesHeaderArchive."Sell-to Customer No.");
        ItemAttributeCollection.GET(SalesLineArchive."No.",SalesLineArchive."Variant Code");
        {
        SalesHeaderArchive.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeaderArchive."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHeaderArchive.SETRANGE("No.",SalesHeaderArchive."No.");
        IF SalesHeaderArchive.FINDLAST THEN;
        }
        TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=SalesHeaderArchive."No.";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=Lineno;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Order Archived";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Brand:=ItemAttributeCollection.Marke;
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Variant Code":=SalesLineArchive."Variant Code";
        TempFreshSalesEntries."Order Date":=SalesHeaderArchive."Order Date";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.Price:=SalesLineArchive."Unit Price";
        IF SalesHeaderArchive."Currency Code" = '' THEN
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":='EUR'
        ELSE
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":=SalesHeaderArchive."Currency Code";
        SalesHeaderArchive.CALCFIELDS("E-Mail");
        TempFreshSalesEntries.CustomerEmail := SalesHeaderArchive."E-Mail";
        TempFreshSalesEntries.INSERT;
      END;

      IF Step =5 THEN BEGIN //ITBO-1316
        //SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo,Lineno);
        SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo);

        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",OrderNo);
        SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
        SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
        IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
          ItemAttributeCollection.GET(SalesLine."No.",SalesLine."Variant Code");
          //Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");

          TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=SalesHeader."No.";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=SalesLine."Line No.";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Payment Received";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Brand:=ItemAttributeCollection.Marke;
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Variant Code":=SalesLine."Variant Code";
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Order Date":=SalesHeader."Order Date";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Price:=SalesLine."Unit Price";
          IF SalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
            TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":='EUR'
          ELSE
            TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":=SalesHeader."Currency Code";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.CustomerEmail := SalesShiptoFieldsHandling.Get_ShipToEMail(SalesHeader.RECORDID,SalesHeader);
          TempFreshSalesEntries.INSERT;
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
      END;
      IF Step =7 THEN BEGIN //ITBO-1316
        //SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo,Lineno);
        SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo);

        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",OrderNo);
        SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
        SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
        IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
          ItemAttributeCollection.GET(SalesLine."No.",SalesLine."Variant Code");
          //Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");

          TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=SalesHeader."No.";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=SalesLine."Line No.";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Payment Delayed";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Brand:=ItemAttributeCollection.Marke;
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Variant Code":=SalesLine."Variant Code";
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Order Date":=SalesHeader."Order Date";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Price:=SalesLine."Unit Price";
          IF SalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
            TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":='EUR'
          ELSE
            TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":=SalesHeader."Currency Code";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.CustomerEmail := SalesShiptoFieldsHandling.Get_ShipToEMail(SalesHeader.RECORDID,SalesHeader);
          TempFreshSalesEntries.INSERT;
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
      END;
      IF Step =6 THEN BEGIN //ITBO-1317
        //SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo,Lineno);
        SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order",OrderNo);

        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::"Return Order");
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",OrderNo);
        SalesLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",Lineno);
        SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
        SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
        IF SalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
          ItemAttributeCollection.GET(SalesLine."No.",SalesLine."Variant Code");
          //Customer.GET(SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");

          TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=SalesLine."Source Document No.";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=SalesLine."Source Document Line No.";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Return Started";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Brand:=ItemAttributeCollection.Marke;
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Variant Code":=SalesLine."Variant Code";
          TempFreshSalesEntries."Order Date":=SalesHeader."Order Date";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Price:=SalesLine."Unit Price";
          IF SalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
            TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":='EUR'
          ELSE
            TempFreshSalesEntries."Currency Code":=SalesHeader."Currency Code";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.CustomerEmail := SalesShiptoFieldsHandling.Get_ShipToEMail(SalesHeader.RECORDID,SalesHeader);
          TempFreshSalesEntries.INSERT;
        END;
      END;

      //SUPPORT-2018 start
      IF Step = 8 THEN BEGIN    //Created for Batch Job report that check if security check status is Approved
        IF SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo,Lineno) THEN BEGIN
          SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo);
          ItemAttributeCollection.GET(SalesLine."No.",SalesLine."Variant Code");
          TempFreshSalesEntries.INIT;
          TempFreshSalesEntries.OrderNo:=SalesHeader."No.";
          TempFreshSalesEntries.LineNo:=Lineno;
          TempFreshSalesEntries.Status:=TempFreshSalesEntries.Status::"Order Confirmed";

          TempFreshSalesEntries.Model:=ItemAttributeCollection.Modell;

        IF SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo,Lineno) THEN BEGIN

    PROCEDURE CheckQuickSales@301510004(QuickSalesLine@301510001 : Record 5104607);
    VAR
      QuickSalesHeader@301510000 : Record 5104606;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510006 : Record 50029;
      VendorCode@301510002 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      IF QuickSalesLine.VendorId = '' THEN
