    LOCAL PROCEDURE eLady_CallAPI@301510000(recQuickSalesHeader@301510010 : Record 5104606;recQuickSalesLine@301510011 : Record 5104607);
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510003 : Record 50026;
      txtURL@301510000 : Text;
      charValue@301510004 : TextConst 'ENU="="';
      err001@301510007 : TextConst 'ENU=Consignment Item is missing for %1';
      txtStatus@301510008 : Text;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510005 : Record 50029;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510002 : Record 50030;
      SetupValue@301510001 : Record 5105011;
      pVendorID@301510006 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      txtURL := eLady_GenerateURL(recQuickSalesHeader,recQuickSalesLine);
      IF txtURL <> '' THEN BEGIN
          HttpWebRequest:= HttpWebRequest.Create(txtURL);
          HttpWebRequest.Method('POST');
          HttpWebResponse := HttpWebRequest.GetResponse();
          ResponseInStream:= HttpWebResponse.GetResponseStream;
          ResponseInStream.READTEXT(JsonText);
          JSONObject := JSONObject.Parse(JsonText);
          txtStatus := JSONObject.GetValue('status').ToString();
          IF txtStatus = '1' THEN
            InsertConsEmailEntry(recQuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",recQuickSalesLine."Variant Code",ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Approved)
          ELSE
            InsertConsEmailEntry(recQuickSalesHeader."External Document No.",recQuickSalesLine."Variant Code",ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE eLady_GenerateURL@301510003(p_recQuickSalesHeader@301510002 : Record 5104606;p_recQuickSalesLine@301510003 : Record 5104607) : Text;
    VAR
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510001 : Record 50029;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510000 : Record 50030;
      SetupValue@301510004 : Record 5105011;
      txtURL@301510005 : Text;
      charValue@301510007 : TextConst 'ENU="="';
      err001@301510006 : TextConst 'ENU=Consignment Item is missing for %1';
    BEGIN
      SetupValue.RESET;
      SetupValue.SETRANGE("Setup Code",'ELADY');
      SetupValue.SETFILTER("Setup Value Productive System",'<>%1','');
      SetupValue.SETCURRENTKEY("Sub Category");
      IF SetupValue.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        txtURL := SetupValue."Setup Value Productive System";
        SetupValue.NEXT;
        REPEAT
          IF SetupValue."Setup Value Productive System" <> 'variable' THEN
            txtURL := txtURL + LOWERCASE(SetupValue.Category) + charValue + SetupValue."Setup Value Productive System"
          ELSE BEGIN
            CASE SetupValue.Category OF
              '&SKU' : BEGIN
                ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.RESET;
                ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.SETRANGE("Item No.",p_recQuickSalesLine."No.");
                ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.SETRANGE("Variant Code",p_recQuickSalesLine."Variant Code");
                IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                  txtURL := txtURL + LOWERCASE(SetupValue.Category) + charValue + ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor Item Id";
                END ELSE
                  ERROR(err001,p_recQuickSalesLine."No." + '_' + p_recQuickSalesLine."Variant Code");
              END;
              '&QUANTITY' : txtURL := txtURL + LOWERCASE(SetupValue.Category) + charValue + FORMAT(p_recQuickSalesLine.Quantity);
            END;
          END;
        UNTIL SetupValue.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      EXIT(txtURL);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertConsEmailEntry@301510002(codDocumentNo@301510000 : Code[20];codVariantNo@301510001 : Code[20];optStatus@301510002 : ' ,Approved,Rejected');
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510003 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.INIT;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Order No." := codDocumentNo;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Variant Code" := codVariantNo;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status := optStatus;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Inserted From" := USERID;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Inserted Date" := TODAY;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Inserted Time" := TIME;
      IF NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.INSERT THEN
        ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.MODIFY;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE eLady_CallAPI_ManualOrder@301510001(recSalesHeader@301510010 : Record 36;recSalesLine@301510011 : Record 37);
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510003 : Record 50026;
      txtURL@301510000 : Text;
      charValue@301510004 : TextConst 'ENU="="';
      err001@301510007 : TextConst 'ENU=Consignment Item is missing for %1';
      txtStatus@301510008 : Text;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510005 : Record 50029;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510002 : Record 50030;
      SetupValue@301510001 : Record 5105011;
      pVendorID@301510006 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      txtURL := eLady_GenerateURL_ManualOrder(recSalesHeader,recSalesLine);
      IF txtURL <> '' THEN BEGIN
          HttpWebRequest:= HttpWebRequest.Create(txtURL);
          HttpWebRequest.Method('POST');
          HttpWebResponse := HttpWebRequest.GetResponse();
          ResponseInStream:= HttpWebResponse.GetResponseStream;
          ResponseInStream.READTEXT(JsonText);
          JSONObject := JSONObject.Parse(JsonText);
          txtStatus := JSONObject.GetValue('status').ToString();
          MESSAGE(txtStatus);
          IF txtStatus = '1' THEN
            InsertConsEmailEntry(recSalesHeader."External Document No.",recSalesLine."Variant Code",ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Approved)
          ELSE
            InsertConsEmailEntry(recSalesHeader."External Document No.",recSalesLine."Variant Code",ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected);
      END;
    END;

OBJECT Codeunit 50038 CHXT Order Management.
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES

    Version List=;
  }
  PROPERTIES

    OnRun=BEGIN
            gSalesHeader.GET(1,'X76254731812');
            CreateTransferOrder(gSalesHeader);
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      gSalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;

    PROCEDURE CreateTransferOrder@301510001(VAR SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37;
      TransferHeader@301510002 : Record 5740;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT CONFIRM('Do you want to continue to create Transfer Order?', FALSE) THEN
        EXIT;

      IF CheckTransferOrderExist(SalesHeader."No.") THEN
        ERROR('Transfer Order is already exist.');

      //IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" <> 'PICKUP' THEN
        //ERROR('Payment method should be PICKUP in sales order');

      CLEAR(TransferHeader);
      CreateTransferHeader(SalesHeader, TransferHeader);

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.", SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type, SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          CheckSalesLineReservationEntry(SalesLine);
          CreateTransferLine(TransferHeader, SalesLine);
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT() = 0;

      CODEUNIT.RUN(CODEUNIT::"Release Transfer Document", TransferHeader);

      MESSAGE('Transfer Order No. %1 has been created.', TransferHeader."No.");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckTransferOrderExist@301510002(OrderNo@301510000 : Code[20]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      TransferHeader@301510001 : Record 5740;
    BEGIN
      TransferHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.", OrderNo);
      IF NOT TransferHeader.ISEMPTY() THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckSalesLineReservationEntry@301510009(SalesLine@301510000 : Record 37);
    VAR
      ReservationEntry2@301510001 : Record 337;
      ReservationEntry@301510002 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      ReservationEntry.RESET();
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID", SalesLine."Document No.");
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type", 37);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.", SalesLine."Line No.");
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code", SalesLine."Variant Code");
      IF ReservationEntry.FINDFIRST() THEN BEGIN
        ReservationEntry2.RESET();
        ReservationEntry2.SETRANGE("Entry No.", ReservationEntry."Entry No.");
        ReservationEntry2.SETRANGE(Positive, NOT ReservationEntry.Positive);
        IF ReservationEntry2.FINDFIRST() THEN
          ReservationEntry2.DELETEALL();

        ReservationEntry.DELETE();
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateTransferHeader@301510028(VAR SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;VAR TransferHeader@301510002 : Record 5740);
    BEGIN
      TransferHeader.INIT();
      TransferHeader."No." := SalesHeader."No.";
      TransferHeader.VALIDATE("Transfer-from Code", SalesHeader."Location Code");
      TransferHeader.VALIDATE("Transfer-to Code", SalesHeader."Pickup Location Code");
      TransferHeader.VALIDATE("External Document No.", SalesHeader."No.");
      TransferHeader.INSERT(TRUE);

      SalesHeader.VALIDATE("Pickup Transfer Order No.", TransferHeader."No.");
      SalesHeader.MODIFY();
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateTransferLine@301510039(TransHeader@301510000 : Record 5740;SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37);
    VAR
      TransferLine@301510002 : Record 5741;
    BEGIN
      TransferLine.INIT;
      TransferLine.VALIDATE("Document No.", TransHeader."No.");
      TransferLine."Line No." := SalesLine."Line No.";
      TransferLine."Transfer-from Code" := TransHeader."Transfer-from Code";
      TransferLine."Transfer-to Code" := TransHeader."Transfer-to Code";
      TransferLine.INSERT(TRUE);

      TransferLine.VALIDATE("Item No.", SalesLine."No.");
      TransferLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code", SalesLine."Variant Code");
      TransferLine.VALIDATE(Quantity, SalesLine.Quantity);
      TransferLine.MODIFY(TRUE);

      CreateReservationEntry(TransferLine);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateReservationEntry@301510056(TransferLine@301510000 : Record 5741);
    VAR
      ReservationEntryNo@301510001 : Integer;
      SerialNo@301510002 : Code[20];
      ReservationEntry@301510003 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      CLEAR(ReservationEntryNo);
      CLEAR(SerialNo);
      IF CheckItemLedgerEntry(TransferLine, ReservationEntryNo, SerialNo) THEN BEGIN
        ReservationEntry.INIT();
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Entry No.", ReservationEntryNo);
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE(Positive, FALSE);
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Reservation Status", ReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation);
        ReservationEntry.INSERT();

        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Source ID", TransferLine."Document No.");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Item No.", TransferLine."Item No.");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Location Code", TransferLine."Transfer-from Code");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Source Type", 5741);
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Source Ref. No.", TransferLine."Line No.");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Qty. per Unit of Measure", TransferLine."Qty. per Unit of Measure");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Quantity (Base)", -TransferLine.Quantity);
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Variant Code", TransferLine."Variant Code");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Serial No.", SerialNo);
        ReservationEntry.MODIFY(TRUE);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckItemLedgerEntry@301510000(TransferLine@301510000 : Record 5741;VAR ReservationEntryNo@301510003 : Integer;VAR SerialNo@301510004 : Code[20]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510001 : Record 32;
      ReservationEntry@301510002 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET();
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.", TransferLine."Item No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code", TransferLine."Transfer-from Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open, TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code", TransferLine."Variant Code");
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST() THEN BEGIN
        ReservationEntry.INIT();
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE(Positive, TRUE);
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Reservation Status", ReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation);
        ReservationEntry.INSERT(TRUE);

        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Item No.", ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Location Code", ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Source Type", 32);
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Source Ref. No.", ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Serial No.", ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Qty. per Unit of Measure", ItemLedgerEntry."Qty. per Unit of Measure");
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Quantity (Base)", ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity);
        IF ReservationEntry."Serial No." <> '' THEN
          ReservationEntry."Item Tracking" := ReservationEntry."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.";
        ReservationEntry.VALIDATE("Variant Code", ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
        ReservationEntry.MODIFY(TRUE);
        ReservationEntryNo := ReservationEntry."Entry No.";
        SerialNo := ReservationEntry."Serial No.";
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateEmailBody@301510000(OrderNo@301510002 : Code[20]) : Text[1020];
    VAR
      PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301510001 : Record 39;
      EmailBodyText@301510003 : Text[1020];
    BEGIN
      CLEAR(EmailBodyText);
      IF PurchaseHeader.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order, OrderNo) THEN BEGIN
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type", PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.", PurchaseHeader."No.");
        IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            EmailBodyText := STRSUBSTNO(PurchaseOrderNoText, PurchaseHeader."No.");
            EmailBodyText += STRSUBSTNO(VendorOrderNoText, PurchaseHeader."Vendor Order No.");
            EmailBodyText += STRSUBSTNO(VariantCodeText, PurchaseLine."Variant Code");
            EmailBodyText += STRSUBSTNO(UnitCostText, PurchaseLine."Direct Unit Cost", GetCurrencyCode(PurchaseHeader."Currency Code"));
            EmailBodyText += TextInfo;
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(EmailBodyText);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE XmlEscape@301510024(Value@301510000 : Text) Result : Text;
    BEGIN
      Result := Value;

      Result := ReplaceText(Result,'&','&amp;');
      Result := ReplaceText(Result,'<','&lt;');
      Result := ReplaceText(Result,'>','&gt;');
      Result := ReplaceText(Result,'"','&quot;');
      Result := ReplaceText(Result,'''','&apos;');

      EXIT(Result);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ReplaceText@301510025(SourceText@301510000 : Text;FindText@301510001 : Text;ReplaceWith@301510002 : Text) Result : Text;
    VAR
      Position@301510003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      Result := SourceText;
      Position := STRPOS(Result,FindText);

      WHILE Position > 0 DO BEGIN
        Result :=
          COPYSTR(Result,1,Position - 1) +
          ReplaceWith +
          COPYSTR(Result,Position + STRLEN(FindText));

        Position := STRPOS(Result,FindText);
      END;

      EXIT(Result);
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }

  {

    PROCEDURE CreateNuveiJson@301510000(SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 112;VendorNo@301510006 : ARRAY [3] OF Code[20]) : Text;
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510008 : Record 113;
      ResponseText@301510010 : Text;
      WebClient@301510009 : DotNet "'System, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      Token@301510011 : Text;
      URL@301510012 : Text;
      mokt@301510015 : Codeunit 50005;
      VendorCount@301510001 : Integer;
      i@301510002 : Integer;
      jObject@301510004 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      jToken@301510003 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken";
      ResponseCode@301510005 : Text;
      JSonText@301510007 : Text;
      SalesPSPCard@301510013 : Record 5227625;
    BEGIN
      ExtRef := SalesHeader."No.";
      chronextVirtualAcc := 'FD5CKXSCscqqoq93bWk9jiRjYW5QppMjgqv';

      ChronextAmount := SalesHeader."Nuvei Chronext Comission";
      SellerAmount := SalesHeader."Nuvei Vendor Amount";
      TotalAmount := ChronextAmount + SellerAmount;

      CheckVendors(VendorNo);

      IF SellerAmount <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        FOR i := 1 TO ARRAYLEN(gVendorCode) DO BEGIN
          IF gVendorCode[i] <> '' THEN BEGIN
            Vendor.GET(gVendorCode[i]);
            gAccountCode[i] := Vendor."Nuvei Virtual Account Code";
          END;
        END;
      END ELSE
        jsonType := 'chronextPayment';

      IF jsonType = '' THEN BEGIN
        IF gAccountCount = 1 THEN
          jsonType := 'singleVendor'
        ELSE
          jsonType := 'multipleVendors';
      END;

      IF isProd = FALSE THEN
        AccountCode := GetVirtualAccount('FD5CKXPW6nSfSLyrN8qYnrZdJkNCvwWupzC')
      ELSE BEGIN
        IF (jsonType IN ['singleVendor','multipleVendors']) THEN BEGIN
          IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" <> 'ZAVER' THEN BEGIN
            IF  (gAccountCode[1] = '') THEN BEGIN
             ERROR('Nuvei Account Code is not found.');
            END;
          END;
        END;
        AccountCode := GetVirtualAccount(gAccountCode[1]);
      END;

      IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'ZAVER' THEN
        jsonType := 'balanceTransfer';

      IF jsonType = 'balanceTransfer' THEN
        URL := GetSetupValues('BALANCETRANSFER')
      ELSE
        URL := GetSetupValues('SPLITPAYMENT');

      IF Vendor."Currency Code" = '' THEN
        CurrencyCode := 'EUR'
      ELSE
        CurrencyCode := Vendor."Currency Code";

      IF isProd = FALSE THEN
        PSPRef := SalesHeader."External Document No."
      ELSE
        PSPRef := GetPSPRef(SalesHeader."External Document No.");

      JSonText := BuildJsonForSplit(SalesHeader);


      mokt.TextExportToFile(JSonText);

      Token := GetSetupValues('TOKEN');

      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Accept', 'application/json');

      ResponseText := WebClient.UploadString(URL,'POST',JSonText);

      jObject := jObject.Parse(ResponseText);
      jToken := jObject.SelectToken('code');

      IF ISNULL(jToken) THEN
        ERROR('POST response did not contain a code.');

      ResponseCode := FORMAT(jToken);
      SalesHeader."EU 3-Party Trade" := TRUE;
      SalesHeader.MODIFY;
      IF SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::"Posted Sales Invoice",SalesHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
        SalesPSPCard."Transaction Identifier" := ResponseCode;
        SalesPSPCard.MODIFY;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        CLEAR(SalesPSPCard);
        SalesPSPCard."Document Type" := SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::"Posted Sales Invoice";

      EXIT('OK');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE EscapeJson@301510001(Value@301510000 : Text) Result : Text;
    BEGIN
      Result := Value;
      Result := DELCHR(Result, '=', '\');
      Result := CONVERTSTR(Result, '"', '''');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetVirtualAccount@301510005(pAccountCode@301510005 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      ResponseText@301510003 : Text;
      WebClient@301510002 : DotNet "'System, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      Token@301510001 : Text;
      URL@301510000 : Text;
      jObject@301510004 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
    BEGIN
      Token := GetSetupValues('TOKEN');
      URL := STRSUBSTNO(GetSetupValues('GETVIRTUALACCOUNT'),pAccountCode);

      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Accept', 'application/json');
      ResponseText := WebClient.DownloadString(URL);
      jObject := jObject.Parse(ResponseText);
      AccountCode := FORMAT(jObject.SelectToken('elements[0].code'));

      EXIT(AccountCode);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ParseResponse@301510006(ResponseTxt@301510006 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      JSONMgt@301510000 : Codeunit 5459;
      ElementMgt@301510001 : Codeunit 5459;
      ElementsTxt@301510002 : Text;
      ElementTxt@301510003 : Text;
      AccountType@301510004 : Text;
      i@301510005 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      JSONMgt.InitializeObject(ResponseTxt);
      EXIT(
        JSONMgt.GetValue('elements[?(@.accountType==''DEFAULT'')].code'));
    END;

    PROCEDURE FindCosts_Inv@301510011(InvNo@301510000 : Code[20];ExtDocNo@301510003 : Text;VAR PurchasePosted@301510004 : Boolean;VAR PurchaseOrderNo@301510005 : Code[20];VAR PurchaseInvNo@301510006 : Code[20];VAR VendorNo@301510007 : ARRAY [3] OF Code[20]) : Decimal;
    VAR
      SalesInvoiceLine@301510001 : Record 113;
      UnpostedDocumentValue@301510002 : Record 5295670;
      i@301510008 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      CLEARALL;
      SalesInvoiceLine.RESET;
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",InvNo);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesInvoiceLine.Type::Item);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        i := 1;
        REPEAT
          UnpostedDocumentValue.RESET;
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",ExtDocNo);
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",SalesInvoiceLine."Line No.");
          IF UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            FindCost_Purchase_Inv(SalesInvoiceLine,PurchasePosted,PurchaseOrderNo,PurchaseInvNo,VendorNo,i);
            IF UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueCode IN ['LVS','ST'] THEN BEGIN
              gCostAmnt := 0;
              gCostAmntIncVAT := 0;
            END;
          END;
          SalesInvoiceLine."Nuvei Vendor Amount" := gCostAmntIncVAT;
          SalesInvoiceLine."Vendor No." := VendorNo[i];
          SalesInvoiceLine.MODIFY;
          i += 1;
        UNTIL SalesInvoiceLine.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      EXIT(gCostAmntIncVAT);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindCost_Purchase_Inv@301510012(SalesInvoiceLine@301510004 : Record 113;VAR PurchasePosted@301510007 : Boolean;VAR PurchaseOrderNo@301510012 : Code[20];VAR PurchaseInvNo@301510011 : Code[20];VAR VendorNo@301510008 : ARRAY [3] OF Code[20];i@301510009 : Integer);
    VAR
      PurchaseLine@301510000 : Record 39;
      PurchInvLine@301510001 : Record 123;
      PurchaseHeader@301510002 : Record 38;
      PurchInvHeader@301510003 : Record 122;
      WatchCost@301510005 : Decimal;
      WatchCostIncVAT@301510006 : Decimal;
      VendorLedgerEntry@301510010 : Record 25;
    BEGIN
      PurchaseOrderNo := '';
      PurchaseInvNo := '';
      PurchasePosted := FALSE;

      PurchInvLine.RESET;
      PurchInvLine.SETRANGE(PurchInvLine."No.",SalesInvoiceLine."No.");
      PurchInvLine.SETRANGE(PurchInvLine."Variant Code",SalesInvoiceLine."Variant Code");
      IF PurchInvLine.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        PurchasePosted := TRUE;
        PurchInvHeader.GET(PurchInvLine."Document No.");
        PurchaseInvNo := PurchInvHeader."No.";
        PurchaseOrderNo := PurchInvHeader."Order No.";
        VendorNo[i] := PurchInvHeader."Buy-from Vendor No.";
        VendorLedgerEntry.RESET;
        VendorLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Vendor No.",VendorNo[i]);
        VendorLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",VendorLedgerEntry."Document Type"::Invoice);
        VendorLedgerEntry.SETFILTER(Description,'%1','*'+PurchaseOrderNo+'*');
        IF VendorLedgerEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          VendorLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Remaining Amount","Remaining Amt. (LCY)");
          gCostAmnt := -VendorLedgerEntry."Remaining Amt. (LCY)";
          gCostAmntIncVAT := -VendorLedgerEntry."Remaining Amt. (LCY)";
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PurchaseLine.RESET;
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",SalesInvoiceLine."No.");
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesInvoiceLine."Variant Code");
        IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          PurchaseHeader.GET(PurchaseLine."Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document No.");
          PurchaseOrderNo := PurchaseHeader."No.";
          VendorNo[i] := PurchaseHeader."Buy-from Vendor No.";
          IF PurchaseHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN BEGIN
            gCostAmnt := PurchaseLine.Amount;
            gCostAmntIncVAT := PurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT";
          END ELSE BEGIN
            IF PurchaseHeader."Currency Factor" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
              gCostAmnt := PurchaseLine.Amount / PurchaseHeader."Currency Factor";
              gCostAmntIncVAT := PurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT" / PurchaseHeader."Currency Factor";
            END;
          END;
        END;
        {
        IF SalesInvoiceLine."Document No." = 'RG0027183' THEN BEGIN
          IF USERID = 'MOKTAY' THEN BEGIN
          MESSAGE(PurchaseLine."Document No.");
          MESSAGE(FORMAT(gCostAmnt));
          MESSAGE(FORMAT(gCostAmntIncVAT));
          END;
        END;
        }
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckVendors@301510007(VendorCode@301510000 : ARRAY [3] OF Code[20]);
    VAR
      IsUnique@301510001 : Boolean;
      i@301510002 : Integer;
      j@301510003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      CLEAR(gVendorCode);

      FOR i := 1 TO ARRAYLEN(VendorCode) DO BEGIN
        IsUnique := TRUE;

        IF VendorCode[i] = '' THEN
          IsUnique := FALSE;

        IF IsUnique THEN BEGIN
          FOR j := 1 TO ARRAYLEN(gVendorCode) DO BEGIN
            IF VendorCode[i] = gVendorCode[j] THEN
              IsUnique := FALSE;
          END;
        END;

        IF IsUnique THEN BEGIN
          j := 1;

          WHILE (j <= ARRAYLEN(gVendorCode)) AND
                (gVendorCode[j] <> '') DO
            j := j + 1;

          IF j <= ARRAYLEN(gVendorCode) THEN
            gVendorCode[j] := VendorCode[i];
        END;
      END;


      gAccountCount := 0;
      FOR i := 1 TO ARRAYLEN(gVendorCode) DO
        IF gVendorCode[i] <> '' THEN
          gAccountCount := gAccountCount + 1;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetPSPRef@301510016(ExtDocNo@301510000 : Text) : Text;

      IF QuickSalesHeader.FINDLAST THEN
        EXIT(QuickSalesHeader."External Transaction No.");
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateNuveiJson_SH@301510014(SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;VendorNo@301510006 : ARRAY [3] OF Code[20]) : Text;
    VAR
      ResponseText@301510010 : Text;
      WebClient@301510009 : DotNet "'System, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      Token@301510011 : Text;
      URL@301510012 : Text;
      mokt@301510015 : Codeunit 50005;
      VendorCount@301510001 : Integer;
      i@301510002 : Integer;
      jObject@301510004 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      jToken@301510003 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken";
      ResponseCode@301510005 : Text;
      JSonText@301510007 : Text;
      SalesPSPCard@301510013 : Record 5227625;
    BEGIN


      ExtRef := SalesHeader."No.";
      chronextVirtualAcc := 'FD5CKXRQcGS7iimCqH1qgtTiaCLWtxa26Zv';


      ChronextAmount := SalesHeader."Nuvei Chronext Comission";
      SellerAmount := SalesHeader."Nuvei Vendor Amount";
      TotalAmount := ChronextAmount + SellerAmount;

      CheckVendors(VendorNo);
      gAccountCount := 1;

      IF SellerAmount <> 0 THEN BEGIN

        FOR i := 1 TO ARRAYLEN(gVendorCode) DO BEGIN
          IF gVendorCode[i] <> '' THEN BEGIN
            Vendor.GET(gVendorCode[i]);
            gAccountCode[i] := Vendor."Nuvei Virtual Account Code";
          END;
        END;


      END ELSE
        jsonType := 'chronextPayment';

      IF jsonType = '' THEN BEGIN
        IF gAccountCount = 1 THEN
          jsonType := 'singleVendor'
        ELSE
          jsonType := 'multipleVendors';
      END;


      IF (jsonType IN ['singleVendor','multipleVendors']) THEN BEGIN
        IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" <> 'ZAVER' THEN BEGIN
          IF  (gAccountCode[1] = '') THEN BEGIN
           ERROR('Nuvei Account Code is not found');
          END;
        END;
      END;


      AccountCode := GetVirtualAccount(gAccountCode[1]);

      IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'ZAVER' THEN
        jsonType := 'balanceTransfer';

      IF jsonType = 'balanceTransfer' THEN
        URL := GetSetupValues('BALANCETRANSFER')
        //URL := 'https://sandbox.payaut.com/api/v2/fund/balance/transfer'
      ELSE
        URL := GetSetupValues('SPLITPAYMENT');
        //URL := 'https://sandbox.payaut.com/api/v1/fund/split-payments';

      IF SalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
        CurrencyCode := 'EUR'
      ELSE
        CurrencyCode := SalesHeader."Currency Code";


      PSPRef := GetPSPRef(SalesHeader."External Document No.");

      JSonText := BuildJsonForSplit_SH(SalesHeader);

      //mokt.TextExportToFile(JSonText);
      //EXIT;

      Token := GetSetupValues('TOKEN');
      //Token:='FD5CKXQmNJCevq8rFmcF8FrgRK3ciHYiaUg.FD5CKXQmPRiwnZKEYPqUCg4qVfezTyAwaiL';

      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Accept', 'application/json');

      ResponseText := WebClient.UploadString(URL,'POST',JSonText);

      jObject := jObject.Parse(ResponseText);
      jToken := jObject.SelectToken('code');

      IF ISNULL(jToken) THEN
        ERROR('POST response did not contain a code.');

      ResponseCode := FORMAT(jToken);
      SalesHeader."EU 3-Party Trade" := TRUE;
      SalesHeader.MODIFY;
      IF SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order,SalesHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
        SalesPSPCard."Transaction Identifier" := ResponseCode;
        SalesPSPCard.MODIFY;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        CLEAR(SalesPSPCard);
        SalesPSPCard."Document Type" := SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order;
        SalesPSPCard."No." := SalesHeader."No.";
        SalesPSPCard."Transaction Identifier" := ResponseCode;
        SalesPSPCard.INSERT(FALSE);
      END;
      MESSAGE('POST successful. Code: %1',ResponseCode);
      EXIT('OK');
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetChronextBalance@301510003();
    VAR
      ChronextAccCode@301510000 : Text;

      jToken@301510006 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken";
      jArray@301510005 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray";

    PROCEDURE BalanceTransfer@301510020(VendorNo@301510002 : Code[20];SellerAmount@301510003 : Decimal;DocNo@301510008 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      URL@301510000 : Text;
      Token@301510001 : Text;
      Err001@301510004 : TextConst 'ENU=Nuvei Account Code is not found';
      JsonText@301510005 : Text;

      ResponseText@301510007 : Text;
    BEGIN

      IF isProd = FALSE THEN
        AccountCode := GetVirtualAccount('FD5CKXPW6nSfSLyrN8qYnrZdJkNCvwWupzC')

        IF Vendor."Nuvei Virtual Account Code" = '' THEN
          ERROR(Err001);

      JsonText :=

        '"fromAccountCode":"' + EscapeJson(chronextVirtualAcc) + '",' +
        '"toAccountCode":"' + EscapeJson(AccountCode) + '",' +

        '"currency":"' + EscapeJson(CurrencyCode) + '",' +

      APICall(Token,URL,JsonText,DocNo);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE APICall@301510024(Token@301510004 : Text;URL@301510003 : Text;JSonText@301510002 : Text;DocNo@301510008 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      WebClient@301510001 : DotNet "'System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      ResponseText@301510000 : Text;
      SalesHeader@301510005 : Record 36;
      SalesPSPCard@301510006 : Record 5227625;
      ResponseCode@301510007 : Text;
      jObject@301510010 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      jToken@301510009 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken";
    BEGIN
      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Accept', 'application/json');

      ResponseText := WebClient.UploadString(URL,'POST',JSonText);

      jObject := jObject.Parse(ResponseText);
      jToken := jObject.SelectToken('code');

      IF ISNULL(jToken) THEN
        ERROR('POST response did not contain a code.');

      ResponseCode := FORMAT(jToken);
      SalesHeader.GET(DocNo);
      SalesHeader."EU 3-Party Trade" := TRUE;
      SalesHeader.MODIFY;
      IF SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::"Posted Sales Invoice",SalesHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
        SalesPSPCard."Transaction Identifier" := ResponseCode;
        SalesPSPCard.MODIFY;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        CLEAR(SalesPSPCard);
        SalesPSPCard."Document Type" := SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::"Posted Sales Invoice";
        SalesPSPCard."No." := SalesHeader."No.";
        SalesPSPCard."Transaction Identifier" := ResponseCode;
        SalesPSPCard.INSERT(FALSE);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateNuveiJson_Shop@301510026(SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 5104606;VendorNo@301510006 : ARRAY [3] OF Code[20]) : Text;
    VAR
      SalesLine@301510008 : Record 5104606;
      ResponseText@301510010 : Text;
      WebClient@301510009 : DotNet "'System, Version=2.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Net.WebClient";
      Token@301510011 : Text;
      URL@301510012 : Text;
      mokt@301510015 : Codeunit 50005;
      VendorCount@301510001 : Integer;
      i@301510002 : Integer;
      jObject@301510004 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      jToken@301510003 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken";
      ResponseCode@301510005 : Text;
      JSonText@301510007 : Text;
      SalesPSPCard@301510013 : Record 5227625;
    BEGIN


      ExtRef := SalesHeader."No.";
      chronextVirtualAcc := 'FD5CKXRQcGS7iimCqH1qgtTiaCLWtxa26Zv';


      ChronextAmount := 0;
      SellerAmount := SalesHeader.Amount;
      TotalAmount := SalesHeader.Amount;

      CheckVendors(VendorNo);
      gAccountCount := 1;

      IF SellerAmount <> 0 THEN BEGIN

        FOR i := 1 TO ARRAYLEN(gVendorCode) DO BEGIN
          IF gVendorCode[i] <> '' THEN BEGIN
            Vendor.GET(gVendorCode[i]);
            gAccountCode[i] := Vendor."Nuvei Virtual Account Code";
          END;
        END;

      END ELSE
        jsonType := 'chronextPayment';

      IF jsonType = '' THEN BEGIN
        IF gAccountCount = 1 THEN
          jsonType := 'singleVendor'
        ELSE
          jsonType := 'multipleVendors';
      END;


      IF (jsonType IN ['singleVendor','multipleVendors']) THEN BEGIN
        IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" <> 'ZAVER' THEN BEGIN
          IF  (gAccountCode[1] = '') THEN BEGIN
           ERROR('Nuvei Account Code is not found');
          END;
        END;
      END;

      AccountCode := GetVirtualAccount(gAccountCode[1]);
      //AccountCode := 'FD5CKXRiu1rbYvqEUx8muhwuoJH1wGJ3dax';

      IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'ZAVER' THEN
        jsonType := 'balanceTransfer';

      IF jsonType = 'balanceTransfer' THEN
        URL := GetSetupValues('BALANCETRANSFER')
        //URL := 'https://sandbox.payaut.com/api/v2/fund/balance/transfer'
      ELSE
        URL := GetSetupValues('SPLITPAYMENT');
        //URL := 'https://sandbox.payaut.com/api/v1/fund/split-payments';

      IF SalesHeader."Currency Code" = '' THEN
        CurrencyCode := 'EUR'
      ELSE
        CurrencyCode := SalesHeader."Currency Code";


      PSPRef := GetPSPRef(SalesHeader."External Document No.");

      JSonText := BuildJsonForSplit_Shop(SalesHeader);

      //mokt.TextExportToFile(JSonText);
      //EXIT;

      Token := GetSetupValues('TOKEN');
      //Token:='FD5CKXQmNJCevq8rFmcF8FrgRK3ciHYiaUg.FD5CKXQmPRiwnZKEYPqUCg4qVfezTyAwaiL';

      WebClient := WebClient.WebClient();
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + Token);
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      WebClient.Headers.Add('Accept', 'application/json');

      ResponseText := WebClient.UploadString(URL,'POST',JSonText);

      jObject := jObject.Parse(ResponseText);
      jToken := jObject.SelectToken('code');

      IF ISNULL(jToken) THEN
        ERROR('POST response did not contain a code.');

      ResponseCode := FORMAT(jToken);
      //SalesHeader."EU 3-Party Trade" := TRUE;
      //SalesHeader.MODIFY;
      IF SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order,SalesHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
        SalesPSPCard."Transaction Identifier" := ResponseCode;
        SalesPSPCard.MODIFY;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        CLEAR(SalesPSPCard);
        SalesPSPCard."Document Type" := SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order;
        SalesPSPCard."No." := SalesHeader."No.";
        SalesPSPCard."Transaction Identifier" := ResponseCode;
        SalesPSPCard.INSERT(FALSE);
      END;
      MESSAGE('POST successful. Code: %1',ResponseCode);
      EXIT('OK');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE BuildJsonForSplit_Shop@301510025(SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 5104606) : Text;
    VAR
      JSonText@301510000 : Text;
    BEGIN
      CASE jsonType OF
        'singleVendor': BEGIN
          JSonText :=
            '{' +
              '"extRef":"' + EscapeJson(ExtRef) + '",' +
              '"totalAmount":' + FORMAT(FormatAmounts(TotalAmount),0,9) + ',' +
              '"description":"Order ' + EscapeJson(ExtRef) + '",' +
              '"items":[' +
                '{' +
                  '"type":"GROUP",' +
                  '"extRef":"' + EscapeJson(ExtRef + 'split') + '",' +
                  '"amount":' + FORMAT(FormatAmounts(TotalAmount),0,9) + ',' +
                  '"accountCode":"' + EscapeJson(AccountCode) + '",' +
                  '"description":"Order ' + EscapeJson(ExtRef) + ' group",' +
                  '"items":[' +
                    '{' +
                      '"type":"GROUP",' +
                      '"extRef":"' + EscapeJson(ExtRef + 'splitgroup') + '",' +
                      '"amount":' + FORMAT(FormatAmounts(TotalAmount),0,9) + ',' +
                      '"description":"Order ' + EscapeJson(ExtRef) + ' group",' +
                      '"items":[' +
                        '{' +
                          '"type":"ITEM",' +
                          '"label":"COMMISSION",' +
                          '"extRef":"' + EscapeJson(ExtRef + 'commission') + '",' +
                          '"amount":' + FORMAT(FormatAmounts(ChronextAmount),0,9) + ',' +
                          '"description":"commission"' +
                        '},' +
                        '{' +
                          '"type":"ITEM",' +
                          '"label":"PRODUCT_ITEM",' +
                          '"extRef":"' + EscapeJson(ExtRef + 'selleramount') + '",' +
                          '"amount":' + FORMAT(FormatAmounts(TotalAmount),0,9) + ',' +
                          '"description":"seller amount"' +
                        '}' +
                      ']' +
                    '}' +
                  ']' +
                '}' +
              '],' +
              '"pspExtRef":"' + EscapeJson(PSPRef) + '",' +
              '"currency":"' + EscapeJson(CurrencyCode) + '",' +
              '"paymentProcessor":"' + EscapeJson(GetPaymentType_Shop(SalesHeader)) + '"' +
            '}';
        END;
        'multipleVendors': BEGIN
          ERROR('Multiple Vendor Payments is under development');
        END;
        'chronextPayment':BEGIN
          JSonText :=
            '{' +
              '"extRef":"' + EscapeJson(ExtRef) + '",' +
              '"totalAmount":' + FORMAT(FormatAmounts(TotalAmount),0,9) + ',' +
              '"description":"Order ' + EscapeJson(ExtRef) + '",' +
              '"items":[' +
                '{' +
                  '"type":"ITEM",' +
                  '"label":"PAYMENT_FEE",' +
                  '"extRef":"' + EscapeJson(ExtRef + 'paymentfee') + '",' +
                  '"amount":' + FORMAT(TotalAmount,0,9) + ',' +
                  '"description":"seller amount"' +
                '}' +
              ']' +
              '"pspExtRef":"' + EscapeJson(PSPRef) + '",' +
              '"currency":"' + EscapeJson(CurrencyCode) + '",' +
              '"paymentProcessor":"' + EscapeJson(GetPaymentType_Shop(SalesHeader)) + '"' +
            '}';
        END;
        'balanceTransfer': BEGIN
          JSonText :=
          '{' +
            '"fromAccountCode":' + EscapeJson(chronextVirtualAcc) +  '",' +
            '"toAccountCode":' + EscapeJson(AccountCode) +  '",' +
            '"amount":"' + FORMAT(FormatAmounts(SellerAmount),0,9) + '",' +
            '"currency":' + EscapeJson(CurrencyCode) + ',' +
            '"idempotencyKey":' + FORMAT(CREATEGUID) + ',' +
            '"type":"INVOICE":' +
          '}'
        END;
      END;


      EXIT(JSonText);
    END;

    BEGIN
      EXIT('MOLLIE');

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine@301480009(VAR vSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      lSalesLine@301490000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // 01 04.07.19 MBLA CHR-657 Falscher Net selling Price: Umbau SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine
      {IF NOT (vSalesHeader."Document Type" IN [vSalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,vSalesHeader."Document Type"::Invoice]) THEN
        EXIT;

      lSalesLine.RESET;
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,lSalesLine.Type::Item);
      IF lSalesLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        lSalesHeader := vSalesHeader;
        lSalesHeader.Status := lSalesHeader.Status::Open;
        REPEAT
          lDoSetDifferentialTaxation := (lSalesLine."Shipment No." = '') AND (lSalesLine."Shipment Line No." = 0); // Nicht fÅr Sammelrechnungen
          IF lDoSetDifferentialTaxation THEN BEGIN
            lModifySalesLine := FALSE;
            lDifferentialTaxation := lSalesLine."Differential Taxation";
            lUnitCostLCY := lSalesLine."Unit Cost (LCY)";
            lSalesLine.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
            IF lSalesLine."Reserved Quantity" = 1.0 THEN BEGIN
              IF lSalesLine."Quantity (Base)" = 1.0 THEN BEGIN
                lReservationEntry.RESET;
                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Sales Line");
                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",lSalesLine."Document Type");
                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID",lSalesLine."Document No.");
                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.",lSalesLine."Line No.");
                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation);
                IF lReservationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN
                  IF lReservationEntry2.GET(lReservationEntry."Entry No.",NOT lReservationEntry.Positive) THEN
                    IF lReservationEntry2."Source Type" = DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry" THEN
                      IF lItemLedgerEntry.GET(lReservationEntry2."Source Ref. No.") THEN
                        IF lItemLedgerEntry.Quantity = 1.0 THEN BEGIN
                          lDifferentialTaxation := lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
                          // 01 10.01.19 MJAN CHR-347 GeÑnderte Ermittlung Einstandspreis
                          //IF lItemLedgerEntry."Completely Invoiced" THEN BEGIN
                          //  lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
                          //  lUnitCostLCY := lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)";
                          //END ELSE BEGIN
                          //  lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)");
                          //  lUnitCostLCY := lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)";
                          //END;
                          lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)","Cost Amount (Actual)");
                          lUnitCostLCY := lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)" + lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)";
                          // 01 10.01.19 MJAN CHR-347 GeÑnderte Ermittlung Einstandspreis ENDE
                        END;
              END;
            END;

            // 01 27.11.18 MJAN CHR-47 Kennzeichen Differenzbesteuerung in VK-Zeile nur, wenn in MwSt.-Buchungsmatrix der Mappingintrag auch auf Differenzbesteuerung steht
            IF lDifferentialTaxation AND (lSalesLine."Differential Taxation" <> lDifferentialTaxation) THEN BEGIN
              lVATPostingSetup.GET(lSalesLine."VAT Bus. Posting Group",lSalesLine."VAT Prod. Posting Group");
              lVATPostingSetup.TESTFIELD("Map.DT VAT Prod. Posting Group");
              lVATPostingSetup2.GET(lSalesLine."VAT Bus. Posting Group",lVATPostingSetup."Map.DT VAT Prod. Posting Group");
              lDifferentialTaxation := lVATPostingSetup2."Differential Taxation";
            END;
            // 01 27.11.18 MJAN CHR-47 Kennzeichen Differenzbesteuerung in VK-Zeile nur, wenn in MwSt.-Buchungsmatrix der Mappingintrag auch auf Differenzbesteuerung steht ENDE

            lModifySalesLine := (lSalesLine."Differential Taxation" <> lDifferentialTaxation) OR (lSalesLine."Unit Cost (LCY)" <> lUnitCostLCY);
            IF lModifySalesLine THEN BEGIN
              lSalesLine.SetSalesHeader(lSalesHeader);
              // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat
              IF lSalesLine."Unit Cost (LCY)" <> lUnitCostLCY THEN
              // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat ENDE
                lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost (LCY)",lUnitCostLCY);

              // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat
              IF lSalesLine."Differential Taxation" <> lDifferentialTaxation THEN
              // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat ENDE
                lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",lDifferentialTaxation);
              lSalesLine.MODIFY;
            END;
          END;
        UNTIL lSalesLine.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      }

      IF NOT (vSalesHeader."Document Type" IN [vSalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,vSalesHeader."Document Type"::Invoice]) THEN
        EXIT;

      lSalesLine.RESET;
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,lSalesLine.Type::Item);
      IF lSalesLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        gSalesHeader := vSalesHeader;
        REPEAT
          SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine2(lSalesLine);
        UNTIL lSalesLine.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      // 01 04.07.19 MBLA CHR-657 Falscher Net selling Price: Umbau SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine2@301490001(VAR vSalesLine@301480000 : Record 37);
    VAR
      lReservationEntry@301480005 : Record 337;
      lReservationEntry2@301480004 : Record 337;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301480003 : Record 32;
      lVATPostingSetup@301480010 : Record 325;
      lVATPostingSetup2@301480011 : Record 325;
      lUnitCostLCY@301480008 : Decimal;
      lDoSetDifferentialTaxation@301480007 : Boolean;
      lDifferentialTaxation@301480002 : Boolean;
      lModifySalesLine@301480001 : Boolean;
      ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802;
      lDevaluation@301510001 : Decimal;
      lSalesLineModify@301510002 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      IF gSalesHeader."No." = '' THEN
        IF NOT gSalesHeader.GET(vSalesLine."Document Type",vSalesLine."Document No.") THEN
          EXIT;

      gSalesHeader.Status := gSalesHeader.Status::Open;
      lDoSetDifferentialTaxation := (vSalesLine."Shipment No." = '') AND (vSalesLine."Shipment Line No." = 0); // Nicht fÅr Sammelrechnungen
      IF lDoSetDifferentialTaxation THEN BEGIN
        lModifySalesLine := FALSE;
        lDifferentialTaxation := vSalesLine."Differential Taxation";
        lSalesLineModify.GET(vSalesLine."Document Type",vSalesLine."Document No.",vSalesLine."Line No.");
        //01 25.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung setzen
        //lUnitCostLCY := vSalesLine."Unit Cost (LCY)";
        lUnitCostLCY := lSalesLineModify."Unit Cost (LCY)"+lSalesLineModify."Unit Cost Devaluation";
        //01 25.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung setzen
        lSalesLineModify.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
        IF lSalesLineModify."Reserved Quantity" = 1.0 THEN BEGIN
          IF lSalesLineModify."Quantity (Base)" = 1.0 THEN BEGIN
            lReservationEntry.RESET;
            lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Sales Line");
            lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",lSalesLineModify."Document Type");
            lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID",lSalesLineModify."Document No.");
            lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.",lSalesLineModify."Line No.");
            lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation);
            IF lReservationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN
              IF lReservationEntry2.GET(lReservationEntry."Entry No.",NOT lReservationEntry.Positive) THEN
                IF lReservationEntry2."Source Type" = DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry" THEN
                  IF lItemLedgerEntry.GET(lReservationEntry2."Source Ref. No.") THEN
                    IF lItemLedgerEntry.Quantity = 1.0 THEN BEGIN
                      lDifferentialTaxation := lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
                      // 01 10.01.19 MJAN CHR-347 GeÑnderte Ermittlung Einstandspreis
                      //IF lItemLedgerEntry."Completely Invoiced" THEN BEGIN
                      //  lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
                      //  lUnitCostLCY := lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)";
                      //END ELSE BEGIN
                      //  lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)");
                      //  lUnitCostLCY := lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)";
                      //END;

                      lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)","Cost Amount (Actual)");
                      lUnitCostLCY := lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)" + lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)";
                        // 01 10.01.19 MJAN CHR-347 GeÑnderte Ermittlung Einstandspreis ENDE
                        //01 25.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung setzen
                      IF lDifferentialTaxation THEN BEGIN
                        ValueEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Devaluation,CHRXID,"Item No.","Variant Code");
                        ValueEntry.SETRANGE(Devaluation,TRUE);
                        ValueEntry.SETRANGE(CHRXID,lItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
                        ValueEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",lItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
                        ValueEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",lItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
                        ValueEntry.CALCSUMS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
                        lDevaluation:=ABS(ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)");
                        IF lDevaluation = 0 THEN
                          lDevaluation:=lItemLedgerEntry."Devaluation Amount"
                        //01 25.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung setzen
                      END;
                    END;
          END;
        END;

        // 01 27.11.18 MJAN CHR-47 Kennzeichen Differenzbesteuerung in VK-Zeile nur, wenn in MwSt.-Buchungsmatrix der Mappingintrag auch auf Differenzbesteuerung steht
        IF lDifferentialTaxation AND (lSalesLineModify."Differential Taxation" <> lDifferentialTaxation) THEN BEGIN
          lVATPostingSetup.GET(lSalesLineModify."VAT Bus. Posting Group",lSalesLineModify."VAT Prod. Posting Group");
          lVATPostingSetup.TESTFIELD("Map.DT VAT Prod. Posting Group");
          lVATPostingSetup2.GET(lSalesLineModify."VAT Bus. Posting Group",lVATPostingSetup."Map.DT VAT Prod. Posting Group");
          lDifferentialTaxation := lVATPostingSetup2."Differential Taxation";
        END;
        // 01 27.11.18 MJAN CHR-47 Kennzeichen Differenzbesteuerung in VK-Zeile nur, wenn in MwSt.-Buchungsmatrix der Mappingintrag auch auf Differenzbesteuerung steht ENDE

        lModifySalesLine := (lSalesLineModify."Differential Taxation" <> lDifferentialTaxation) OR (lSalesLineModify."Unit Cost (LCY)" <> lUnitCostLCY) OR (lSalesLineModify."Unit Cost Devaluation" <> ABS(lDevaluation));
        IF lModifySalesLine THEN BEGIN
          lSalesLineModify.SetSalesHeader(gSalesHeader);
          // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat
          IF lSalesLineModify."Unit Cost (LCY)" <> lUnitCostLCY THEN BEGIN
          // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat ENDE
            lSalesLineModify."Unit Cost Devaluation":=ABS(lDevaluation);
            lSalesLineModify.VALIDATE("Unit Cost (LCY)",lUnitCostLCY);
          END;

          // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat
          IF lSalesLineModify."Differential Taxation" <> lDifferentialTaxation THEN
          // 01 31.10.18 MJAN CHR-47 énderung Differenzbesteuerung und Einstandspreis nur, wenn sich der Wert auch geÑndert hat ENDE
            lSalesLineModify.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",lDifferentialTaxation);
          lSalesLineModify.MODIFY;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckUpdateDifferentialTaxationOnAppliedItemLedgerEntry@301480004(pItemLedgerEntry@301480000 : Record 32);
    VAR
      lItemLedgerEntry@301480002 : Record 32;
      lItemApplicationEntry@301480001 : Record 339;
      lStopSearch@301480004 : Boolean;
      lSearchOutbound@301480005 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      lItemApplicationEntry.RESET;
      lItemApplicationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Inbound Item Entry No.","Item Ledger Entry No.");
      lItemApplicationEntry.SETRANGE("Inbound Item Entry No.",pItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
      lItemApplicationEntry.SETRANGE("Item Ledger Entry No.",pItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
      lItemApplicationEntry.SETRANGE("Outbound Item Entry No.",0);
      IF lItemApplicationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        lSearchOutbound := TRUE;
        lStopSearch := FALSE;
        REPEAT
          IF lSearchOutbound THEN BEGIN
            lItemApplicationEntry.RESET;
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Inbound Item Entry No.","Item Ledger Entry No.");
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETRANGE("Inbound Item Entry No.",lItemApplicationEntry."Inbound Item Entry No.");
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETFILTER("Item Ledger Entry No.",'<>%1',lItemApplicationEntry."Inbound Item Entry No.");
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETFILTER("Outbound Item Entry No.",'<>%1',0);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            lItemApplicationEntry.RESET;
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Outbound Item Entry No.","Item Ledger Entry No.");
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETRANGE("Outbound Item Entry No.",lItemApplicationEntry."Outbound Item Entry No.");
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETFILTER("Item Ledger Entry No.",'<>%1',lItemApplicationEntry."Outbound Item Entry No.");
            lItemApplicationEntry.SETFILTER("Inbound Item Entry No.",'<>%1',0);
          END;
          lStopSearch := NOT lItemApplicationEntry.FINDFIRST;
          IF NOT lStopSearch THEN BEGIN
            lItemLedgerEntry.GET(lItemApplicationEntry."Item Ledger Entry No.");
            IF (lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" <> pItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase") AND
               (ABS(lItemLedgerEntry.Quantity) = ABS(pItemLedgerEntry.Quantity)) THEN BEGIN
              lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" := pItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
              lItemLedgerEntry.MODIFY;
            END;
            lSearchOutbound := NOT lSearchOutbound;
          END;
        UNTIL lStopSearch;
      END;
      EXIT;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetDiffTaxation@301490004(SourceType@301490002 : Integer;VAR SalesLine@301490001 : Record 37) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SerialNo@301490000 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      SerialNo := GetSerialNoFromReservationEntry(SourceType,SalesLine); // variable assignment is easier to debug

      IF SerialNo <> '' THEN
        EXIT(GetDiffTaxationFromILEBeforeFirstSales(SerialNo));
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetDiffTaxationFromILEBeforeFirstSales@301490005(SerialNo@301490000 : Code[20]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301490001 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",SerialNo);
      // 01 30.07.19 MBLA CHR-483 Uhr wird nach Retoure nicht mehr als Diff verkauft: Bugfix
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<%1',0);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Document Type",'%1|%2',ItemLedgerEntry."Document Type"::"Sales Shipment",ItemLedgerEntry."Document Type"::"Sales Invoice");
      // 01 30.07.19 MBLA CHR-483 Uhr wird nach Retoure nicht mehr als Diff verkauft: Bugfix ENDE
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Sale);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Entry No.",'<%1',ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
        // 01 21.08.19 MBLA CHR-483 Uhr wird nach Retoure nicht mehr als Diff verkauft: Filter erweitert und Artikelnr. und Variante
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
        // 01 21.08.19 MBLA CHR-483 Uhr wird nach Retoure nicht mehr als Diff verkauft: Filter erweitert und Artikelnr. und Variante ENDE
        // 01 30.07.19 MBLA CHR-483 Uhr wird nach Retoure nicht mehr als Diff verkauft: Bugfix
        //IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDFIRST THEN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type");
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST THEN

        // 01 26.11.18 MJAN CHR-123 Feld "Differential Taxation Purchase" unabhÑngig von der Postenart vom Buchblatt in Artikel- und Wertposten Åbernehmen
        //// 01 11.10.18 MBLA CHR-129 öbernahme der BestÑnde bei Chronext

        //  ItemJournalLine."Entry Type"::"Positive Adjmt."] THEN
        //// 01 11.10.18 MBLA CHR-129 öbernahme der BestÑnde bei Chronext ENDE
        // 01 26.11.18 MJAN CHR-123 Feld "Differential Taxation Purchase" unabhÑngig von der Postenart vom Buchblatt in Artikel- und Wertposten Åbernehmen ENDE

      END ELSE BEGIN

        NewItemLedgEntry."Differential Taxation Sale" := FALSE;
      END;
    END;

  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=VAR
            lBatchJobWizardManagement@301510001 : Codeunit 5139828;
            lFunction@301510000 : Text;
            lTemp@301510002 : Text;
          BEGIN
            IF UPPERCASE(USERID) = 'MOKTAY' THEN BEGIN
              switchItemJob_Manuel;
              EXIT;
            END;

            gGUI := GUIALLOWED;

              gGUI := FALSE;

              lBatchJobWizardManagement.ReadVariable('DEBUG',lTemp);
              IF UPPERCASE(lTemp) = 'TRUE' THEN
                  gDebug := TRUE;

              lBatchJobWizardManagement.ReadVariable('FUNKTION',lFunction);

              IF UPPERCASE(lFunction) = 'SWITCH' THEN
                switchItemJob;
              IF UPPERCASE(lFunction) = 'DELLOG' THEN
                clearLog;

            END;
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      SwitchItem@301510005 : TextConst 'DEU=Wollen Sie die Artikel/Variante (%1,%2) auf die Artikel/Variante (%3,%4) Ñndern?';
      SwitchItemError@301510004 : TextConst 'DEU=Menge akt. Lieferung darf nicht gesetzt sein!';
      SwitchItemError2@301510003 : TextConst 'DEU=Menge "Ware im Haus" muss gesetzt sein!';
      SwitchItemError3@301510002 : TextConst 'DEU=Es gibt mehr als eine Vorauszahlungsrechung!';
      SwitchItemError4@301510001 : TextConst 'DEU=Es kînnen nur Bestellungen mit einem Artikel zurÅckgesetzt werden!';

      SwitchItemError5@301510006 : TextConst 'DEU=ItemSwitch nicht erforderlich';
      SwitchItemError6@301510007 : TextConst 'DEU=ItemSwitch not Possible';
      SwitchItemsuccess@301510008 : TextConst 'DEU=Item Switch erfolgreich! %1;ENU=Item Switch successful';
      gDebug@301510009 : Boolean;
      gGUI@301510010 : Boolean;
