    LOCAL PROCEDURE switchItemJob@301510002();
    VAR
      lItemSwitchTransfer@301510000 : Record 26102;
      lWarehouseReceiptLine@301510001 : Record 7317;
      lLogisticMgtChronext@301510002 : Codeunit 85200;
      lTempSerial@301510003 : Code[50];
    BEGIN
      //ONLYDEBUG
      // lItemSwitchTransfer.MODIFYALL(Processed,FALSE);
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE(Processed,FALSE);
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE(Mandant,UPPERCASE('GMBH'));
      IF lItemSwitchTransfer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF lTempSerial <> lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No" THEN BEGIN
            lTempSerial := lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No";

            lWarehouseReceiptLine.RESET;
            lWarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",lItemSwitchTransfer."Purchase No");
            IF lWarehouseReceiptLine.ISEMPTY THEN
              LogSwitch('Purchase Line not found',1,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No");

            IF lWarehouseReceiptLine.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                IF (lLogisticMgtChronext.getSNR(lWarehouseReceiptLine) = lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No") THEN
                  IF switchItemVariant(lWarehouseReceiptLine,lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No",lItemSwitchTransfer.ID) THEN BEGIN
                    LogSwitch('OK',2,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No");
                    lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE("Serial No",lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No");
                    lItemSwitchTransfer.MODIFYALL(Processed,TRUE);
                    COMMIT;
                    //lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE("Serial No");
                  END
                  ELSE
                    LogSwitch(SwitchItemError6,1,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No");

              UNTIL lWarehouseReceiptLine.NEXT = 0; //IF lWarehouseReceiptLine.FINDSET THEN

          END; //IF lTempSerial <> lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No" THEN BEGIN
        UNTIL lItemSwitchTransfer.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE switchItemVariant@301510000(pWarehouseReceiptLine@301510000 : Record 7317;pSerialNo@301510014 : Code[50];pID@301510015 : Integer) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lPurchaseHeader@301510011 : Record 38;
      lPurchaseLine@301510002 : Record 39;
      lReservationEntry@301510001 : Record 337;
      lItemVariant@301510006 : Record 5401;
      lPurchInvHeader@301510007 : Record 122;
      lPurchInvLine@301510008 : Record 123;
      lItemSwitchProcessing@301510016 : Record 26104;
      lItem@301510017 : Record 27;
      lItemSwitchTransfer@301510018 : Record 26102;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301510022 : Record 7505;
      lSystemValueLine@301510023 : Record 5105031;
      lItemAttribute@301510024 : Record 7500;
      lPurchLineReserve@301510003 : Codeunit 99000834;
      lApprovalsMgmt@301510010 : Codeunit 1535;
      lPurchPostYNPrepmt@301510009 : Codeunit 445;
      lNoSeriesManagement@301510013 : Codeunit 396;
      lSerialNo@301510004 : Code[20];
      lItemVariantList@301510005 : Page 50011;
      lPostPrepmt@301510012 : Boolean;
      lIsDiff@301510021 : Boolean;
      lItemAttValue@301510020 : Text;
      lItemAttName@301510019 : Text;
    BEGIN
      lPostPrepmt := FALSE;
      IF lPurchaseLine.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order,pWarehouseReceiptLine."Source No.",pWarehouseReceiptLine."Source Line No.") THEN BEGIN
        lPurchaseHeader.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type",lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
        lPurchLineReserve.FindReservEntry(lPurchaseLine,lReservationEntry);
        lSerialNo := lReservationEntry."Serial No.";
        lItemVariant.GET(lPurchaseLine."No.",lPurchaseLine."Variant Code");

        lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",5401);
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",lPurchaseLine."No.");
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",lPurchaseLine."Variant Code");
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",12);

        IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = 'diff' THEN
            lIsDiff := TRUE;
        END;
        IF lPurchaseLine."Differential Taxation" THEN
          lIsDiff := TRUE;


        IF pWarehouseReceiptLine."Qty. to Receive" <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          LogSwitch(SwitchItemError,1,pID,pSerialNo);
          EXIT(FALSE);
        END;

        IF pWarehouseReceiptLine."Qty. in Stock" = 0 THEN BEGIN
          LogSwitch(SwitchItemError2,1,pID,pSerialNo);
          EXIT(FALSE);
        END;


        lPurchInvHeader.SETRANGE("Prepayment Order No.",lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
        IF lPurchInvHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN

          lPurchInvLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",lPurchInvHeader."No.");
          IF lPurchInvLine.COUNT > 1 THEN BEGIN
            LogSwitch(SwitchItemError4,1,pID,pSerialNo);
            EXIT(FALSE);
          END;


          lPostPrepmt := TRUE;
        END;

        IF NOT searchSwitchItemVariant(pWarehouseReceiptLine,pSerialNo) THEN
          EXIT(FALSE)
        ELSE
          LogSwitch(STRSUBSTNO(SwitchItemsuccess,pWarehouseReceiptLine."Source No."),1,pID,pSerialNo);


        COMMIT;

        //Mit neu anlage verarbeiten
        lItemSwitchProcessing.RESET;
        lItemSwitchProcessing.SETRANGE(createNewVariant,TRUE);
        lItemSwitchProcessing.SETRANGE(Processed,FALSE);
        lItemSwitchProcessing.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pSerialNo); //MOKT
        IF lItemSwitchProcessing.FINDSET THEN
          REPEAT
            lItem.GET(lItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.");
            CLEAR(lItemVariant);
            lItemVariant.INIT;
            lItemVariant."Item No." := lItem."No.";
            lItemVariant.Code := lNoSeriesManagement.GetNextNo('VARIANTE',TODAY,TRUE);
            lItemVariant.INSERT(TRUE);

            lItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code" := lItemVariant.Code;
            lItemSwitchProcessing.MODIFY;

            finalSwitch(lItemSwitchProcessing);

            //TransferDiffAttriute
            IF lIsDiff THEN
              addAttrributeValueToVariant(lItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",lItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code",'Besteuerung','diff')
            ELSE
              addAttrributeValueToVariant(lItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",lItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code",'Besteuerung','full');


            //Add Attributes
            lItemSwitchTransfer.RESET;
            lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE(Mandant,UPPERCASE('GMBH'));
            lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE("Serial No",lItemSwitchProcessing."Serial No.");
            IF lItemSwitchTransfer.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                //Attributwerte mappen
                lItemAttValue := mapAttributeValue(lItemSwitchTransfer."Attribute Value");
                lItemAttName := translateAttributeName(lItemSwitchTransfer."Attribute Name");
                addAttrributeValueToVariant(lItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",lItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code",lItemAttName,lItemAttValue);
                LogSwitch(STRSUBSTNO(AttributeAdd,lItemAttName,lItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",lItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code"),2,pID,pSerialNo);
              UNTIL lItemSwitchTransfer.NEXT = 0;

            //Base Attributes
            lSystemValueLine.RESET;
            lSystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Value No.",66010);
            IF lSystemValueLine.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                lItemAttribute.GET(lSystemValueLine."Calc Value 1");

                lItemAttValue := mapAttributeValue(lSystemValueLine."Text 1");
                lItemAttName := translateAttributeName(lItemAttribute.Name);
                addAttrributeValueToVariant(lItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",lItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code",lItemAttName,lItemAttValue);
                LogSwitch(STRSUBSTNO(AttributeAdd,lItemAttName,lItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",lItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code"),2,pID,pSerialNo);
              UNTIL lSystemValueLine.NEXT = 0;

          UNTIL lItemSwitchProcessing.NEXT = 0;


      END;
      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE searchSwitchItemVariant@301510015(pWarehouseReceiptLine@301510015 : Record 7317;pSerialNo@301510000 : Code[50]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lSQLServerManagement@301510007 : Codeunit 5105061;
      lItemSwitchTransfer@301510001 : Record 26102;
      lTempItemAttributeValueMapping@301510002 : TEMPORARY Record 7505;
      lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch@301510005 : TEMPORARY Record 7505;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301510003 : Record 7505;
      lItemSwitchTransferTemp@301510019 : TEMPORARY Record 26102;
      lSQLScriptResult@301510008 : TEMPORARY Record 5105099;
      lItem@301510016 : Record 27;
      lItemAttributeValue@301510025 : Record 7501;
      lItemAttValue@301510010 : Text;
      lItemAttName@301510011 : Text;
      lTempItemNo@301510012 : Code[20];
      lTempItemVariant@301510014 : Code[10];
      lSpecifiedAttributes@301510004 : Integer;
      lRowCount@301510006 : Integer;
      lTempInt@301510009 : Integer;
      i@301510013 : Integer;
      DebugCount@301510018 : Integer;
      lNewVariant@301510017 : Boolean;
      lBrandValue@301510020 : Integer;
      lModelValue@301510021 : Integer;
      lReference@301510024 : Text;
      lOKay@301510022 : Boolean;
      lPostingGroup@301510023 : Code[3];
      lReferenceValueID@301510026 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      lSpecifiedAttributes := 0;
      lNewVariant := TRUE;
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE(Processed,FALSE);
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE("Serial No",pSerialNo);
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No");
      IF lItemSwitchTransfer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          lSQLScriptResult.RESET;
          lSQLScriptResult.DELETEALL;

          //Attributwerte mappen
          lItemAttValue := mapAttributeValue(lItemSwitchTransfer."Attribute Value");
          lItemAttName := translateAttributeName(lItemSwitchTransfer."Attribute Name");

          IF lItemSwitchTransfer."Attribute Name" = 'reference' THEN
            lReference := lItemAttValue;


          //Box und Zertifikat
          IF processingAfterwards(lItemAttName) THEN BEGIN
            lItemSwitchTransferTemp := lItemSwitchTransfer;
            lItemSwitchTransferTemp."Attribute Name" := lItemAttName;
            lItemSwitchTransferTemp."Attribute Value" := lItemAttValue;
            lItemSwitchTransferTemp.INSERT;
          END
          ELSE BEGIN
            lSQLServerManagement.SetForceReloadScript('ITEM SWITCH');
            lSQLServerManagement.Set3Parameter(lItemAttValue,lItemAttName, checkPostingGroup(pWarehouseReceiptLine));
            lSQLServerManagement.ExecuteScriptSaveResultWithoutCC('ITEM SWITCH','GET_ATTRIBUTE',FALSE,lSQLScriptResult,FALSE,FALSE);

            LogSwitch(FORMAT(lSQLScriptResult.COUNT) + '|' + lItemAttName + '|'+ lItemAttValue,2,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,pSerialNo);

            IF lSQLScriptResult.COUNT > 0 THEN BEGIN
              lSpecifiedAttributes += 1;
              //TransferToAttributeTable
              EVALUATE(lTempInt,lSQLScriptResult."Field 1");
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",lTempInt);
              EVALUATE(lTempInt,lSQLScriptResult."Field 3");
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",lTempInt);
              EVALUATE(lTempInt,lSQLScriptResult."Field 5");
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value ID",lTempInt);
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value Text",lItemAttValue);
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Text",lItemAttName);
              IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                  IF lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" = 1 THEN
                    lBrandValue := lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID";
                  IF lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" = 2 THEN
                    lModelValue := lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID";
                REPEAT
                  lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.INIT;
                  lTempItemAttributeValueMapping := lItemAttributeValueMapping;
                  IF lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT THEN;
                UNTIL lItemAttributeValueMapping.NEXT = 0;
              END;
            END;

          END;
        UNTIL lItemSwitchTransfer.NEXT = 0;
      LogSwitch('BrandValue:' + FORMAT(lBrandValue),2,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,pSerialNo);
      LogSwitch('ModelValue:' + FORMAT(lModelValue),2,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,pSerialNo);
      lPostingGroup := checkPostingGroup(pWarehouseReceiptLine);
      CLEAR(lTempItemNo);
      lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
      IF lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          //Sehr gefrickelt mit dem lOkay, aber war jetzt nicht mehr anders zu machen, die Anpassung ist sehr Historisch gewachsen!
          // Die Brand und Model Ids sind fix genua wie Referenz

          IF lTempItemNo <> lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No." THEN BEGIN
            lOKay := FALSE;
            lTempItemNo := lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No.";

            lItem.RESET;
            lItem.SETRANGE("No.",lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No.");
            lItem.SETFILTER("Gen. Prod. Posting Group",'%1',COPYSTR(lPostingGroup,1,2) + '*');
            IF NOT lItem.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",27);
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",lTempItemNo);
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",'');
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value ID",lBrandValue);
              lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",1);
              IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",2);
                lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value ID",lModelValue);
                IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN
                  lOKay := TRUE;

                lItemAttributeValue.RESET;
                lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(Value,lReference);
                IF lItemAttributeValue.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                  lReferenceValueID := lItemAttributeValue.ID;

                  lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
                  lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",5401);
                  lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",lTempItemNo);
                  lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Item Attribute ID",'5|6|7');
                  lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value ID",lReferenceValueID);
                  IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN
                    lOKay := TRUE
                  ELSE
                    lOKay := FALSE;
                END;
              END;

            END;
          END;

          IF lOKay THEN BEGIN
            lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch := lTempItemAttributeValueMapping;
            lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."Item Attribute Value ID" := 0;
            lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.INSERT;
          END
          ELSE
            lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.DELETE;

        UNTIL lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.NEXT = 0;

        LogSwitch(FORMAT(lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.COUNT) + '|AttributeValueMappingCount',2,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,pSerialNo);

      CLEAR(lTempItemNo);
      //Macht nur Sinn wenn es mindestens eine Trefferrate der Attribute gibt
      IF lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.COUNT >= 1 THEN BEGIN
        //Artikelattribute durchgehen
        lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.SETCURRENTKEY("No.","Item Variant Code");
        lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDSET;
        REPEAT
          IF (lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No." <> 'C2C-SW') AND (lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No." <> 'CPST-SW') AND (lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No." <> 'TI-SW') THEN
          BEGIN
            IF (lTempItemNo <> lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No.") OR (lTempItemVariant <> lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
              lTempItemNo := lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No.";
              lTempItemVariant := lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code";
              lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.SETRANGE("No.",lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."No.");
              IF lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
                //Box und Zertifikat check
                insertBoxAndZertifikat(lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch,lItemSwitchTransferTemp,checkPostingGroup(pWarehouseReceiptLine),lTempItemNo,lTempItemVariant);
                lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",lTempItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code");
              END
              ELSE
                lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code");
              lRowCount := lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.COUNT;
              IF lRowCount > 0 THEN BEGIN
                lTempInt := ROUND((lRowCount / lSpecifiedAttributes)*100 ,1);
                lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.MODIFYALL("Item Attribute Value ID",lTempInt,FALSE)
              END;
            END;
          END;
          DebugCount += 1;
        UNTIL lTempItemAttributeValueMapping.NEXT = 0;

        LogSwitch('DebugCount=' + FORMAT(DebugCount),2,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,pSerialNo);

        lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.RESET;
        lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value ID",0);
        lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.DELETEALL;
        i:= 0;
        CLEAR(lTempItemNo);
        lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.RESET;
        lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.SETCURRENTKEY("Item Attribute Value ID");
        lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.ASCENDING(FALSE);
        IF lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.FINDSET THEN
          REPEAT
            IF ((lTempItemNo <> lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."No.") OR (lTempItemVariant <> lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."Item Variant Code"))
              AND (lItem.GET(lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."No.")) THEN BEGIN
              lTempItemNo := lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."No.";
              lTempItemVariant := lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."Item Variant Code";
              i+=1;
              insertProcessing(pSerialNo,lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."No.",lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."Item Variant Code",
              lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch."Item Attribute Value ID",pWarehouseReceiptLine."No.",pWarehouseReceiptLine."Line No.",lNewVariant,pWarehouseReceiptLine."Source No.",
              pWarehouseReceiptLine."Source Line No.");
            END;
          UNTIL (lTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.NEXT = 0) OR (i=1);
        COMMIT;

        EXIT(TRUE);

      END
      ELSE
        EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE processingAfterwards@301510027(pItemAttributeName@301510000 : Text) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lSystemValueLine@301510001 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      lSystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Value No.",66009);
      lSystemValueLine.SETRANGE("Text 1",pItemAttributeName);
      IF lSystemValueLine.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

      lSystemValueLine@301510001 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      lSystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Value No.",66009);
      lSystemValueLine.SETRANGE("Text 1",pItemAttributeName);
      IF lSystemValueLine.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(lSystemValueLine."Calc Value 1");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE insertBoxAndZertifikat@301510017(VAR pTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch@301510000 : TEMPORARY Record 7505;VAR pItemSwitchTransferTemp@301510001 : TEMPORARY Record 26102;pPostingGroup@301510006 : Code[3];pTempItemNo@301510003 : Code[20];pTempItemVariant@301510002 : Code[10]);
    VAR
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301510004 : Record 7505;
      lItem@301510005 : Record 27;
    BEGIN
      IF pItemSwitchTransferTemp.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          lItem.RESET;
          lItem.SETRANGE("No.",pTempItemNo);
          lItem.SETFILTER("Gen. Prod. Posting Group",'%1',COPYSTR(pPostingGroup,1,2) + '*');
          IF NOT lItem.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN

            lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",pTempItemNo);
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",pTempItemVariant);

            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",getAfterwardsAttributeID(pItemSwitchTransferTemp."Attribute Name"));

            lItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
            IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN
              IF (pItemSwitchTransferTemp."Attribute Value" = lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text")
                OR (pItemSwitchTransferTemp."Attribute Value" = lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" )
                 THEN BEGIN
                pTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.INIT;
                pTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch := lItemAttributeValueMapping;
                pTempItemAttributeValueMappingSearch.INSERT;

              END;
          END;
        UNTIL pItemSwitchTransferTemp.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE insertProcessing@301510022(pSerialNo@301510001 : Code[20];pItemNo@301510002 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301510003 : Code[10];pHitRate@301510004 : Integer;pSourceNo@301510005 : Code[20];pSourceLineNo@301510006 : Integer;pCreateNewVariant@301510007 : Boolean;pPSourceNo@301510009 : Code[20];pPSourceLineNo@301510008 : Integer);
    VAR

      lItemSwitchProcessing.INIT;

      lItemSwitchProcessing."Hit Rate" := pHitRate;
      lItemSwitchProcessing."Source No." := pSourceNo;
      lItemSwitchProcessing."Source Line No." := pSourceLineNo;
      lItemSwitchProcessing."Purchase Source No." := pPSourceNo;
      lItemSwitchProcessing."Purchase Source Line No." := pPSourceLineNo;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE checkPostingGroup@301510006(pWarehouseReceiptLine@301510000 : Record 7317) : Code[3];
    VAR
      lPurchaseLine@301510001 : Record 39;
    BEGIN
      IF lPurchaseLine.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order,pWarehouseReceiptLine."Source No.",pWarehouseReceiptLine."Source Line No.") THEN BEGIN
        IF STRLEN(lPurchaseLine."Product Group Code") >= 2 THEN
          IF COPYSTR(lPurchaseLine."Product Group Code",1,2) = 'KW' THEN
            EXIT('KW%');
        IF STRLEN(lPurchaseLine."Gen. Prod. Posting Group") >= 2 THEN
          IF COPYSTR(lPurchaseLine."Gen. Prod. Posting Group",1,2) = 'KW' THEN
            EXIT('KW%');
      END;
      EXIT('HA%');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE translateAttributeName@301510003(pName@301510000 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      lItemAttributeTranslation@301510001 : Record 7502;
      lItemAttribute@301510002 : Record 7500;
      lTempText@301510003 : Text;
    BEGIN
      pName := CONVERTSTR(pName,'_',' ');
      lItemAttributeTranslation.SETRANGE("Language Code",'ENU');
      lItemAttributeTranslation.SETRANGE(Name,pName);
      IF lItemAttributeTranslation.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        lTempText := UPPERCASE(COPYSTR(pName,1,1));
        pName := lTempText + DELSTR(pName,1,1);
        lItemAttributeTranslation.SETRANGE(Name,pName);
        IF lItemAttributeTranslation.ISEMPTY THEN
          lItemAttributeTranslation.SETFILTER(Name,'@%1',pName);
      END;
      IF lItemAttributeTranslation.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        IF lItemAttribute.GET(lItemAttributeTranslation."Attribute ID") THEN
          EXIT(lItemAttribute.Name);

      END;
      EXIT(pName);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE mapAttributeValue@301510004(pAttributeValue@301510000 : Text) rText : Text;
    BEGIN
      rText := CONVERTSTR(pAttributeValue,'_',' ');

      IF STRPOS(rText,'''') > 0 THEN
        rText := INSSTR(rText,'''',STRPOS(rText,''''));

      IF pAttributeValue = '1' THEN
        rText := 'ja'
      ELSE IF pAttributeValue = '0' THEN
        rText := 'nein';
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE addAttrributeValueToVariant@301510010(pItem@301510000 : Code[20];pVariant@301510001 : Code[10];pAttribtueName@301510002 : Text;pAttributeValue@301510003 : Text);
    VAR
      lItemAttribute@301510004 : Record 7500;
      lItemAttributeValue@301510005 : Record 7501;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301510006 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN

      //Search Attribute
      lItemAttribute.SETRANGE(Name,pAttribtueName);
      lItemAttribute.SETRANGE("Category Type",lItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Item Variant");
      IF lItemAttribute.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        lItemAttributeValue.RESET;
        lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",lItemAttribute.ID);
        lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(Value,pAttributeValue);
        IF NOT lItemAttributeValue.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          lItemAttributeValue.INIT;
          lItemAttributeValue."Attribute ID" := lItemAttribute.ID;
          lItemAttributeValue.Value := pAttributeValue;
          lItemAttributeValue.INSERT(TRUE);
        END;

        lItemAttributeValueMapping.INIT;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID" := 5401;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."No." := pItem;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code" := pVariant;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" := lItemAttribute.ID;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" := lItemAttributeValue.ID;
        IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT(TRUE) THEN;

      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE LogSwitch@301510001(pMessageText@301510000 : Text[250];pType@301510001 : 'Error,Done,Debug';pID@301510003 : Integer;pSerial@301510004 : Code[50]);
    VAR
      lItemSwitchTransfer@301510002 : Record 26103;
    BEGIN
      IF (pType::Debug = pType) AND (NOT gDebug) THEN
        EXIT;
      lItemSwitchTransfer.INIT;
      lItemSwitchTransfer.ID := pID;
      lItemSwitchTransfer."Inserted at" := CURRENTDATETIME;
      lItemSwitchTransfer.Message := pMessageText;
      lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No." := pSerial;
      lItemSwitchTransfer.Status := pType;
      lItemSwitchTransfer.INSERT;
      COMMIT;
    END;

    PROCEDURE finalSwitch@301510013(pItemSwitchProcessing@301510015 : Record 26104);
    VAR
      lPurchaseHeader@301510012 : Record 38;
      lPurchaseLine@301510011 : Record 39;
      lReservationEntry@301510010 : Record 337;
      lItemVariant@301510009 : Record 5401;
      lPurchInvHeader@301510008 : Record 122;
      lPurchInvLine@301510007 : Record 123;
      lItemSwitchProcessing@301510014 : Record 26104;
      lWarehouseReceiptLine@301510013 : Record 7317;
      lPurchLineReserve@301510006 : Codeunit 99000834;
      lApprovalsMgmt@301510005 : Codeunit 1535;
      lPurchPostYNPrepmt@301510004 : Codeunit 445;
      lNoSeriesManagement@301510003 : Codeunit 396;
      lSerialNo@301510002 : Code[20];
      lItemVariantList@301510001 : Page 50011;
      lPostPrepmt@301510000 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      lPostPrepmt := FALSE;

      IF lWarehouseReceiptLine.GET(pItemSwitchProcessing."Source No.",pItemSwitchProcessing."Source Line No.") THEN BEGIN

      IF lPurchaseLine.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order,lWarehouseReceiptLine."Source No.",lWarehouseReceiptLine."Source Line No.") THEN BEGIN
        lPurchaseHeader.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type",lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
        lPurchLineReserve.FindReservEntry(lPurchaseLine,lReservationEntry);
        lSerialNo := lReservationEntry."Serial No.";
        lItemVariant.GET(pItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",pItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code");

        IF lWarehouseReceiptLine."Qty. to Receive" <> 0 THEN
          ERROR(SwitchItemError);

        IF lWarehouseReceiptLine."Qty. in Stock" = 0 THEN
          ERROR(SwitchItemError);

        lPurchInvHeader.SETRANGE("Prepayment Order No.",lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
        IF lPurchInvHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN

          //Checks
          IF gGUI THEN
            IF NOT CONFIRM(SwitchPrePayment,FALSE,lPurchaseLine."Document No.") THEN
              EXIT;

          lPurchInvLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",lPurchInvHeader."No.");
          IF lPurchInvLine.COUNT > 1 THEN
            ERROR(SwitchItemError4);

          lPostPrepmt := TRUE;
        END;
        lItemVariant.GET(pItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.",pItemSwitchProcessing."Variant Code");

        IF gGUI THEN BEGIN
          lItemVariantList.SETRECORD(lItemVariant);
          lItemVariant.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemSwitchProcessing."Item No.");
          lItemVariantList.SETTABLEVIEW(lItemVariant);
          lItemVariantList.RUNMODAL;
          lItemVariantList.getData(lItemVariant);
        END;

        //Fehler meldung
        IF (lItemVariant.Code = lPurchaseLine."Variant Code") AND (lItemVariant."Item No." = lPurchaseLine."No.") THEN
          EXIT;

        IF gGUI THEN
          IF NOT CONFIRM(SwitchItem,FALSE,lPurchaseLine."No.",lPurchaseLine."Variant Code",lItemVariant."Item No.",lItemVariant.Code) THEN
            EXIT;

        //Gutschrift
        IF lPostPrepmt THEN BEGIN
          lPurchPostYNPrepmt.SetOptions(TRUE,TRUE);
          IF lApprovalsMgmt.PrePostApprovalCheckPurch(lPurchaseHeader) THEN BEGIN
            lPurchaseHeader."Vendor Cr. Memo No." := lNoSeriesManagement.GetNextNo('SWITCH',TODAY,TRUE);
            lPurchaseHeader."Prepmt. Cr. Memo No." :=  lNoSeriesManagement.GetNextNo(lPurchaseHeader."Prepmt. Cr. Memo No. Series",TODAY,TRUE);
            lPurchaseHeader."Vendor Invoice No." := lNoSeriesManagement.GetNextNo(lPurchaseHeader."Prepayment No. Series",TODAY,TRUE);
            lPurchaseHeader.MODIFY;
            lPurchPostYNPrepmt.PostPrepmtCrMemoYN(lPurchaseHeader,FALSE);
            //Zeile neu holen
            lPurchaseLine.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order,lWarehouseReceiptLine."Source No.",lWarehouseReceiptLine."Source Line No.")
          END;
        END;

        lPurchaseLine."Variant Code" := lItemVariant.Code;
        lPurchaseLine."No." := lItemVariant."Item No.";
        lPurchaseLine."Change Date" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        lPurchaseLine."Changed from" := USERID;
        lWarehouseReceiptLine."Item No." := lItemVariant."Item No.";
        lWarehouseReceiptLine."Variant Code" := lItemVariant.Code;
        lReservationEntry."Item No." := lItemVariant."Item No.";
        lReservationEntry."Variant Code" := lItemVariant.Code;

        lReservationEntry.MODIFY;
        lPurchaseLine.MODIFY;
        lWarehouseReceiptLine.MODIFY;

        IF lPostPrepmt THEN BEGIN
          lPurchaseHeader.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type",lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
          lPurchaseHeader."Prepayment No." := lNoSeriesManagement.GetNextNo(lPurchaseHeader."Prepayment No. Series",TODAY,TRUE);
          IF lApprovalsMgmt.PrePostApprovalCheckPurch(lPurchaseHeader) THEN
            lPurchPostYNPrepmt.PostPrepmtInvoiceYN(lPurchaseHeader,FALSE);
        END;

        lItemSwitchProcessing.SETRANGE("Serial No.",lSerialNo);
        lItemSwitchProcessing.MODIFYALL(Processed,TRUE);
        lItemSwitchProcessing.MODIFYALL("Processed by",USERID);
        lItemSwitchProcessing.MODIFYALL("Processed at",CURRENTDATETIME);

        COMMIT;
      END;
      // 01 01.10.21 LACK MSD-17492 Item/Variant switch during WE1 Ende
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE clearLog@301510005();
    VAR
      lItemSwitchLog@301510000 : Record 26103;
    BEGIN
      lItemSwitchLog.SETFILTER("Inserted at",'<%1',CURRENTDATETIME - 1000000000);
      lItemSwitchLog.DELETEALL;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE switchItemJob_Manuel@301510007();
    VAR
      lItemSwitchTransfer@301510000 : Record 26102;
      lWarehouseReceiptLine@301510001 : Record 7317;
      lLogisticMgtChronext@301510002 : Codeunit 85200;
      lTempSerial@301510003 : Code[50];
    BEGIN
      //ONLYDEBUG
      // lItemSwitchTransfer.MODIFYALL(Processed,FALSE);
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE(Processed,FALSE);
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE(Mandant,UPPERCASE('GMBH'));
      lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE("Serial No",'X53488');
      IF lItemSwitchTransfer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
            lWarehouseReceiptLine.RESET;
            lWarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",lItemSwitchTransfer."Purchase No");
            IF lWarehouseReceiptLine.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                IF (lLogisticMgtChronext.getSNR(lWarehouseReceiptLine) = lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No") THEN
                  IF switchItemVariant(lWarehouseReceiptLine,lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No",lItemSwitchTransfer.ID) THEN BEGIN
                    LogSwitch('OK',2,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No");
                    lItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE("Serial No",lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No");
                    lItemSwitchTransfer.MODIFYALL(Processed,TRUE);
                    COMMIT;
                  END
                  ELSE
                    LogSwitch(SwitchItemError6,1,lItemSwitchTransfer.ID,lItemSwitchTransfer."Serial No");

              UNTIL lWarehouseReceiptLine.NEXT = 0; //IF lWarehouseReceiptLine.FINDSET THEN

        UNTIL lItemSwitchTransfer.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE SwitchItem_Manual@301510008(VAR WarehouseReceiptLine@301510000 : Record 7317;VariantNo@301510002 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      PurchaseLine@301510001 : Record 39;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510004 : Record 7505;
      ItemSwitchTransfer@301510005 : Record 26102;
      LogisticMgtChronext@301510006 : Codeunit 85200;
      SerialNo@301510007 : Text;
      SellWatchVendorInfo@301510008 : Record 50012;
      ItemNo@301510009 : Text;
      ReservationEntry@301510011 : Record 337;
      Pos@301510012 : Integer;
      AttributeID@301510013 : Integer;
      AttributeValueID@301510014 : Integer;
      ItemVariant@301510003 : Record 5401;
    BEGIN
      PurchaseLine.GET(PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order,WarehouseReceiptLine."Source No.",WarehouseReceiptLine."Source Line No.");

      ItemVariant.RESET;
      ItemVariant.SETRANGE(Code,VariantNo);
      ItemVariant.FINDFIRST;

      ItemNo := ItemVariant."Item No.";
      SerialNo := LogisticMgtChronext.getSNR(WarehouseReceiptLine);

      PurchaseLine."No." := ItemNo;
      PurchaseLine."Variant Code" := VariantNo;
      PurchaseLine.MODIFY;

      WarehouseReceiptLine."Item No." := ItemNo;
      WarehouseReceiptLine."Variant Code" := VariantNo;
      WarehouseReceiptLine.MODIFY;

      ReservationEntry.RESET;
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID",PurchaseLine."Document No.");
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",SerialNo);
      IF ReservationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ReservationEntry."Item No." := ItemNo;
        ReservationEntry."Variant Code" := VariantNo;
        ReservationEntry.MODIFY;
      END;

      ItemSwitchTransfer.RESET;
      ItemSwitchTransfer.SETRANGE("Serial No",SerialNo);
      IF ItemSwitchTransfer.FINDSET THEN
        ItemSwitchTransfer.MODIFYALL(Processed,TRUE);


        {
        REPEAT
          AttributeID := getItemAttributeID(ItemSwitchTransfer."Attribute Name");
          AttributeValueID := getItemAttributeValueID(AttributeID,ItemSwitchTransfer."Attribute Value");
          IF AttributeID IN [1,2] THEN BEGIN
            IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(27,ItemNo,AttributeID,VariantNo,'') THEN
              insertAttributeValueMapping(27,ItemNo,AttributeID,VariantNo,'',AttributeValueID);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(5401,ItemNo,AttributeID,VariantNo,SerialNo) THEN
              insertAttributeValueMapping(5401,ItemNo,AttributeID,VariantNo,SerialNo,AttributeValueID);
          END;
        UNTIL ItemSwitchTransfer.NEXT = 0;
        }
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE getItemAttributeID@301510009(pAttributeName@301510000 : Text) : Integer;
    VAR
      ItemAttribute@301510001 : Record 7500;
    BEGIN
      ItemAttribute.RESET;
      ItemAttribute.SETRANGE(Name,pAttributeName);
      IF ItemAttribute.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(ItemAttribute.ID)
      ELSE
        EXIT(0);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE getItemAttributeValueID@301510011(pAttributeID@301510002 : Integer;pAttributeValueName@301510000 : Text) : Integer;
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValue@301510001 : Record 7501;
    BEGIN
      ItemAttributeValue.RESET;
      ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(ItemAttributeValue."Attribute ID",pAttributeID);
      ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(ItemAttributeValue.Value,pAttributeValueName);
      IF ItemAttributeValue.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(ItemAttributeValue.ID)
      ELSE
        EXIT(0);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE insertAttributeValueMapping@301510016(TableID@301510000 : Integer;No@301510001 : Code[20];AttributeID@301510002 : Integer;VariantCode@301510003 : Code[20];SerialNo@301510004 : Text;AttributeValueID@301510006 : Integer);
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510005 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      CLEAR(ItemAttributeValueMapping);
      ItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID" := TableID;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping."No." := No;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" := AttributeID;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code" := VariantCode;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No." := SerialNo;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" := AttributeValueID;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 05.02.24 LACK MSD-25829 Anpassung QS
    }
    END.
  }

OBJECT [Codeunit 81000 Test Case Handler ]
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=03.07.17;
    Time=12:17:36;
    Version List=;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    TableNo=81000;
    OnRun=VAR
            TestCaseResult@1001050000 : Record 81001;
          BEGIN
            FINDFIRST;

            TestCaseResult.SETRANGE("Test Case Entry No.","Entry No.");
            TestCaseResult.SETRANGE("Test Result",TestCaseResult."Test Result"::" ");
            TestCaseResult.FINDSET;
            REPEAT
              CASE TestCaseResult."Test Code" OF
                'CHECK AMOUNT' : CHECKAMOUNT(Rec,TestCaseResult);
                'CHECK NO OF LINES' : CHECKNOOFLINES(Rec,TestCaseResult);
                'CHECK NO OF ITEMLINES' :  CHECKNOOFITEMLINES(Rec,TestCaseResult);
                ELSE
                  ERROR('nix da');
              END;
            UNTIL TestCaseResult.NEXT = 0;
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CHECKAMOUNT@1001050001(PTestCase@1001050003 : Record 81000;VAR PTestCaseResult@1001050000 : Record 81001);
    VAR
      LSalesInvoiceHeader@1001050001 : Record 112;
      LRefAmount@1001050002 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.SETCURRENTKEY(LSalesInvoiceHeader."External Document No.");
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",PTestCase."Identifier 1");
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.SETAUTOCALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.FINDSET;
      EVALUATE(LRefAmount,PTestCaseResult."Input 1");
      IF LSalesInvoiceHeader."Amount Including VAT" = LRefAmount THEN BEGIN
        PTestCaseResult."Test Result" := PTestCaseResult."Test Result"::OK;
        PTestCaseResult."Result Description" := 'Betrag korrekt';
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PTestCaseResult."Test Result" := PTestCaseResult."Test Result"::Error;
        PTestCaseResult."Result Description" := 'Betrag stimmt nicht';
      END;
      PTestCaseResult.MODIFY;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CHECKNOOFLINES@1001050002(PTestCase@1001050001 : Record 81000;VAR PTestCaseResult@1001050000 : Record 81001);
    VAR
      LSalesInvoiceHeader@1001050004 : Record 112;
      LSalesInvoiceLine@1001050003 : Record 113;
      LRefAmount@1001050002 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.SETCURRENTKEY(LSalesInvoiceHeader."External Document No.");
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",PTestCase."Identifier 1");
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.FINDSET;
      LSalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",LSalesInvoiceHeader."No.");
      EVALUATE(LRefAmount,PTestCaseResult."Input 1");
      IF LSalesInvoiceLine.COUNT = LRefAmount THEN BEGIN
        PTestCaseResult."Test Result" := PTestCaseResult."Test Result"::OK;
        PTestCaseResult."Result Description" := 'Anzahl der Zeilen korrekt';
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PTestCaseResult."Test Result" := PTestCaseResult."Test Result"::Error;
        PTestCaseResult."Result Description" := 'Anzahl der Zeilen stimmt nicht';
      END;
      PTestCaseResult.MODIFY;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CHECKNOOFITEMLINES@1001050003(PTestCase@1001050001 : Record 81000;VAR PTestCaseResult@1001050000 : Record 81001);
    VAR
      LSalesInvoiceHeader@1001050002 : Record 112;
      LSalesInvoiceLine@1001050003 : Record 113;
      LRefAmount@1001050004 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.SETCURRENTKEY(LSalesInvoiceHeader."External Document No.");
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",PTestCase."Identifier 1");
      LSalesInvoiceHeader.FINDSET;
      LSalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",LSalesInvoiceHeader."No.");
      LSalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE(Type,LSalesInvoiceLine.Type::Item);
      EVALUATE(LRefAmount,PTestCaseResult."Input 1");
      IF LSalesInvoiceLine.COUNT = LRefAmount THEN BEGIN
        PTestCaseResult."Test Result" := PTestCaseResult."Test Result"::OK;
        PTestCaseResult."Result Description" := 'Anzahl der Artikelzeilen korrekt';
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PTestCaseResult."Test Result" := PTestCaseResult."Test Result"::Error;
        PTestCaseResult."Result Description" := 'Anzahl der Artikelzeilen stimmt nicht';
      END;
      PTestCaseResult.MODIFY;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }

OBJECT Codeunit 82001 Export Gateway Sales Price
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=20.03.19;
    Time=11:10:29;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=CHNX;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=BEGIN
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      NotImplemented@301480000 : TextConst 'DEU=Externes Interface %1 ist nicht implementiert;ENU=External Interface %1 is not implemented';

    PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceFile@301480003(pSalesPrice@301480001 : Record 7002);
    VAR
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480000 : Record 5275378;
      lExtInterfaceSetup@301480002 : Record 5275373;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT lExtInterfaceSetup.GET('UPDPRI') THEN
        ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(NotImplemented,'UPDPRI'));

      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INIT;
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::"to process";
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Code" := 'UPDPRIFILE';
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename := 'Item No.=' + FORMAT(pSalesPrice."Item No.",0,9) + '&Variant Code=' + FORMAT(pSalesPrice."Variant Code",0,9);
      CreateSourceFile(lExtInterfaceOutboundFile,pSalesPrice);
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.User := USERID;
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSourceFile@301480008(VAR vExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480007 : Record 5275378;pSalesPrice@301480000 : Record 7002);
    VAR
      lJSONManagement@301480001 : Codeunit 5459;
      lDataTypeManagement@301480004 : Codeunit 701;
      lJObject@301480002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lRecordRef@301480003 : RecordRef;
      lFieldRef@301480005 : FieldRef;
      lFieldCount@301480006 : Integer;
      lOStream@301480008 : OutStream;
      lPropertyName@301480009 : Text;
      lCurrentPropertyName@301480010 : Text;
      lJsonPropertyNames@301480011 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.List`1";
    BEGIN
      IF NOT lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRef(pSalesPrice, lRecordRef) THEN
        EXIT;

      lJObject := lJObject.JObject;
      lJSONManagement.GetJsonPropertyNamesByEntity(PAGE::"CHNX Sales Price Entity",lJsonPropertyNames);
      FOR lFieldCount := 1 TO lRecordRef.FIELDCOUNT DO BEGIN
        lFieldRef := lRecordRef.FIELDINDEX(lFieldCount);
        IF ProcessFieldRef(lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
          lPropertyName := lJSONManagement.PrettifyJsonProperty(lFieldRef.NAME);
          FOREACH lCurrentPropertyName IN lJsonPropertyNames DO BEGIN
            IF UPPERCASE(lPropertyName) = UPPERCASE(lCurrentPropertyName) THEN
                lPropertyName := lCurrentPropertyName;
          END;
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,lPropertyName,lFieldRef.VALUE);
        END;
      END;

      vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(lOStream, TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      lOStream.WRITE(lJObject.ToString());
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessFieldRef@301480021(VAR vFieldRef@301480000 : FieldRef) : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // Handle Special Cases

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) IN ['MEDIA','MEDIASET','BLOB'] THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) = 'FLOWFIELD' THEN BEGIN
        vFieldRef.CALCFIELD;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,7002,OnAfterInsertEvent)]

      // 01 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Temporary Deactivated ENDE

      // 01 11.12.18 MKLE CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      CreateExternalInterfaceFile(Rec);
    END;

      CreateExternalInterfaceFile(Rec);

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,82012,OnAfterSalesPriceModify)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE HandleOnAfterSalesPriceModify@301510007(VAR vSalesPriceRec@301510000 : Record 7002;VAR vSalesPricexRec@301510001 : Record 7002;RunTrigger@301510002 : Boolean);
    BEGIN
      // 01 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Temporary Deactivated
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
      //EXIT;
      IF NOT RunTrigger THEN
        EXIT;
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates ENDE
      // 01 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Temporary Deactivated ENDE

      // LF 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 HandleOnAfterSalesPriceModify
      IF vSalesPriceRec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF (vSalesPriceRec."Price Includes VAT" <> vSalesPricexRec."Price Includes VAT") OR
         (vSalesPriceRec."Unit Price" <> vSalesPricexRec."Unit Price") OR
         (vSalesPriceRec."Strike-Price incl. VAT" <> vSalesPricexRec."Strike-Price incl. VAT") OR
         (vSalesPriceRec."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT" <> vSalesPricexRec."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT") THEN
           CreateExternalInterfaceFile(vSalesPriceRec);
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,7002,OnAfterModifyEvent)]

    BEGIN
      // 01 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Temporary Deactivated
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
      //EXIT;
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates ENDE
      // 01 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Temporary Deactivated ENDE

      // LF 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 HandleOnAfterModifyEvent
      IF NOT RunTrigger THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF (Rec."Price Includes VAT" <> xRec."Price Includes VAT") OR
         (Rec."Unit Price" <> xRec."Unit Price") OR
         (Rec."Strike-Price incl. VAT" <> xRec."Strike-Price incl. VAT") OR
         (Rec."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT" <> xRec."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT") THEN
           CreateExternalInterfaceFile(Rec);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 29.10.18 MKLE CHR-111 Export Sales Prices
      // 01 11.12.18 MKLE CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
      // LF 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 HandleOnAfterSalesPriceModify
      // LF 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 HandleOnAfterModifyEvent
      // 01 24.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Temporary Deactivated
      // UF 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates: added Parameter RunTrigger in <HandleOnAfterModifyEvent>
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
    }
    END.

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateFileFromMessage@301480009(ExtInterfOutboundMessage@301480000 : Record 5275376) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceSetup@301480001 : Record 5275373;
      ExtInterfaceMessageSetup@301480003 : Record 5275374;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480002 : Record 5275378;
      Item@301480004 : Record 27;
    BEGIN
      // LF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateFileFromMessage
      gSetupGet."Get ExtIntSetup"(ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Ext Interface Setup Name",ExtInterfaceSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      ExtInterfaceSetup.TESTFIELD("File Code");
      gSetupGet."Get ExtIntMsgSetup"(ExtInterfaceSetup."File Code",ExtInterfaceMessageSetup,FALSE,FALSE);

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Ext Interface Setup Name" := ExtInterfaceSetup.Code;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Hold := ExtInterfaceMessageSetup.Hold;

      Item.GET(ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code);

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename := 'Item No.=' + FORMAT(Item."No.",0,9) + '&Id=' + FORMAT(Item.Id,0,9);

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.User := USERID;
      CreateSourceFile(ExtInterfaceOutboundFile,Item);
      IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE) THEN BEGIN
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.User := USERID;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::processed;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Destination File Entry No." := ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Entry No.";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Processed at" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.MODIFY;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
      // LF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateFileFromMessage ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceMessage@301480011(ItemNo@301480001 : Code[20];MessageReason@301480006 : Text[20]);
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceSetup@301480002 : Record 5275373;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage@301480000 : Record 5275376;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage2@301480004 : Record 5275376;
      ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt@301480005 : Codeunit 5275373;
      CreateMessage@301480003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // GF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateExternalInterfaceMessage
      IF NOT gSetupGet."Get ExtIntSetup"('UPDITM',ExtInterfaceSetup,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        ERROR(NotImplemented);

      ExtInterfaceSetup.TESTFIELD("Message Code");

      CreateMessage := FALSE;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.RESET;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETCURRENTKEY("Message Code",Status,Hold,Code,"Code 2");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Message Code",ExtInterfaceSetup."Message Code");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETFILTER(Status,'%1|%2',ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::new,ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::"to process");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Hold,FALSE);
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Code,ItemNo);
      IF ExtInterfOutboundMessage.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        // Fehlerhafte EintrÑge zurÅcksetzen
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::error);
        IF ExtInterfOutboundMessage.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.GET(ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Entry No.");
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.Status::"to process";
          ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt.InsertProtocolEntry(
             DATABASE::"Ext. Interf. Outbound Message",
             ExtInterfOutboundMessage2."Entry No.",
             'SYSTEM','SYS002',USERID,'','','','');
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2."Message Reason" := MessageReason;
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.MODIFY;
          ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt.WriteBackProtocolEntries;
        END ELSE
          // Wenn keine zu verarbeitenden oder fehlerhaften EintrÑge vorhanden sind, neuen erstellen
          CreateMessage := TRUE;
      END;

      IF CreateMessage THEN BEGIN
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.RESET;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.INIT;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Entry No." := 0;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::"to process";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Code" := ExtInterfaceSetup."Message Code";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Ext Interface Setup Name" := ExtInterfaceSetup.Code;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code := ItemNo;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Reason" := MessageReason;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.User := USERID;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.INSERT(TRUE);
      END;
      // GF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateExternalInterfaceMessage ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSourceFile@301480008(VAR vExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480007 : Record 5275378;pItem@301480000 : Record 27);
    VAR
      lJSONManagement@301480001 : Codeunit 5459;
      lDataTypeManagement@301480004 : Codeunit 701;
      lJArrayItemFunctionMapping@301480017 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=4.5.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray";
      lJObjectItemFunctionMapping@301480016 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping@301480010 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=4.5.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray";
      lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping@301480014 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lJObjectItem@301480002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lRecordRef@301480003 : RecordRef;
      lFieldRef@301480005 : FieldRef;
      lFieldCount@301480006 : Integer;
      lOStream@301480008 : OutStream;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480013 : Record 7505;
      lItemFunctionMapping@301480015 : Record 85000;
      lPropertyName@301480009 : Text;
      lCurrentPropertyName@301480012 : Text;
      lJsonPropertyNames@301480011 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.List`1";
    BEGIN
      IF NOT lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRef(pItem,lRecordRef) THEN
        ERROR(CantGetRecRef);

      // 1. Translate Item to JSON

      lJObjectItem := lJObjectItem.JObject;
      lJSONManagement.GetJsonPropertyNamesByEntity(PAGE::"CHNX Item Entity",lJsonPropertyNames);
      FOR lFieldCount := 1 TO lRecordRef.FIELDCOUNT DO BEGIN
        lFieldRef := lRecordRef.FIELDINDEX(lFieldCount);
        IF ProcessFieldRef(lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
          lPropertyName := lJSONManagement.PrettifyJsonProperty(lFieldRef.NAME);
          FOREACH lCurrentPropertyName IN lJsonPropertyNames DO BEGIN
            IF UPPERCASE(lPropertyName) = UPPERCASE(lCurrentPropertyName) THEN
              lPropertyName := lCurrentPropertyName;
          END;
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectItem,lPropertyName,lFieldRef.VALUE);
        END;
      END;

      // 2. Add Item Attributes as JSON

      lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::Item);
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",pItem."No.");
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",'');
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Serial No.",'');
      IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping := lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping.JArray;
        CLEAR(lJsonPropertyNames);
        lJSONManagement.GetJsonPropertyNamesByEntity(PAGE::"CHNX Item Attribute Entity",lJsonPropertyNames);
        REPEAT
          IF NOT lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRef(lItemAttributeValueMapping,lRecordRef) THEN
            ERROR(CantGetRecRef);
          lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping := lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping.JObject;
          FOR lFieldCount := 1 TO lRecordRef.FIELDCOUNT DO BEGIN
            lFieldRef := lRecordRef.FIELDINDEX(lFieldCount);
            IF ProcessFieldRef(lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
              lPropertyName := lJSONManagement.PrettifyJsonProperty(lFieldRef.NAME);
              FOREACH lCurrentPropertyName IN lJsonPropertyNames DO BEGIN
                IF UPPERCASE(lPropertyName) = UPPERCASE(lCurrentPropertyName) THEN
                  lPropertyName := lCurrentPropertyName;
              END;
              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping,lPropertyName,lFieldRef.VALUE);
            END;
          END;
          lJSONManagement.AddJObjectToJArray(lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping,lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping);
        UNTIL lItemAttributeValueMapping.NEXT = 0;
        lJSONManagement.AddJArrayToJObject(lJObjectItem,'itemAttributes',lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping);
      END;

      // 3. Add Item Functions as JSON

      lItemFunctionMapping.RESET;
      lItemFunctionMapping.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItem."No.");
      IF lItemFunctionMapping.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        lJArrayItemFunctionMapping := lJArrayItemFunctionMapping.JArray;
        CLEAR(lJsonPropertyNames);
        lJSONManagement.GetJsonPropertyNamesByEntity(PAGE::"CHNX Item Function Entity",lJsonPropertyNames);
        REPEAT
          IF NOT lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRef(lItemFunctionMapping,lRecordRef) THEN
            ERROR(CantGetRecRef);
          lJObjectItemFunctionMapping := lJObjectItemFunctionMapping.JObject;
          FOR lFieldCount := 1 TO lRecordRef.FIELDCOUNT DO BEGIN
            lFieldRef := lRecordRef.FIELDINDEX(lFieldCount);
            IF ProcessFieldRef(lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
              lPropertyName := lJSONManagement.PrettifyJsonProperty(lFieldRef.NAME);
              FOREACH lCurrentPropertyName IN lJsonPropertyNames DO BEGIN
                IF UPPERCASE(lPropertyName) = UPPERCASE(lCurrentPropertyName) THEN
                  lPropertyName := lCurrentPropertyName;
              END;
              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectItemFunctionMapping,lPropertyName,lFieldRef.VALUE);
            END;
          END;
          lJSONManagement.AddJObjectToJArray(lJArrayItemFunctionMapping,lJObjectItemFunctionMapping);
        UNTIL lItemFunctionMapping.NEXT = 0;
        lJSONManagement.AddJArrayToJObject(lJObjectItem,'itemFunctions',lJArrayItemFunctionMapping);
      END;

      vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(lOStream, TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      lOStream.WRITE(lJObjectItem.ToString());
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessFieldRef@301480021(VAR vFieldRef@301480000 : FieldRef) : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // Handle Special Cases

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.NAME)) = 'ASSIGNED' THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) IN ['MEDIA','MEDIASET','BLOB'] THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) = 'FLOWFIELD' THEN BEGIN
        vFieldRef.CALCFIELD;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateFileFromMessage@301480009(ExtInterfOutboundMessage@301480000 : Record 5275376) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceSetup@301480001 : Record 5275373;
      ExtInterfaceMessageSetup@301480003 : Record 5275374;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480002 : Record 5275378;
      ItemVariant@301480004 : Record 5401;
    BEGIN
      // LF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateFileFromMessage
      gSetupGet."Get ExtIntSetup"(ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Ext Interface Setup Name",ExtInterfaceSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      ExtInterfaceSetup.TESTFIELD("File Code");
      gSetupGet."Get ExtIntMsgSetup"(ExtInterfaceSetup."File Code",ExtInterfaceMessageSetup,FALSE,FALSE);

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INIT;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Entry No." := 0;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::"to process";

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Code" := ExtInterfaceSetup."File Code";
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Ext Interface Setup Name" := ExtInterfaceSetup.Code;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Hold := ExtInterfaceMessageSetup.Hold;

      ItemVariant.GET(ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code,ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Code 2");

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename := 'Item No.=' + FORMAT(ItemVariant."Item No.",0,9) + '&Code=' + FORMAT(ItemVariant.Code,0,9);
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.User := USERID;
      CreateSourceFile(ExtInterfaceOutboundFile,ItemVariant);

        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.User := USERID;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::processed;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Destination File Entry No." := ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Entry No.";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Processed at" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.MODIFY;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
      // LF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateFileFromMessage ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceMessage@301480011(ItemNo@301480001 : Code[20];VariantCode@301480007 : Code[10];MessageReason@301480006 : Text[20]);
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceSetup@301480002 : Record 5275373;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage@301480000 : Record 5275376;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage2@301480004 : Record 5275376;
      ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt@301480005 : Codeunit 5275373;
      CreateMessage@301480003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // GF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateExternalInterfaceMessage
      IF NOT gSetupGet."Get ExtIntSetup"('UPDVAR',ExtInterfaceSetup,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        ERROR(NotImplemented);


      ExtInterfaceSetup.TESTFIELD("Message Code");

      CreateMessage := FALSE;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.RESET;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETCURRENTKEY("Message Code",Status,Hold,Code,"Code 2");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Message Code",ExtInterfaceSetup."Message Code");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETFILTER(Status,'%1|%2',ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::new,ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::"to process");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Hold,FALSE);
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Code,ItemNo);
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Code 2",VariantCode);
      IF ExtInterfOutboundMessage.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        // Fehlerhafte EintrÑge zurÅcksetzen
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::error);
        IF ExtInterfOutboundMessage.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.GET(ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Entry No.");
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.Status::"to process";
          ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt.InsertProtocolEntry(
             DATABASE::"Ext. Interf. Outbound Message",
             ExtInterfOutboundMessage2."Entry No.",
             'SYSTEM','SYS002',USERID,'','','','');
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2."Message Reason" := MessageReason;
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.MODIFY;
          ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt.WriteBackProtocolEntries;
        END ELSE
          // Wenn keine zu verarbeitenden oder fehlerhaften EintrÑge vorhanden sind, neuen erstellen
          CreateMessage := TRUE;
      END;

      IF CreateMessage THEN BEGIN
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.RESET;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.INIT;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Entry No." := 0;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::"to process";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Code" := ExtInterfaceSetup."Message Code";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Ext Interface Setup Name" := ExtInterfaceSetup.Code;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code := ItemNo;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Code 2" := VariantCode;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Reason" := MessageReason;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.User := USERID;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.INSERT(TRUE);
      END;
      // GF 16.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateExternalInterfaceMessage ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSourceFile@301480008(VAR vExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480007 : Record 5275378;pItemVariant@301480000 : Record 5401);
    VAR
      lJSONManagement@301480001 : Codeunit 5459;
      lDataTypeManagement@301480004 : Codeunit 701;
      lJObjectItemVariant@301480002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=4.5.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lFieldCount@301480003 : Integer;
      lRecordRef@301480005 : RecordRef;
      lFieldRef@301480006 : FieldRef;
      lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping@301480011 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=4.5.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray";
      lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping@301480010 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480009 : Record 7505;
      lOStream@301480008 : OutStream;
      lPropertyName@301480014 : Text;
      lCurrentPropertyName@301480013 : Text;
      lJsonPropertyNames@301480012 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.List`1";
    BEGIN
      IF NOT lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRef(pItemVariant,lRecordRef) THEN
        ERROR(CantGetRecRef);

      // 1. Translate Item Variant to JSON

      lJObjectItemVariant := lJObjectItemVariant.JObject;
      lJSONManagement.GetJsonPropertyNamesByEntity(PAGE::"CHNX Item Variant Entity",lJsonPropertyNames);
      FOR lFieldCount := 1 TO lRecordRef.FIELDCOUNT DO BEGIN
        lFieldRef := lRecordRef.FIELDINDEX(lFieldCount);
        IF ProcessFieldRef(lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
          lPropertyName := lJSONManagement.PrettifyJsonProperty(lFieldRef.NAME);
          FOREACH lCurrentPropertyName IN lJsonPropertyNames DO BEGIN
            IF UPPERCASE(lPropertyName) = UPPERCASE(lCurrentPropertyName) THEN
              lPropertyName := lCurrentPropertyName;
          END;
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectItemVariant,lPropertyName,lFieldRef.VALUE);
        END;
      END;

      // 2. Add Item Variant Attributes as JSON

      lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Item Variant");
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",pItemVariant."Item No.");
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",pItemVariant.Code);
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Serial No.",'');
      IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping := lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping.JArray;
        CLEAR(lJsonPropertyNames);
        lJSONManagement.GetJsonPropertyNamesByEntity(PAGE::"CHNX Item Var. Attr. Entity",lJsonPropertyNames);
        REPEAT
          IF NOT lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRef(lItemAttributeValueMapping,lRecordRef) THEN
            ERROR(CantGetRecRef);
          lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping := lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping.JObject;
          FOR lFieldCount := 1 TO lRecordRef.FIELDCOUNT DO BEGIN
            lFieldRef := lRecordRef.FIELDINDEX(lFieldCount);
            IF ProcessFieldRef(lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
              lPropertyName := lJSONManagement.PrettifyJsonProperty(lFieldRef.NAME);
              FOREACH lCurrentPropertyName IN lJsonPropertyNames DO BEGIN
                IF UPPERCASE(lPropertyName) = UPPERCASE(lCurrentPropertyName) THEN
                  lPropertyName := lCurrentPropertyName;
              END;
              IF FORMAT(lFieldRef.VALUE) = FORMAT(229015) THEN
                lFieldRef.VALUE :=18160;
                lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping,lPropertyName,lFieldRef.VALUE);
            END;
          END;
          lJSONManagement.AddJObjectToJArray(lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping,lJObjectItemAttributeValueMapping);
        UNTIL lItemAttributeValueMapping.NEXT = 0;
        lJSONManagement.AddJArrayToJObject(lJObjectItemVariant,'itemVariantAttributes',lJArrayItemAttributeValueMapping);
      END;

      vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(lOStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      lOStream.WRITE(lJObjectItemVariant.ToString());
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessFieldRef@301480021(VAR vFieldRef@301480000 : FieldRef) : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // Handle Special Cases

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) IN ['MEDIA','MEDIASET','BLOB'] THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) = 'FLOWFIELD' THEN BEGIN
        vFieldRef.CALCFIELD;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSourceFile@301480008(VAR vExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480007 : Record 5275378;pSalesShipmentHeader@301480000 : Record 110);
    VAR
      lJSONManagement@301480001 : Codeunit 5459;
      lCustomerManagement@301480006 : Codeunit 87000;
      lSalesShiptoFieldsHandling@301480009 : Codeunit 5104640;
      lJObject@301480010 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lOStream@301480008 : OutStream;
      lContact@301480002 : Record 5050;
      lShiptoAddress@301480003 : Record 222;
      lUserMachineSelection@301490004 : Record 5104557;
      lHasDifferentShipToAddress@301480004 : Boolean;
      lSalesHeader@301480005 : Record 36;
      lSurname@301480011 : Text;
      lFirstname@301480012 : Text;
      lMachineName@301490001 : Code[250];
      lMachineID@301490002 : Integer;
      lMacTerminalSession@301490000 : DotNet "'MacNetTools, Version=7.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=5c84ffa9ea79bb67'.MacNetTools.MacTerminalSession" RUNONCLIENT;
      lSystemValue@301490003 : Record 5105031;
      PackingListHeader@301510000 : Record 5104639;
    BEGIN

      lSalesHeader.TRANSFERFIELDS(pSalesShipmentHeader);
      lHasDifferentShipToAddress := lCustomerManagement.IsDiffInvShipAddress(lSalesHeader);

      IF lHasDifferentShipToAddress THEN
        IF (pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to Code" = '') OR NOT lShiptoAddress.GET(pSalesShipmentHeader."Sell-to Customer No.",pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to Code") THEN
          lHasDifferentShipToAddress := FALSE;

      lJObject := lJObject.JObject;

      // 01 09.05.19 LACK CHR-119 Carrier Plan B / Umstellung auf n Drucker
      // Rechnernamen bestimmen
      lMacTerminalSession := lMacTerminalSession.MacTerminalSession;
      lMachineName := lMacTerminalSession.GetTerminalSessionClientName('',lMacTerminalSession.GetTerminalSessionId());

      lUserMachineSelection.RESET;
      lUserMachineSelection.SETRANGE("Machine Hostname",lMachineName);

      IF lUserMachineSelection.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        lSystemValue.RESET;
        lSystemValue.SETRANGE("System Value No.",50053);
        lSystemValue.SETRANGE("Code Value 1",lUserMachineSelection."Machine Name");

        IF lSystemValue.FINDFIRST THEN
          lMachineID := lSystemValue."Calc Value 1"
      END
      ELSE
        lMachineID := 1;
      // 01 09.05.19 LACK CHR-119 Carrier Plan B / Umstellung auf n Drucker Ende

      IF lHasDifferentShipToAddress THEN BEGIN
        // 01 13.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HotFix
        getName(lShiptoAddress,lFirstname,lSurname);
        lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'firstname',lFirstname);
        lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'surname',lSurname);
        // 01 13.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HotFix Ende
      END ELSE BEGIN

        IF NOT lContact.GET(pSalesShipmentHeader."Sell-to Contact No.") THEN
          ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(ContactNotFound,pSalesShipmentHeader."Sell-to Contact No."));

        lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'firstname',lContact."First Name");
        lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'surname',lContact.Surname);

      END;

      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'orderId',pSalesShipmentHeader."External Document No.");
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'street',pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to Address");
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'street2',pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to Address 2");

      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'postalCode',pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to Post Code");
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'city',pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to City");
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'country',pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code");
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'contactPerson',pSalesShipmentHeader."Ship-to Name");
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'phoneNumber',lSalesShiptoFieldsHandling.Get_ShipToPhoneNo(pSalesShipmentHeader.RECORDID,pSalesShipmentHeader));
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'email',lSalesShiptoFieldsHandling.Get_ShipToEMail(pSalesShipmentHeader.RECORDID,pSalesShipmentHeader));
      // 01 09.05.19 LACK CHR-119 Carrier Plan B / Umstellung auf n Drucker
      lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'MachineID',FORMAT(lMachineID));
      // 01 09.05.19 LACK CHR-119 Carrier Plan B / Umstellung auf n Drucker Ende

      // 01 28.01.22 SGA ERP-455>>
      PackingListHeader.RESET;
      PackingListHeader.SETRANGE("Source No.",pSalesShipmentHeader."External Document No.");
      IF PackingListHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        IF PackingListHeader."Shipping Agent Code"  = 'DGT' THEN
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'trackingID',PackingListHeader."Identification Code");
      END;
      // 01 28.01.22 SGA ERP-455<<

      vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(lOStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      lOStream.WRITE(lJObject.ToString());
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE getName@301510001(pShiptoAddress@301510002 : Record 222;VAR pFirstname@301510000 : Text;VAR pSurname@301510001 : Text);
    VAR
      iTemp@301480000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // 01 13.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HotFix
      // Wenn name vorhanden alles Prima
      IF (pShiptoAddress."Ship-to First Name" <> '') AND (pShiptoAddress."Ship-to Surname" <> '') THEN BEGIN
        pFirstname := pShiptoAddress."Ship-to First Name";
        pSurname := pShiptoAddress."Ship-to Surname"
      END
      ELSE BEGIN
        //Leerzeichen entfernen
        pFirstname := DELCHR(pShiptoAddress.Name,'<',' ');
        iTemp := STRPOS(pFirstname,' ');
        IF iTemp > 0 THEN BEGIN
          pSurname := COPYSTR(pFirstname,iTemp + 1,STRLEN(pFirstname));
          pFirstname := COPYSTR(pFirstname,1,iTemp - 1);
        END;
      END;
      // 01 13.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HotFix Ende
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 23.10.18 MKLE CHR-119 Carrier Plan B / tnt-label-print-service
      // 01 13.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HotFix
      // 01 09.05.19 LACK CHR-119 Carrier Plan B / Umstellung auf n Drucker
      // 01 28.01.22 SGA ERP-455 DG Integration
    }
    END.
  }

OBJECT Codeunit 82010 Payment at pickup Management
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=27.11.18;
    Time=19:09:32;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=CHNX;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=BEGIN
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {

    PROCEDURE CheckDepositStatusOnSalesOrderCheckPostProcessing@301480001(VAR vSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36;VAR vSalesLineTEMP@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 37;VAR vPostProcessingEntryTEMP@301480008 : TEMPORARY Record 5104950) : Boolean;
    VAR
      SetupGet@301480007 : Codeunit 5105007;
      SystemValueLine@301480013 : Record 5105031;
      SystemValueLine1@301480010 : Record 5105031;
      CustomerSetup@301480011 : Record 87000;
      PaymentMethod@301480012 : Record 289;
      PostProcessingManagement@301480006 : Codeunit 5104950;
      SystemManagementManagement@301480016 : Codeunit 5105000;
      SystemValueNo@301480004 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@301480003 : Code[10];
      ValueOK@301480002 : Boolean;
      WaitingForDeposit@301480009 : TextConst 'DEU=Warte auf Anzahlung;ENU=Waiting for deposit';
      DepositUndefined@301480005 : TextConst 'DEU=Anzahlung erforderlich nicht definiert;ENU=Not defined if desposit is required.';
    BEGIN
      SystemValueCode := 'ZLGFORM';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;
      ValueOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT PostProcessingManagement.UsePostProcessingCode(vSalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF NOT SetupGet."Get System Value Line"(SystemValueLine,SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT(ValueOK);

      IF SetupGet."Get System Value Line"(SystemValueLine1,SystemValueLine."Ref. System Value No.",vSalesHeader."Payment Method Code",TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        BEGIN
          SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
          IF vSalesHeader."Payment Method Code" <> CustomerSetup."Payment Method Pickup" THEN
            EXIT(ValueOK);

            ValueOK :=  vSalesHeader."Order Type"::Store = vSalesHeader."Order Type";

            IF NOT ValueOK THEN BEGIN
              vSalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Deposit required");
              IF vSalesHeader."Deposit required" = vSalesHeader."Deposit required"::Yes THEN BEGIN
                ValueOK := PaymentMethod.GET(CustomerSetup."Payment Method Pickup");
                ValueOK := SystemManagementManagement."test prepayed Amount"(vSalesHeader,'3280100',
                            0,0,0); // To-Do Account Payment Method
              END ELSE
                ValueOK := vSalesHeader."Deposit required" = vSalesHeader."Deposit required"::No
            END;
        END;

      IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",SystemValueCode);
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
        IF vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.VALIDATE(Open,FALSE);
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.MODIFY(TRUE);
        UNTIL vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.NEXT = 0;
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        IF vSalesHeader."Deposit required" = vSalesHeader."Deposit required"::Undefined THEN
          PostProcessingManagement.InsertPostProcessingEntry(vSalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine1,'',DepositUndefined,TRUE,FALSE)
        ELSE
          PostProcessingManagement.InsertPostProcessingEntry(vSalesHeader,0,SystemValueLine1,'',WaitingForDeposit,TRUE,FALSE);
        PostProcessingManagement.GetPostProcessEntryTemp(vPostProcessingEntryTEMP);
      END;

      EXIT(ValueOK);
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,36,OnAfterValidateEvent,"Payment Method Code")]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE ClearDepositRequiredOnAfterValidatePaymentMethodSalesHeader@301480000(VAR Rec@301480000 : Record 36;VAR xRec@301480001 : Record 36;CurrFieldNo@301480002 : Integer);
    VAR
      CustomerSetup@301480005 : Record 87000;
      DocumentValueManagement@301480003 : Codeunit 5295670;
      SetupGet@301480004 : Codeunit 5105007;
    BEGIN
      // 01 27.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Defaultwert fÅr Anzahlung
      SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,TRUE,TRUE);
      IF CustomerSetup."Deposit Required Default Value" = CustomerSetup."Deposit Required Default Value"::Undefined THEN BEGIN
      // 01 27.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Defaultwert fÅr Anzahlung ENDE
        DocumentValueManagement.SetSourceRecordID(Rec.RECORDID);

        DocumentValueManagement.SetFieldNoAsIdentifierAndKeyValue(Rec.FIELDNO("Deposit required"));
        DocumentValueManagement.DeleteEntries;
      // 01 27.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Defaultwert fÅr Anzahlung
      END ELSE BEGIN
        Rec."Deposit required" := CustomerSetup."Deposit Required Default Value";

    }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSourceFile@301480008(VAR vExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480007 : Record 5275378;pWarehouseActivityHeader@301480000 : Record 5766) : Text[250];
    VAR
      lJSONManagement@301480001 : Codeunit 5459;
      lJObjectRoot@301480002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lJObjectData@301480003 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
