      lOStream@301480008 : OutStream;
      lWarehouseActivityLine@301480009 : Record 5767;
      lSalesHeader@301480010 : Record 36;
      lCustomerSetup@301480005 : Record 87000;
      lItemAttributeManagement@301480006 : Codeunit 7500;
      lBrand@301480011 : Text[250];
      lModel@301480012 : Text[250];
      lReference@301480013 : Text[250];
      lManufacturerSerialNo@301480014 : Text[250];
      MachineName@301480016 : Code[250];
      MacTerminalSession@301480015 : DotNet "'MacNetTools, Version=7.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=5c84ffa9ea79bb67'.MacNetTools.MacTerminalSession" RUNONCLIENT;
      lTable@301480017 : Integer;
      SystemValue@301480018 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      lCustomerSetup.GET;
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Brand Attribute");
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Model Attribute");
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Reference Attribute");
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");

      IF ((pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source Type" = DATABASE::"Sales Line") AND (pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source Subtype" = 1)) OR
         ((pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source Type" = DATABASE::"Transfer Line") AND (pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source Subtype" = 0)) THEN BEGIN

        IF NOT lSalesHeader.GET(lSalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source No.") THEN BEGIN
          vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INIT;
          vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::error;
          vExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Code" := 'UPDCPSFILE';
          vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename := 'Source No.=' + FORMAT(pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source No.",0,9);
          vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.User := USERID;
          vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE);
          EXIT(STRSUBSTNO(DocumentNotFound,pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source No."));
        END;

        lWarehouseActivityLine.RESET;
        lWarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Activity Type",pWarehouseActivityHeader.Type);
        lWarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("No.",pWarehouseActivityHeader."No.");
        lWarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",lWarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Take);

        IF lWarehouseActivityLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN

          REPEAT

            IF lWarehouseActivityLine."Item No." <> lCustomerSetup."Box Item" THEN BEGIN

              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INIT;
              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Entry No." := 0;
              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::"to process";
              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Code" := 'UPDCPSFILE';
              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename := 'Source No.=' + FORMAT(pWarehouseActivityHeader."Source No.",0,9);
              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.User := USERID;

              lJObjectRoot := lJObjectRoot.JObject;
              lJObjectData := lJObjectData.JObject;
              lJObjectCertficate := lJObjectCertficate.JObject;

              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectData,'orderId',lSalesHeader."External Document No.");

              // Item Attributes

              lBrand := lItemAttributeManagement.GetTranslatedAttributeValue(
                lWarehouseActivityLine."Item No.",
                '',
                '',
                lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute",
                lSalesHeader."Language Code",
                DATABASE::Item);

              lModel := lItemAttributeManagement.GetTranslatedAttributeValue(
                lWarehouseActivityLine."Item No.",
                '',
                '',
                lCustomerSetup."Model Attribute",
                lSalesHeader."Language Code",
                DATABASE::Item);

              // Item Variant Attributes

              lReference := lItemAttributeManagement.GetTranslatedAttributeValue(
                lWarehouseActivityLine."Item No.",
                lWarehouseActivityLine."Variant Code",
                '',
                lCustomerSetup."Reference Attribute",
                lSalesHeader."Language Code",
                DATABASE::"Item Variant");

              // Item Ledger Entry Attributes

              lManufacturerSerialNo := lItemAttributeManagement.GetTranslatedAttributeValue(
                lWarehouseActivityLine."Item No.",
                lWarehouseActivityLine."Variant Code",
                lWarehouseActivityLine."Serial No.",
                lCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu",
                lSalesHeader."Language Code",
                DATABASE::"Serial No. Information");

              // 01 31.01.18 CRET CHR-393 Packtischinformation zur Steuerung verschiedener Zertifikatsdrucker

              // Rechnernamen bestimmen

               MacTerminalSession := MacTerminalSession.MacTerminalSession;
               MachineName := MacTerminalSession.GetTerminalSessionClientName('',MacTerminalSession.GetTerminalSessionId());


              //Systemwert Einrichtung Zertifikatsdrucker abfragen

               SystemValue.RESET;
               SystemValue.SETFILTER(SystemValue."System Value No.",'50053');
               SystemValue.SETFILTER(SystemValue."Code Value 1",MachineName);

               IF SystemValue.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN

                lTable := SystemValue."Calc Value 1";

               END
              //Else Default Drucker
               ELSE
                lTable := 1;

               SystemValue.RESET;

               // 01 31.01.18 CRET CHR-393 Packtischinformation zur Steuerung verschiedener Zertifikatsdrucker ENDE

              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectCertficate,'model',lModel);
              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectCertficate,'brand',lBrand);
              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectCertficate,'reference',lReference);
              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectCertficate,'serialNumber',lManufacturerSerialNo);
              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectCertficate,'internalId',lWarehouseActivityLine."Serial No.");

              // 01 31.01.18 CRET CHR-393 Packtischinformation zur Steuerung verschiedener Zertifikatsdrucker
              lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObjectCertficate,'tableID',lTable);
              // 01 31.01.18 CRET CHR-393 Packtischinformation zur Steuerung verschiedener Zertifikatsdrucker ENDE

              lJSONManagement.AddJObjectToJObject(lJObjectData,'certificate',lJObjectCertficate);
              lJSONManagement.AddJObjectToJObject(lJObjectRoot,'data',lJObjectData);

              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(lOStream,TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
              lOStream.WRITE(lJObjectRoot.ToString());
              vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE);

            END;

          UNTIL lWarehouseActivityLine.NEXT = 0;

        END;
      END;
    END;

OBJECT Codeunit 82012 Import Sales Prices
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=08.05.19;
    Time=18:43:06;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=CHNX;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    TableNo=5275377;
    OnRun=VAR
            ExtInterfaceInboundFile@301480000 : Record 5275377;
          BEGIN
            //ExtInterfaceInboundFile.GET(31646);
            // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
            RunTriggerAndEvents := Rec."Ext Interface Setup Name" <> 'IMPPRI';
            // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates ENDE

            ProcessFile(Rec);
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      UnknownColumn@301480000 : TextConst 'DEU=Unbekannte Spalte: %1.;ENU=Unkown Column: %1.';
      RowCountDiffering@301480001 : TextConst 'DEU=Eingelesene Zeilen: %1, fÅr die Verarbeitung ausgewÑhlt: %2.;ENU=Read lines: %1, marked for processing: %2.';
      ProcessingError@301480002 : TextConst 'DEU=Fehler beim EinfÅgen/Aktualiseren der Verkaufspreise.;ENU=Error while processing sales prices.';
      RunTriggerAndEvents@301510000 : Boolean;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessFile@301480000(VAR vExtInterfaceInboundFile@301480000 : Record 5275377);
    VAR
      lInStream@301480001 : InStream;
      lCurrentLine@301480002 : Text;
      lCurrentLineDotNet@301480005 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      lCurrentLineValues@301480003 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Array";
      lSpererator@301480004 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      lRowCount@301480006 : Integer;
      lSalesPriceTemp@301480007 : TEMPORARY Record 7002;
      lErrorText@301480008 : Text;
      lGeneralLedgerSetup@301480009 : Record 98;
    BEGIN
      IF vExtInterfaceInboundFile.SourceFile.HASVALUE THEN
        vExtInterfaceInboundFile.CALCFIELDS(SourceFile);
      vExtInterfaceInboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEINSTREAM(lInStream);
      lSpererator := ',';
      lRowCount := 0;
      lGeneralLedgerSetup.GET;

      WHILE NOT lInStream.EOS DO BEGIN

        lInStream.READTEXT(lCurrentLine);
        lCurrentLineDotNet := lCurrentLine;
        lCurrentLineValues := lCurrentLineDotNet.Split(lSpererator.ToCharArray());

        IF lRowCount <> 0 THEN
          ProcessLine(lCurrentLineValues,lSalesPriceTemp,lGeneralLedgerSetup)
        ELSE
          IF NOT EvaluateHeaderRow(lCurrentLineValues,lErrorText) THEN BEGIN
            vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status := vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status::error;
            vExtInterfaceInboundFile.MODIFY;
            WriteProtocol(vExtInterfaceInboundFile."Entry No.",lErrorText);
            EXIT;
          END;

        lRowCount += 1;

      END;

      IF ((lRowCount - 1) <> lSalesPriceTemp.COUNT) THEN BEGIN
        vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status := vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status::error;
        vExtInterfaceInboundFile.MODIFY;
        WriteProtocol(vExtInterfaceInboundFile."Entry No.",STRSUBSTNO(RowCountDiffering,lRowCount,lSalesPriceTemp.COUNT));
        EXIT;
      END;

      IF NOT WriteSalesPrices(lSalesPriceTemp) THEN BEGIN
        vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status := vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status::error;
        WriteProtocol(vExtInterfaceInboundFile."Entry No.",ProcessingError);
      END ELSE
        vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status := vExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status::processed;
      vExtInterfaceInboundFile.MODIFY;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessLine@301480011(pCurrentLineValues@301480000 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Array";VAR vSalesPriceTemp@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 7002;pGeneralLedgerSetup@301480007 : Record 98);
    VAR
      lValue@301480002 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      lIntValue@301480004 : Integer;
      lDecimalValue@301480005 : Decimal;
      lBoolValue@301480006 : Boolean;
      lIndex@301480003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      vSalesPriceTemp.INIT;

      lIndex := 0;
      FOREACH lValue IN pCurrentLineValues DO BEGIN
        lValue := lValue.Replace('"','');
          CASE lIndex OF
            0:
              vSalesPriceTemp."Item No." := lValue;
            1:
              vSalesPriceTemp."Variant Code" := lValue;
            2:
              BEGIN
                IF EVALUATE(lIntValue,lValue) THEN
                  vSalesPriceTemp."Sales Type" := lIntValue;
              END;
            3:
              vSalesPriceTemp."Sales Code" := lValue;
            4:
              BEGIN
                IF FORMAT(lValue) <> pGeneralLedgerSetup."LCY Code" THEN
                  vSalesPriceTemp."Currency Code"  := lValue
                ELSE
                  //01 LACK Hotfix
                  vSalesPriceTemp."Currency Code"  := '';
                // HoTFIX ENDE
              END;
            5:
              vSalesPriceTemp."Country/Region Code" := lValue;
            6:
              BEGIN
                IF EVALUATE(lDecimalValue,lValue) THEN
                  vSalesPriceTemp."Unit Price" := lDecimalValue;
              END;
            7:
              BEGIN
                IF EVALUATE(lBoolValue,lValue) THEN
                  vSalesPriceTemp."Price Includes VAT"  := lBoolValue;
              END;
            8:
              BEGIN
                IF EVALUATE(lDecimalValue,lValue) THEN
                  vSalesPriceTemp."Strike-Price incl. VAT" := lDecimalValue;
              END;
            9:
              BEGIN
                IF EVALUATE(lDecimalValue,lValue) THEN
                  vSalesPriceTemp."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT" := lDecimalValue;
              END;
          END;
        lIndex += 1;
      END;

      vSalesPriceTemp.INSERT;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE EvaluateHeaderRow@301480017(pCurrentLineValues@301480000 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Array";VAR vErrorText@301480004 : Text[250]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lValue@301480001 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      lAllowedValue@301480003 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      lAllowedValues@301480002 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.List`1";
    BEGIN
      lAllowedValues := lAllowedValues.List;

      lAllowedValues.Add('Item No_');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Variant Code');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Sales Type');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Sales Code');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Currency Code');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Country_Region Code');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Unit Price');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Price Includes VAT');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Strike-Price incl_ VAT');
      lAllowedValues.Add('Recom_ Retail Price incl_ VAT');

      FOREACH lValue IN pCurrentLineValues DO BEGIN
        lValue := lValue.Replace('"','');
        IF NOT lAllowedValues.Contains(lValue) THEN BEGIN
          vErrorText := STRSUBSTNO(UnknownColumn,lValue);
          EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE WriteProtocol@301480001(pSourceNo@301480001 : Integer;pMessage@301480002 : Text[250]);
    VAR
      lExtInterfaceProtocol@301480000 : Record 5275379;
      lLastEntryNo@301480003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT (pMessage <> '') THEN
        EXIT;

      lExtInterfaceProtocol.RESET;
      lExtInterfaceProtocol.SETCURRENTKEY("Entry No.");
      lExtInterfaceProtocol.SETRANGE("Source Entry No.",pSourceNo);
      IF lExtInterfaceProtocol.FINDLAST THEN
        lLastEntryNo := lExtInterfaceProtocol."Entry No.";
      lLastEntryNo += 1;

      lExtInterfaceProtocol.INIT;
      lExtInterfaceProtocol."Entry No." := lLastEntryNo;
      lExtInterfaceProtocol."Source Entry No." := pSourceNo;
      lExtInterfaceProtocol."Source Table" := 5275377;
      lExtInterfaceProtocol."Par 1" := pMessage;
      lExtInterfaceProtocol.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE WriteSalesPrices@301480023(VAR vSalesPriceTemp@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 7002) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lSalesPrice@301480001 : Record 7002;
      lSalesPriceCopy@301510000 : Record 7002;
      lGeneralLedgerSetup@301480002 : Record 98;
    BEGIN
      lGeneralLedgerSetup.GET;
      vSalesPriceTemp.RESET;
      IF vSalesPriceTemp.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        lSalesPrice.LOCKTABLE;
        REPEAT
          //Item No.,Sales Type,Sales Code,Promotion Medium No.,Prom.Med.Tar.Grp.No.,Set No.,Starting Date,Currency Code,Country/Region Code,Variant Code,Unit of Measure Code,Minimum Quantity
          IF NOT lSalesPrice.GET(vSalesPriceTemp."Item No.",vSalesPriceTemp."Sales Type",vSalesPriceTemp."Sales Code",vSalesPriceTemp."Promotion Medium No.",vSalesPriceTemp."Prom.Med.Tar.Grp.No.",
            vSalesPriceTemp."Set No.",vSalesPriceTemp."Starting Date",vSalesPriceTemp."Currency Code",vSalesPriceTemp."Country/Region Code",vSalesPriceTemp."Variant Code",vSalesPriceTemp."Unit of Measure Code",
            vSalesPriceTemp."Minimum Quantity") THEN BEGIN
              lSalesPrice.INIT;
              lSalesPrice."Item No." := vSalesPriceTemp."Item No.";
              lSalesPrice."Variant Code" := vSalesPriceTemp."Variant Code";
              lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Sales Type",vSalesPriceTemp."Sales Type");
              lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Sales Code",vSalesPriceTemp."Sales Code");
              IF vSalesPriceTemp."Currency Code" <> lGeneralLedgerSetup."LCY Code" THEN
                lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Currency Code",vSalesPriceTemp."Currency Code");
              lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Country/Region Code",vSalesPriceTemp."Country/Region Code");
              lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Unit Price",vSalesPriceTemp."Unit Price");
              lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Price Includes VAT",vSalesPriceTemp."Price Includes VAT");
              lSalesPrice."Strike-Price incl. VAT" := vSalesPriceTemp."Strike-Price incl. VAT";
              lSalesPrice."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT" := vSalesPriceTemp."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT";
              // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
              //lSalesPrice.INSERT;
              lSalesPrice.INSERT(RunTriggerAndEvents);
              // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates ENDE
            END ELSE BEGIN
              // 01 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Bugfix Subscriber: Rec and xRec are the same
              lSalesPriceCopy.COPY(lSalesPrice);
              // 01 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Bugfix Subscriber: Rec and xRec are the same ENDE
              lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Unit Price",vSalesPriceTemp."Unit Price");
              lSalesPrice.VALIDATE("Price Includes VAT",vSalesPriceTemp."Price Includes VAT");
              lSalesPrice."Strike-Price incl. VAT" := vSalesPriceTemp."Strike-Price incl. VAT";
              lSalesPrice."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT" := vSalesPriceTemp."Recom. Retail Price incl. VAT";
              lSalesPrice.MODIFY;
              // 01 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Bugfix Subscriber: Rec and xRec are the same
              // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
              //OnAfterSalesPriceModify(lSalesPrice,lSalesPriceCopy);
              OnAfterSalesPriceModify(lSalesPrice,lSalesPriceCopy,RunTriggerAndEvents);
              // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates ENDE
              // 01 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Bugfix Subscriber: Rec and xRec are the same ENDE
            END;
        UNTIL (vSalesPriceTemp.NEXT = 0)
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    [Integration]
    PROCEDURE OnAfterSalesPriceModify@301510000(VAR vSalesPriceRec@301510000 : Record 7002;VAR vSalesPricexRec@301510001 : Record 7002;RunTrigger@301510002 : Boolean);
    BEGIN
      // GF 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 OnAfterSalesPriceModify
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 29.10.18 MKLE CHR-111 Import Sales Prices
      // GF 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 OnAfterSalesPriceModify
      // 01 23.01.19 MKLE CHR-184 Bugfix Subscriber: Rec and xRec are the same
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-184 Preise als Partial Updates
    }
    END.
  }

    PROCEDURE CreateJsonObject@301480004(pSalesHeaderToExport@301480000 : Record 36) : Text;
    VAR

      Contact@301480007 : Record 5050;
      JObject@301480002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";

      JSONManagement.AddJObjectToJObject(JObject,'deliveryAddress',JObjectDeliveryAddress);

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillTempSalesLines@301480002(VAR pTempSalesLine@301480005 : TEMPORARY Record 37;VAR pSalesHeader@301480006 : Record 36;VAR pOrderAmount@301480007 : Decimal);
    VAR
      SalesLine@301480000 : Record 37;
      VariableHasToBeTempErr@301480001 : TextConst 'DEU=Die Variable Sales Line muss temporÑr sein (XMLPort: 82000);ENU=Sales Line variable has to be temporary. (XMLPort: 82000)';
      SalesLineArchive@301480002 : Record 5108;
      SalesHeaderArchive@301480004 : Record 5107;
      orderAmountFromArchive@301480003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT pTempSalesLine.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        ERROR(VariableHasToBeTempErr);

      pTempSalesLine.RESET;
      pTempSalesLine.DELETEALL;

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",pSalesHeader."No.");
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          pTempSalesLine := SalesLine;
          pTempSalesLine.INSERT;
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0
      ELSE BEGIN
        SalesLineArchive.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesHeader."Document Type");
        SalesLineArchive.SETRANGE("Document No.",pSalesHeader."No.");
        SalesLineArchive.SETRANGE("Version No.",1);
        IF SalesLineArchive.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            // 01 17.04.19 MKLE CHR-489 Transfer Last Occurence
            IF IsLastOccurrence(SalesLineArchive) THEN BEGIN
            // 01 17.04.19 MKLE CHR-489 Transfer Last Occurence ENDE
              pTempSalesLine.TRANSFERFIELDS(SalesLineArchive);
              pTempSalesLine.INSERT;
            // 01 17.04.19 MKLE CHR-489 Transfer Last Occurence
            END;
            // 01 17.04.19 MKLE CHR-489 Transfer Last Occurence ENDE
          UNTIL SalesLineArchive.NEXT = 0;
          orderAmountFromArchive := TRUE;
        END;
      END;

      IF orderAmountFromArchive THEN BEGIN
        SalesHeaderArchive.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesHeader."Document Type");
        SalesHeaderArchive.SETRANGE("No.",pSalesHeader."No.");
        SalesHeaderArchive.SETRANGE("Version No.",1);
        IF SalesHeaderArchive.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SalesHeaderArchive.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
          pOrderAmount := SalesHeaderArchive."Amount Including VAT";
        END;
      END;
    END;

      IF NOT lExtInterfaceSetup.GET('UPDDLT') THEN
        ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(NotImplemented,'UPDDLT'));

      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INIT;
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::"to process";

        '&Variant Code=' + FORMAT(pDeliveryTimesAggregate."Variant Code",0,9) +

    [External]
    PROCEDURE FindItemsByFunctions@50(VAR FilterItemFunctionsBuffer@1001 : Record 85008;VAR TempFilteredItem@1004 : TEMPORARY Record 27);
    VAR
      ItemFunctionMapping@1003 : Record 85000;
      ItemAttribute@1000 : Record 7500;
      AttributeValueIDFilter@1005 : Text;
      FunctionCount@301480000 : Integer;
      FilterString@301480001 : Text;
    BEGIN
      // 01 17.09.18 MBLA CHR-121 Suchmîglichkeit nach Funktionen und Attributen
      IF NOT FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        EXIT;

      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,FALSE);
      IF FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          ItemFunctionMapping.SETRANGE(Description,FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.Attribute);
          IF ItemFunctionMapping.FINDSET THEN
            REPEAT
              IF TempFilteredItem.GET(ItemFunctionMapping."Item No.") THEN
                TempFilteredItem.DELETE;
            UNTIL ItemFunctionMapping.NEXT = 0;
        UNTIL FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.NEXT = 0;

      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.RESET;
      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,TRUE);
      FunctionCount := FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.COUNT;
      IF FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          FilterString += FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.Attribute +'|';
        UNTIL FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.NEXT = 0;
        FilterString := DELCHR(FilterString, '>', '|'); //delete pipe

      TempItemBuffer.DELETEALL;
      ItemFunctionMapping.SETFILTER(Description,FilterString);
      IF ItemFunctionMapping.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          InsertIntoTempBuffer(ItemFunctionMapping."Item No.");
        UNTIL ItemFunctionMapping.NEXT = 0;

      TempItemBuffer.SETRANGE("Statistics Group",FunctionCount);
      IF TempItemBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF NOT TempFilteredItem.GET(TempItemBuffer."No.") THEN BEGIN
            TempFilteredItem.INIT;
            TempFilteredItem."No." := TempItemBuffer."No.";
            TempFilteredItem."No. 2" := 'FUNCTION';
            TempFilteredItem.INSERT;
          END;
        UNTIL TempItemBuffer.NEXT = 0;

      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertIntoTempBuffer@301480001(pItemNo@301480000 : Code[20]);
    BEGIN
      // 01 17.09.18 MBLA CHR-121 Suchmîglichkeit nach Funktionen und Attributen
      IF NOT TempItemBuffer.GET(pItemNo) THEN BEGIN
        TempItemBuffer."No." := pItemNo;
        TempItemBuffer."Statistics Group" := 1;
        TempItemBuffer.INSERT;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        TempItemBuffer."Statistics Group" += 1;
        TempItemBuffer.MODIFY;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 28.07.18 MKLE CHR-48 Added Page Item Function Management
      // NF 17.09.18 MBLA CHR-121 Suchmîglichkeit nach Funktionen und Attributen:<FindItemsByFunctions>
      // NF 17.09.18 MBLA CHR-121 Suchmîglichkeit nach Funktionen und Attributen:<InsertIntoTempBuffer>
    }
    END.
  }

OBJECT Codeunit 85001 Extended Search Mgt.
{

  CODE

    PROCEDURE FindItemVariantsByAttributes@50(VAR FilterItemAttributesBuffer@1001 : Record 7506;VAR TempFilteredItemVariant@1004 : TEMPORARY Record 5401);
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@1003 : Record 7505;
      ItemAttribute@1000 : Record 7500;
      AttributeValueIDFilter@1005 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT FilterItemAttributesBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        EXIT;

      //ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Item Variant");
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Table ID",'%1|%2',DATABASE::"Item Variant",DATABASE::"Serial No. Information");

      REPEAT
        ItemAttribute.SETRANGE(Name,FilterItemAttributesBuffer.Attribute);
        IF ItemAttribute.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",ItemAttribute.ID);
          AttributeValueIDFilter := GetItemVariantAttributeValueFilter(FilterItemAttributesBuffer,ItemAttribute);
          IF AttributeValueIDFilter = '' THEN BEGIN
            TempFilteredItemVariant.DELETEALL;
            EXIT;
          END;

          GetFilteredItemVariants(ItemAttributeValueMapping,TempFilteredItemVariant,AttributeValueIDFilter);
          IF TempFilteredItemVariant.ISEMPTY THEN
            EXIT;
        END;
      UNTIL FilterItemAttributesBuffer.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetItemVariantAttributeValueFilter@9(VAR FilterItemAttributesBuffer@1000 : Record 7506;VAR ItemAttribute@1003 : Record 7500) AttributeFilter : Text;
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValue@1001 : Record 7501;
    BEGIN
      ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",ItemAttribute.ID);
      ItemAttributeValue.SetValueFilter(ItemAttribute,FilterItemAttributesBuffer.Value);

      IF NOT ItemAttributeValue.FINDSET THEN
        EXIT;

      REPEAT
        AttributeFilter += STRSUBSTNO('%1|',ItemAttributeValue.ID);
      UNTIL ItemAttributeValue.NEXT = 0;

      EXIT(COPYSTR(AttributeFilter,1,STRLEN(AttributeFilter) - 1));
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetFilteredItemVariants@51(VAR ItemAttributeValueMapping@1001 : Record 7505;VAR TempFilteredItemVariant@1000 : TEMPORARY Record 5401;AttributeValueIDFilter@1002 : Text);
    BEGIN
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Item Attribute Value ID",AttributeValueIDFilter);

      IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        TempFilteredItemVariant.RESET;
        TempFilteredItemVariant.DELETEALL;
        EXIT;
      END;

      IF NOT TempFilteredItemVariant.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDSET THEN
          REPEAT
            TempFilteredItemVariant.Code := ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code";
            TempFilteredItemVariant."Item No." := ItemAttributeValueMapping."No.";
            TempFilteredItemVariant.INSERT;
          UNTIL ItemAttributeValueMapping.NEXT = 0;
        EXIT;
      END;

      REPEAT
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",TempFilteredItemVariant."Item No.");
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",TempFilteredItemVariant.Code);
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.ISEMPTY THEN
          TempFilteredItemVariant.DELETE;
      UNTIL TempFilteredItemVariant.NEXT = 0;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.");
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code");
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetItemVariantCodeFilterText@12(VAR TempFilteredItemVariant@1000 : TEMPORARY Record 5401;VAR ParameterCount@1004 : Integer) FilterText : Text;
    VAR
      NextItemVariant@1002 : Record 5401;
      PreviousNo@1001 : Code[20];
      FilterRangeStarted@1003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT TempFilteredItemVariant.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        FilterText := '<>*';
        EXIT;
      END;

      REPEAT
        IF FilterText = '' THEN BEGIN
          FilterText := TempFilteredItemVariant.Code;
          NextItemVariant.Code := TempFilteredItemVariant.Code;
          ParameterCount += 1;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          IF NextItemVariant.NEXT = 0 THEN
            NextItemVariant.Code := '';
          IF TempFilteredItemVariant.Code = NextItemVariant.Code THEN BEGIN
            IF NOT FilterRangeStarted THEN
              FilterText += '..';
            FilterRangeStarted := TRUE;
          END ELSE
            IF NOT FilterRangeStarted THEN BEGIN
              FilterText += STRSUBSTNO('|%1',TempFilteredItemVariant.Code);
              ParameterCount += 1;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              FilterText += STRSUBSTNO('%1|%2',PreviousNo,TempFilteredItemVariant.Code);
              FilterRangeStarted := FALSE;
              ParameterCount += 2;
            END;
        END;
        PreviousNo := TempFilteredItemVariant.Code;
      UNTIL TempFilteredItemVariant.NEXT = 0;

      // close range if needed
      IF FilterRangeStarted THEN BEGIN
        FilterText += STRSUBSTNO('%1',PreviousNo);
        ParameterCount += 1;
      END;
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE FindItemVariantsByItemFunctions@301480000(VAR FilterItemFunctionsBuffer@1001 : Record 85008;VAR TempFilteredItemVariant@1004 : TEMPORARY Record 5401);
    VAR
      ItemFunctionMapping@1003 : Record 85000;
      ItemAttribute@1000 : Record 7500;
      ItemVariant@301480002 : Record 5401;
      TempItemBuffer@301480003 : TEMPORARY Record 27;
      AttributeValueIDFilter@1005 : Text;
      FunctionCount@301480000 : Integer;
      FilterString@301480001 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        EXIT;

      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,FALSE);
      IF FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          ItemFunctionMapping.SETRANGE(Description,FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.Attribute);
          IF ItemFunctionMapping.FINDSET THEN
            REPEAT
              //IF TempFilteredItemVariant.GET(ItemFunctionMapping."Item No.") THEN
              //  TempFilteredItemVariant.DELETE;
              TempFilteredItemVariant.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemFunctionMapping."Item No.");
              TempFilteredItemVariant.DELETEALL;
            UNTIL ItemFunctionMapping.NEXT = 0;
        UNTIL FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.NEXT = 0;

      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.RESET;
      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,TRUE);
      FunctionCount := FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.COUNT;
      IF FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          FilterString += FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.Attribute +'|';
        UNTIL FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.NEXT = 0;
      FilterString := DELCHR(FilterString, '>', '|'); //delete last pipe

      TempItemBuffer.DELETEALL;
      ItemFunctionMapping.SETFILTER(Description,FilterString);
      IF ItemFunctionMapping.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT

          IF NOT TempItemBuffer.GET(ItemFunctionMapping."Item No.") THEN BEGIN
            TempItemBuffer."No." := ItemFunctionMapping."Item No.";
            TempItemBuffer."Statistics Group" := 1;
            TempItemBuffer.INSERT;
          END ELSE BEGIN
            TempItemBuffer."Statistics Group" += 1;
            TempItemBuffer.MODIFY;
          END;

        UNTIL ItemFunctionMapping.NEXT = 0;

      TempItemBuffer.SETFILTER("Statistics Group",'%1..',FunctionCount);
      IF TempItemBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          TempFilteredItemVariant.RESET;
          TempFilteredItemVariant.SETRANGE("Item No.",TempItemBuffer."No.");
          IF TempFilteredItemVariant.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            ItemVariant.RESET;
            ItemVariant.SETRANGE("Item No.",TempItemBuffer."No.");
            IF ItemVariant.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                TempFilteredItemVariant.INIT;
                TempFilteredItemVariant.TRANSFERFIELDS(ItemVariant);
                //TempFilteredItemVariant."No. 2" := 'FUNCTION';
                TempFilteredItemVariant.INSERT;
              UNTIL ItemVariant.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        UNTIL TempItemBuffer.NEXT = 0;

      TempFilteredItemVariant.RESET;

      FilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 01 17.09.18 MBLA CHR-121 Suchmîglichkeit nach Funktionen und Attributen
    }
    END.
  }
}

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessFile@301480004(VAR vExtInterfaceInboundFile@301480000 : Record 5275377) : Text;
    VAR

      lInStream@301480001 : InStream;

    PROCEDURE ImportApplicationData@1000000139(pPathAndFilename@1000000000 : Text;pTableNo@1000000006 : Integer;pSeparator@1000000003 : Text[1];pRunTrigger@301480000 : Boolean) : Boolean;
    VAR
      TempCSVBuffer@1000000002 : TEMPORARY Record 1234;
      FileManagement@1000000001 : Codeunit 419;
    BEGIN
      FileManagement.ServerFileExists(pPathAndFilename);

      Counter := 0;
      TempCSVBuffer.LoadData(pPathAndFilename,pSeparator);
      TempCSVBuffer.SETFILTER("Line No.",'%1..',2);
      IF TempCSVBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        OpenProgressbar(GetTableName(pTableNo),TempCSVBuffer.COUNT);
        REPEAT
          ImportLine(TempCSVBuffer,pTableNo,pRunTrigger);
          Counter += 1;
          UpdateProgressbar(Counter);
        UNTIL (TempCSVBuffer.NEXT = 0);
        CloseProgressbar;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

        DATABASE::"Item Attribute Value Mapping": ImportVariantUpdate(TempCSVBuffer,pRunTrigger);
        DATABASE::"Portfolio Transfer": ImportVariantCodes(TempCSVBuffer,pRunTrigger);
        DATABASE::"Value Transfer": ImportOnDemandItems(TempCSVBuffer,pRunTrigger);
        // ...
       END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE OpenProgressbar@80004(Context@80001 : Text;pCounterTotal@80002 : Integer);
    VAR
      Text000@80000 : TextConst 'DEU=Tabelle: #1####################################\Datensatz: #2####################################\Fortschritt: @3@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@';
    BEGIN
      IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN
        EXIT;

      Counter := 0;

      CounterTotal := pCounterTotal;
      Progressbar.OPEN(Text000);
      Progressbar.UPDATE(1,Context);
      SaveTime := TIME;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE UpdateProgressbar@80005(Counter@80001 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN
        EXIT;

      //Progressbar.UPDATE(1,Rec.Name);
      Progressbar.UPDATE(2,FORMAT(Counter)+' / '+FORMAT(CounterTotal));
      IF ABS(TIME - SaveTime) > 999 THEN BEGIN
        SaveTime := TIME;
        Progressbar.UPDATE(3,ROUND(Counter/CounterTotal * 9999.99,1));
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CloseProgressbar@80006();
    BEGIN
      IF NOT GUIALLOWED THEN
        EXIT;

      Progressbar.CLOSE;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CastToInt@1000000152(Value@1000000000 : Text) ReturnInt : Integer;
    BEGIN
      CASE TRUE OF
        Value IN ['NULL','"NULL"',''] : Value := '0';
      END;

      IF NOT EVALUATE(ReturnInt,Value) THEN
        ReturnInt := 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CleanUpValue@1000000077(pText@1000000000 : Text[250]) : Text[250];
    BEGIN
      IF pText IN ['NULL','"NULL"'] THEN
        EXIT('');

      pText := DELCHR(pText,'<>','"');
      pText := DELCHR(pText,'=','\');
      pText := DELCHR(pText,'=','∞');
      //pText := DELCHR(pText,'=','?');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«œ','Ñ');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«Ù','î');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«Õ','ô');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«¨','Å');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«˛','·');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«∏','Ç');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«≠','∆');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'«˘','ä');
      pText := ReplaceWith(pText,'« ','‡');
      EXIT(pText);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ReplaceWith@1000000079(String@1000000000 : Text;FindWhat@1000000001 : Text;ReplaceWith@1000000002 : Text) : Text;
    BEGIN
      WHILE STRPOS(String,FindWhat) > 0 DO
        String := DELSTR(String,STRPOS(String,FindWhat)) + ReplaceWith + COPYSTR(String,STRPOS(String,FindWhat) + STRLEN(FindWhat));
      EXIT(String);
    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertGenJournalLine@301510002(GlobalArray@301510001 : ARRAY [20] OF Text[250];pRunTrigger@301510000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      GenJournalLine@301510002 : Record 81;
      CustomerBankAccount@301510006 : Record 287;
      VendorBankAccount@301510007 : Record 288;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510009 : Record 112;
      SalesHeader@301510010 : Record 36;
      vDate@301510003 : Date;
      vDecimal@301510004 : Decimal;
      vIBAN@301510005 : Text;
      vOrderNo@301510008 : Text;
      bolCheckOrder@301510011 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      GenJournalLine.INIT;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Template Name" := g_TemplateCode;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Batch Name" := g_BatchCode;
      GenJournalLine."Line No." := JournalLineNo;
      EVALUATE(vDate,GlobalArray[1]);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Posting Date",vDate);
      GenJournalLine."Document Type" := GenJournalLine."Document Type"::Payment;
      EVALUATE(vDecimal,GlobalArray[5]);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,-vDecimal);
      vIBAN := IBANString(GlobalArray[4]);
      bolCheckOrder := FALSE;
      IF vIBAN <> '' THEN BEGIN
        IF vDecimal > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CustomerBankAccount.RESET;
          CustomerBankAccount.SETRANGE(IBAN,vIBAN);
          IF CustomerBankAccount.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF CustomerBankAccount.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
              GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Customer);
              GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",CustomerBankAccount."Customer No.");
            END;
          END ELSE
            bolCheckOrder := TRUE;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          VendorBankAccount.RESET;
          VendorBankAccount.SETRANGE(IBAN,vIBAN);
          IF VendorBankAccount.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
            IF VendorBankAccount.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
              GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Vendor);
              GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",VendorBankAccount."Vendor No.");
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END ELSE
        bolCheckOrder := TRUE;

      IF bolCheckOrder THEN BEGIN
        vOrderNo := OrderString(GlobalArray[4]);
        IF vOrderNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
          IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,vOrderNo) THEN BEGIN
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Customer);
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Customer No. Reference",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
            IF SalesHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'VORAUS' THEN BEGIN
              CASE GlobalArray[6] OF
                'EUR' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_EUR');
                'CHF' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_CHF');
                'GBP' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_GBP');
                'USD' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_USD');
                'CAD' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_CAD');
              END;
            END;
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Order No. Reference",vOrderNo);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
            SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",vOrderNo);
            IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
              GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Customer);
              GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Order No. Reference",vOrderNo);
              GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Customer No. Reference",SalesInvoiceHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
              IF SalesInvoiceHeader."Payment Method Code" = 'VORAUS' THEN BEGIN
                  CASE GlobalArray[6] OF
                    'EUR' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_EUR');
                    'CHF' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_CHF');
                    'GBP' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_GBP');
                    'USD' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_USD');
                    'CAD' : GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'VORAUS_CAD');
                  END;
              END;
            END;
          END
        END;
      END;

      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bal. Account Type",GenJournalLine."Bal. Account Type"::"Bank Account");
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bal. Account No.",BankAccountNo(GlobalArray[7]));

      GenJournalLine.Description := COPYSTR(ParseDescription(GlobalArray[4]),1,50);
      GenJournalLine.INSERT;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ParseDescription@301510001(p_Description@301510000 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      lTxt001@301510001 : TextConst 'ENU=" End-to-End-Ref"';
    BEGIN
      IF STRPOS(p_Description,lTxt001) <> 0 THEN
        p_Description := COPYSTR(p_Description,1,STRPOS(p_Description,lTxt001));

      EXIT(p_Description);
    END;

    PROCEDURE IBANString@301510005(p_Description@301510000 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      Candidate@301510001 : Text;
      IsNumeric@301510002 : Boolean;
      i@301510003 : Integer;
      j@301510004 : Integer;
      Char@301510005 : Char;
    BEGIN
      FOR i := 1 TO STRLEN(p_Description) - 21 DO BEGIN
        IF COPYSTR(p_Description, i, 2) = 'DE' THEN BEGIN
          Candidate := COPYSTR(p_Description, i, 22);
          IsNumeric := TRUE;
          FOR j := 3 TO 22 DO BEGIN
            Char := Candidate[j];
            IF NOT (Char IN ['0'..'9']) THEN BEGIN
              IsNumeric := FALSE;
              BREAK;
            END;
          END;
          IF IsNumeric THEN
            EXIT(Candidate);
        END;
      END;

      EXIT('');
    END;

    PROCEDURE OrderString@301510006(p_Description@301510000 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      Candidate@301510005 : Text;
      IsNumeric@301510004 : Boolean;
      i@301510003 : Integer;
      j@301510002 : Integer;
      Char@301510001 : Char;
    BEGIN
      i := 1;
      WHILE i <= STRLEN(p_Description) DO BEGIN
        Char := p_Description[i];
        IF Char = 'X' THEN BEGIN
          Candidate := 'X';
          i := i + 1;
          WHILE (i <= STRLEN(p_Description)) AND (p_Description[i] IN ['0'..'9']) DO BEGIN
            Candidate += FORMAT(p_Description[i]);
            i := i + 1;
          END;
          IF STRLEN(Candidate) > 1 THEN
            EXIT(COPYSTR(Candidate,1,12));
        END ELSE
          i := i + 1;
      END;

      EXIT('');
    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertGenJournalLine_MossStatement@301510012(GlobalArray@301510001 : ARRAY [20] OF Text[250];pRunTrigger@301510000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      GenJournalLine@301510002 : Record 81;
      CustomerBankAccount@301510006 : Record 287;
      VendorBankAccount@301510007 : Record 288;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510009 : Record 112;
      SalesHeader@301510010 : Record 36;
      vDate@301510003 : Date;
      vDecimal@301510004 : Decimal;
      vIBAN@301510005 : Text;
      vOrderNo@301510008 : Text;
      bolCheckOrder@301510011 : Boolean;
      vAccNo@301510012 : Code[20];
      iYear@301510013 : Integer;
      iMonth@301510014 : Integer;
      iDay@301510015 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      GenJournalLine.INIT;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Template Name" := g_TemplateCode;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Batch Name" := g_BatchCode;
      GenJournalLine."Line No." := JournalLineNo;

      EVALUATE(iYear, COPYSTR(GlobalArray[1], 1, 4));   // 2025
      EVALUATE(iMonth, COPYSTR(GlobalArray[1], 6, 2));  // 07
      EVALUATE(iDay, COPYSTR(GlobalArray[1], 9, 2));    // 10
      vDate := DMY2DATE(iDay, iMonth, iYear);


      //EVALUATE(vDate,GlobalArray[1]);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Posting Date",vDate);
      GenJournalLine."Document Type" := GenJournalLine."Document Type"::Payment;
      EVALUATE(vDecimal,GlobalArray[5]);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,-vDecimal);
      GenJournalLine.Comment := 'MOSS';
      vAccNo := FindVendor_MossStatement(GlobalArray[4]);
      IF vAccNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Vendor);
        GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",vAccNo);
        GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Currency Code",'');
      END;

      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bal. Account Type",GenJournalLine."Bal. Account Type"::"G/L Account");
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bal. Account No.",'13701');

      IF vAccNo = '' THEN
        GenJournalLine.Description := GlobalArray[4];
      GenJournalLine.INSERT;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ParseDescription_MossStatement@301510007(pText@301510000 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      Pos@301510001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      Pos := STRPOS(UPPERCASE(pText),'WWW.');
      IF Pos <> 0 THEN
        pText := DELSTR(pText,Pos,4);

      Pos := STRPOS(pText,' ');
      IF Pos <> 0 THEN
        pText := COPYSTR(pText,1,Pos-1);

      Pos := STRPOS(pText,'.');
      IF Pos <> 0 THEN
        pText := COPYSTR(pText,1,Pos-1);

      Pos := STRPOS(pText,',');
      IF Pos <> 0 THEN
        pText := COPYSTR(pText,1,Pos-1);

      Pos := STRPOS(pText,'*');
      IF Pos <> 0 THEN
        pText := COPYSTR(pText,1,Pos-1);

      EXIT(pText);
    END;

    PROCEDURE FindVendor_MossStatement@301510013(pText@301510000 : Text) : Code[20];
    VAR
      Vendor@301510001 : Record 23;
      PaymentMappingSetup@301510003 : Record 5295383;
    BEGIN
      pText := ParseDescription_MossStatement(pText);

      PaymentMappingSetup.RESET;
      PaymentMappingSetup.SETRANGE("Bank Interface Code",'MOSS');
      PaymentMappingSetup.SETFILTER("Purpose Filter",'%1', '*' + UPPERCASE(pText) + '*');
      IF PaymentMappingSetup.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(PaymentMappingSetup."Account No.")
      ELSE
        EXIT('');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ImportVariantUpdate@301510010(VAR TempCSVBuffer@301510001 : Record 1234;pRunTrigger@301510000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      ItemVariant@301510007 : Record 5401;

    BEGIN

      CASE TempCSVBuffer."Field No." OF
        1: GlobalArray[1] := TempCSVBuffer.Value; //Variant Code
        2: GlobalArray[2] := TempCSVBuffer.Value; //Wrist Size 99
      END;

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.RESET;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.SETRANGE("Vendor Item Id",UPPERCASE(GlobalArray[1]));
      IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN

      //IF ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(GlobalArray[1]) THEN BEGIN
        ItemVariant.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.",ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code");
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.INIT;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID" := 5401;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping."No." := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.";
        ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" := 99;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code" := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code";
        ItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No." := '';
        ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" := InsertNewAttribute(GlobalArray[2]);
        IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT THEN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.MODIFY;


        {
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(5401,ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Item No.",10,ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Variant Code",'');
        ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" := 18151;
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.MODIFY(TRUE);
        }

        gSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(gCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
        CASE gCustomerSetup."ExtInterf Item Variant Changes" OF
          gCustomerSetup."ExtInterf Item Variant Changes"::File:
            ExportGatewayItemVariant.CreateExternalInterfaceFile(ItemVariant);
          gCustomerSetup."ExtInterf Item Variant Changes"::"Message (And File)":
            ExportGatewayItemVariant.CreateExternalInterfaceMessage(ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,STRSUBSTNO('P%1_MOD',PAGE::"Item Variants"));
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertNewAttribute@301510011(ItemAttributeText@301510001 : Text) : Integer;
    VAR
      ItemAttribute@301510000 : Record 7500;
      ItemAttributeValue@301510004 : Record 7501;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510002 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      ItemAttributeValue.RESET;
      ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",99);
      ItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(Value,UPPERCASE(ItemAttributeText));
      IF ItemAttributeValue.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(ItemAttributeValue.ID)
      ELSE BEGIN
        ItemAttributeValue.INIT;
        ItemAttributeValue.VALIDATE("Attribute ID",99);
        IF ItemAttributeValue.INSERT THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValue.VALIDATE(Value,UPPERCASE(ItemAttributeText));
          ItemAttributeValue.MODIFY(TRUE);
          EXIT(ItemAttributeValue.ID);
        END;
      END ;
    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertGenJournalLine_Mollie@301510019(GlobalArray@301510001 : ARRAY [20] OF Text[250];pRunTrigger@301510000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      GenJournalLine@301510002 : Record 81;
      CustomerBankAccount@301510006 : Record 287;
      VendorBankAccount@301510007 : Record 288;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510009 : Record 112;
      SalesHeader@301510010 : Record 36;
      vDate@301510003 : Date;
      vDecimal@301510004 : Decimal;
      vIBAN@301510005 : Text;
      vOrderNo@301510008 : Text;
      bolCheckOrder@301510011 : Boolean;
      vAccNo@301510012 : Code[20];
      iYear@301510013 : Integer;
      iMonth@301510014 : Integer;
      iDay@301510015 : Integer;
      vDateTime@301510016 : DateTime;
      DateText@301510017 : Text;
      custName@301510018 : Text;
    BEGIN
      GenJournalLine.INIT;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Template Name" := g_TemplateCode;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Batch Name" := g_BatchCode;
      GenJournalLine."Line No." := JournalLineNo;
      DateText := GlobalArray[1];
      EVALUATE(iYear,COPYSTR(DateText,1,4));
      EVALUATE(iMonth,COPYSTR(DateText,6,2));
      EVALUATE(iDay,COPYSTR(DateText,9,2));
      vDate := DMY2DATE(iDay,iMonth,iYear);
      custName := '';

      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Posting Date",vDate);
      GenJournalLine."Document Type" := GenJournalLine."Document Type"::Payment;
      IF STRPOS(GlobalArray[2], ',') > 0 THEN
          GlobalArray[2] := DELCHR(GlobalArray[2], '=', ',');
      IF STRPOS(GlobalArray[2], '.') > 0 THEN
          GlobalArray[2] := CONVERTSTR(GlobalArray[2], '.', ',');

      EVALUATE(vDecimal,GlobalArray[2]);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,-vDecimal);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bal. Account Type",GenJournalLine."Bal. Account Type"::"G/L Account");
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bal. Account No.",'14601');
      vOrderNo := OrderString(GlobalArray[4]);
      IF vOrderNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,vOrderNo) THEN BEGIN
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Customer);
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Customer No. Reference",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
            custName := SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer Name";
        END ELSE BEGIN
          SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
          SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",vOrderNo);
          IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Customer);
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Customer No. Reference",SalesInvoiceHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
            GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",SalesInvoiceHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
            custName := SalesInvoiceHeader."Sell-to Customer Name";
          END;
        END;
        GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Order No. Reference",vOrderNo);
      END ELSE
         GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",'14610');
      IF vOrderNo <> '' THEN
        GenJournalLine.Description := custName + '_' + vOrderNo
      ELSE
        GenJournalLine.Description := COPYSTR(GlobalArray[4],1,50);
      GenJournalLine.INSERT;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 27.09.19 MBLA MSD-9064 Sorting Boost analog des pricings einspielen.
    }
    END.
  }

    BEGIN

      IF CheckConditionsSalesLineForSerialNo(pSalesLine) THEN BEGIN
        GetCustomerSetup;
        gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");
        IF pSalesLine."No." <> gCustomerSetup."Box Item" THEN BEGIN
          CASE pSalesLine."Document Type" OF
            pSalesLine."Document Type"::Order,pSalesLine."Document Type"::"Return Order":
              BEGIN

                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.",pSalesLine."Line No.");

                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
                IF pSalesLine."Document Type" = pSalesLine."Document Type"::Order THEN
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation)
                ELSE
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Surplus);
                lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Item Tracking",lReservationEntry."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.");
                lReservationEntry.SETFILTER("Serial No.",'<>%1','');
                // LF 03.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 GetManufacturerSerialNoFromItemAttributes
                //IF lReservationEntry.FINDSET THEN
                //  rSerialNo := lReservationEntry."Serial No.";
                IF lReservationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                    rSerialNo := GetManufacturerSerialNoFromItemAttributes(lReservationEntry."Serial No.");
                //END;
                // LF 03.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 GetManufacturerSerialNoFromItemAttributes ENDE
                // 01 24.09.20 ERP-69 NKON Hestellerseriennr. fÅr IC auch angzeigen Item Tracking ist leer
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  lReservationEntry.RESET;
                  lReservationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source ID","Source Ref. No.");
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Sales Line");
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",pSalesLine."Document Type");
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID",pSalesLine."Document No.");
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.",pSalesLine."Line No.");
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pSalesLine."No.");
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
                  lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
                  IF pSalesLine."Document Type" = pSalesLine."Document Type"::Order THEN
                    lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation)
                  ELSE
                    lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Surplus);
                  IF lReservationEntry.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                    IF lReservationEntry1.GET(lReservationEntry."Entry No.",TRUE) THEN
                      IF lReservationEntry1."Serial No." <> '' THEN
                        rSerialNo := GetManufacturerSerialNoFromItemAttributes(lReservationEntry1."Serial No.");
                  END;
                END;
                // 01 24.09.20 ERP-69 NKON Hestellerseriennr. fÅr IC auch angzeigen Item Tracking ist leer
              END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

                  lReservationEntry.SETFILTER("Serial No.",'<>%1','');

                    rSerialNo := lReservationEntry."Serial No.";

                // LF 03.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 GetManufacturerSerialNoFromItemAttributes

                  rSerialNo := GetManufacturerSerialNoFromItemAttributes(rSerialNo);

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetReferenceFromItemAttributes@301480006(VAR pTempNameValueBuffer@301510000 : TEMPORARY Record 823;pReferenceValueToFind@301510001 : Text) : Text;

    BEGIN
      // GF 17.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 FindAttributeReferenceForRecord

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindAttributeReferenceInWarehouseReceiptLine@301480000(pReferenceValueToFind@301480003 : Text;VAR pFilterString@301480000 : Text);
    VAR
      TempNameValueBuffer@301510000 : TEMPORARY Record 823;
      WarehouseReceiptLine@301480002 : Record 7317;
    BEGIN
      // LF 17.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 FindAttributeReferenceInWarehouseReceiptLine
      GetCustomerSetup;
      GetReferenceFromItemAttributes(TempNameValueBuffer,pReferenceValueToFind);

      TempNameValueBuffer.RESET;
      IF TempNameValueBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Item No.",TempNameValueBuffer.Name);
          WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",TempNameValueBuffer.Value);
          IF WarehouseReceiptLine.FINDSET THEN
            REPEAT
              IF STRPOS(pFilterString,WarehouseReceiptLine."No.") = 0 THEN
                pFilterString += STRSUBSTNO('%1|',WarehouseReceiptLine."No.");
            UNTIL WarehouseReceiptLine.NEXT = 0;
        UNTIL TempNameValueBuffer.NEXT = 0;

      pFilterString := DELCHR(pFilterString,'>','|');
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetSalesLineSerialNo@301510000(ParSerialNo@301510002 : Code[20];VAR ParSalesLine@301510003 : Record 37;VAR ParSalesLineFound@301510000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      lReservationEntry@301510001 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      // GF 09.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 "GetSalesLineSerialNo", "GetPurchaseLineSerialNo"
      ParSalesLineFound := FALSE;
      GetCustomerSetup;
      gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");
      lReservationEntry.RESET;
      lReservationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Serial No.");
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Sales Line");
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",lReservationEntry."Source Subtype"::"1");
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",ParSerialNo);
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation);
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Item Tracking",lReservationEntry."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.");
      IF lReservationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ParSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",lReservationEntry."Source ID");
        ParSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",ParSalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
        ParSalesLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",lReservationEntry."Source Ref. No.");
        IF ParSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ParSalesLineFound := TRUE;
          IF NOT CheckConditionsSalesLineForSerialNo(ParSalesLine) THEN
            ParSalesLine.RESET
          ELSE IF ParSalesLine."No." = gCustomerSetup."Box Item" THEN
            ParSalesLine.RESET;
        END;
      END;

      // GF 09.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 "GetSalesLineSerialNo", "GetPurchaseLineSerialNo" ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetPurchaseLineSerialNo@301510003(ParSerialNo@301510002 : Code[20];VAR ParPurchLine@301510001 : Record 39;VAR ParPurchLineFound@301510003 : Boolean);
    VAR
      lReservationEntry@301510000 : Record 337;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301510004 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      // GF 09.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 "GetSalesLineSerialNo", "GetPurchaseLineSerialNo"
      ParPurchLineFound := FALSE;

      GetCustomerSetup;
      gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");
      lReservationEntry.RESET;
      lReservationEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Serial No.");
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Purchase Line");
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",lReservationEntry."Source Subtype"::"1");
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",ParSerialNo);
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Reservation Status",lReservationEntry."Reservation Status"::Reservation);
      lReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Item Tracking",lReservationEntry."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.");
      IF lReservationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ParPurchLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",lReservationEntry."Source ID");
        ParPurchLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",ParPurchLine."Document Type"::Order);
        ParPurchLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",lReservationEntry."Source Ref. No.");
        IF ParPurchLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ParPurchLineFound := TRUE;
          IF NOT CheckConditionsPurchaseLineForSerialNo(ParPurchLine) THEN
            ParPurchLine.RESET
          ELSE IF ParPurchLine."No." = gCustomerSetup."Box Item" THEN
            ParPurchLine.RESET;
        END;
      END;

      IF ParPurchLineFound THEN
        EXIT;

      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.", ParSerialNo);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type", lItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item Tracking", lItemLedgerEntry."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.");
      IF lItemLedgerEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
         //01 28.03.23 NKON
        lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Purchase Order No.");
        //01 28.03.23 NKON
        ParPurchLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",lItemLedgerEntry."Purchase Order No.");
        ParPurchLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",ParPurchLine."Document Type"::Order);
        ParPurchLine.SETRANGE("No.", lItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        ParPurchLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code", lItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
        IF ParPurchLine.FINDFIRST THEN
          ParPurchLineFound := TRUE;
      END;
      // GF 09.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 "GetSalesLineSerialNo", "GetPurchaseLineSerialNo" ENDE
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 30.11.18 MJAN CHR-000 Erstellung
      // LF 03.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 GetManufacturerSerialNoFromItemAttributes
      // GF 17.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 FindAttributeReferenceForRecord
      // LF 17.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 FindAttributeReferenceInWarehouseReceiptLine
      // LF 17.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 GetReferenceFromItemAttributes
      // 01 24.09.20 NKON ERP-69 Hestellerseriennr. fÅr IC auch angzeigen Item Tracking ist leer
      // GF 09.03.23 GDRA CHRON-22 "GetSalesLineSerialNo", "GetPurchaseLineSerialNo"
    }
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckPurchDocOwnGoodsVsCommission@301480004(pPurchaseHeader@301480000 : Record 38);
    VAR
      lPurchaseLine@301480001 : Record 39;
      lPurchaseLine2@301480002 : Record 39;
    BEGIN
      lPurchaseLine.RESET;
      lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",pPurchaseHeader."Document Type");
      lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",pPurchaseHeader."No.");
      lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE(Type,lPurchaseLine.Type::Item);
      lPurchaseLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','');
      IF lPurchaseLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        lPurchaseLine2.RESET;
        lPurchaseLine2.SETRANGE("Document Type",pPurchaseHeader."Document Type");
        lPurchaseLine2.SETRANGE("Document No.",pPurchaseHeader."No.");
        lPurchaseLine2.SETRANGE(Type,lPurchaseLine.Type::Item);
        lPurchaseLine2.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','');
        lPurchaseLine2.SETRANGE(Commission,NOT lPurchaseLine.Commission);
        IF NOT lPurchaseLine2.ISEMPTY THEN
          ERROR(gText_Error_MixCommission);
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 05.11.18 MJAN CHR-128 Objekt erstellt
    }
    END.
  }

    [External]
    PROCEDURE CreateAttributeManufacturerSerialNo@301480001(pItemNo@301480003 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301480002 : Code[10];pSerialNo@301480001 : Code[20];"pManufacturerSerialNo."@301480000 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      lItemAttribute@301480007 : Record 7500;
      lItemAttributeValue@301480006 : Record 7501;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480005 : Record 7505;
      lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection@301480004 : TEMPORARY Record 7504;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301490000 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      // Parameter prÅfen
      IF pItemNo = '' THEN
        ERROR(gText_Error_ItemNoEmpty);

      IF pVariantCode = '' THEN
        ERROR(gText_Error_VariantCodeEmpty);

      IF pSerialNo = '' THEN
        ERROR(gText_Error_SerialNoEmpty);

      // 01 28.02.19 MJAN CHR-375 Bei Herstellerseriennr. auch leeren Wert zulassen
      //IF "pManufacturerSerialNo." = '' THEN
      //  ERROR(gText_Error_ManufacturerSerialNoEmpty);
      // 01 28.02.19 MJAN CHR-375 Bei Herstellerseriennr. auch leeren Wert zulassen ENDE

      // PrÅfen, ob Attribut in der Kundeneinrichtung hinterlegt ist
      gSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(gCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");

      lItemAttribute.GET(gCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");
      lItemAttribute.TESTFIELD("Category Type",lItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Serial No.");

      // Temp. AttributeValueSelection fÅllen
      lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Attribute ID" := gCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu";
      lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Item No." := pItemNo;
      lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Variant Code" := pVariantCode;
      lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Serial No." := pSerialNo;
      lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection.Value := "pManufacturerSerialNo.";


      // // PrÅfen, ob Herstellerseriennr. bereits verwendet
       IF lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection.FindAttributeValueFromRecord(lItemAttributeValue,lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection) THEN BEGIN
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Serial No. Information");
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",gCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Serial No.",'<>%1',pSerialNo);
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1',pItemNo);
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Item Variant Code",'<>%1',pVariantCode);
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value ID",lItemAttributeValue.ID);
        // 01 10.06.20 NKON ERP-57 PrÅfung Herstellerseriennr. ob vorhanden Åber Artikelposten
        IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,"Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.","Item No.");
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pSerialNo);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.","pManufacturerSerialNo.");
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1',pItemNo);
          IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
         // 01 10.06.20 NKON ERP-57 PrÅfung Herstellerseriennr. ob vorhanden Åber Artikelposten
            ERROR(gText_Error_ManufacturerSerialNoExists,"pManufacturerSerialNo.",lItemAttributeValueMapping."No.",lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code",lItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No.");
        END ELSE BEGIN
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Serial No. Information");
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",gCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Serial No.",'<>%1',pSerialNo);
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("No.",'%1',pItemNo);
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETFILTER("Item Variant Code",'%1',pVariantCode);
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute Value ID",lItemAttributeValue.ID);
          // 01 10.06.20 NKON ERP-57 PrÅfung Herstellerseriennr. ob vorhanden Åber Artikelposten
          IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Open,"Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.","Item No.");
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pSerialNo);
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.","pManufacturerSerialNo.");
            ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemNo);
            IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
           // 01 10.06.20 NKON ERP-57 PrÅfung Herstellerseriennr. ob vorhanden Åber Artikelposten
              ERROR(gText_Error_ManufacturerSerialNoExists,"pManufacturerSerialNo.",lItemAttributeValueMapping."No.",lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code",lItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No.");
          END;
        END;

       END;
      // 01 10.06.20 NKON ERP-57 PrÅfung Herstellerseriennr. ob vorhanden auskommentiert

      // Attributswert und Mapping einfÅgen oder Ñndern
      FindOrInsertAttributeValueAndInsertOrModifyAttributeValueMapping(lItemAttribute,lTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection);
    END;

    PROCEDURE FindOrInsertAttributeValue@301480006(pItemAttribute@301480004 : Record 7500;pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 7504;VAR vItemAttributeValue@301480002 : Record 7501);
    VAR

    [External]
    PROCEDURE InsertOrModifyAttributeValueMapping@301480003(pItemAttribute@301480004 : Record 7500;pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 7504;pItemAttributeValue@301480002 : Record 7501);
    VAR
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480003 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Item No.");
      CASE pItemAttribute."Category Type" OF
        pItemAttribute."Category Type"::Item:
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::Item);
        pItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Item Variant":
          BEGIN
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Item Variant");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Variant Code");
          END;
        pItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Serial No.":
          BEGIN
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Serial No. Information");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Variant Code");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Serial No.");
          END;
      END;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Attribute ID");

      IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" := pItemAttributeValue.ID;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.MODIFY;

        // 01 21.03.19 MJAN CHR-375 Nicht mehr benîtigte Attributswerte lîschen nach énderung oder Lîschung des Mappings
        IF gRemoveUnusedArbitraryValues THEN
          pItemAttribute.RemoveUnusedArbitraryValues;
        // 01 21.03.19 MJAN CHR-375 Nicht mehr benîtigte Attributswerte lîschen nach énderung oder Lîschung des Mappings ENDE

      END ELSE BEGIN
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.INIT;
        CASE pItemAttribute."Category Type" OF
          pItemAttribute."Category Type"::Item:
            lItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID" := DATABASE::Item;
          pItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Item Variant":
            lItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID" := DATABASE::"Item Variant";
          pItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Serial No.":
            lItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID" := DATABASE::"Serial No. Information";
        END;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."No." := pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Item No.";
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code" := pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Variant Code";
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No." := pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Serial No.";
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" := pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Attribute ID";
        lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" := pItemAttributeValue.ID;
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.INSERT;
      END;
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE DeleteAttributeValueMapping@301480007(pItemAttribute@301480004 : Record 7500;pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 7504);
    VAR
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480003 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Item No.");
      CASE pItemAttribute."Category Type" OF
        pItemAttribute."Category Type"::Item:
          lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::Item);
        pItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Item Variant":
          BEGIN
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Item Variant");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Variant Code");
          END;
        pItemAttribute."Category Type"::"Serial No.":
          BEGIN
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Serial No. Information");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Variant Code");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Serial No.");
          END;
      END;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",pTEMPItemAttributeValueSelection."Attribute ID");

      // 01 21.03.19 MJAN CHR-375 Nicht mehr benîtigte Attributswerte lîschen nach énderung oder Lîschung des Mappings
      //IF NOT lItemAttributeValueMapping.ISEMPTY THEN
      //  lItemAttributeValueMapping.DELETEALL;
      IF NOT lItemAttributeValueMapping.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.DELETEALL;
        IF gRemoveUnusedArbitraryValues THEN

    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE AttributeValueFormatAsXML@301480058(pAttributeID@301480000 : Decimal;VAR vValue@301480001 : Text[250]);
    VAR
      lItemAttribute@301480002 : Record 7500;
      lDummyDate@301480003 : Date;
      lDummyDateTime@301480004 : DateTime;
    BEGIN
      IF lItemAttribute.GET(pAttributeID) THEN
        IF lItemAttribute.Type = lItemAttribute.Type::Text THEN
          CASE lItemAttribute."Format As" OF
            lItemAttribute."Format As"::Date:
              IF NOT EVALUATE(lDummyDate,vValue,9) THEN BEGIN
                EVALUATE(lDummyDate,vValue);
                vValue := FORMAT(lDummyDate,0,9);
              END;
            lItemAttribute."Format As"::DateTime:
              IF NOT EVALUATE(lDummyDateTime,vValue,9) THEN BEGIN
                EVALUATE(lDummyDateTime,vValue);
                vValue := FORMAT(lDummyDateTime,0,9);
              END;
          END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE AttributeValueFormatFromXML@301480004(pAttributeID@301480000 : Decimal;VAR vValue@301480001 : Text[250]);
    VAR
      lItemAttribute@301480002 : Record 7500;
      lDummyDate@301480003 : Date;
      lDummyDateTime@301480004 : DateTime;
    BEGIN
      IF lItemAttribute.GET(pAttributeID) THEN
        IF lItemAttribute.Type = lItemAttribute.Type::Text THEN
          CASE lItemAttribute."Format As" OF
            lItemAttribute."Format As"::Date:
              IF EVALUATE(lDummyDate,vValue,9) THEN
                vValue := FORMAT(lDummyDate);
            lItemAttribute."Format As"::DateTime:
              IF EVALUATE(lDummyDateTime,vValue,9) THEN
                vValue := FORMAT(lDummyDateTime);
          END;
    END;
