    LOCAL PROCEDURE ValidateBrand_OnBeforceModifyEvent_T7505@301490012(VAR Rec@301490000 : Record 7505;VAR xRec@301490001 : Record 7505;RunTrigger@301490002 : Boolean);
    VAR
      lCustomerSetup@301490003 : Record 87000;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301490005 : Record 7505;
      lItemAttributeValue@301490010 : Record 7501;
      lSetupGet@301490004 : Codeunit 5105007;
      lModelValueId@301490009 : Integer;
      lBrandValueID@301490008 : Integer;
      lModelValue@301490007 : Text;
      lIsUpdateAllowed@301490006 : Boolean;
      lModelNotInBrandError@301490011 : TextConst 'DEU=Die Marke ''%1'' gehîrt nicht zum Model ''%2''.;ENU=The Brand ''%1'' does not belong to Model ''%2''.';
      lBrandValue@301490012 : Text;
      lBrandNotInModellError@301480000 : TextConst 'DEU=Das Modell ''%1'' gehîrt nicht zur Marke ''%2''.;ENU=The modell ''%1'' does not belong to brand ''%2''.';
      lEmptyBrand@301490013 : TextConst 'DEU=Die Marke muss gefÅllt sein;ENU=The brand must be filled';
    BEGIN
      // 01 27.05.19 LACK CHR-548 Kleiner Fix
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      lSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(lCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      Rec.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");

      CASE Rec."Item Attribute ID" OF
        lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute":
          BEGIN
            lBrandValueID := Rec."Item Attribute Value ID";
            lBrandValue := Rec."Item Attribute Value Text";
            //Modell finden
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",27);
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",Rec."No.");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Model Attribute");
            IF NOT lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN
              EXIT;

            lModelValueId := lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID";
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
            lModelValue := lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text";
            IF lModelValue = '' THEN
              EXIT;

            IF (lModelValue <> '') AND (lBrandValue = '') THEN
              ERROR(lEmptyBrand);

            lItemAttributeValue.RESET;
            lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Parent Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute");
            lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Parent ID",lBrandValueID);
            lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(ID,lModelValueId);
            IF lItemAttributeValue.FINDSET THEN REPEAT // Alle mîglichen Modelle der Marke
              IF UPPERCASE(lItemAttributeValue.Value) = UPPERCASE(lModelValue) THEN
                lIsUpdateAllowed := TRUE;
            UNTIL lItemAttributeValue.NEXT = 0;

            IF NOT lIsUpdateAllowed THEN;
              //ERROR(lModelNotInBrandError,FORMAT(lBrandValue),lModelValue);
          END;
        lCustomerSetup."Model Attribute":
          BEGIN
            lModelValueId := Rec."Item Attribute Value ID";
            lModelValue := Rec."Item Attribute Value Text";
            IF lModelValue = '' THEN
              EXIT;
            //Brand finden
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",27);
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",Rec."No.");
            lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute");
            // Wenn noch nicht gefunden also zugeordnet darf ebenfalls kein Modell gesetzt werden
            IF NOT lItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN
              ERROR(lEmptyBrand);

            lItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");

            lBrandValueID := lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID";
            lBrandValue := lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text";

            IF lBrandValue = '' THEN
              ERROR(lEmptyBrand);

            lItemAttributeValue.RESET;
            lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Parent Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute");
            lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Parent ID",lBrandValueID);
            IF lItemAttributeValue.FINDSET THEN REPEAT // Alle mîglichen Modelle der Marke
              IF UPPERCASE(lItemAttributeValue.Value) = UPPERCASE(lModelValue) THEN
                lIsUpdateAllowed := TRUE;
            UNTIL lItemAttributeValue.NEXT = 0;

            IF NOT lIsUpdateAllowed THEN;
              // 01 29.07.19 MBLA CHR-548 Bei Fehlermeldung erscheint immer "Marke passt nicht zu Modell"
              //ERROR(lModelNotInBrandError,lModelValue,lBrandValue);
              //ERROR(lBrandNotInModellError,lModelValue,lBrandValue);
              // 01 29.07.19 MBLA CHR-548 Bei Fehlermeldung erscheint immer "Marke passt nicht zu Modell" ENDE
          END;
        ELSE
          EXIT;

      END;

      // 01 27.05.19 LACK CHR-548 Kleiner Fix Ende
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ValidateModel@301490040(VAR vItemAttributeValueSelection@301490000 : Record 7504);
    VAR
      lCustomerSetup@301490007 : Record 87000;
      lSetupGet@301490006 : Codeunit 5105007;
      lItemAttributeValue@301490005 : Record 7501;
      lBrandValueId@301490004 : Integer;
      lBrandValue@301490003 : Text;
      lModelValue@301490002 : Text;
      lIsUpdateAllowed@301490001 : Boolean;
      lModelNotInBrandError@301490008 : TextConst 'DEU=Das Modell ''%1'' gehîrt nicht zur Marke ''%2''.;ENU=The model ''%1'' does not belong to brand ''%2''.';
      lItemAttributeValueSelectionTemp@301490009 : TEMPORARY Record 7504;
    BEGIN
      // LF 23.05.19 MKLR CHR-548 ValidateModel
      lSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(lCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      IF NOT (vItemAttributeValueSelection."Attribute ID" = lCustomerSetup."Model Attribute") THEN
        EXIT;

      IF (vItemAttributeValueSelection.Value <> '') THEN
        lModelValue := vItemAttributeValueSelection.Value
      ELSE
        EXIT;

      vItemAttributeValueSelection.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute");
      IF vItemAttributeValueSelection.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        IF (vItemAttributeValueSelection.Value = '') THEN // Keine Marke = Alle Modelle
          EXIT;
        lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute");
        lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE(Value,vItemAttributeValueSelection.Value);
        IF lItemAttributeValue.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          lBrandValueId := lItemAttributeValue.ID; // Werte-ID der Marke ermitteln
          lBrandValue := lItemAttributeValue.Value; // Name der Marke
        END;
        lItemAttributeValue.RESET;
        lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Parent Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Brand Attribute");
        lItemAttributeValue.SETRANGE("Parent ID",lBrandValueId);
        IF lItemAttributeValue.FINDSET THEN REPEAT // Alle mîglichen Modelle der Marke
          IF UPPERCASE(lItemAttributeValue.Value) = UPPERCASE(lModelValue) THEN
            lIsUpdateAllowed := TRUE;
        UNTIL lItemAttributeValue.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      vItemAttributeValueSelection.SETRANGE("Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Model Attribute");
      vItemAttributeValueSelection.FINDFIRST;
      vItemAttributeValueSelection.Value := lModelValue;
      vItemAttributeValueSelection.SETRANGE("Attribute ID");

      IF NOT lIsUpdateAllowed THEN
        ERROR(lModelNotInBrandError,lModelValue,lBrandValue);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ClearFieldRef@301490014(VAR vFieldRef@301490000 : FieldRef);
    BEGIN
      // LF 23.05.19 MKLE CHR-548 ClearFieldRef
      CASE FORMAT(vFieldRef.TYPE) OF
        'Text' : vFieldRef.VALUE := '';
        'Integer' : vFieldRef.VALUE := 0;
        'Decimal' : vFieldRef.VALUE := 0;
        'Date' : vFieldRef.VALUE := 0D;
        'Code' : vFieldRef.VALUE := '';
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ClearAttributeFromItemAttributeCollection@301480003(pItemAttributeValueMapping@301490000 : Record 7505);
    VAR
      lItemAttributeCollection@301490001 : Record 85011;
      lDataTypeManagement@301490002 : Codeunit 701;
      lRecRef@301490003 : RecordRef;
      lFieldRef@301490004 : FieldRef;
    BEGIN
      // GF 23.05.19 MKLE CHR-548 ClearAttributeFromItemAttributeCollection
      IF (pItemAttributeValueMapping."No." = '') OR
         (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" = 0) THEN
           EXIT;

      CASE pItemAttributeValueMapping."Table ID" OF
        DATABASE::Item : BEGIN
          lItemAttributeCollection.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemAttributeValueMapping."No.");
          IF lItemAttributeCollection.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
            IF lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRefAndFieldRef(lItemAttributeCollection,pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID",
              lRecRef,lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
                ClearFieldRef(lFieldRef);
                lRecRef.MODIFY;
            END;
          UNTIL lItemAttributeCollection.NEXT = 0;
        END;
        DATABASE::"Item Variant" : BEGIN
          IF (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code" <> '') THEN
            IF lItemAttributeCollection.GET(pItemAttributeValueMapping."No.",pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code") THEN
              IF lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRefAndFieldRef(lItemAttributeCollection,pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID",
                lRecRef,lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
                  ClearFieldRef(lFieldRef);
                  lRecRef.MODIFY;
              END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE DeleteItemAttributeCollection@301490004(pItemVariant@301490000 : Record 5401);
    VAR
      lItemAttributeCollection@301490001 : Record 85011;
    BEGIN
      // GF 20.05.19 MKLE CHR-548 DeleteItemAttributeCollection
      IF lItemAttributeCollection.GET(pItemVariant."Item No.",pItemVariant.Code) THEN
        lItemAttributeCollection.DELETE;
    END;

    VAR
      ItemVariant@301490000 : Record 5401;

      lSaveDateTime@301490003 : DateTime;
      lTotalCount@301490004 : Integer;

    BEGIN
      // LF 01.04.19 MBLA CHR-248 Erweiterte Artikelsuche ist nicht nutzbar aufgrund mangelnder Performance:<InitItemAttributeCollection>
      ItemVariant.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      lTotalCount := ItemVariant.COUNT;
      IF ItemVariant.FINDSET THEN
        BEGIN

          IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
            lDialog.OPEN(DialogTxt);
            lSaveDateTime := CREATEDATETIME(TODAY,TIME);
          END;

          REPEAT
            lCounter += 1;

            //UpdateOrModifyItemAttributeCollection(ItemVariant);
            InsertOrModifyItemAttributeCollection(ItemVariant);

            IF (GUIALLOWED) AND (ABS(CREATEDATETIME(TODAY,TIME) - lSaveDateTime) > 999) THEN
              BEGIN
                lSaveDateTime := CREATEDATETIME(TODAY,TIME);
                lDialog.UPDATE(1,FORMAT(lCounter) +' / '+ FORMAT(lTotalCount));
                lDialog.UPDATE(2,ROUND(lCounter/lTotalCount * 9999.99,1));
              END;
            // 01 28.02.20 LACK MSD-11069 Fertigstellung Artikel-Anlage
            COMMIT;
            // 01 28.02.20 LACK MSD-11069 Fertigstellung Artikel-Anlage Ende
          UNTIL ItemVariant.NEXT = 0;

          IF GUIALLOWED THEN
            lDialog.CLOSE;
        END;
    END;

              vSalesHeader."Ship-to Code" := CheckOrInsertShipToAddress(vSalesHeader,lShowcaseSetup,ShiptoAddress);
              vSalesHeader.VALIDATE("Ship-to Code");
              // 01 02.08.19 MJAN CHR-721 Buchungsgruppen (wegen MwSt.) aus Lieferadresse ENDE

            //END;
            END ELSE
              ERROR(gText_Error_NoShipToAddressForShowcaseCustomer,lShowcaseSetup."Dummy Customer No.");

            vSalesHeader.VALIDATE("Ship-to Code",'');
            // 01 02.08.19 MJAN CHR-721 Buchungsgruppen (wegen MwSt.) aus Lieferadresse ENDE

            gSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(gCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
            gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Mail Order Location Code");
            vSalesHeader.VALIDATE("Payment Method Code",'');
            vSalesHeader.VALIDATE("Location Code",gCustomerSetup."Mail Order Location Code");
            vSalesHeader."Status Address Check" := vSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"Not Started";

    [External]
    PROCEDURE LookupAvailableItemsSerialNo@301480003(pSalesLine@301480000 : Record 37) : Code[20];
    VAR
      lItemLedgerEntry@301480001 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      GetAndCheckSalesHeader(pSalesLine);

      lItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.",Open,"Variant Code",Positive,"Location Code","Posting Date","Duty Sign");
      lItemLedgerEntry.FILTERGROUP(99);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Serial No.",'<>%1','');
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",gSalesHeader."Location Code");
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0.0);
      lItemLedgerEntry.FILTERGROUP(0);
      IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,lItemLedgerEntry,lItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.") = ACTION::LookupOK THEN
        EXIT(lItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE InsertSalesLineBySerialNo@301480000(pSalesLine@301480000 : Record 37;VAR vSerialNo@301480001 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      lItemLedgerEntry@301480002 : Record 32;
      lSalesLine@301480003 : Record 37;
      lLogisticMgtShptChronext@301480005 : Codeunit 85201;
      lSerialNo@301480007 : Code[20];
      lNextLineNo@301480004 : Integer;
      lItemLederEntryFound@301480009 : Boolean;
      lText_SNNotAvailable@301480006 : TextConst 'DEU=SKU mit Seriennummer %1 ist am Standort %2 nicht verfÅgbar!;ENU=SKU with SN %1 not available at location %2!';
    BEGIN
      IF vSerialNo = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      GetAndCheckSalesHeader(pSalesLine);

      lItemLederEntryFound := FALSE;
      lItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.");
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",vSerialNo);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",gSalesHeader."Location Code");
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0.0);
      IF NOT lItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        lItemLedgerEntry.FINDFIRST;
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1',lItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        IF lItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",lItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
          lItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Variant Code",'<>%1',lItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
          IF lItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            lItemLederEntryFound := TRUE;
          END;
        END;
      END;

      IF lItemLederEntryFound THEN BEGIN
        lSalesLine.RESET;
        lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",gSalesHeader."Document Type");
        lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",gSalesHeader."No.");
        IF lSalesLine.FINDLAST THEN
          lNextLineNo := lSalesLine."Line No." + 10000
        ELSE
          lNextLineNo := 10000;
        lSalesLine.INIT;
        lSalesLine.SetSkipReserve(TRUE);
        lSalesLine.SetHideValidationDialog_(TRUE);
        lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Document Type",gSalesHeader."Document Type");
        lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",gSalesHeader."No.");
        lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Line No.",lNextLineNo);
        lSalesLine.INSERT(TRUE);
        lSalesLine.VALIDATE(Type,lSalesLine.Type::Item);
        lSalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",lItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        lSalesLine.VALIDATE("Variant Code",lItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
        lSalesLine.TESTFIELD("Location Code",gSalesHeader."Location Code");
        lSalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,1.0);
        lSalesLine.MODIFY(TRUE);
        InsertReservationEntriesForItemLedgerEntryAndSalesLine(lItemLedgerEntry,lSalesLine);
        lLogisticMgtShptChronext.CreateBoxSupplementSalesLine(gSalesHeader);
        vSerialNo := '';
      END ELSE
        MESSAGE(lText_SNNotAvailable,vSerialNo,gSalesHeader."Location Code");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetAndCheckSalesHeader@301480004(pSalesLine@301480000 : Record 37);
    VAR
      lShowcaseSetup@301480001 : Record 85050;
    BEGIN
      pSalesLine.TESTFIELD("Document No.");
      gSalesHeader.GET(pSalesLine."Document Type",pSalesLine."Document No.");
      // 01 27.11.18 CZIE CHR-135 Vitrinen einrichtbar
      //gSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(gCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      gSalesHeader.TESTFIELD("Showcase Code");
      lShowcaseSetup.GET(gSalesHeader."Showcase Code");

      CASE gSalesHeader."Order Type" OF
        gSalesHeader."Order Type"::Showcase:
          BEGIN
            // 01 27.11.18 CZIE CHR-135 Vitrinen einrichtbar
            //gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Location Code Showcase London");
            //gSalesHeader.TESTFIELD("Location Code",gCustomerSetup."Location Code Showcase London");
            lShowcaseSetup.TESTFIELD("Location Code");
            gSalesHeader.TESTFIELD("Location Code",lShowcaseSetup."Location Code");
            // 01 27.11.18 CZIE CHR-135 Vitrinen einrichtbar ENDE
          END;
        ELSE
          BEGIN
            gSalesHeader.TESTFIELD("Location Code");
          END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetShowcaseCode@301480006(VAR vSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36;VAR vShowcaseSetup@301480001 : Record 85050);
    BEGIN
      // NF 27.11.18 CZIE CHR-135 SelectShowCaseCode
      IF vShowcaseSetup.GET(vSalesHeader."Showcase Code") THEN
       EXIT;

      vShowcaseSetup.TESTFIELD("Payment Method Code");
      vShowcaseSetup.TESTFIELD("Shipping Agent Code");
      vShowcaseSetup.TESTFIELD("Location Code");

      vSalesHeader."Showcase Code" := vShowcaseSetup.Code;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckOrInsertShipToAddress@301480018(pSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36;pShowcaseSetup@301480008 : Record 85050;pShiptoAddressShowcase@301480007 : Record 222) : Code[10];
    VAR
      lShiptoAddress@301480001 : Record 222;
      lShiptoAddress2@301480002 : Record 222;
      lNoOfAddresses@301480003 : Integer;
      lInsertAddress@301480004 : Boolean;
      lAddressModified@301480005 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // LF 02.08.19 MJAN CHR-721 CheckOrInsertShipToAddress
      pSalesHeader.TESTFIELD("Sell-to Customer No.");
      lInsertAddress := FALSE;
      lShiptoAddress.RESET;
      lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("Customer No.",pSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE(Name,pShiptoAddressShowcase.Name);
      lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("Name 2",pShiptoAddressShowcase."Name 2");
      lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE(Address,pShiptoAddressShowcase.Address);
      lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("Address 2",pShiptoAddressShowcase."Address 2");
      lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("Post Code",pShiptoAddressShowcase."Post Code");
      lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("Country/Region Code",pShiptoAddressShowcase."Country/Region Code");

      IF lShiptoAddress.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        //PrÅfen, ob Lieferadresse statt mit Adresse mit Stra·e und Hausnummer gefunden wird
        lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE(Address);
        lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE(Street,pShiptoAddressShowcase.Street);
        lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("House No.",pShiptoAddressShowcase."House No.");
        lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("House No. Adding",pShiptoAddressShowcase."House No. Adding");
        IF lShiptoAddress.ISEMPTY THEN
          //Nicht vorhandene Lieferadresse anlegen
          lInsertAddress := TRUE;
      END;

      //Lieferadresse anlegen
      IF lInsertAddress THEN BEGIN
        lShiptoAddress.RESET;
        lShiptoAddress.SETRANGE("Customer No.",pSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
        lShiptoAddress.SETFILTER(Code,'V*');
        lNoOfAddresses := lShiptoAddress.COUNT;
        lShiptoAddress.INIT;
        lShiptoAddress := pShiptoAddressShowcase;
        lShiptoAddress."Customer No." := pSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.";
        IF lNoOfAddresses > 0 THEN BEGIN
          CASE TRUE OF
            lNoOfAddresses < 10:
              lShiptoAddress.Code := 'V00' + FORMAT(lNoOfAddresses);
            lNoOfAddresses < 100:
              lShiptoAddress.Code := 'V0' + FORMAT(lNoOfAddresses);
            ELSE
              lShiptoAddress.Code := 'V' + FORMAT(lNoOfAddresses);
          END;
          REPEAT
            lShiptoAddress.Code := INCSTR(lShiptoAddress.Code);
          UNTIL NOT lShiptoAddress2.GET(lShiptoAddress."Customer No.",lShiptoAddress.Code);
        END ELSE
          lShiptoAddress.Code := 'V001';
        lShiptoAddress."Location Code" := pShowcaseSetup."Location Code";
        lShiptoAddress."Shipping Agent Code" := pShowcaseSetup."Shipping Agent Code";
        lShiptoAddress."Last Date Modified" := TODAY;
        lShiptoAddress.INSERT;
      END ELSE
        lShiptoAddress.FINDFIRST;

      IF lShiptoAddress."Location Code" <> pShowcaseSetup."Location Code" THEN BEGIN
        lShiptoAddress."Location Code" := pShowcaseSetup."Location Code";
        lAddressModified := TRUE;
      END;
      IF lShiptoAddress."Shipping Agent Code" <> pShowcaseSetup."Shipping Agent Code" THEN BEGIN
        lShiptoAddress."Shipping Agent Code" := pShowcaseSetup."Shipping Agent Code";
        lAddressModified := TRUE;
      END;

      IF lAddressModified THEN BEGIN
        lShiptoAddress."Last Date Modified" := TODAY;
        lShiptoAddress.MODIFY;
      END;

      EXIT(lShiptoAddress.Code);
      // LF 02.08.19 MJAN CHR-721 CheckOrInsertShipToAddress ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckFieldChange@301480015(pSalesheader@301480000 : Record 36;pxrecSalesHeader@301480001 : Record 36;pCurrFieldNo@301480002 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      // LF 02.08.19 MJAN CHR-721 CheckFieldChange
      IF pSalesheader."Order Type" = pSalesheader."Order Type"::Showcase THEN BEGIN
        CASE pCurrFieldNo OF
          pSalesheader.FIELDNO("Ship-to Code"):
            IF (pSalesheader."Ship-to Code" <> pxrecSalesHeader."Ship-to Code") THEN
              ERROR(gText_Error_ChangeFieldNotAllowed,pSalesheader.FIELDCAPTION("Ship-to Code"));
          pSalesheader.FIELDNO("Location Code"):
            IF (pSalesheader."Location Code" <> pxrecSalesHeader."Location Code") THEN
              ERROR(gText_Error_ChangeFieldNotAllowed,pSalesheader.FIELDCAPTION("Location Code"));
          pSalesheader.FIELDNO("Shipping Agent Code"):
            IF (pSalesheader."Shipping Agent Code" <> pxrecSalesHeader."Shipping Agent Code") THEN
              ERROR(gText_Error_ChangeFieldNotAllowed,pSalesheader.FIELDCAPTION("Shipping Agent Code"));
          pSalesheader.FIELDNO("Pickup Location Code"):
            IF (pSalesheader."Pickup Location Code" <> pxrecSalesHeader."Pickup Location Code") THEN
              ERROR(gText_Error_ChangeFieldNotAllowed,pSalesheader.FIELDCAPTION("Pickup Location Code"));
        END;
      END;
      // LF 02.08.19 MJAN CHR-721 CheckFieldChange ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckAndInsertEntry@301480000();
    VAR
      lItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;
    BEGIN
      // PrÅfen, ob ein nicht verarbeiteter Eintrag vorhanden, ansonsten anlegen
      IF (gItemNo = '') OR (gLocationCode = '') THEN
        EXIT;

      lItemMatchProcessEntry.RESET;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Processed,"Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code");
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE(Processed,lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed::" ");
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",gLocationCode);
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",gItemNo);
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",gVariantCode);
      IF lItemMatchProcessEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
        InsertEntry;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ForceInsertEntry@301480002();
    VAR
      lItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry2@301480001 : Record 85100;
    BEGIN
      // Vorhandene nicht verarbeitete EintrÑge schlie·en und einen neuen anlegen
      IF (gItemNo = '') OR (gLocationCode = '') THEN
        EXIT;

      lItemMatchProcessEntry.RESET;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Processed,"Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code");
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE(Processed,lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed::" ");
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",gLocationCode);
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",gItemNo);
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",gVariantCode);
      IF lItemMatchProcessEntry.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          lItemMatchProcessEntry2.GET(lItemMatchProcessEntry."Entry No.");
          lItemMatchProcessEntry2.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed::Cancelled);
          lItemMatchProcessEntry2.MODIFY;
        UNTIL lItemMatchProcessEntry.NEXT = 0;
      InsertEntry;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertEntry@301480001();
    VAR
      lItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;
    BEGIN
      // Neuen Eintrag anlegen
      IF (gItemNo = '') OR (gLocationCode = '') THEN
        EXIT;

      lItemMatchProcessEntry.INIT;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Entry No." := FindLastEntryNo + 1;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No." := gItemNo;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code" := gVariantCode;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code" := gLocationCode;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type := lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type::" ";
      CASE gSourceType OF
        DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry":
          IF gQuantity > 0 THEN // Zugang aus Artikelposten
            lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type := lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type::Offer;
        DATABASE::"Sales Line":
          IF (gSourceSubtype = gSourceSubtype::"1") AND (gQuantity > 0) THEN // positive VK-Auftragszeile
            lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type := lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type::Demand;
      END;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Source Type" := gSourceType;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Source Subtype" := gSourceSubtype;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Source ID" := gSourceID;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry."Source Ref. No." := gSourceRefNo;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed := lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed::" ";
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindLastEntryNo@301480017() : BigInteger;
    VAR
      lItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;
    BEGIN
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.RESET;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.LOCKTABLE;
      IF lItemMatchProcessEntry.FINDLAST THEN
        EXIT(lItemMatchProcessEntry."Entry No.");
      EXIT(0);
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE TestLocationCodeInFilter@301480007(pLocationCode@301480001 : Code[10]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lLocation@301480000 : Record 14;
    BEGIN
      IF pLocationCode = '' THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      GetCustomerSetup;
      gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Item Match LocationCode Filter");

      lLocation.RESET;
      lLocation.FILTERGROUP(98);
      lLocation.SETFILTER(Code,gCustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter");
      lLocation.FILTERGROUP(99);
      lLocation.SETRANGE(Code,pLocationCode);
      lLocation.FILTERGROUP(0);
      EXIT(NOT lLocation.ISEMPTY);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetCustomerSetup@301480005();
    BEGIN
      IF NOT gCustomerSetupRead THEN BEGIN
        gSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(gCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
        gCustomerSetupRead := TRUE;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 11.09.18 MJAN CHR-49 Objekt erstellt
    }
    END.
  }
}

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckForNewEntries@301480000();
    VAR
      lItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry2@301480001 : Record 85100;
      lTEMPItemMatchOffer@301480002 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;
      lTEMPItemMatchDemand@301480003 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;
      lDoMatching@301480004 : Boolean;
      lItemMatchProcessed@301480005 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT gTEMPItemMatchProcessEntry.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        ERROR(gText_Error_TempTableNotTemporary);
      gTEMPItemMatchProcessEntry.DELETEALL;

      // PrÅfen, ob nicht verarbeitete EintrÑge vorhanden sind
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.RESET;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.RESET;
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Processed,"Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code");
      lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE(Processed,lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed::" ");
      IF gLocationCode <> '' THEN
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",gLocationCode)
      ELSE
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",'<>%1','');
      IF gItemNo <> '' THEN
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",gItemNo)
      ELSE
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','');
      IF gVariantCode <> '' THEN
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",gVariantCode);
      //  lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",gVariantCode)
      //ELSE
      //  lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETFILTER("Variant Code",'<>%1','');

      gSourceType := 0; // Nicht auf einzelne VorgÑnge abfiltern, es muss immer alles gematcht werden
      IF gSourceType <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",gSourceType);
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",gSourceSubtype);
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Source ID",gSourceID);
        lItemMatchProcessEntry.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.",gSourceRefNo);
      END;

      IF lItemMatchProcessEntry.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        // In TemporÑre DatensÑtze schreiben, um damit in Codeunit 85102 das Fehlerprotokoll schreiben zu kînnen
        REPEAT
          gTEMPItemMatchProcessEntry.INIT;
          gTEMPItemMatchProcessEntry := lItemMatchProcessEntry;
          gTEMPItemMatchProcessEntry.INSERT;
        UNTIL lItemMatchProcessEntry.NEXT = 0;

        lItemMatchProcessEntry.FINDSET;
        REPEAT
          lDoMatching := FALSE;
          lItemMatchProcessed := FALSE;
          IF gCHNXItemMatchProcessEntryMgt.TestLocationCodeInFilter(lItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code") THEN BEGIN
            // Matching Tabelle vorbereiten
            PrepareItemMatchEntries(lItemMatchProcessEntry,lTEMPItemMatchOffer,lTEMPItemMatchDemand);

            IF lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type = lItemMatchProcessEntry.Type::Demand THEN BEGIN
              // Zuerst Angebot fÅllen, dann Bedarf (wenn es bei Verarbeitung von Bedarf kein Angebot gibt, muss nicht unnîtig gesucht werden)
              // Matching Tabelle mit Angebot fÅllen
              IF FillItemMatchOfferEntries(lItemMatchProcessEntry,lTEMPItemMatchOffer) THEN
                // Matching Tabelle mit Bedarf fÅllen
                IF FillItemMatchDemandEntries(lItemMatchProcessEntry,lTEMPItemMatchDemand) THEN
                  lDoMatching := TRUE;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              // Zuerst Bedarf fÅllen, dann Angebot (wenn es bei Verarbeitung von Angebot kein Bedarf gibt, muss nicht unnîtig gesucht werden)
              // Matching Tabelle mit Bedarf fÅllen
              IF FillItemMatchDemandEntries(lItemMatchProcessEntry,lTEMPItemMatchDemand) THEN
                // Matching Tabelle mit Angebot fÅllen
                IF FillItemMatchOfferEntries(lItemMatchProcessEntry,lTEMPItemMatchOffer) THEN
                  lDoMatching := TRUE;
            END;

            // Matching durchfÅhren
            IF lDoMatching THEN
              lItemMatchProcessed := ProcessItemMatchEntries(lItemMatchProcessEntry,lTEMPItemMatchOffer,lTEMPItemMatchDemand);

            // Eintrag als erledigt kennzeichnen
            lItemMatchProcessEntry2.GET(lItemMatchProcessEntry."Entry No.");
            IF lItemMatchProcessed THEN
              lItemMatchProcessEntry2.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed::Yes)
            ELSE
              lItemMatchProcessEntry2.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchProcessEntry.Processed::WithoutMatch);
            lItemMatchProcessEntry2.MODIFY;

            // EintrÑge spreichern
            SaveItemMatchEntries(lItemMatchProcessEntry,lTEMPItemMatchOffer,lTEMPItemMatchDemand);

            // Je Artikel/Varianten/Lagerort Kombination die Daten committen, um Sperren kurz zu halten
            COMMIT;
          END;
        UNTIL lItemMatchProcessEntry.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

      // Ggf. EintrÑge nicht lîschen, um besser kontrollieren zu kînnen

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillItemMatchOfferEntries@301480008(pItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;VAR vTEMPItemMatchOffer@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 85101) rEntryInserted : Boolean;
    VAR
      lTEMPItemMatchOffer1@301480002 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;
      lTEMPItemMatchOffer2@301480003 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301480004 : Record 32;
      lPurchaseHeader@301480005 : Record 38;
      lPurchaseLine@301480006 : Record 39;
      lEntryNo@301480007 : BigInteger;
    BEGIN
      rEntryInserted := FALSE;
      lItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.",Open,"Variant Code",Positive,"Location Code");
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      IF pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code" <> '' THEN
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0.0);
      IF lItemLedgerEntry.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
         // 01 28.09.21 VMO ERP-322 <<
         {
         lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
         IF (lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)" = 0) AND (lItemLedgerEntry.Commission = FALSE) THEN
            EXIT(FALSE);
         }
         // 01 28.09.21 VMO ERP-322 >>
        lEntryNo := FindLastEntryNo(vTEMPItemMatchOffer);
        REPEAT
          lEntryNo := lEntryNo + 1;
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer.INIT;
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Entry No." := lEntryNo;
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Type := vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Type::Offer;
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Type" := DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Subtype" := 0;
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source ID" := '';
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Ref. No." := lItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Item No." := lItemLedgerEntry."Item No.";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Variant Code" := lItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Location Code" := lItemLedgerEntry."Location Code";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation" := lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Full Taxation" := NOT vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Quantity := lItemLedgerEntry."Remaining Quantity";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Receipt Date" := lItemLedgerEntry."Posting Date";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Warranty Date" := GetWarrantyDateForILE(lItemLedgerEntry);
          SetDateSortingItemMatchOfferEntries(vTEMPItemMatchOffer);
          //vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Commission Trade" := ;
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Process Entry Entry No." := pItemMatchProcessEntry."Entry No.";
          vTEMPItemMatchOffer.INSERT;
          rEntryInserted:= TRUE;
          lTEMPItemMatchOffer1.INIT;
          lTEMPItemMatchOffer1 := vTEMPItemMatchOffer;
          lTEMPItemMatchOffer1.INSERT;
        UNTIL lItemLedgerEntry.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      // Ggf. EK-Bestellungen ermitteln ("bald" ankommende Ware)
      IF rEntryInserted THEN BEGIN
        GetCustomerSetup;
        gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Item Match ArrivingSoon Past");
        gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Item Match ArrivingSoon Future");
        lTEMPItemMatchOffer1.RESET;
        lTEMPItemMatchOffer1.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry");
        //lTEMPItemMatchOffer1.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation",FALSE);
        lTEMPItemMatchOffer1.FINDSET;
        REPEAT
          lPurchaseLine.RESET;
          lPurchaseLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type",Type,"No.","Variant Code","Drop Shipment","Location Code","Expected Receipt Date");
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",lPurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE(Type,lPurchaseLine.Type::Item);
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Item No.");
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Variant Code");
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Location Code");
          lPurchaseLine.SETFILTER("Outstanding Qty. (Base)",'<>%1',0);
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Expected Receipt Date",
             CALCDATE(gCustomerSetup."Item Match ArrivingSoon Past",WORKDATE),
             CALCDATE(gCustomerSetup."Item Match ArrivingSoon Future",WORKDATE));
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation",TRUE); // Nur EK-Bestellzeilen, welche als differenzbesteuert gekennzeichnet sind, vollbesteuerte VK AuftrÑge werden spÑter eh direkt gematcht
          IF lPurchaseLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              // EK-Bestellzeile nur einmal berÅcksichtigen
              IF (lPurchaseHeader."Document Type" <> lPurchaseLine."Document Type") OR
                 (lPurchaseHeader."No." <> lPurchaseLine."Document No.") THEN
                lPurchaseHeader.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type",lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
              // Nur freigegebene Bestellungen fÅr "bald" ankommende Ware berÅcksichtigen
              IF lPurchaseHeader.Status = lPurchaseHeader.Status::Released THEN BEGIN
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.RESET;
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Purchase Line");
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",lPurchaseLine."Document Type");
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.SETRANGE("Source ID",lPurchaseLine."Document No.");
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.SETRANGE("Source Ref. No.",lPurchaseLine."Line No.");
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.SETRANGE("Item No.",lPurchaseLine."No.");
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.SETRANGE("Variant Code",lPurchaseLine."Variant Code");
                lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.SETRANGE("Location Code",lPurchaseLine."Location Code");
                IF lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
                  lEntryNo := lEntryNo + 1;
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer.INIT;
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Entry No." := lEntryNo;
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Type := vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Type::Offer;
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Type" := DATABASE::"Purchase Line";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Subtype" := lPurchaseLine."Document Type";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source ID" := lPurchaseLine."Document No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Ref. No." := lPurchaseLine."Line No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Item No." := lPurchaseLine."No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Variant Code" := lPurchaseLine."Variant Code";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Location Code" := lPurchaseLine."Location Code";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation" := lPurchaseLine."Differential Taxation";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Full Taxation" := NOT vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Quantity := lPurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Receipt Date" := lPurchaseLine."Expected Receipt Date";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Warranty Date" := 0D;
                  SetDateSortingItemMatchOfferEntries(vTEMPItemMatchOffer);
                  //vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Commission Trade" := ;
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Process Entry Entry No." := pItemMatchProcessEntry."Entry No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchOffer.INSERT;
                  lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.RESET;
                  lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.INIT;
                  lTEMPItemMatchOffer2 := vTEMPItemMatchOffer;
                  lTEMPItemMatchOffer2.INSERT;
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
                // END;
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  // 01 02.07.19 MJAN CHR-703 Bugfix: Funktion lInsertIgnoredItemMatchOfferEntry muss mit temp. DatensÑtzen einfÅgen
                  //lInsertIgnoredItemMatchOfferEntry(lEntryNo,pItemMatchProcessEntry,lPurchaseHeader,lPurchaseLine,-1000);
                  lInsertIgnoredItemMatchOfferEntry(lEntryNo,vTEMPItemMatchOffer,pItemMatchProcessEntry,lPurchaseHeader,lPurchaseLine,-1000);
                  // 01 02.07.19 MJAN CHR-703 Bugfix: Funktion lInsertIgnoredItemMatchOfferEntry muss mit temp. DatensÑtzen einfÅgen ENDE
                END;
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf ENDE
              END;
            UNTIL lPurchaseLine.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        UNTIL lTEMPItemMatchOffer1.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      EXIT(rEntryInserted);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillItemMatchDemandEntries@301480009(pItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;VAR vTEMPItemMatchDemand@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 85101) rEntryInserted : Boolean;
    VAR
      lSalesHeader@301480002 : Record 36;
      lSalesLine@301480003 : Record 37;
      lTEMPSystemValueLine@301480004 : TEMPORARY Record 5105031;
      lEntryNo@301480005 : BigInteger;
    BEGIN
      rEntryInserted := FALSE;
      lSalesLine.RESET;
      lSalesLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type",Type,"No.","Variant Code");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",lSalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,lSalesLine.Type::Item);
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
      IF pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code" <> '' THEN
        lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0.0);
      // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Bedarf nur bei ausstehender Menge berÅcksichtigen
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Quantity (Base)",1.0);
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Outstanding Qty. (Base)",1.0);
      // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Bedarf nur bei ausstehender Menge berÅcksichtigen ENDE
      IF lSalesLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        GetCustomerSetup;
        gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Item Match PPCode Not Reserved");
        gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Item Match PPCode Start Match");
        lEntryNo := FindLastEntryNo(vTEMPItemMatchDemand);
        gSetupGet."Load SystemValueLines"(lTEMPSystemValueLine,5104800);
        REPEAT
          IF (lSalesHeader."Document Type" <> lSalesLine."Document Type") OR
             (lSalesHeader."No." <> lSalesLine."Document No.") THEN
            lSalesHeader.GET(lSalesLine."Document Type",lSalesLine."Document No.");
          // Auftrag nur berÅcksichtigen, wenn Status offen ist
          IF lSalesHeader.Status = lSalesHeader.Status::Open THEN BEGIN

            // 01 08.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Bei Start vom Matching auch Filter auf A-Selektionen berÅcksichtigen
            //// PrÅfen, ob der Auftrag wegen Aussteuerungsgrund "Nicht reserviert" ausgesteuert ist, nur dann berÅcksichtigen
            //IF CheckSalesHeaderOpenPostProcessingEntryExists(lSalesHeader,gCustomerSetup."Item Match PPCode Not Reserved") THEN BEGIN
            //  // PrÅfen, ob der Auftrag nur noch wegen zulÑssiger AussteuerungsgrÅnde ausgesteuert ist, nur dann berÅcksichtigen
            //  IF NOT CheckSalesHeaderOpenPostProcessingEntryExists(lSalesHeader,gCustomerSetup."Item Match PPCode Start Match") THEN BEGIN
            // PrÅfen, ob der Auftrag wegen Aussteuerungsgrund "Nicht reserviert" ausgesteuert ist, nur dann berÅcksichtigen
            IF CheckSalesHeaderOpenPostProcessingEntryExists(lSalesHeader,
                                                             gCustomerSetup."Item Match PPCode Not Reserved",
                                                             '') THEN BEGIN
              // PrÅfen, ob der Auftrag nur noch wegen zulÑssiger AussteuerungsgrÅnde ausgesteuert ist, nur dann berÅcksichtigen
              IF NOT CheckSalesHeaderOpenPostProcessingEntryExists(lSalesHeader,
                                                                   gCustomerSetup."Item Match PPCode Start Match",
                                                                   gCustomerSetup."ItemMatch PP O-Sel Start Match") THEN BEGIN
              // 01 08.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Bei Start vom Matching auch Filter auf A-Selektionen berÅcksichtigen
                // LF 11.11.18 CZIE CHR-49 Transaction Security Status berÅcksichtigen ApprovedByTransactionSecurity
                IF ApprovedByTransactionSecurity(lSalesHeader) THEN BEGIN
                // LF 11.11.18 CZIE CHR-49 Transaction Security Status berÅcksichtigen ApprovedByTransactionSecurity ENDE

                  lEntryNo := lEntryNo + 1;
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand.INIT;
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Entry No." := lEntryNo;
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Type := vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Type::Demand;
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Type" := DATABASE::"Sales Line";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Subtype" := lSalesLine."Document Type";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source ID" := lSalesLine."Document No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Ref. No." := lSalesLine."Line No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Item No." := lSalesLine."No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Variant Code" := lSalesLine."Variant Code";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Location Code" := lSalesLine."Location Code";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Differential Taxation" := lSalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Full Taxation" := NOT vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Differential Taxation";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Quantity := lSalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Order DateTime" := CREATEDATETIME(lSalesHeader."Order Date",lSalesHeader."Order Time");
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Promised Delivery Date" := lSalesLine."Promised Delivery Date";
                  IF (vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Promised Delivery Date" <> 0D) AND (vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Promised Delivery Date" <= WORKDATE) THEN
                    vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Prom Del. Date Sorting" := vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Promised Delivery Date"
                  ELSE
                    vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Prom Del. Date Sorting" := 31129999D;
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Priority" := lSalesLine.Priority;
                  IF lTEMPSystemValueLine.GET(5104800,vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Priority") THEN
                    vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Priority Sorting" := lTEMPSystemValueLine."Calc Value 1";
                  IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Priority Sorting" = 0 THEN
                    vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Priority Sorting" := 999999;
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Process Entry Entry No." := pItemMatchProcessEntry."Entry No.";
                  vTEMPItemMatchDemand.INSERT;
                  rEntryInserted := TRUE;
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
                // // LF 11.11.18 CZIE CHR-49 Transaction Security Status berÅcksichtigen ApprovedByTransactionSecurity
                // END;
                // // LF 11.11.18 CZIE CHR-49 Transaction Security Status berÅcksichtigen ApprovedByTransactionSecurity
                // Auftrag erfÅllt nicht TransactionSecurity
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  lInsertIgnoredItemMatchDemandEntry(lEntryNo,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,pItemMatchProcessEntry,lSalesHeader,lSalesLine,-40);
                END;
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf ENDE
              // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
              // END;
              // Auftrag hat noch andere AussteuerungsgrÅnde
              END ELSE BEGIN
                lInsertIgnoredItemMatchDemandEntry(lEntryNo,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,pItemMatchProcessEntry,lSalesHeader,lSalesLine,-30);
              END;
              // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf ENDE
            // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
            // END;
            // Auftrag hat nicht mind. einen der notwendigen AussteuerungsgrÅnde
            END ELSE BEGIN
              lInsertIgnoredItemMatchDemandEntry(lEntryNo,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,pItemMatchProcessEntry,lSalesHeader,lSalesLine,-20);
            END;
            // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf ENDE
          // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
          // END;
          // Auftrag nich offen
          END ELSE BEGIN
            lInsertIgnoredItemMatchDemandEntry(lEntryNo,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,pItemMatchProcessEntry,lSalesHeader,lSalesLine,-10);
          END;
          // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf ENDE
        UNTIL lSalesLine.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      EXIT(rEntryInserted);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetDateSortingItemMatchOfferEntries@301480007(VAR vTEMPItemMatchOffer@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 85101);
    BEGIN
      IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Warranty Date" = 0D THEN BEGIN
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Warranty Date Sorting" := 31129999D;
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Receipt Date Sorting" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Receipt Date";
      END ELSE BEGIN
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Warranty Date Sorting" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Warranty Date";
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Offer: Receipt Date Sorting" := 31129999D;
      END;
    END;

      // vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
      // vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
      // vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");
      // IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
      //  REPEAT
      //    lSorting += 1;
      //    vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Sorting Diff Taxation First" := lSorting;
      //    vTEMPItemMatchOffer.MODIFY;
      //  UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchOffer.NEXT = 0
      // END;
      //

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetSortingItemMatchDemandEntries@301480014(pItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;VAR vTEMPItemMatchDemand@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 85101);
    VAR
      lSorting@301480002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand.ISEMPTY THEN
        EXIT;

      // Sortierung fÅr "Differenzbesteuerung zuerst" setzen (Full = nein ergibt Diff = Ja, somit Diff = Ja zuerst in der Sortierreihenfolge)
      lSorting := 0;
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.RESET;
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETCURRENTKEY("Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code","Demand: Priority Sorting","Full Taxation","Demand: Prom Del. Date Sorting","Demand: Order DateTime");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");
      IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          lSorting += 1;
          vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Sorting Diff Taxation First" := lSorting;
          vTEMPItemMatchDemand.MODIFY;
        UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchDemand.NEXT = 0
      END;

      // Sortierung fÅr "Vollbesteuerung zuerst" setzen (Diff = nein ergibt Full = Ja, somit Full = Ja zuerst in der Sortierreihenfolge)
      lSorting := 0;
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.RESET;
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETCURRENTKEY("Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code","Demand: Priority Sorting","Differential Taxation","Demand: Prom Del. Date Sorting","Demand: Order DateTime");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");
      IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          lSorting += 1;
          vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Sorting Full Taxation First" := lSorting;
          vTEMPItemMatchDemand.MODIFY;
        UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchDemand.NEXT = 0
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessItemMatchEntries@301480010(pItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;VAR vTEMPItemMatchOffer@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;VAR vTEMPItemMatchDemand@301480002 : TEMPORARY Record 85101) rReservationEntriesInserted : Boolean;
    VAR
      lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon@301480003 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;
      lNoOfDemandEntries@301480004 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      rReservationEntriesInserted := FALSE;
      IF (NOT vTEMPItemMatchOffer.ISEMPTY) OR (NOT vTEMPItemMatchDemand.ISEMPTY) THEN BEGIN
        // Sortierung an Offer und Demand EintrÑgen setzen
        SetSortingItemMatchOfferEntries(pItemMatchProcessEntry,vTEMPItemMatchOffer);
        SetSortingItemMatchDemandEntries(pItemMatchProcessEntry,vTEMPItemMatchDemand);

        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.RESET;
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETCURRENTKEY("Sorting Diff Taxation First","Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code","Source Type");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Purchase Line"); // "bald" ankommende Angebote aus EK-Bestellzeilen
        IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.INIT;
            lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon := vTEMPItemMatchOffer;
            lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.INSERT;
          UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchOffer.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.RESET;
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETCURRENTKEY("Sorting Diff Taxation First","Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code","Source Type");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry"); // nur Angebote aus Artikelposten
        //vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE(Processed,FALSE);
        IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Processed = vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Processed::" " THEN BEGIN
              vTEMPItemMatchDemand.RESET;

              // 01 05.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Sortierung fÅr Warenbedarf auf vollbesteuert zuerst, wenn Warenangebot vollbesteuert ist
              IF NOT vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation" THEN
                vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETCURRENTKEY("Sorting Full Taxation First","Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code","Source Type")
              ELSE
              // 01 05.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Sortierung fÅr Warenbedarf auf vollbesteuert zuerst, wenn Warenangebot vollbesteuert ist ENDE

                vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETCURRENTKEY("Sorting Diff Taxation First","Location Code","Item No.","Variant Code","Source Type");
              vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Location Code",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Location Code");
              vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Item No.",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Item No.");
              vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Variant Code");
              // Differenzbesteuerung berÅcksichtigen (Wenn Angebot differenzbesteuert, dann muss bei Bedarf Verwendung differenzbesteuert mîglich sein)
              // VK Verwendung diff mîglich     EK diff eingekauft
              //        Nein                -->      Nein
              //         Ja                 -->      Nein oder Ja
              IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation" THEN
                vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation");
              IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
                REPEAT
                  IF (vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Processed = vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Processed::" ") AND (vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Processed = vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Processed::" ") THEN BEGIN
                    IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Differential Taxation" THEN BEGIN
                      // 1. Regel: EK differenzbesteuert --> Matching durchfÅhren
                      InsertReservationEntries(vTEMPItemMatchOffer,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,1);
                      rReservationEntriesInserted := TRUE;
                    END ELSE BEGIN
                      IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Demand: Promised Delivery Date" <= WORKDATE THEN BEGIN
                        // 2. Regel: EK nicht differenzbesteuert (=vollbesteuert) und VK zugesagtes Lieferdatum (CPDD) Åberschritten --> Matching durchfÅhren
                        InsertReservationEntries(vTEMPItemMatchOffer,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,2);
                        rReservationEntriesInserted := TRUE;
                      END ELSE BEGIN
                        IF NOT vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Differential Taxation" THEN BEGIN
                          // 3. Regel: EK nicht differenzbesteuert (=vollbesteuert) und bei VK Verwendung diff nicht mîglich --> Matching durchfÅhren
                          InsertReservationEntries(vTEMPItemMatchOffer,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,3);
                          rReservationEntriesInserted := TRUE;
                        END ELSE BEGIN
                          vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE(Processed,vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Processed::" ");
                          lNoOfDemandEntries := vTEMPItemMatchDemand.COUNT;
                          vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE(Processed);
                          IF lNoOfDemandEntries = 1 THEN BEGIN
                            // 4. Regel: EK nicht differenzbesteuert (=vollbesteuert) und nur noch ein VK Auftrag vorhanden --> Matching durchfÅhren
                            InsertReservationEntries(vTEMPItemMatchOffer,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,4);
                            rReservationEntriesInserted := TRUE;
                          END ELSE BEGIN
                            lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.RESET;
                            lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.SETCURRENTKEY("Sorting Diff Taxation First");
                            lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.SETRANGE(Processed,lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.Processed::" ");
                            IF lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
                              // 5. Regel: EK nicht differenzbesteuert (=vollbesteuert) und kein weiterer Artikel "bald" im Zulauf --> Matching durchfÅhren
                              InsertReservationEntries(vTEMPItemMatchOffer,vTEMPItemMatchDemand,5);
                              rReservationEntriesInserted := TRUE;
                            END ELSE BEGIN
                              // 6. Regel: EK nicht differenzbesteuert (=vollbesteuert) und weiterer Artikel "bald" im Zulauf --> Kein Matching durchfÅhren, "bald" ankommende EK-Bestellzeile als verwendet markieren
                              lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.FINDFIRST;
                              lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.Processed := lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.Processed::ArrivingSoon;
                              lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon."Matched To Entry No." := -vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Entry No.";
                              lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon."Applied Matching Rule" := 6;
                              lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.MODIFY;
                              vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Processed := vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Processed::ArrivingSoon;
                              vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Matched To Entry No." := -lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon."Entry No.";
                              vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Applied Matching Rule" := lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon."Applied Matching Rule";
                              vTEMPItemMatchDemand.MODIFY;
                            END;
                          END;
                        END;
                      END;
                    END;
                  END;
                UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchDemand.NEXT = 0;
              END;
            END;
          UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchOffer.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        // Verarbneitungszennzeichen fÅr "bald" ankommende EK-Bestellzeilen wegschreiben
        lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.RESET;
        IF lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            vTEMPItemMatchOffer.GET(lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon."Entry No.");
            vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Processed := lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.Processed;
            vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Matched To Entry No." := lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon."Matched To Entry No.";
            vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Applied Matching Rule" := lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon."Applied Matching Rule";
            vTEMPItemMatchOffer.MODIFY;
          UNTIL lTEMPItemMatchOfferArrivingSoon.NEXT = 0;
        END;

      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SaveItemMatchEntries@301480002(pItemMatchProcessEntry@301480000 : Record 85100;VAR vTEMPItemMatchOffer@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;VAR vTEMPItemMatchDemand@301480002 : TEMPORARY Record 85101);
    VAR
      lItemMatchOffer@301480003 : Record 85101;
      lItemMatchDemand@301480004 : Record 85101;
      lEntryNo@301480005 : BigInteger;
      lID@301480006 : BigInteger;
    BEGIN
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer.RESET;
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Location Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Location Code");
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Item No.");
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemMatchProcessEntry."Variant Code");

      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.RESET;
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Location Code",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Location Code");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Item No.",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Item No.");
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Variant Code");

      IF (NOT vTEMPItemMatchOffer.ISEMPTY) OR (NOT vTEMPItemMatchDemand.ISEMPTY) THEN BEGIN
        lEntryNo := FindLastEntryNo(lItemMatchOffer);
        lID := FindLastID(lItemMatchOffer) + 1;
        lItemMatchOffer.RESET;

        IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            lEntryNo := lEntryNo + 1;
            lItemMatchOffer.INIT;
            lItemMatchOffer := vTEMPItemMatchOffer;
            lItemMatchOffer."Entry No." := lEntryNo;
            lItemMatchOffer.ID := lID;
            CASE TRUE OF
              lItemMatchOffer."Matched To Entry No." < 0:
                lItemMatchOffer.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchOffer.Processed::ArrivingSoon);
              lItemMatchOffer."Matched To Entry No." > 0:
               lItemMatchOffer.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchOffer.Processed::Yes);
              ELSE
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
                IF lItemMatchOffer."Applied Matching Rule" < 0 THEN
                  lItemMatchOffer.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchOffer.Processed::Ignored)
                ELSE
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
                  lItemMatchOffer.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchOffer.Processed::WithoutMatch)
            END;
            lItemMatchOffer.INSERT(TRUE);

            // "Echte" Lfd. Nr. merken
            vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Temp. Entry No." := lItemMatchOffer."Entry No.";
            vTEMPItemMatchOffer.MODIFY;
          UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchOffer.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            lEntryNo := lEntryNo + 1;
            lItemMatchDemand.INIT;
            lItemMatchDemand := vTEMPItemMatchDemand;
            lItemMatchDemand."Entry No." := lEntryNo;
            lItemMatchDemand.ID := lID;
            CASE TRUE OF
              lItemMatchDemand."Matched To Entry No." < 0:
                lItemMatchDemand.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchDemand.Processed::ArrivingSoon);
              lItemMatchDemand."Matched To Entry No." > 0:
               lItemMatchDemand.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchDemand.Processed::Yes);
              ELSE
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
                IF lItemMatchDemand."Applied Matching Rule" < 0 THEN
                  lItemMatchDemand.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchDemand.Processed::Ignored)
                ELSE
                // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 Protokollierung nicht berÅcksichtiger Angebote/Bedarf
                  lItemMatchDemand.VALIDATE(Processed,lItemMatchDemand.Processed::WithoutMatch)
            END;
            IF lItemMatchDemand."Matched To Entry No." <> 0 THEN BEGIN
              // "Matched To Entry No." an Demand von Offer setzen
              vTEMPItemMatchOffer.GET(ABS(lItemMatchDemand."Matched To Entry No."));
              lItemMatchDemand."Matched To Entry No." := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Temp. Entry No.";
            END;
            lItemMatchDemand.INSERT(TRUE);

            // "Echte" Lfd. Nr. merken
            vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Temp. Entry No." := lItemMatchDemand."Entry No.";
            vTEMPItemMatchDemand.MODIFY;
          UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchDemand.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        // "Matched To Entry No." an Offer von Demand setzen
        vTEMPItemMatchOffer.SETFILTER("Matched To Entry No.",'<>%1',0);
        IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
              lItemMatchOffer.GET(vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Temp. Entry No.");
              vTEMPItemMatchDemand.GET(ABS(lItemMatchOffer."Matched To Entry No."));
              lItemMatchOffer."Matched To Entry No." := vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Temp. Entry No.";
              lItemMatchOffer.MODIFY;
          UNTIL vTEMPItemMatchOffer.NEXT = 0;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE InsertReservationEntries@301480004(VAR vTEMPItemMatchOffer@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;VAR vTEMPItemMatchDemand@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 85101;pAppliedMatchingRule@301480007 : Integer);
    VAR
      lReservationEntry1@301480002 : Record 337;
      lReservationEntry2@301480003 : Record 337;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301480004 : Record 32;
      lSalesLine@301480005 : Record 37;
      lEntryNo@301480006 : Integer;
      CHNXDifferentialTaxationMgt@301490000 : Codeunit 80000;
      SalesLineVarIsSet@301490001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      lReservationEntry1.RESET;
      lReservationEntry1.LOCKTABLE;
      IF lReservationEntry1.FINDLAST THEN
        lEntryNo := lReservationEntry1."Entry No." + 1
      ELSE
        lEntryNo := 1;

      // Reservierungsposten fÅr Angebot
      lReservationEntry1.INIT;
      lReservationEntry1."Entry No." := lEntryNo;
      lReservationEntry1.Positive := TRUE;
      lReservationEntry1."Source Type" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Type";
      lReservationEntry1."Source Subtype" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Subtype";
      lReservationEntry1."Source ID" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source ID";
      lReservationEntry1."Source Ref. No." := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Ref. No.";
      lReservationEntry1."Location Code" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Location Code";
      lReservationEntry1."Item No." := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Item No.";
      lReservationEntry1."Variant Code" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Variant Code";
      lReservationEntry1."Quantity (Base)" := vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Quantity;
      lReservationEntry1.Quantity := lReservationEntry1."Quantity (Base)";
      lReservationEntry1."Qty. to Handle (Base)" := lReservationEntry1."Quantity (Base)";
      lReservationEntry1."Qty. to Invoice (Base)" := lReservationEntry1."Quantity (Base)";
      lReservationEntry1."Qty. per Unit of Measure" := 1;
      lReservationEntry1."Reservation Status" := lReservationEntry1."Reservation Status"::Reservation;
      lReservationEntry1."Planning Flexibility" := lReservationEntry1."Planning Flexibility"::Unlimited;
      // Warenausg.-Datum aus VK-Zeile des Bedarfs in beiden Reservierungsposten speichern
      IF vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Type" = DATABASE::"Sales Line" THEN
        // 01 08.03.19 MKLE CHR-427 Set "Item Matching"
        //IF lSalesLine.GET(vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Subtype",vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source ID",vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Ref. No.") THEN
        IF lSalesLine.GET(vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Subtype",vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source ID",vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Ref. No.") THEN BEGIN
        // 01 08.03.19 MKLE CHR-427 Set "Item Matching" ENDE
          lReservationEntry1."Shipment Date" := lSalesLine."Shipment Date";
        // 01 08.03.19 MKLE CHR-427 Set "Item Matching"
          lSalesLine."Item Matching" := TRUE;
          lSalesLine.MODIFY;
          SalesLineVarIsSet := TRUE;
        END;
        // 01 08.03.19 MKLE CHR-427 Set "Item Matching" ENDE
      // Seriennr. aus Artikelposten
      IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Type" = DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry" THEN
        IF lItemLedgerEntry.GET(vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Ref. No.") THEN
          IF lItemLedgerEntry."Serial No." <> '' THEN BEGIN
            lReservationEntry1."Serial No." := lItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.";
            lReservationEntry1."Item Tracking" := lReservationEntry1."Item Tracking"::"Serial No.";
          END;
      lReservationEntry1."Creation Date" := TODAY;
      lReservationEntry1."Created By" := USERID;
      lReservationEntry1.INSERT;

      // Reservierungsposten fÅr Bedarf
      lReservationEntry2.INIT;
      lReservationEntry2 := lReservationEntry1;
      lReservationEntry2.Positive := NOT lReservationEntry1.Positive;
      lReservationEntry2."Source Type" := vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Type";
      lReservationEntry2."Source Subtype" := vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Subtype";
      lReservationEntry2."Source ID" := vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source ID";
      lReservationEntry2."Source Ref. No." := vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Ref. No.";
      lReservationEntry2."Quantity (Base)" := -lReservationEntry2."Quantity (Base)";
      lReservationEntry2.Quantity := -lReservationEntry2.Quantity;
      lReservationEntry2."Qty. to Handle (Base)" := -lReservationEntry2."Qty. to Handle (Base)";
      lReservationEntry2."Qty. to Invoice (Base)" := -lReservationEntry2."Qty. to Invoice (Base)";
      // Zollkennzeichen fÅr Reservierungsposten Bedarf aus Artikelposten des Angebots
      IF vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Type" = DATABASE::"Item Ledger Entry" THEN
        IF lItemLedgerEntry.GET(vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Source Ref. No.") THEN
          lReservationEntry2."Duty Sign" := lItemLedgerEntry."Duty Sign";
      lReservationEntry2.INSERT;

      // 01 04.07.19 MBLA CHR-657 Falscher Net selling Price: Umbau SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine
      IF NOT SalesLineVarIsSet THEN
        SalesLineVarIsSet := lSalesLine.GET(vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Subtype",vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source ID",vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Source Ref. No.");

      IF SalesLineVarIsSet THEN
        CHNXDifferentialTaxationMgt.SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine2(lSalesLine);
      // 01 04.07.19 MBLA CHR-657 Falscher Net selling Price: Umbau SetDifferentialTaxationOnSalesLine ENDE

      vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Processed := vTEMPItemMatchOffer.Processed::Yes;
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Matched To Entry No." := vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Entry No.";
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Reservation Entry No." := lReservationEntry1."Entry No.";
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Applied Matching Rule" := pAppliedMatchingRule;
      vTEMPItemMatchOffer.MODIFY;

      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Processed := vTEMPItemMatchDemand.Processed::Yes;
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Matched To Entry No." := vTEMPItemMatchOffer."Entry No.";
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Reservation Entry No." := lReservationEntry2."Entry No.";
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand."Applied Matching Rule" := pAppliedMatchingRule;
      vTEMPItemMatchDemand.MODIFY;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetWarrantyDateForILE@301480012(pItemLederEntry@301480000 : Record 32) : Date;
    VAR
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480001 : Record 7505;
      lWarrantyDate@301480002 : Date;
    BEGIN
      IF (pItemLederEntry."Item No." = '') OR (pItemLederEntry."Serial No." = '') THEN
        EXIT(0D);
      GetCustomerSetup;
      gCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Warranty Date Attribute");
      IF lItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(DATABASE::"Serial No. Information",
                                        pItemLederEntry."Item No.",
                                        gCustomerSetup."Warranty Date Attribute",
                                        pItemLederEntry."Variant Code",
                                        pItemLederEntry."Serial No.") THEN BEGIN
        lItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS(lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text");
        IF EVALUATE(lWarrantyDate,lItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text",9) THEN
          EXIT(lWarrantyDate);
      END;
      EXIT(0D);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckSalesHeaderOpenPostProcessingEntryExists@301480015(pSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36;pPostProcessingCodeFilter@301480001 : Code[250];pPostProcessingOutsortSelectionCodeFilter@301480003 : Code[250]) : Boolean;
    VAR

    BEGIN
      // 01 06.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 TemporÑre Nachbearbeitungsposten bei Matching-PrÅfung beachten
      // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 öberprÅfung NachbearbeitungsgrÅnde auf Basis TempRec nur durchfÅhren wenn Verursacher geprÅft wird
      gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.RESET;

      // 01 13.06.19 NLOR CHR-604 öberprÅfung NachbearbeitungsgrÅnde auf Basis TempRec nur durchfÅhren wenn Verursacher geprÅft wird ENDE
      IF NOT gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.RESET;
        gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",gTEMPPostProcessingEntry."Entry Type"::Sale);
        gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesHeader."Document Type");

        gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Visible,TRUE);

        // 01 08.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Bei Start vom Matching auch Filter auf A-Selektionen berÅcksichtigen
        //EXIT(NOT gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY);
        lPostProcessingEntryFound := NOT gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY;
        // Wenn keine Nachbearbeitungsposten innerhalb des Filters vorhanden, dann keine weitere PrÅfung notwendig
        IF NOT lPostProcessingEntryFound THEN
          EXIT(lPostProcessingEntryFound);

          // Wenn keine Posten gefunden wurden, dann sind nur noch A-Selektionen vorhanden, denn sonst wÑre schon ein Ausstieg bei der vorherigen PrÅfung
          IF NOT lPostProcessingEntryFound THEN BEGIN
            gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",'ASELEKTION');
            gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Document Addional No.",pPostProcessingOutsortSelectionCodeFilter);
            lPostProcessingEntryFound := NOT gTEMPPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY;
            EXIT(lPostProcessingEntryFound);
          END;
        END;

        EXIT(lPostProcessingEntryFound);
        // 01 08.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Bei Start vom Matching auch Filter auf A-Selektionen berÅcksichtigen ENDE

      END ELSE BEGIN
      // 01 06.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 TemporÑre Nachbearbeitungsposten bei Matching-PrÅfung beachten ENDE

        lPostProcessingEntry.RESET;
        lPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",lPostProcessingEntry."Entry Type"::Sale);
        lPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesHeader."Document Type");
        lPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",pSalesHeader."No.");
        lPostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",pPostProcessingCodeFilter);
        lPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
        lPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Visible,TRUE);

        // 01 08.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Bei Start vom Matching auch Filter auf A-Selektionen berÅcksichtigen
        //EXIT(NOT lPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY);
        lPostProcessingEntryFound := NOT lPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY;
        // Wenn keine Nachbearbeitungsposten innerhalb des Filters vorhanden, dann keine weitere PrÅfung notwendig
        IF NOT lPostProcessingEntryFound THEN
          EXIT(lPostProcessingEntryFound);

        // Wenn Filter fÅr A-Selektionen Åbergeben wurde, diese prÅfen
        IF pPostProcessingOutsortSelectionCodeFilter <> '' THEN BEGIN
          lPostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",pPostProcessingCodeFilter + '&<>ASELEKTION');
          lPostProcessingEntryFound := NOT lPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY;
          // Wenn keine Posten gefunden wurden, dann sind nur noch A-Selektionen vorhanden, denn sonst wÑre schon ein Ausstieg bei der vorherigen PrÅfung
          IF NOT lPostProcessingEntryFound THEN BEGIN
            lPostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",'ASELEKTION');
            lPostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Document Addional No.",pPostProcessingOutsortSelectionCodeFilter);
            lPostProcessingEntryFound := NOT lPostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY;
            EXIT(lPostProcessingEntryFound);
          END;
        END;

        EXIT(lPostProcessingEntryFound);
        // 01 08.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 Bei Start vom Matching auch Filter auf A-Selektionen berÅcksichtigen ENDE

      // 01 06.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 TemporÑre Nachbearbeitungsposten bei Matching-PrÅfung beachten
      END;
      // 01 06.11.18 MJAN CHR-49 TemporÑre Nachbearbeitungsposten bei Matching-PrÅfung beachten ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ApprovedByTransactionSecurity@301480019(VAR pSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36) : Boolean;
    VAR
      approvedStatus@301480001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // LF 11.11.18 CZIE CHR-49 Transaction Security Status berÅcksichtigen ApprovedByTransactionSecurity
      pSalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Address Check","Status Approve Order");
      approvedStatus := (pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order" = pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved) AND
                        (pSalesHeader."Status Address Check" IN [pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Approved,
                                                                pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Ignore,
                                                                pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"No Differences"]);


      EXIT(approvedStatus);
    END;
