    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckItemDemandForSalesLines@301480048(VAR pSalesHeader@301480001 : Record 36);
    VAR
      SalesLine@301480003 : Record 37;
      PaymentMethod@301480000 : Record 289;
    BEGIN
      // LF 18.10.18 CZIE CHR-138 CheckItemDemandForSalesLine
      IF pSalesHeader.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      pSalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Approve Order","Status Address Check");
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
      //IF pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order" <> pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved THEN
      //  EXIT;
      IF pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order" <> pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(pSalesHeader,1,'Demand','Status Approve Order',STRSUBSTNO('%1 <> pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved',pSalesHeader."Status Approve Order"));
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
      //IF pSalesHeader."Status Address Check" IN [pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Declined,pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"Waiting for Approval",pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"Not Started"] THEN
      //  EXIT;
      IF pSalesHeader."Status Address Check" IN [pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Declined,pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"Waiting for Approval",pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"Not Started"] THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(pSalesHeader,1,'Demand','Status Address Check',STRSUBSTNO('"Status Address Check": %1',pSalesHeader."Status Address Check"));
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      IF PaymentMethod.GET(pSalesHeader."Payment Method Code") THEN
        IF PaymentMethod."Payment Type Code" = 'GENERIC' THEN BEGIN
          pSalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Generic Payment");
          // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
          //IF pSalesHeader."Status Generic Payment" <> pSalesHeader."Status Generic Payment"::Processed THEN
          //  EXIT;
          IF pSalesHeader."Status Generic Payment" <> pSalesHeader."Status Generic Payment"::Processed THEN BEGIN
            OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(pSalesHeader,1,'Demand','Status Generic Payment',STRSUBSTNO('pSalesHeader."Status Generic Payment": %1',pSalesHeader."Status Generic Payment"));
            EXIT;
          END;
          // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE
        END;

      gSalesHeader := pSalesHeader;

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",pSalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF HasToGenerateDemandForSalesLine(SalesLine) THEN
            CreateSupplierRequestInExtInterface(SalesLine,'REQSUPFILE',FALSE);
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE HasToGenerateDemandForSalesLine@301480047(pSalesLine@301480000 : Record 37) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301480001 : Record 32;
      PurchaseLine@301480002 : Record 39;
      SalesLine@301480003 : Record 37;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480004 : Record 5275378;
      PostProcessingEntry@301490000 : Record 5104950;
      CustomerSetup@301490002 : Record 87000;
      Location@301480005 : Record 14;
      SetupGet@301490001 : Codeunit 5105007;
    BEGIN
      // LF 18.10.18 CZIE CHR-138 HasToGenerateDemandForSalesLine
      IF pSalesLine.Type <> pSalesLine.Type::Item THEN
        EXIT;

      pSalesLine.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
      //IF (pSalesLine."Reserved Quantity" <> 0) OR (pSalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" = 0) THEN
      //  EXIT;
      IF (pSalesLine."Reserved Quantity" <> 0) OR (pSalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" = 0) THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,1,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1',pSalesLine."Line No."),'Reserved Quantity',
          STRSUBSTNO('Res.Qty:%1 Outst.Qty:%2',pSalesLine."Reserved Quantity",pSalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)"));
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'');
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE(Filename,FORMAT(pSalesLine.RECORDID,0,9));
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETFILTER(Status,'<>%1',ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::canceled);
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
      // IF NOT ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.ISEMPTY THEN
      //  EXIT;
      IF NOT ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,0,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1 vorhanden!',pSalesLine."Line No."),'ExtIntOutboundFile %1',STRSUBSTNO('Ext.Int.OutboundFile vorhanden:%1',pSalesLine.RECORDID));
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      // 01 05.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Kein Demand fÅr Box Artikel erzeugen
      IF  pSalesLine."No." = GetBoxItem THEN
        EXIT;
      // 01 05.11.18 CZIE CHR-000 Kein Demand fÅr Box Artikel erzeugen ENDE

      SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE
      //  IF CustomerSetup."Exclude Demand PP Filter" = '' THEN
      //  EXIT;
      IF CustomerSetup."Exclude Demand PP Filter" = '' THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,1,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1',pSalesLine."Line No."),'Exclude Demand PP Filter','Exclude Demand PP Filter ist leer.');
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",pSalesLine."Document No.");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",pSalesLine."Document Type");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETFILTER("Post Processing Code",CustomerSetup."Exclude Demand PP Filter");
      PostProcessingEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
      // IF NOT PostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
      //  EXIT;
      IF NOT PostProcessingEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,1,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1',pSalesLine."Line No."),'PostProcessingEntry',STRSUBSTNO('%1',CustomerSetup."Exclude Demand PP Filter"));
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      IF CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter" = '' THEN
       EXIT;

      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen
      Location.FILTERGROUP(99);
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen ENDE
      Location.SETFILTER(Code,CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter");
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
      // IF NOT Location.FINDSET THEN
      //  EXIT;
      IF NOT Location.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,1,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1',pSalesLine."Line No."),'Item Match LocationCode Filter',STRSUBSTNO('Item Match LocationCode Filter: %1',CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter"));
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen
      //Location.RESET;
      Location.FILTERGROUP(98);
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen ENDE
      Location.SETRANGE(Code,pSalesLine."Location Code");
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen
      Location.FILTERGROUP(0);
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE
      // // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen ENDE
      // IF Location.ISEMPTY THEN
      //  EXIT;
      // // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen ENDE
      IF Location.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,1,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1',pSalesLine."Line No."),'Location Code',STRSUBSTNO('pSalesLine."Location Code": %1',pSalesLine."Location Code"));
        EXIT;
      END;
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE

      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pSalesLine."No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
      // 01 25.01.19 LACK CHR-404 Demand Netto
      IF NOT pSalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible" THEN
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation Purchase",FALSE);
      // 01 25.01.19 LACK CHR-404 Demand Netto Ende
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen
      //ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Location Code",CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter");
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDSET THEN
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCSUMS(Quantity);

      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",pSalesLine."No.");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen
      //PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
      PurchaseLine.SETFILTER("Location Code",CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter");
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen ENDE
      PurchaseLine.SETFILTER("Outstanding Qty. (Base)",'<>0');
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDSET THEN
        PurchaseLine.CALCSUMS("Outstanding Qty. (Base)");

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",pSalesLine."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pSalesLine."Variant Code");
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen
      //SalesLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",pSalesLine."Location Code");
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("Location Code",CustomerSetup."Item Match LocationCode Filter");
      // 01 20.11.18 MBLA CHR-000 Bugfix Demand erzeugen ENDE
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("Outstanding Qty. (Base)",'<>0');
      SalesLine.SETFILTER("Reserved Quantity",'0');
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        SalesLine.CALCSUMS("Outstanding Qty. (Base)");

      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht
      //IF ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity + PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" - SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" < 0 THEN
      //  EXIT(TRUE);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity + PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" - SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" < 0 THEN BEGIN
        OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,0,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1',pSalesLine."Line No."),
          'Demand wird erzeugt!',
          STRSUBSTNO('Artikelposten: %1 + Bestellzeilen: %2 - VKZeilen: %3 = %4 ist < 0',
            ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity,
            PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)",
            SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)",
          ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity + PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" - SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)"));
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      OnCheckItemDemandForSalesLines(gSalesHeader,1,STRSUBSTNO('Demand %1',pSalesLine."Line No."),
          'Demand wird nicht erzeugt!',
          STRSUBSTNO('Artikelposten: %1 + Bestellzeilen: %2 - VKZeilen: %3 = %4 ist >= 0',
            ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity,
            PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)",
            SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)",
          ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity + PurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" - SalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)"));
      // 01 06.08.19 MBLA CHR-745 Demand wird erst Tage spÑter gepusht ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CustomsPostProcessing@301480049(VAR vSalesHeader@301480007 : Record 36;VAR vPostProcessingEntryTEMP@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 5104950);
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@301480008 : Record 5105031;
      PostProcessingManagement@301480005 : Codeunit 5104950;
      SystemValueNo@301480002 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@301480001 : Code[10];
      IsEUOrder@301480003 : Boolean;
      LTextPostProcDesc@301480004 : TextConst 'DEU=Auftrag hat Zollrelevanz;ENU=Order has customs relevancy';
      PostProcessingEntry@301480009 : Record 5104950;
      CountryRegion@301480006 : Record 9;
      WasOpenBefore@301480010 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // 01 23.10.18 TFIE CHR-57 Zollrelevante AuftrÑge aussteuern
      SystemValueCode := 'ZOLL';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;

      //Kein Zoll im Storeverkauf
      // 01 07.11.18 MJAN CHR-135 Auftragsart "Vitrine London" statt "Filiale" fÅr Verkauf London verwenden
      //IF vSalesHeader."Order Type" = vSalesHeader."Order Type"::Store THEN
      IF vSalesHeader."Order Type" IN [vSalesHeader."Order Type"::Showcase] THEN
      // 01 07.11.18 MJAN CHR-135 Auftragsart "Vitrine London" statt "Filiale" fÅr Verkauf London verwenden ENDE
        EXIT;

      IF NOT PostProcessingManagement.UsePostProcessingCode(vSalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT SetupGet."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT;

      IsEUOrder := CountryRegion.IsEUCountry(vSalesHeader."Ship-to Country/Region Code");

      //Falls schon mal geschlossen, nicht noch einmal îffnen
      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en ENDE
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code", SystemValueCode);
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE(Open, FALSE);
      WasOpenBefore := NOT vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.ISEMPTY;
      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en
      //IF WasOpenBefore THEN
      //  EXIT;
      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en ENDE
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;

      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en
      //IF NOT IsEUOrder THEN BEGIN
      IF NOT IsEUOrder AND NOT WasOpenBefore THEN BEGIN
      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en ENDE
        PostProcessingManagement.InsertPostProcessingEntry(vSalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',LTextPostProcDesc,TRUE,FALSE);
        PostProcessingManagement.GetPostProcessEntryTemp(vPostProcessingEntryTEMP);
      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en
      //END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",SystemValueCode);
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
        IF vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.VALIDATE(Open,FALSE);
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.MODIFY(TRUE);
        UNTIL vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.NEXT = 0;
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;
      END;
      // 01 10.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Austeuerungsgrund Zoll lÑsst sich nicht schlie·en ENDE
      // 01 23.10.18 TFIE CHR-57 Zollrelevante AuftrÑge aussteuern ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetDefaultPackageValuesOnBeforeInsertPackingListHeader@301480050(VAR Rec@301480000 : Record 5104639;RunTrigger@301480001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      SystemValueLineHeight@301480002 : Record 5105031;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PostProcessingHandleShipToCode@301490010(VAR vSalesHeader@301490000 : Record 36;VAR vSalesLineTEMP@301490001 : TEMPORARY Record 37;VAR vPostProcessingEntryTEMP@301490002 : TEMPORARY Record 5104950);
    VAR
      "System Value Line"@301480008 : Record 5105031;
      PostProcessingManagement@301480005 : Codeunit 5104950;
      SystemValueNo@301480002 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@301480001 : Code[10];
      IsShipToCodeEqual@301480003 : Boolean;
      LTextPostProcDesc@301480004 : TextConst 'DEU=Lief. an Code in Kopf und Zeile sind ungleich;ENU=Header and lines are different';
      PostProcessingEntry@301480009 : Record 5104950;
      CountryRegion@301480006 : Record 9;
      WasOpenBefore@301480010 : Boolean;
      lSalesLine@301490003 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // LF 21.08.19 SWIT CHR-672 Aussteuerung wenn Lief. an Code in Kopf und Zeile ungleich
      SystemValueCode := 'SHIPTOCODE';
      SystemValueNo := 63800;

      IF NOT PostProcessingManagement.UsePostProcessingCode(vSalesHeader,SystemValueCode) THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT SetupGet."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        EXIT;

      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code", SystemValueCode);
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE(Open, FALSE);
      WasOpenBefore := NOT vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.ISEMPTY;
      vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;

      IsShipToCodeEqual := TRUE;
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
      lSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
      IF lSalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF lSalesLine."Ship-to Code" <> '' THEN
            IsShipToCodeEqual := vSalesHeader."Ship-to Code" = lSalesLine."Ship-to Code";
        UNTIL (lSalesLine.NEXT = 0) OR (NOT IsShipToCodeEqual);

      IF NOT IsShipToCodeEqual AND NOT WasOpenBefore THEN BEGIN
        PostProcessingManagement.InsertPostProcessingEntry(vSalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',LTextPostProcDesc,TRUE,FALSE);
        PostProcessingManagement.GetPostProcessEntryTemp(vPostProcessingEntryTEMP);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",SystemValueCode);
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
        IF vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.VALIDATE(Open,FALSE);
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.MODIFY(TRUE);
        UNTIL vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.NEXT = 0;
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,36,OnAfterModifyEvent)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetStatusGenericPaymentOnAfterModifySalesHeader@301480055(VAR Rec@301480000 : Record 36;VAR xRec@301480001 : Record 36;RunTrigger@301480003 : Boolean);
    VAR
      SalesPSPCard@301480005 : Record 5227625;
      PSPExtendedSetup@301480007 : Record 5227633;

      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY OR NOT RunTrigger OR (Rec."Payment Method Code" = '') OR (Rec."Document Type" <> Rec."Document Type"::Order) THEN

        DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(Rec.RECORDID,Rec.FIELDNO("Status Generic Payment"),Rec."Status Generic Payment"::Processed);

      // 01 04.11.18 CZIE CHR-144 Finetrade als bezahlt markieren ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckAndApplyBoxOnSalesOrderCheckPostProcessing@1000000000(VAR vSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36;VAR vSalesLineTEMP@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 37;VAR vPostProcessingEntryTEMP@301480013 : TEMPORARY Record 5104950);
    VAR
      CustomerSetup@1000000002 : Record 87000;

      Contact@301480011 : Record 5050;
      SalesLine2@1000000003 : Record 37;
      SetupGet@301480007 : Codeunit 5105007;
      PostProcessingManagement@301480006 : Codeunit 5104950;
      DocumentValueManagement@301480005 : Codeunit 5295670;
      CreditRankingManagement@301480010 : Codeunit 5229122;

      SystemValueNo@301480004 : Integer;
      SystemValueCode@301480003 : Code[10];
      ValueOK@301480002 : Boolean;
      msgDescription@301480012 : Text;
      BoxNotAvailableTxt@1000000001 : TextConst 'DEU=Box nicht vorhanden: Artikel %1, Variante %2.;ENU=Box not available: Item %1, Variant %2.';
      BoxVariantCode@1000000005 : Code[20];

      ValueOK := TRUE;

      IF NOT SetupGet."Get System Value Line"("System Value Line",SystemValueNo,SystemValueCode,TRUE,FALSE) THEN

      IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN

        SalesLine2.SETFILTER("Outstanding Quantity",'>%1',0);
        SalesLine2.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1',CustomerSetup."Box Item");
        IF SalesLine2.FINDSET THEN
          REPEAT
            IF LogisticMgtChronext.HasBoxItem(SalesLine2."No.",SalesLine2."Variant Code") THEN BEGIN
              BoxVariantCode := LogisticMgtShptChronext.GetSerialNoFromSalesLine(SalesLine2);
              IF BoxVariantCode <> '' THEN BEGIN
                IF NOT LogisticMgtShptChronext.CheckBoxVariant(CustomerSetup."Box Item",BoxVariantCode,FALSE) THEN BEGIN
                  ValueOK := FALSE;
                  msgDescription := STRSUBSTNO(BoxNotAvailableTxt,SalesLine2."No.",SalesLine2."Variant Code");
                END;
              END;
            END;
          UNTIL SalesLine2.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      IF ValueOK THEN
        LogisticMgtShptChronext.CreateBoxSupplementSalesLine(vSalesHeader);

      IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",SystemValueCode);
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");
        IF vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.VALIDATE(Open,FALSE);
          vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.MODIFY(TRUE);
        UNTIL vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.NEXT = 0;
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.RESET;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PostProcessingManagement.InsertPostProcessingEntry(vSalesHeader,0,"System Value Line",'',msgDescription,TRUE,FALSE);
        PostProcessingManagement.GetPostProcessEntryTemp(vPostProcessingEntryTEMP);
      END;
    END;

                IF NOT EVALUATE(lYear,COPYSTR(lItemAttributeValueTemp.Value,1,4)) OR
                  NOT EVALUATE(lMonth,COPYSTR(lItemAttributeValueTemp.Value,6,2)) OR
                  NOT EVALUATE(lDay,COPYSTR(lItemAttributeValueTemp.Value,9,2)) THEN BEGIN

                ELSE IF NOT (DMY2DATE(lDay,lMonth,lYear) <= TODAY) THEN BEGIN
                  ValueOK := FALSE;
                  lPPText := STRSUBSTNO(TEXT002,lItemAttributeValueTemp.Value);
                END; // ELSE IF DMY2DATE(lDay,lMonth,lYear) <=  TODAY THEN BEGIN....
              END //IF lItemAttributeValueTemp.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                ELSE BEGIN
                  ValueOK := FALSE;
                  lPPText := TEXT001;
                END;
            END;
          END;
        END;



      IF ValueOK THEN BEGIN
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Post Processing Code",SystemValueCode);
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document Type",vSalesHeader."Document Type");
        vPostProcessingEntryTEMP.SETRANGE("Document No.",vSalesHeader."No.");

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateItemVariantReference@301510002(VAR vItemVariant@301510000 : Record 5401);
    VAR
      lItem@301510001 : Record 27;
      lItemCrossReference@301510005 : Record 5717;
      lCrossRefNo@301510004 : Text;
      lCustomerSetup@301510002 : Record 87000;
    BEGIN
      // LF 27.11.18 MKLE CHR-000 CreateItemVariantReference: Barcode autom. anlegen
      lCustomerSetup.GET;
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");

      IF vItemVariant.ISTEMPORARY OR (vItemVariant."Item No." = lCustomerSetup."Box Item") THEN
        EXIT;

      lItem.GET(vItemVariant."Item No.");
      lCrossRefNo := vItemVariant."Item No." + '-' + vItemVariant.Code;

      IF NOT lItemCrossReference.GET(
        vItemVariant."Item No.",
        vItemVariant.Code,
        lItem."Base Unit of Measure",
        lItemCrossReference."Cross-Reference Type"::"Bar Code",
        '',
        lCrossRefNo) THEN BEGIN
          lItemCrossReference.INIT;
          lItemCrossReference.VALIDATE("Item No.",vItemVariant."Item No.");
          lItemCrossReference."Variant Code" := vItemVariant.Code;
          lItemCrossReference."Unit of Measure" :=  lItem."Base Unit of Measure";
          lItemCrossReference."Cross-Reference Type" := lItemCrossReference."Cross-Reference Type"::"Bar Code";
          lItemCrossReference."Cross-Reference No." := lCrossRefNo;
          lItemCrossReference.INSERT;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrderFromSupplierPortal@301510004(pOrderNo@301480003 : Code[20];pLineNo@301510001 : Integer;pItemNo@301510000 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301510002 : Code[10];pVendorNo@301510003 : Code[20];pUnitCost@301510004 : Decimal;pDeliveryDate@301510005 : Date;pDifferentialTaxation@301510006 : Boolean) : Code[20];
    VAR
      SalesLine@301480002 : Record 37;
      CopySalesLine@301480016 : Record 37;
      TempPurchaseLine@301480001 : TEMPORARY Record 39;
      CustomerManagement@301480000 : Codeunit 87000;
      PositionNotFound@301480004 : TextConst 'DEU=Artikel %1 %2 wurde in Auftrag %3 nicht gefunden (Positionsnr.: %4);ENU=Item %1 %2 not found in order %3 (Lineno.: %4)';
      JSONManagement@301480005 : Codeunit 5459;
      EmptyRequest@301480007 : TextConst 'DEU=Request ist leer.;ENU=Request is empty.';
      AlreadyLinkedWithPurchaseOrder@301510007 : TextConst 'DEU=Die Zeile ist bereits mit EK-Bestellung %1 verknÅpft;ENU=Sales line already linked with purchase order %1';
      lCustomerSetup@301490000 : Record 87000;
    BEGIN
      // 01 12.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Bestellungen aus dem Supplier-Portal anlegen CreatePurchaseOrderFromSupplierPortal

      ValidateEntries(pDeliveryDate,pUnitCost,pVendorNo);

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",pOrderNo);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",pLineNo);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",pItemNo);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pVariantCode);

      IF NOT SalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN
       ERROR(PositionNotFound,pItemNo,pVariantCode,pOrderNo,pLineNo);

      IF SalesLine."Special Order Purchase No." <> '' THEN
        ERROR(AlreadyLinkedWithPurchaseOrder,SalesLine."Special Order Purchase No.");

      TempPurchaseLine."Buy-from Vendor No." := pVendorNo;
      TempPurchaseLine."Direct Unit Cost" := pUnitCost;
      TempPurchaseLine."Promised Receipt Date" := pDeliveryDate;
      TempPurchaseLine."Differential Taxation" := pDifferentialTaxation;
      // 01 12.03.19 MKLE CHR-200 Always Create PO with Location Code 'HL'
      lCustomerSetup.GET;
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Extra Order Purch. Loc. Code");
      TempPurchaseLine."Location Code" := lCustomerSetup."Extra Order Purch. Loc. Code";
      // 01 12.03.19 MKLE CHR-200 Always Create PO with Location Code 'HL' ENDE

      CopySalesLine := SalesLine;

      SalesLine.SetDontRecalcPriceAndLinediscount(TRUE);
      SalesLine.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code", 'SPEZ-AUFTR');

      // 01 13.02.19 MJAN CHR-200 Bugfix: Erstellung EK-Bestellung aus SupplierPortal fÅr VK-Auftrag
      //SalesLine."Unit Cost (LCY)" := TempPurchaseLine."Direct Unit Cost";
      // 01 13.02.19 MJAN CHR-200 Bugfix: Erstellung EK-Bestellung aus SupplierPortal fÅr VK-Auftrag ENDE

      IF CopySalesLine."Unit Price" <> SalesLine."Unit Price" THEN
        SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",CopySalesLine."Unit Price");

      IF CopySalesLine."Line Discount %" <> 0 THEN
        SalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Discount %",CopySalesLine."Line Discount %");

      IF CopySalesLine."Line Discount Amount" <> 0 THEN
        SalesLine.VALIDATE("Line Discount Amount",CopySalesLine."Line Discount Amount");

      SalesLine.MODIFY;

      CustomerManagement.CreatePurchaseOrderForSalesLine(SalesLine,TempPurchaseLine,FALSE);

      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",pOrderNo);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",pLineNo);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",pItemNo);
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pVariantCode);
      SalesLine.FINDFIRST;
      EXIT(SalesLine."Special Order Purchase No.");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ValidateEntries@301510003(pDeliveryDate@301480002 : Date;pUnitCost@301480003 : Decimal;pVendor@301480004 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      Vendor@301480001 : Record 23;
      errorMsg@301480000 : Text;
      DeliveryDateInFuture@301480005 : TextConst 'DEU=Das Lieferdatum muss in der Zukunft liegen\;ENU=Delivery Date has to be in the future\';
      UnitCostPositive@301480006 : TextConst 'DEU=Der Einkaufspreis muss einen positiven Wert haben\;ENU=Unit cost has to be positive\';
      VendorIsEmpty@301480007 : TextConst 'DEU=Der Kreditor muss ausgefÅllt sein\;ENU=Vendor is empty';
      VendorDoesNotExist@301480008 : TextConst 'DEU=Kreditor %1 existiert nicht;ENU=Vendor %1 does not exist';
    BEGIN
      // 01 12.12.18 CZIE CHR-000 Bestellungen aus dem Supplier-Portal anlegen CreatePurchaseOrderFromSupplierPortal
      errorMsg := '';

      IF  pDeliveryDate < TODAY THEN
        errorMsg += DeliveryDateInFuture;

      IF pUnitCost <= 0 THEN
        errorMsg += UnitCostPositive;

      IF pVendor = '' THEN
        errorMsg += VendorIsEmpty
      ELSE
        IF NOT Vendor.GET(pVendor) THEN
          errorMsg += STRSUBSTNO(VendorDoesNotExist,pVendor);

      IF errorMsg <> '' THEN
        ERROR(errorMsg);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CleanSpecialOrderFieldsAndCheckAssocPurchOrder@301490008(VAR vSalesLine@301490001 : Record 37;VAR vIsHandled@301490000 : Boolean);
    VAR
      lPurchaseHeader@301490004 : Record 38;
      lPurchaseLine@301490003 : Record 39;
      lPurchasing@301490002 : Record 5721;
      lSalesHeader@301490005 : Record 36;
    BEGIN
      // GF 20.05.19 MKLE CHR-489 CleanSpecialOrderFieldsAndCheckAssocPurchOrder

      // Flag depending Pruch. Order
      IF lPurchaseHeader.GET(lPurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order,vSalesLine."Special Order Purchase No.") THEN BEGIN
        lPurchaseHeader."Sales Order Line Deleted" := TRUE;
        lPurchaseHeader.MODIFY;
      END;

      // Clean Purch. Order Line
      IF lPurchaseLine.GET(lPurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order,vSalesLine."Special Order Purchase No.",vSalesLine."Special Order Purch. Line No.") THEN BEGIN
        IF lPurchasing.GET(lPurchaseLine."Purchasing Code") AND lPurchasing."Special Order" THEN BEGIN
          lPurchaseLine."Special Order" := FALSE;
          lPurchaseLine."Purchaser Code" := '';
        END;
        lPurchaseLine."Special Order Sales No." := '';
        lPurchaseLine."Special Order Sales Line No." := 0;
        lPurchaseLine.MODIFY;
      END;

      // Clean Sales Line
      vSalesLine."Special Order Purchase No." := '';
      vSalesLine."Special Order Purch. Line No." := 0;
      IF lSalesHeader.GET(lSalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,vSalesLine."Document No.") THEN BEGIN
        lSalesHeader.Status := lSalesHeader.Status::Open;
        vSalesLine.SetSalesHeader(lSalesHeader);
        vSalesLine.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",'');
        // UF 09.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 Modify verschoben, damit Funktion aus <Handle_OnAfterValidateCancelReason_T39> aufgerufen werden kann
        vSalesLine.MODIFY;
        // UF 09.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 Modify verschoben, damit Funktion aus <Handle_OnAfterValidateCancelReason_T39> aufgerufen werden kann ENDE
      END;

      //Everything fine
      vIsHandled := TRUE;
    END;

      // LF 08.04.19 NLOR CHR-183 AssignFieldsOnAfterFillInvoicePostBuffer ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetApplyOnBeforePostInvPostBuffer@301490009(VAR GenJnlLine@301490000 : Record 81;VAR InvoicePostBuffer@301490001 : Record 49;VAR PurchHeader@301490002 : Record 38);
    BEGIN

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetApplyOnPrepaymentAccount@301490015(VAR GenJnlLine@301490003 : Record 81);
    VAR
      LGLAccount@301490002 : Record 15;
      LGLEntry@301490001 : Record 17;
      LGLEntry2@301490005 : Record 17;
      LApplyID@301490000 : Code[50];
    BEGIN
      // LF 08.04.19 NLOR CHR-183 SetApplyOnPrepaymentAccount
      // Ausgleich bei Verbuchung von EK-Belegen auf dem Vorauszahlungs-Sachkonto
      IF LGLAccount.GET(GenJnlLine."Account No.") AND LGLAccount."akq OE Account" AND (GenJnlLine."Source Document No." <> '') THEN BEGIN
        LGLEntry.RESET;
        LGLEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("G/L Account No.","akq Applies-to ID","akq Open","akq Positive");
        LGLEntry.SETRANGE("G/L Account No.",GenJnlLine."Account No.");
        LGLEntry.SETRANGE("Posting Date",0D,GenJnlLine."Posting Date");
        LGLEntry.SETRANGE("akq Open",TRUE);
        LGLEntry.SETRANGE("Source Document Type",1);
        LGLEntry.SETRANGE("Source Document No.",GenJnlLine."Source Document No.");
        LGLEntry.SETRANGE("akq Currency Code",GenJnlLine."Currency Code");
        IF LGLEntry.FINDSET(TRUE,FALSE) THEN BEGIN
          LApplyID := CREATEGUID;
          GenJnlLine."Applies-to ID" := LApplyID;
          REPEAT
            LGLEntry2.SETAUTOCALCFIELDS("akq Remaining Amount","akq Remaining Amt. (FCY)");
            LGLEntry2.GET(LGLEntry."Entry No.");
            LGLEntry2."akq Applies-to ID" := LApplyID;
            LGLEntry2."akq Amount to Apply" := LGLEntry2."akq Remaining Amount";
            IF LGLEntry2."akq Currency Code" = '' THEN
              LGLEntry2."akq Amount to Apply (FCY)" := LGLEntry2."akq Remaining Amount"
            ELSE
              LGLEntry2."akq Amount to Apply (FCY)" := LGLEntry2."akq Remaining Amt. (FCY)";

            CODEUNIT.RUN(CODEUNIT::"G/L Entry-Edit",LGLEntry2);
          UNTIL LGLEntry.NEXT = 0;
        END;
      END;
      // LF 08.04.19 NLOR CHR-183 SetApplyOnPrepaymentAccount ENDE
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,27,OnAfterValidateEvent,Commission)]

      lSalesInvoiceHeader@301490002 : Record 112;

    END;

    PROCEDURE GetUnitCostLcyFromItemLedgerEntry@301490013(pSalesLine@301490000 : Record 37;pItemLedgerEntry@301490001 : Record 32) rUnitCostLcy : Decimal;
    VAR
      lErrEntryTypeNotAllowed@301490002 : TextConst 'DEU=Postenart ''%1'' wird nicht unterstÅtzt.;ENU=Entry Type ''%1'' is not supported.';
      lSalesInvoiceLine@301490005 : Record 113;
      lValueEntry@301490004 : Record 5802;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301490003 : Record 32;
      lErrDocumentTypeNotAllowed@301490006 : TextConst 'DEU=Belegart ''%1'' wird nicht unterstÅtzt.;ENU=Document Type ''%1'' is not supported.';
      lSalesHeader@301490007 : Record 36;
      lCurrency@301490008 : Record 4;
      lCurrExchRate@301490009 : Record 330;
      lDate@301490010 : Date;
    BEGIN
      // GF 15.07.19 MKLE CHR-483 GetUnitCostFromLastItemLedgerEntry
      IF NOT (pItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type" IN [pItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Sale]) THEN
        ERROR(lErrEntryTypeNotAllowed,pItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type");

      IF NOT (pSalesLine."Document Type" IN [pSalesLine."Document Type"::"Return Order"]) THEN
        ERROR(lErrDocumentTypeNotAllowed,pSalesLine."Document Type");

      CASE pSalesLine."Document Type" OF
        pSalesLine."Document Type"::"Return Order" : BEGIN
          lSalesInvoiceLine.GET(pSalesLine."Return Base Invoice No.",pSalesLine."Invoice LineNo");
          lValueEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",lValueEntry."Document Type"::"Sales Invoice");
          lValueEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",lSalesInvoiceLine."Document No.");
          lValueEntry.SETRANGE("Document Line No.",lSalesInvoiceLine."Line No.");
          lValueEntry.SETRANGE("Item Ledger Entry Type",pItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type");
          IF lValueEntry.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
            lItemLedgerEntry.GET(lValueEntry."Item Ledger Entry No.");
            // 01 22.07.19 MBLA CHR-483 Calcfields in <GetUnitCostLcyFromItemLedgerEntry>
            lItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
            // 01 22.07.19 MBLA CHR-483 Calcfields in <GetUnitCostLcyFromItemLedgerEntry> ENDE
            lSalesHeader.GET(pSalesLine."Document Type",pSalesLine."Document No.");
            IF (lSalesHeader."Currency Code" <> '') THEN BEGIN
              lCurrency.GET(lSalesHeader."Currency Code");
              lCurrency.TESTFIELD("Unit-Amount Rounding Precision");
              IF (lSalesHeader."Posting Date" <> 0D) THEN
                lDate := lSalesHeader."Posting Date"
              ELSE
                lDate := WORKDATE;
              rUnitCostLcy :=
                ROUND(
                  lCurrExchRate.ExchangeAmtFCYToLCY(
                    lDate,lSalesHeader."Currency Code",
                    ROUND(lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)" / lItemLedgerEntry.Quantity),lSalesHeader."Currency Factor"),
                  lCurrency."Unit-Amount Rounding Precision");
            END ELSE
              rUnitCostLcy := ROUND(lItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)" / lItemLedgerEntry.Quantity);
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,39,OnAfterValidateEvent,"Processing Status")]
    PROCEDURE Handle_OnAfterValidateProcessingStatus_T39@301480060(VAR Rec@301490000 : Record 39;VAR xRec@301490001 : Record 39;CurrFieldNo@301490002 : Integer);
    VAR
      ExtraOrderHeader@301480002 : Record 5104716;
      ExtraOrderLine@301480003 : Record 5104717;
      Purchasing@301480005 : Record 5721;
      SalesHeader@301480004 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@301490003 : Record 37;
      ExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301490004 : Record 5275378;
      SubscriberSkipManagement@301480000 : Codeunit 5295339;
      IsHandled@301480001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF gSubscriberSkipManagement.SkipSubscriber(CODEUNIT::"Customer Management",'Handle_OnAfterValidateCancelReason_T39') THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Rec."Correction Reason" <> '' THEN
        BEGIN
          IF (Rec."Special Order") AND (Rec."Special Order Sales No." <> '') THEN
            BEGIN
              IF SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order,Rec."Special Order Sales No.",Rec."Special Order Sales Line No.") THEN
                BEGIN


                  // 01 09.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 <Handle_OnAfterValidateCancelReason_T39> ruft <OnBeforeCleanSpecialOrderFieldsAndCheckAssocPurchOrder> auf
                  //SalesLine."Special Order Purchase No." := '';
                  //SalesLine."Special Order Purch. Line No." := 0;
                  //SalesLine.MODIFY;

                  // 01 12.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 Leeren der Special Order Felder muss anders gelîst werden
                  IF Purchasing.GET(Rec."Purchasing Code") AND Purchasing."Special Order" THEN BEGIN
                    Rec."Special Order" := FALSE;
                    Rec."Purchaser Code" := '';
                  END;

                  Rec."Special Order Sales No." := '';
                  Rec."Special Order Sales Line No." := 0;
                  Rec.MODIFY;

                  // Clean Sales Line
                  SalesLine."Special Order Purchase No." := '';
                  SalesLine."Special Order Purch. Line No." := 0;
                  IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,SalesLine."Document No.") THEN BEGIN
                    SalesHeader.Status := SalesHeader.Status::Open;
                    SalesLine.SetSalesHeader(SalesHeader);
                    SalesLine.VALIDATE("Purchasing Code",'');
                    SalesLine.MODIFY;
                  END;
                  // 01 12.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 Leeren der Special Order Felder muss anders gelîst werden ENDE

                  // 01 09.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 <Handle_OnAfterValidateCancelReason_T39> Extra Order Header lîschen
                  ExtraOrderHeader.SETRANGE("Sales Order No.",SalesLine."Document No.");
                  IF ExtraOrderHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
                    BEGIN
                      ExtraOrderLine.SETRANGE("Extra Order No.",ExtraOrderHeader."No.");
                      IF NOT ExtraOrderLine.ISEMPTY THEN
                        BEGIN
                          ExtraOrderLine.DELETEALL(FALSE); // don't run trigger logic
                          ExtraOrderHeader.DELETE(FALSE);  // don't run trigger logic

                          IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFileEntryExistsForSalesLine('REQSUPFILE',SalesLine) THEN
                            BEGIN
                              CreateSupplierRequestInExtInterface(SalesLine,'DECSUPFILE',GUIALLOWED);

                              ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE("Message Code",'REQSUPFILE');
                              ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SETRANGE(Filename,FORMAT(SalesLine.RECORDID,0,9));
                              IF ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                                ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename += '-DECLINED';
                                ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.MODIFY;
                              END;
                            END;
                        END;
                    END;
                    // 01 09.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 <Handle_OnAfterValidateCancelReason_T39> Extra Order Header lîschen ENDE
                  // 01 09.09.19 MBLA MSD-9274 <Handle_OnAfterValidateCancelReason_T39> ruft <OnBeforeCleanSpecialOrderFieldsAndCheckAssocPurchOrder> auf ENDE


                END;
            END;
        END;

      // 01 13.11.19 PWIE MSD-9958 PP refund ist nicht rausgegangen
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ReleasePurchaseOrder@301490020();
    VAR
      lPurchaseHeader@301490001 : Record 38;
      lPurchaseLine@301490002 : Record 39;
      lReleasePurchaseDocument@301490000 : Codeunit 415;
      l_recItemAttrValMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
      l_recCustSetup@301510001 : Record 87000;
    BEGIN
      // 01 06.11.20 LACK MSD-13094 PO Creation API extension
      // 01 27.04.21 VMO ERP-99 <<
      l_recCustSetup.GET;
      l_recCustSetup.TESTFIELD("Condition Attribute");
      // 01 27.04.21 VMO ERP-99 >>
      lPurchaseHeader.RESET;
      lPurchaseHeader.SETRANGE(Status,lPurchaseHeader.Status::Open);
      lPurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",lPurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      lPurchaseHeader.SETRANGE(APICreation,TRUE);
      lPurchaseHeader.SETFILTER("Insert Time",'<%1',TIME-50000);
      IF lPurchaseHeader.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          lPurchaseLine.RESET;
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",lPurchaseHeader."Document Type");
          lPurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",lPurchaseHeader."No.");
          lPurchaseLine.SETFILTER(Type,'>0');
          lPurchaseLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>0');
          IF lPurchaseLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
             // 01 27.04.21 VMO ERP-99 <<
             REPEAT
             l_recItemAttrValMapping.RESET;
             l_recItemAttrValMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",DATABASE::"Item Variant");
             l_recItemAttrValMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",l_recCustSetup."Condition Attribute");
             l_recItemAttrValMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",lPurchaseLine."Variant Code");
             IF l_recItemAttrValMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                l_recItemAttrValMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
                IF LOWERCASE(l_recItemAttrValMapping."Item Attribute Value Text") <> 'new' THEN BEGIN
                   lPurchaseLine."Used good" := TRUE;
                   lPurchaseLine.MODIFY;
                END;
             END;
            UNTIL lPurchaseLine.NEXT = 0;
            // 01 27.04.21 VMO ERP-99 >>
            lReleasePurchaseDocument.SetHideDialog(TRUE);
            lReleasePurchaseDocument.RUN(lPurchaseHeader);
          END;
        UNTIL lPurchaseHeader.NEXT = 0;
      // 01 06.11.20 LACK MSD-13094 PO Creation API extension Ende
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,80,OnBeforePostSalesDoc)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetPaygateOk@301490017(VAR SalesHeader@301490001 : Record 36);
    VAR
      pSalesHeader@301490000 : Record 36;
      PaymentMethod@301490002 : Record 289;
      PaygateEntry@301490003 : Record 50009;
      PspHdlgManagement@301490004 : Codeunit 5227622;
      PayGateAmount@301490005 : Decimal;
      OrderAmount@301490006 : Decimal;
      SystemMgtMgt@301490007 : Codeunit 5105000;
    BEGIN
      //EV 03.09.21 NKON CHRON-2 PickUp Auftrag erst buchen wenn Capture erfolgt ist
      pSalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.");

      IF PspHdlgManagement.IsPayGate(PaymentMethod) THEN BEGIN

        PayGateAmount:=PaygateEntry."Request Amount";
        OrderAmount:=SystemMgtMgt."CalcPre-PayAmount(expected)"(pSalesHeader,FALSE);
        IF OrderAmount = PayGateAmount THEN BEGIN
          SalesHeader."Paygate Amount ok":=TRUE;
          COMMIT;
        END;
      END;
      //EV 03.09.21 NKON CHRON-2 PickUp Auftrag erst buchen wenn Capture erfolgt ist
    END;

    PROCEDURE CollectPrepayment@301490018(VAR SalesHeader@301490000 : Record 36);
    VAR
      UserSetup@301490009 : Record 91;
      SalesLine@301490008 : Record 37;
      SystemValueLine@301490007 : Record 5105031;
      TerminalID@301490006 : Text[80];
      GenJournalBatch@301490005 : Record 232;
      GenJournalLineTemp@301490004 : TEMPORARY Record 81;
      SystemValueHead@301490002 : Record 5105030;
      SystemValueLRun@301490001 : Record 5105031;
      GenJournalLine@301510000 : Record 81;
      PrepayFound@301510001 : Decimal;
      CustLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 21;
      RemainingAmount@301510003 : Decimal;
      MACPayGateHandling@301510004 : Codeunit 5227646;
      PaygateEntry@301510005 : Record 50009;
      PaygateAmount@301510006 : Decimal;
      ReleaseSalesDocument@301510007 : Codeunit 5105005;
      lLocation@301510008 : Code[10];
    BEGIN
      //01 18.11.21 NKON CHRON-4 Vorkasse vereinnahmen
      UserSetup.GET(USERID);
      SalesLine.RESET;
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
      SalesLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN
        IF SystemValueLine.GET(60200,SalesLine."Location Code") THEN BEGIN
          IF UserSetup."Terminal ID" <> SystemValueLine."Code Value 2" THEN BEGIN
            SystemValueLRun.RESET;
            SystemValueLRun.SETRANGE("System Value No.",60200);
            IF SystemValueLRun.FINDSET THEN
              IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(5105031,SystemValueLRun) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
                TerminalID:=SystemValueLRun."Code Value 2";
                UserSetup."Terminal ID":=TerminalID;
                UserSetup.MODIFY;
              END;
          END;
        END;
        IF SystemValueHead.GET(SystemValueLine."System Value No.") THEN
          lLocation:=SystemValueLine."System Code"
        ELSE
          lLocation:='HL';
        IF lLocation = '' THEN EXIT;

      //    Customer.SETCURRENTKEY("Customers Group Code","No.");
      //    Customer.SETRANGE("Customers Group Code",'FKT-DEB');
      //
      //    Customer.SETFILTER("No.",'VORAUS*');
      //    Customer.SETRANGE("Currency Code",SalesHeader."Currency Code");
      //    Customer.FIND('-');
          PrepayFound:=SalesHeader."Pre-Pay Amount (found)"; //bereits geleistete Vorauskasse
          //offene Zahlungen
          CustLedgerEntry.RESET;
          CustLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Customer No.",Open,Positive);
          CustLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
          CustLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
          CustLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,FALSE);
          IF CustLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
              CustLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS(CustLedgerEntry."Remaining Amount");
              RemainingAmount+=ABS(CustLedgerEntry."Remaining Amount");
            UNTIL CustLedgerEntry.NEXT=0;
          //offene Zahlungen
          //Paygate Zahlung
          IF MACPayGateHandling.IsPaymentMethodInPayGate(SalesHeader."Payment Method Code") THEN BEGIN
            PaygateEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
            PaygateEntry.SETRANGE("Amount ok",TRUE);
            IF PaygateEntry.FIND('-') THEN
              REPEAT
                PaygateAmount+=PaygateEntry."Request Amount";
              UNTIL PaygateEntry.NEXT=0;
          END;
          //Paygate Zahlung
          GenJournalBatch.GET('ZAHLGEING',lLocation);
          IF GenJournalLine.GET(GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name",GenJournalBatch.Name,20000) THEN
            GenJournalLine.DELETE;
          GenJournalLineTemp.INIT;
          GenJournalLineTemp."Journal Template Name":=GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name";
          GenJournalLineTemp."Journal Batch Name":=GenJournalBatch.Name;
          GenJournalLineTemp."Line No.":=20000;
          GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Document Type",GenJournalLineTemp."Document Type"::Payment);
          GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          //GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Order No. Reference",SalesHeader."No.");
          //GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Customer No. Reference",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
          GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLineTemp."Account Type"::Customer);
          //GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Account No.",Customer."No.");
          GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Account No.",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
          GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Posting Date",TODAY);
          GenJournalLineTemp.Description:=SystemValueLine."System Code"+' '+SalesHeader."No.";
          SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS(SalesHeader."Amount Including VAT");
          //GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE(Amount,(SalesHeader."Amount Including VAT"-PrepayFound-RemainingAmount)*-1);
          IF (SystemValueHead."Insert Text 1") AND (SystemValueLine."Text 2" <> '') THEN BEGIN
            GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Bal. Account Type",GenJournalLineTemp."Bal. Account Type"::"G/L Account");
            GenJournalLineTemp.VALIDATE("Bal. Account No.",SystemValueLine."Text 2");
          END;
          GenJournalLineTemp.INSERT;
          GenJournalLineTemp.RESET;
          GenJournalLineTemp.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name");
          GenJournalLineTemp.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",GenJournalBatch.Name);
          IF GenJournalLineTemp.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            GenJournalLine.INIT;
            GenJournalLine.TRANSFERFIELDS(GenJournalLineTemp);
            GenJournalLine.INSERT;
          END;
          COMMIT;
          GenJournalLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",GenJournalLine."Document Type"::Payment);
          GenJournalLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
          GenJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name");
          GenJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",GenJournalBatch.Name);
          IF GenJournalLine.FINDSET THEN
          PAGE.RUNMODAL(50076,GenJournalLine);
          COMMIT;
          ReleaseSalesDocument.ReleaseSalesOrder(SalesHeader,FALSE);

      //END;



      //01 18.11.21 NKON CHRON-4 Vorkasse vereinnahmen
    END;

    PROCEDURE ImportPaypal@301800046();
    VAR
      SettlementRegister@301800004 : Record 5275423;
      ExtInterfaceInboundFile@301800005 : Record 5275377;
      "PayPal Setup"@301800003 : Record 5275420;
      ExtInterfaceSetup@301820000 : Record 5275373;
      UseAutomatedImport@301800002 : Boolean;
      AutomatedFile@301800001 : Text[250];
      OrgFile_Name@301800000 : Text[1024];
      TempBlob@301800007 : Record 99008535;
      FileMgt@301800006 : Codeunit 419;
      ImportInbound@301820002 : Codeunit 5275369;
      KFileName@301820001 : Text;
    BEGIN
      // LF 25.05.23 GDRA CHRON-25 Settlement file direkt ins Buchblatt Åbernehmen-Paypal öbertragung
      ExtInterfaceInboundFile.SETFILTER("Message Code",'PAYPALFILE');
      ExtInterfaceInboundFile.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status::"to process");

      IF ExtInterfaceInboundFile.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT

          ExtInterfaceInboundFile.CALCFIELDS(SourceFile);
          TempBlob.Blob := ExtInterfaceInboundFile.SourceFile;

          KFileName := FileMgt.CombinePath(TEMPORARYPATH,ExtInterfaceInboundFile.Filename);
          FileMgt.BLOBExportToServerFile(TempBlob,KFileName);

          SettlementRegister.AutomatedImport("PayPal Setup",KFileName,ExtInterfaceInboundFile.Filename);
          SettlementRegister.ImportSettlementFile;

          ExtInterfaceInboundFile.VALIDATE(Status,ExtInterfaceInboundFile.Status::processed);
          ExtInterfaceInboundFile.MODIFY;
        UNTIL ExtInterfaceInboundFile.NEXT = 0;
      END;
      // LF 25.05.23 GDRA CHRON-25 Settlement file direkt ins Buchblatt Åbernehmen-Paypal öbertragung ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckDevaluationItemJournal@301510008(VAR ItemJournLine@301510000 : Record 83);
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510001 : Record 32;
      CheckitemJournalLine@301510002 : Record 83;
      ErrorDevaluation@301510003 : TextConst 'DEU=Artikel/Bestand/Faktura Zeile lîschen!;ENU=Iitem/inventory/factura Delete Line!';
      MessageDevalution@301510004 : TextConst 'DEU=wenn vorhanden werden fehlerhafte EintrÑge angezeigt!;ENU=displayed faulty entries!';
    BEGIN
      CheckitemJournalLine.RESET;
      CheckitemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",ItemJournLine."Journal Template Name");
      CheckitemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",ItemJournLine."Journal Batch Name");
      CheckitemJournalLine.SETRANGE(Devaluation,TRUE);
      IF CheckitemJournalLine.FIND('-') THEN
        REPEAT
          ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code","Serial No.",Open,Positive);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",CheckitemJournalLine."Item No.");
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",CheckitemJournalLine."Variant Code");
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",CheckitemJournalLine.CHRXTID);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Invoiced Quantity",'>%1',0);
          IF ItemLedgerEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            CheckitemJournalLine.MARK(TRUE);
            CheckitemJournalLine.Description:=ErrorDevaluation;
            CheckitemJournalLine.MODIFY(FALSE);
          END;
        UNTIL CheckitemJournalLine.NEXT=0;
        COMMIT;
        CheckitemJournalLine.MARKEDONLY(TRUE);
        MESSAGE(MessageDevalution);
        PAGE.RUNMODAL(40,CheckitemJournalLine);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateUpdateValueEntries@301510011(ItemJournalLine@301510001 : Record 83);
    VAR
      ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802;
      NewValueEntry@301510002 : Record 5802;
      InvtSetup@301510005 : Record 313;
      CurrExchRate@301510008 : Record 330;
      ItemRegister@301510010 : Record 46;
      InvtPostingToGL@301510006 : Codeunit 5802;
      CostDiff@301510003 : Decimal;
      OldCost@301510007 : Decimal;
      NextItemRegisterNo@301510011 : Integer;
      lItemJournal@301510009 : Record 83;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510013 : Record 32;
      Error01@301510004 : TextConst 'DEU=Fehlerhafte EintrÑge bitte lîschen!;ENU=Delete Wrong Lines!';
    BEGIN
      //GF 23.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung buchen
      IF NOT CheckDevaluationItemJournalBeforBook(ItemJournalLine) THEN
        ERROR(Error01);
      lItemJournal.RESET;
      lItemJournal.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",ItemJournalLine."Journal Template Name");
      lItemJournal.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",ItemJournalLine."Journal Batch Name");
      IF lItemJournal.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code","Serial No.",Open,Positive);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",lItemJournal."Item No.");
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",lItemJournal."Variant Code");
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",lItemJournal.CHRXTID);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
          ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
          IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
            ValueEntry.SETRANGE("Item Ledger Entry No.", ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
            ValueEntry.SETRANGE(Adjustment,FALSE);
            IF ValueEntry.CALCSUMS("Cost Amount (Expected)","Cost Amount (Actual)") THEN
              OldCost := ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)";
            IF ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN BEGIN
              ItemLedgerEntry."Devaluation Amount":=lItemJournal.Amount;
              ItemLedgerEntry.MODIFY(FALSE);
            END;
            // Get the original Purchase Price Entry
            ValueEntry.FINDFIRST();

            ValueEntry.LOCKTABLE();
            NewValueEntry.INIT();
            NewValueEntry.TRANSFERFIELDS(ValueEntry);

            NewValueEntry."Entry No." := GetNextValueEntryNo();
            NewValueEntry."Entry Type" := NewValueEntry."Entry Type"::Revaluation;
            IF NewValueEntry."Posting Date" < TODAY THEN
              NewValueEntry."Posting Date" := TODAY;
            NewValueEntry."Valuation Date" := TODAY;

            CostDiff :=lItemJournal.Amount;
            IF CostDiff > 0 THEN
              CostDiff:=CostDiff*-1
            ELSE
              CostDiff:=CostDiff*+1;
            //NewValueEntry."Purchase Amount (Expected)" := CostDiff;
            //NewValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)" := CostDiff;
            NewValueEntry."Expected Cost Posted to G/L" := CostDiff;
            NewValueEntry."Cost per Unit" := CostDiff;

            NewValueEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)":=CostDiff;
            NewValueEntry."Purchase Amount (Actual)":=CostDiff;
            NewValueEntry.Description := 'EK-PreisÑnderung';


            // Clear Fields
            NewValueEntry."Expected Cost Posted to G/L" := 0;
            NewValueEntry."Exp. Cost Posted to G/L (ACY)" := 0;
            NewValueEntry."Cost Posted to G/L" := 0;
            NewValueEntry."Cost Posted to G/L (ACY)" := 0;
            NewValueEntry."Item Ledger Entry Quantity" := 0;
            NewValueEntry."Purchase Amount (Expected)":=0;
            NewValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)":=0;
            NewValueEntry.Devaluation:=TRUE;
            NewValueEntry.CHRXID:=lItemJournal.CHRXTID;
            NewValueEntry."User ID" := USERID;
            NewValueEntry."Expected Cost":=FALSE;
            NewValueEntry.INSERT();

            //Artikeljournal ergÑnzen
            ItemRegister.RESET;
            ItemRegister.FIND('+');
            NextItemRegisterNo := ItemRegister."No." + 1;
            ItemRegister.INIT;
            ItemRegister."No." := NextItemRegisterNo;
            ItemRegister."Creation Date" := TODAY;
            ItemRegister."User ID" := USERID;
            ItemRegister."From Value Entry No." := NewValueEntry."Entry No.";
            ItemRegister."To Value Entry No." := NewValueEntry."Entry No.";
            ItemRegister."Source Code" := 'NEUBW';
            ItemRegister.INSERT;

            // Automatic Cost Posting
            InvtSetup.GET();
            IF InvtSetup."Automatic Cost Posting" THEN BEGIN
              IF InvtPostingToGL.BufferInvtPosting(NewValueEntry) THEN BEGIN
                InvtPostingToGL.Initialize(FALSE);
                InvtPostingToGL.RUN(NewValueEntry);
              END;
            END ELSE
              InsertPostValueEntryToGL(NewValueEntry);
          END;
        UNTIL lItemJournal.NEXT=0;
        lItemJournal.DELETEALL;
      END;
      //GF 23.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung buchen
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetNextValueEntryNo@301510010() ValueEntryNo : Integer;
    VAR
      ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802;
    BEGIN
      //GF 23.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung buchen
      IF ValueEntryNo > 0 THEN

      ValueEntry.LOCKTABLE;

        ValueEntryNo := ValueEntry."Entry No." + 1;
      //GF 23.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung buchen
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertPostValueEntryToGL@301510009(ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802);

    LOCAL PROCEDURE IsPostToGL@301510012(ValueEntry@301510000 : Record 5802) : Boolean;
    VAR
      InvtSetup@301510001 : Record 313;
    BEGIN
      //GF 23.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung buchen
      InvtSetup.GET();
      EXIT(ValueEntry.Inventoriable AND NOT InvtSetup."Automatic Cost Posting" AND
          (((NOT ValueEntry."Expected Cost") AND ((ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)" <> 0) OR (ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Actual) (ACY)" <> 0)))
          OR (InvtSetup."Expected Cost Posting to G/L" AND ((ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)" <> 0) OR (ValueEntry."Cost Amount (Expected) (ACY)" <> 0)))));
      //GF 23.08.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung buchen
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,80,OnAfterPostSalesDoc)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE OnAfterPostSalesOrderTransfer@301510014(VAR SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;VAR GenJnlPostLine@301510001 : Codeunit 12;SalesShptHdrNo@301510002 : Code[20];RetRcpHdrNo@301510003 : Code[20];SalesInvHdrNo@301510004 : Code[20];SalesCrMemoHdrNo@301510005 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      GenJournalLine@301510006 : Record 81;
      GenJournalBatch@301510007 : Record 232;
      lineNo@301510008 : Integer;
      PurchaseHeader@301510009 : Record 38;
      GenJnlPostLine1@301510010 : Codeunit 12;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510011 : Record 112;
      SalesCrMemoHeader@301510012 : Record 114;
      lAmount@301510013 : Decimal;
      GenJnlPost@301510014 : Codeunit 231;
      lCurrency@301510015 : Code[10];
      DiVAPrepayedManagement@301510018 : Codeunit 5104599;
      PrePeymantCustNo@301510017 : Code[20];
      SystemManagementSetup@301510016 : Record 5105000;
      Error01@301510019 : TextConst 'DEU=Zahlungsform %1 darf nicht umgebucht werden.;ENU=Payment method %1 cannot be transferred.';
    BEGIN
      //EV 29.09.23 NKON CRON-38 Umbuchen Verkauf
      IF SalesHeader."Transfer Purch Order" = '' THEN EXIT;
      IF NOT CheckPaymentMethode(SalesHeader."Payment Method Code") THEN
        ERROR(Error01,STRSUBSTNO(SalesHeader."Payment Method Code"));
      IF SalesInvoiceHeader.GET(SalesInvHdrNo) THEN BEGIN
        SalesInvoiceHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
        lAmount:=SalesInvoiceHeader."Amount Including VAT";
      END;
      IF SalesCrMemoHeader.GET(SalesCrMemoHdrNo) THEN BEGIN
        SalesCrMemoHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
        lAmount:=(SalesCrMemoHeader."Amount Including VAT"*-1);
      END;
      IF NOT PurchaseHeader.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order,SalesHeader."Transfer Purch Order") THEN EXIT;
      GenJournalBatch.GET('ALLGEMEIN','UMBUCH');
      GenJournalLine.RESET;
      GenJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name");
      GenJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",GenJournalBatch.Name);
      IF GenJournalLine.FIND('+') THEN
        GenJournalLine.DELETEALL;

      lineNo:=1000;

      GenJournalLine.INIT;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Template Name":=GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name";
      GenJournalLine."Journal Batch Name":=GenJournalBatch.Name;
      GenJournalLine."Line No.":=lineNo;
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Customer);
      SystemManagementSetup.GET;
      CLEAR(SystemManagementSetup."Customer No. Prepay" );
      DiVAPrepayedManagement.GetPrepCustFromSH(SalesHeader,SystemManagementSetup);
      IF SystemManagementSetup."Customer No. Prepay" <> '' THEN BEGIN
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",SystemManagementSetup."Customer No. Prepay");
      //  GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Customer No. Reference",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      //  GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Order No. Reference",SalesHeader."No.");
      END ELSE
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Posting Date",TODAY);
      GenJournalLine.Description:='Transfer'+' '+SalesHeader."No.";
      SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS(Amount);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,(lAmount*-1));
      lCurrency:=GenJournalLine."Currency Code";
      GenJournalLine.INSERT;

      GenJournalLine.INIT;
      GenJournalLine."Journal Template Name":=GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name";
      GenJournalLine."Journal Batch Name":=GenJournalBatch.Name;
      GenJournalLine."Line No.":=lineNo+1;
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account Type",GenJournalLine."Account Type"::Vendor);
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Account No.",PurchaseHeader."Buy-from Vendor No.");
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Posting Date",TODAY);
      GenJournalLine.Description:='Transfer'+' '+SalesHeader."No.";
      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,lAmount);
      GenJournalLine.TESTFIELD("Currency Code",lCurrency);
      GenJournalLine.INSERT;
      //COMMIT;
      // GenJournalLine.RESET;
      // GenJournalLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
      // IF GenJournalLine.FINDSET THEN
      //GenJnlPostLine1.RunWithoutCheck(GenJournalLine)
      GenJnlPost.SetPrevies(TRUE);
      GenJnlPost.RUN(GenJournalLine);
      //CODEUNIT.RUN(CODEUNIT::"Gen. Jnl.-Post",GenJournalLine);
    END;

       DiVAPrepayedManagement.GetPrepCustFromSH(SalesHeader,SystemManagementSetup);
       IF SystemManagementSetup."Customer No. Prepay" <> '' THEN BEGIN

      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,(lAmount*-1));

      GenJournalLine."Journal Template Name":=GenJournalBatch."Journal Template Name";
      GenJournalLine."Journal Batch Name":=GenJournalBatch.Name;

      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE("Posting Date",TODAY);

      GenJournalLine.VALIDATE(Amount,(lAmount));

    [EventSubscriber(Page,50,OnAfterValidateEvent,"Transfer Sales Order")]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckpaymentMethodeonPO@301510017(VAR Rec@301510000 : Record 38;VAR xRec@301510001 : Record 38);

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ShipPurchOrder@301490001();
    VAR
      IntercompanyOrderEntry@301490000 : Record 85004;
      PurchaseHeader@301490001 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301490002 : Record 39;
      ReleasePurchDoc@301490003 : Codeunit 415;
      SystemValueLine@301490004 : Record 5105031;
      WarehouseReceiptLine@301490005 : Record 7317;
      WarehouseReceiptHeader@301490006 : Record 7316;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301490007 : Record 5767;
      PostedWhseReceiptLine@301490008 : Record 7319;
      PostedWhseReceiptHeader@301490009 : Record 7318;
      WhseActRegisterYesNo@301490010 : Codeunit 7306;
      "Purch.-Post"@301510000 : Codeunit 90;
      VendorNo@301490011 : Code[100];
      SystemValueLine1@301490012 : Record 5105031;
      WhsePostReceipt@301510002 : Codeunit 5760;
      CHNXAttributeMgt@301510001 : Codeunit 85020;
      Text001Loc@301510003 : TextConst 'DEU=EK-Bestellung fehlt!';
      Text002Loc@301510004 : TextConst 'DEU=Herstellerseriennr. fehlt!';
      Text003Loc@301510005 : TextConst 'DEU=Diff. Best. ist falsch';
    BEGIN
      //01 11.11.20 ERP-149 NKON Fehler Counter
      SetErrorIN;
      //01 11.11.20 ERP-149 NKON Fehler Counter
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(61033,'PURCHBV') THEN
        IF SystemValueLine."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN

          SystemValueLine1.SETRANGE("System Value No.",61033);
          SystemValueLine1.SETRANGE("Code Value 1",SystemValueLine."System Code");
          IF SystemValueLine1.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              IF VendorNo <>'' THEN
                VendorNo:=VendorNo+'|'+SystemValueLine1."System Code"
              ELSE
                VendorNo :=SystemValueLine1."System Code";
            UNTIL SystemValueLine1.NEXT=0;
          END;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.RESET;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(Status,IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Purchase Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Sales Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Purchase Order Ship",FALSE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(WareHouseBook,TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETFILTER("Manufacturer SerialNo.",'<>%1',' ');
          IF IntercompanyOrderEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
              PurchaseHeader.RESET;
              // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
              PurchaseHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Buy-from Vendor No.","No.");
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
              PurchaseHeader.SETFILTER("Buy-from Vendor No.",VendorNo);
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Company Sales Order");
              IF PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
               IF PurchaseHeader.Status=PurchaseHeader.Status::Released THEN
                  ReleasePurchDoc.Reopen(PurchaseHeader);
               // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
                PurchaseLine.RESET;
                // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry.Item);
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Item Variant");
                IF PurchaseLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                  PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Direct Unit Cost",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Unit Price");
                  PurchaseLine.Audit:=FALSE;
                  PurchaseLine.Box:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Box;
                  PurchaseLine.Certificate:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Certifikat;
                  PurchaseLine."Used good":=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Gebraucht;
                  //ERP-75 NKON bei Validate werden Buchungsgruppen gedreht 11.03.21
                  PurchaseLine.VALIDATE("Differential Taxation",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Diff. Best. Einkauf");
                  //PurchaseLine."Differential Taxation":=IntercompanyOrderEntry."Diff. Best. Einkauf";
                  PurchaseLine.Audit:=TRUE;

                  PurchaseLine.MODIFY;
                  IF PurchaseHeader.Status=PurchaseHeader.Status::Open THEN
                    ReleasePurchDoc.PerformManualRelease(PurchaseHeader);
                    COMMIT;
                  WarehouseReceiptLine.RESET;
                  WarehouseReceiptLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source No.","Source Line No.");
                  WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Type",39);
                  WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",PurchaseLine."Document No.");
                  WarehouseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PurchaseLine."Line No.");
                  IF WarehouseReceiptLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                    WarehouseReceiptLine."IC SerialNo.":=IntercompanyOrderEntry.SerialNo;
                    WarehouseReceiptLine."Warranty Date":=IntercompanyOrderEntry."Warrenty Date";
                    WarehouseReceiptLine.MODIFY;
                    WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE("Qty. in Stock",WarehouseReceiptLine.Quantity);
                    WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE("Qty. to Receive",WarehouseReceiptLine.Quantity);
                    WarehouseReceiptLine."Manufacturer SerialNo.":=IntercompanyOrderEntry."Manufacturer SerialNo.";
                    WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE(Box,IntercompanyOrderEntry.Box);
                    WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE(Certificate,IntercompanyOrderEntry.Certifikat);
                    WarehouseReceiptLine.VALIDATE("Used good",IntercompanyOrderEntry.Gebraucht);

                    WarehouseReceiptLine.MODIFY;
                    // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
                    IF PurchaseLine."Differential Taxation" = IntercompanyOrderEntry."Diff. Best. Einkauf" THEN BEGIN
                    // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Purchase Order Ship":=TRUE;
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Purchase Order":=PurchaseLine."Document No.";
                      //01 11.11.20 ERP-149 NKON Fehler Counter
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error Counter IN"+=1;
                      //01 11.11.20 ERP-149 NKON Fehler Counter
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY;
                      WhsePostReceipt.RUN(WarehouseReceiptLine);
                      COMMIT;
                      IF IntercompanyOrderEntry."Manufacturer SerialNo." <> '' THEN
                        CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeManufacturerSerialNo(IntercompanyOrderEntry.Item,IntercompanyOrderEntry."Item Variant",IntercompanyOrderEntry.SerialNo,IntercompanyOrderEntry."Manufacturer SerialNo.");
                      IF IntercompanyOrderEntry."Warrenty Date" <> 0D THEN
                        CHNXAttributeMgt.CreateAttributeWarrantyDate(IntercompanyOrderEntry.Item,IntercompanyOrderEntry."Item Variant",IntercompanyOrderEntry.SerialNo,IntercompanyOrderEntry."Warrenty Date");
                    END ELSE BEGIN
                      // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error Counter IN"+=1;
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=Text003Loc;
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY;
                      // 01 01.03.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
                    END;

                  END;
                END;
              END ELSE BEGIN
                IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
                IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error Counter IN"+=1;
                IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=Text001Loc;
                IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY;
              END;
            UNTIL IntercompanyOrderEntry.NEXT=0;
          END;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.RESET;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(Status,IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Purchase Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Sales Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Purchase Order Ship",FALSE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(WareHouseBook,TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETFILTER("Manufacturer SerialNo.",'%1',' ');
          IF IntercompanyOrderEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN REPEAT
            IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
            IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error Counter IN"+=1;
            IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=Text002Loc;
            IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY;
          UNTIL IntercompanyOrderEntry.NEXT=0;
        END;
      END;

    END;

    PROCEDURE CalcUnitPriceIC@301490002(SalesLine@301490000 : Record 37;VAR CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys@301510001 : Record 85104) : Decimal;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301490001 : Record 32;
      UnitPriceLoc@301490002 : Decimal;
      VATPostingSetup@301490003 : Record 325;
      Item@301510000 : Record 27;
      CHXICEntry@301510002 : Record 85104;
    BEGIN
      //EK-Preis aus Artikelposten ermitteln. Aufruf Create Order
      CLEAR(UnitPriceLoc);
      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.",Open,"Variant Code",Positive,"Location Code","Posting Date","Duty Sign");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      //ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          CLEAR(UnitPriceLoc);
          CHXICEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Item No.");
          CHXICEntry.SETRANGE("Item Variant",CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Item Variant");
          CHXICEntry.SETRANGE("Insertet at",CREATEDATETIME(CALCDATE('<-4D>',TODAY),120000T));
          CHXICEntry.SETRANGE("Unit Price",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
          IF CHXICEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)", "Cost Amount (Actual)");
            UnitPriceLoc:=(ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)") /ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity;
            //IF NOT SalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible" THEN BEGIN
            IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN BEGIN
              IF VATPostingSetup.GET(SalesLine."VAT Bus. Posting Group",SalesLine."VAT Prod. Posting Group") THEN BEGIN
                UnitPriceLoc:=(UnitPriceLoc/100)*(100+VATPostingSetup."VAT %");
                UnitPriceLoc := ROUND(UnitPriceLoc, 0.01, '>');
              END;
            END;
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Unit Price":=ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.";//missbrauch NKON 05.09.22
            EXIT(UnitPriceLoc);
          END;
        UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT=0;
      END;
    END;
