            REPEAT
              IF VendorNo <>'' THEN
                VendorNo:=VendorNo+'|'+SystemValueLine1."System Code"
              ELSE
                VendorNo :=SystemValueLine1."System Code";
            UNTIL SystemValueLine1.NEXT=0;
          END;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.RESET;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(Status,IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Purchase Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Sales Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Purchase Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(WareHouseBook,TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Storage Create",FALSE);
          IF IntercompanyOrderEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              PurchaseHeader.SETCURRENTKEY("Document Type","Buy-from Vendor No.","No.");
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
              PurchaseHeader.SETFILTER("Buy-from Vendor No.",VendorNo);
              PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Company Sales Order");
              IF PurchaseHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type");
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE(Type,PurchaseLine.Type::Item);
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry.Item);
                PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Item Variant");
                IF PurchaseLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                    //Einlagerung erstellen
                  PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Type","Source Subtype","Source No.","Source Line No.","Posted Source Document","Posted Source No.");
                  PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Purchase Order");
                  PostedWhseReceiptLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PurchaseLine."Line No.");
                  IF PostedWhseReceiptLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                    PostedWhseReceiptLine.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
                    PostedWhseReceiptHeader.GET(PostedWhseReceiptLine."No.");
                    //PostedWhseReceiptLine.CreatePutAwayDoc(PostedWhseReceiptLine,PostedWhseReceiptHeader."Assigned User ID");
                    //Einlagerung suchen registieren.
                    WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Line No.","Source Subline No.","Serial No.","Lot No.");
                    WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Purchase Order");
                    WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PurchaseLine."Line No.");
                    //WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place);
                    IF WarehouseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                      REPEAT
                        CLEAR(WarehouseActivityLine."Zone Code");
                        WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Qty. to Handle",WarehouseActivityLine.Quantity);
                        IF WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type" = WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place THEN
                          IF WarehouseActivityLine."Item No."='BOX' THEN
                            WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Box Bin Content")
                          ELSE
                            WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Bin Content");
                        WarehouseActivityLine.MODIFY;
                      UNTIL WarehouseActivityLine.NEXT =0;
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Posted Warehouse DocNo.":=PostedWhseReceiptLine."No.";
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Storage Create":=TRUE;
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Storage No.":=WarehouseActivityLine."No.";
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Abgeschlossen;
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Finished on":=TODAY;
                      IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY;
                      COMMIT;
                      WhseActRegisterYesNo.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
                      WhseActRegisterYesNo.RUN(WarehouseActivityLine);
                      COMMIT;
                      PurchaseHeader.Invoice:=TRUE;
                      PurchaseHeader."Vendor Invoice No.":=IntercompanyOrderEntry."Company Sales Order";
                      PurchaseHeader."Posting Date":=TODAY;
                      PurchaseHeader.MODIFY;
                      "Purch.-Post".RUN(PurchaseHeader);
                      //01 04.10.23 NKON CHRON-34 prÅfen ob gebucht
                      IF NOT POCheck.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type",PurchaseHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry."Invoiced PO":=TRUE;
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY(FALSE);
                      END;
                      //01 04.10.23 NKON  CHRON-34 prÅfen ob gebucht
                    END ELSE BEGIN
                      PostedWhseReceiptLine.CreatePutAwayDoc(PostedWhseReceiptLine,PostedWhseReceiptHeader."Assigned User ID");
                      WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Line No.","Source Subline No.","Serial No.","Lot No.");
                      WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Purchase Order");
                      WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",PurchaseLine."Line No.");
                      //WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place);
                      IF WarehouseActivityLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                        REPEAT
                          WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Qty. to Handle",WarehouseActivityLine.Quantity);
                          IF WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type" = WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place THEN
                            IF WarehouseActivityLine."Item No."='BOX' THEN
                              WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Box Bin Content")
                            ELSE
                              WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Bin Content");
                          WarehouseActivityLine.MODIFY;
                        UNTIL WarehouseActivityLine.NEXT =0;
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry."Posted Warehouse DocNo.":=PostedWhseReceiptLine."No.";
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry."Storage Create":=TRUE;
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry."Storage No.":=WarehouseActivityLine."No.";
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Abgeschlossen;
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry."Finished on":=TODAY;
                        IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY;
                        COMMIT;
                        WhseActRegisterYesNo.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
                        WhseActRegisterYesNo.RUN(WarehouseActivityLine);
                        COMMIT;
                        PurchaseHeader.Invoice:=TRUE;
                        PurchaseHeader."Vendor Invoice No.":=IntercompanyOrderEntry."Company Sales Order";
                        PurchaseHeader."Posting Date":=TODAY;
                        PurchaseHeader.MODIFY;
                        "Purch.-Post".RUN(PurchaseHeader);
                        //01 04.10.23 NKON CHRON-34 prÅfen ob gebucht
                        IF NOT POCheck.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type",PurchaseHeader."No.") THEN BEGIN
                          IntercompanyOrderEntry."Invoiced PO":=TRUE;
                          IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY(FALSE);
                        END;
                      //01 04.10.23 NKON CHRON-34 prÅfen ob gebucht
                      END;
                    END;
                  END;
                END;
              END;
            UNTIL IntercompanyOrderEntry.NEXT=0;
          END;
          //01 04.10.23 NKON CHRON-34 prÅfen ob gebucht
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.RESET;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Purchase Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Sales Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Purchase Order Ship",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(WareHouseBook,TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Storage Create",TRUE);
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Invoiced PO",FALSE);
          IF IntercompanyOrderEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              IF POCheck.GET(POCheck."Document Type"::Order,IntercompanyOrderEntry."Purchase Order") THEN BEGIN
                POCheck.Invoice:=TRUE;
                POCheck."Vendor Invoice No.":=IntercompanyOrderEntry."Company Sales Order";
                POCheck."Posting Date":=TODAY;
                POCheck.MODIFY;
                "Purch.-Post".RUN(POCheck);
              END ELSE BEGIN
                IntercompanyOrderEntry."Invoiced PO":=TRUE;
                IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY(FALSE);
              END;
            UNTIL IntercompanyOrderEntry.NEXT=0
          END;
        //01 04.10.23 NKON CHRON-34 prÅfen ob gebucht
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalcUnitPriceICwithSerial@301490004(VAR SalesLine@301490000 : Record 37;SerialNo@301490004 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301490001 : Record 32;
      UnitPriceLoc@301490002 : Decimal;
      VATPostingSetup@301490003 : Record 325;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301490005 : Record 7505;
      SL@301490006 : Record 37;
      gCHNXChronextIDMgt@301510000 : Codeunit 85010;
      ReservationEntry@301510001 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      //EK-Preis aus Artikelposten ermitteln. Aufruf Create Order
      // 01 17.09.20 NKON ERP-109 Preis fÅr IC muss aus Artikelposten gesetzt werden
      CLEAR(UnitPriceLoc);
      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.",Open,"Variant Code",Positive,"Location Code","Posting Date","Duty Sign");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",SerialNo);
      //ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(6504,SalesLine."No.",48,SalesLine."Variant Code",SerialNo) THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          ItemLedgerEntry."Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.":=ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text";
          ItemLedgerEntry.MODIFY;
        END;
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)", "Cost Amount (Actual)");
        UnitPriceLoc:=(ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)") /ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity;
        //IF NOT SalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible" THEN BEGIN
      //  IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN BEGIN
      //    IF VATPostingSetup.GET(SalesLine."VAT Bus. Posting Group",SalesLine."VAT Prod. Posting Group") THEN BEGIN
      //      UnitPriceLoc:=(UnitPriceLoc/100)*(100+VATPostingSetup."VAT %");
      //      UnitPriceLoc := ROUND(UnitPriceLoc, 0.01, '>');
      //    END;
      //  END;
        SalesLine."Differential Taxation":=ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
        IF UnitPriceLoc <> 0 THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost",UnitPriceLoc);
          SalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",(UnitPriceLoc*SalesLine.Quantity));
        END;

      END;
      // 01 17.09.20 NKON ERP-109 Preis fÅr IC muss aus Artikelposten gesetzt werden
    END;

    PROCEDURE FindQuantityAtCompany@301490006(VAR SalesLine@301490000 : Record 37);
    VAR
      ItemSourceCompany@301490001 : Record 27;
      ItemVariantSourceCompany@301510004 : Record 5401;
      ItemTargetCompany@301510001 : Record 27;
      CHNXIntercompanySetup@301510000 : Record 85103;
      ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany@301510002 : Record 32;
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany@301510005 : Record 32;
      Purchasing@301510003 : Record 5721;
      SalesLineCount@301510006 : Record 37;
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys@301510007 : Record 85104;
    BEGIN
      IF SalesLine."Sell-to Customer No." = 'CXT PURCHASING BV' THEN EXIT;
      // 01 09.06.22 JHAN MSD-19229 InterCompany Order
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      IF SalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible" = FALSE THEN
        ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation Purchase",FALSE);
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
      //06.09.22 NKON bereits reservierte
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
      ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
      //06.09.22 NKON bereits reservierte
      IF ItemLedgerEntrySourceCompany.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          CHNXIntercompanySetup.RESET;
          CHNXIntercompanySetup.SETRANGE("Intercompany Active",TRUE);
          IF CHNXIntercompanySetup.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              // 01 30.08.22 JHAN MSD-19229 Intercompany / ArtikelverfÅgbarkeit
              SalesLineCount.RESET;
              SalesLineCount.SETRANGE("Intercompany Code",CHNXIntercompanySetup."Intercompany Code");
              SalesLineCount.SETRANGE("No.", SalesLine."No.");
              SalesLineCount.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
              SalesLineCount.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
              // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders
              SalesLineCount.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
              SalesLineCount.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
              // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders END
              // 01 30.08.22 JHAN MSD-19229 Intercompany / ArtikelverfÅgbarkeit ENDE
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.RESET;
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.CHANGECOMPANY(CHNXIntercompanySetup."Intercompany Code");
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
              IF SalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible" = FALSE THEN
                ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation Purchase",FALSE);
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
              // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
              // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders ENDE
              ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.SETRANGE("Reserved Quantity",0);
              IF CHNXIntercompanySetup."Location Code" <> '' THEN
                ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.SETFILTER("Location Code",CHNXIntercompanySetup."Location Code");
              // 01 30.08.22 JHAN MSD-19229 Intercompany / ArtikelverfÅgbarkeit
              //IF NOT ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.ISEMPTY THEN
              IF NOT ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
                // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders
                //IF SalesLineCount.COUNT <= ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.COUNT THEN BEGIN
                IF SalesLineCount.COUNT < ItemLedgerEntryTargetCompany.COUNT THEN BEGIN
                // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders END
                // 01 30.08.22 JHAN MSD-19229 Intercompany / ArtikelverfÅgbarkeit ENDE
                  SalesLine."Intercompany Code" := CHNXIntercompanySetup."Intercompany Code";
                  IF Purchasing.FINDFIRST THEN
                    SalesLine."Purchasing Code" := Purchasing.Code;
                  SalesLine.MODIFY;
                // 01 30.08.22 JHAN MSD-19229 Intercompany / ArtikelverfÅgbarkeit
                END;
                // 01 30.08.22 JHAN MSD-19229 Intercompany / ArtikelverfÅgbarkeit ENDE
              // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders
              END;
              // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders END
            UNTIL CHNXIntercompanySetup.NEXT = 0;
          END;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateInterCompanyEntryFromPO@301510000(PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38);
    VAR
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys@301510001 : Record 85104;
      PurchaseLine@301510003 : Record 39;
      SalesLine@301510002 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // 01 09.06.22 JHAN MSD-19229 InterCompany Order
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.RESET;
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.SETRANGE("Source Company Code",COMPANYNAME);
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.SETRANGE("Source Purchase Order",PurchaseHeader."No.");
      IF CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        PurchaseLine.RESET;
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
        PurchaseLine.SETFILTER("Special Order Sales No.",'<>%1','');
        IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SalesLine.RESET;
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseLine."Special Order Sales No.");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",PurchaseLine."No.");
          SalesLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",PurchaseLine."Special Order Sales Line No.");
          IF SalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.INIT;
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Company Code" := COMPANYNAME;
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Purchase Order" := PurchaseHeader."No.";
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Target Company Code" := SalesLine."Intercompany Code";
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Item No." := PurchaseLine."No.";
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Item Variant" := PurchaseLine."Variant Code";
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Quantity := PurchaseLine.Quantity;
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Status := CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Status::New;
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Insertet at" := CURRENTDATETIME;
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Sales Order" := PurchaseLine."Special Order Sales No.";
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Unit Price" := PurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT";
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Diff. Taxed. Purch." := PurchaseLine."Differential Taxation";
            CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.INSERT(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSalesOrderInterCompany@301510002();
    VAR
      CHNXIntercompanySetup@301510000 : Record 85103;
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys@301510001 : Record 85104;
      SourceSalesHeader@301510002 : Record 36;
      SourceSalesLine@301510003 : Record 37;
      TargetSalesHeader@301510004 : Record 36;
      TargetSalesLine@301510005 : Record 37;
      SourcePurchaseHeader@301510006 : Record 38;
      SourcePurchaseLine@301510007 : Record 39;
      TargetCustomer@301510009 : Record 18;
      TargetItem@301510010 : Record 27;
      TempSalesLine@301510011 : Record 37;
      UnitofMeasure@301510015 : Record 204;
      CalChange@301510013 : Record 7602;
      VATPostingSetup@301510014 : Record 325;
      PromotionMedium@301510016 : Record 5104501;
      DocumentValueManagement@301510020 : Codeunit 5295670;

      pRecordID@301510018 : RecordID;
      UnitPriceIC@301510021 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // LF 21.06.22 JHAN MSD-19229 InterCompany Order
      // Create SalesOrder in Target Company
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.RESET;
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.SETRANGE(Status,CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Status::New);
      CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.SETRANGE("Target Company Code",COMPANYNAME);
      IF CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        CHNXIntercompanySetup.CHANGECOMPANY(CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Company Code");
        SourcePurchaseHeader.CHANGECOMPANY(CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Company Code");
        SourcePurchaseLine.CHANGECOMPANY(CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Company Code");
        SourceSalesLine.CHANGECOMPANY(CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Company Code");
        REPEAT
          CHNXIntercompanySetup.RESET;
          CHNXIntercompanySetup.SETRANGE("Intercompany Code",CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Target Company Code");
          CHNXIntercompanySetup.SETRANGE("Intercompany Active",TRUE);
          IF CHNXIntercompanySetup.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            IF SourcePurchaseHeader.GET(SourcePurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order,CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Source Purchase Order") THEN BEGIN
              SourcePurchaseLine.RESET;
              SourcePurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SourcePurchaseHeader."No.");
              IF SourcePurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                IF TargetCustomer.GET(CHNXIntercompanySetup."Customer No.") THEN BEGIN
                  //SalesHeader
                  TargetSalesHeader.INIT;
                  TargetSalesHeader."No." := NoSeriesMgt.GetNextNo(CHNXIntercompanySetup."Number series for Orders",TODAY,TRUE);
                  TargetSalesHeader.VALIDATE("Document Type",TargetSalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
                  TargetSalesHeader."Order Date" := TODAY;
                  TargetSalesHeader."Order Time" := TIME;
                  TargetSalesHeader."Inserted from" := USERID;
                  TargetSalesHeader."Salesperson Code" := USERID;
                  TargetSalesHeader."Insert Date" := TODAY;
                  TargetSalesHeader."Insert Time" := TIME;
                  TargetSalesHeader.INSERT;
                  TargetSalesHeader.VALIDATE("Sell-to Customer No.",CHNXIntercompanySetup."Customer No.");
                  TargetSalesHeader."Ship-to Contact No." := CHNXIntercompanySetup."Customer No.";
                  TargetSalesHeader."External Document No." := TargetSalesHeader."No.";
                  TargetSalesHeader."Payment Method Code" := CHNXIntercompanySetup."Payment Method Code";
                  TargetSalesHeader."Shipping Agent Code" := CHNXIntercompanySetup."Shipping Agent Code";
                  TargetSalesHeader."Shipping No. Series" :='V-LIEF';
                  TargetSalesHeader."Prom.Med.No." := 'CHRONEXT_EUR';
                  TargetSalesHeader."Prom.Med.Tar.Grp.No." := 'STD';
                  TargetSalesHeader."Must-Shipping Agent" := TRUE;
                  TargetSalesHeader."Minimum Qty. add. costs Option" := TargetSalesHeader."Minimum Qty. add. costs Option"::"manual Minimum Qty. add. costs";
                  TargetSalesHeader."Freshness add. costs Option" := TargetSalesHeader."Freshness add. costs Option"::"manual Freshness add. costs";
                  //TargetSalesHeader."Status Approve Order" := TargetSalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::"Waiting For Approval";
                  //TargetSalesHeader."Status Address Check" :=  TargetSalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Ignore;
                  TargetSalesHeader.MODIFY;

                  //SalesLine
                  TargetSalesLine.INIT;
                  TargetSalesLine."Document Type" := TargetSalesLine."Document Type"::Order;
                  TargetSalesLine."Line No." := 10000;
                  TargetSalesLine."Document No." := TargetSalesHeader."No.";
                  TargetSalesLine."Sell-to Customer No." := TargetCustomer."No.";
                  TargetSalesLine.Type := TargetSalesLine.Type::Item;
                  TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE("No.",SourcePurchaseLine."No.");
                  TargetSalesLine."Variant Code" := SourcePurchaseLine."Variant Code";
                  //NKON 22.08.22 Berechnung EK-Preis angepasst
                  //TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE(TargetSalesLine."Unit Price",SourcePurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT");
                  TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,SourcePurchaseLine.Quantity);
                  TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE("Outstanding Quantity",SourcePurchaseLine.Quantity);
                  //TargetSalesLine.Amount := SourcePurchaseLine."Unit Cost";
                  UnitPriceIC:=CalcUnitPriceIC(TargetSalesLine,CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys);
                  IF UnitPriceIC <> 0 THEN BEGIN
                    TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost",UnitPriceIC);
                    TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",(UnitPriceIC*SourcePurchaseLine.Quantity));
                    TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE(Amount,UnitPriceIC);
                  END;
      //            END ELSE BEGIN
      //              TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Cost",SourcePurchaseLine.Amount);
      //              TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE("Unit Price",(SourcePurchaseLine.Amount*SourcePurchaseLine.Quantity));
      //              TargetSalesLine.VALIDATE(Amount,SourcePurchaseLine.Amount);
      //
      //            END;






      //            TargetSalesLine."Amount Including VAT" := SourcePurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT";
      //            TargetSalesLine."Outstanding Amount" := SourcePurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT";
      //            TargetSalesLine."Outstanding Amount (LCY)" := SourcePurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT";
      //            TargetSalesLine."VAT Base Amount" := SourcePurchaseLine."Unit Cost";
      //            TargetSalesLine."Line Amount" := SourcePurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT";
      //            TargetSalesLine."Quantity (Base)" := SourcePurchaseLine."Quantity (Base)";

                  //TargetSalesLine."Set Unit Price" := SourcePurchaseLine."Amount Including VAT";
                  //NKON 22.08.22 Berechnung EK-Preis angepasst
                  TargetSalesLine.Planned := FALSE;
                  TargetSalesLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)" := SourcePurchaseLine."Outstanding Qty. (Base)";
                  TargetSalesLine."Transfer Order Line No." := TargetSalesLine."Line No.";
                  IF SourceSalesLine.GET(SourceSalesLine."Document Type"::Order,SourcePurchaseLine."Special Order Sales No.",SourcePurchaseLine."Special Order Sales Line No.") THEN
                    TargetSalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible" := SourceSalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible";
                  TargetSalesLine.INSERT;

                  //SourcePurchaseHeader aktualisieren
                  SourcePurchaseHeader."Vendor Order No." := TargetSalesHeader."No.";
                  SourcePurchaseHeader.MODIFY;

                  // Intercompany Order Entrys aktualisieren
                  CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Target Sales Order" := TargetSalesHeader."No.";
                  CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys."Processed at" := CURRENTDATETIME;
                  CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.MODIFY;

                  //Transaction Security genehmigen
                  pRecordID := TargetSalesHeader.RECORDID;
                  CustomerManagement.ResetStatusOrder(TargetSalesHeader);
                  CustomerManagement.DeclineOrIgnoreAddressChange(pRecordID,TargetSalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.",TRUE);
                  CustomerManagement.DoExportSalesOrderToExtInterface(TargetSalesHeader."External Document No.",'UPDORDFILE');
                  DocumentValueManagement.TableFieldNoSaveOrModifyValueToEntry(pRecordID,TargetSalesHeader.FIELDNO("Status Approve Order"),TargetSalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved);

                  //Transaktion erfolgreich
                  CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Status := CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Status::Done;
                  CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.MODIFY;
                END ELSE BEGIN
                  CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Status := CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.Status::Error;
                  CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.MODIFY;
                END;
              END;
            END;
          END;
          COMMIT;
        UNTIL CHNXIntercompanyOrderEntrys.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckBeforebookOut@301510003();
    VAR
      IntercompanyOrderEntry@301510000 : Record 85004;
      SalesLine@301510001 : Record 37;
      CHNXChronextIDMgt@301510002 : Codeunit 85010;
      ErrorMF@301510003 : TextConst 'DEU=Herstellerseriennr. fehlt!;ENU=Manufacturer Serial missing!';
      ErrorBinItem@301510004 : TextConst 'DEU=Lagerplatzinhalt Artikel fehlt!;ENU=Missing Item Bin Content!';
      ErrorBinbox@301510005 : TextConst 'DEU=Lagerplatzinhalt Box fehlt!;ENU=Missing Box Bin Content!';
      WarehouseShipmentHeader@301510006 : Record 7320;
      WarehouseShipmentLine@301510007 : Record 7321;
      BinContent@301510008 : Record 7302;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510009 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      IntercompanyOrderEntry.RESET;
      IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETFILTER(Status,'%1|%2',IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung,IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler);
      IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Purchase Order Ship",TRUE);
      IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Sales Order Ship",FALSE);
      IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(WareHouseBook,FALSE);
      IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE(Company,COMPANYNAME);
      IF IntercompanyOrderEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung;
          IF IntercompanyOrderEntry."Manufacturer SerialNo." = '' THEN BEGIN
            SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
            SalesLine.SETRANGE("No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry.Item);
            SalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Item Variant");
            IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              IntercompanyOrderEntry."Manufacturer SerialNo.":=CHNXChronextIDMgt.GetSerialNoSalesLine(SalesLine);
              IF IntercompanyOrderEntry."Manufacturer SerialNo." <> '' THEN BEGIN
                IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung;
              END ELSE BEGIN
                IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
                IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=ErrorMF;
              END;
            END;
          END;
          IF IntercompanyOrderEntry."Whse. No." = '' THEN BEGIN
            WarehouseShipmentLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Source No.","Source Type");
            WarehouseShipmentLine.SETRANGE("Source No.",IntercompanyOrderEntry."Company Sales Order");
            IF WarehouseShipmentLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
              WarehouseShipmentHeader.GET(WarehouseShipmentLine."No.");
              IntercompanyOrderEntry."Whse. No.":=WarehouseShipmentHeader."No.";
            END;
          END;
          IF (IntercompanyOrderEntry."Bin Content" = '') AND (IntercompanyOrderEntry."Box Bin Content" = '') THEN BEGIN
            IF IntercompanyOrderEntry.ItemLedgerEntryNo <> 0 THEN BEGIN
              IF ItemLedgerEntry.GET(IntercompanyOrderEntry.ItemLedgerEntryNo) THEN BEGIN
                ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Blocked By Whse. Rcpt.");
                IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry."Blocked By Whse. Rcpt." THEN
                  IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung
                ELSE BEGIN
                  IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
                  IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":='offene IST-Wareneingang';
                END;
              END;
            END ELSE BEGIN
              IF IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error Counter Out" = 10 THEN BEGIN
                IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=ErrorBinItem;
                IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
              END ELSE
                IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error Counter Out":=10;
            END;
          END ELSE
            IF NOT BinContent.GET('HL',IntercompanyOrderEntry."Bin Content",IntercompanyOrderEntry.Item,IntercompanyOrderEntry."Item Variant",'STCK') THEN BEGIN
              IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=ErrorBinItem;
              IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
            END;
      //    IF IntercompanyOrderEntry."Box Bin Content" = '' THEN BEGIN
      //      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error Counter Out":=10;
      //      IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=ErrorBinbox;
      //      IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
      //    END ELSE
      //      IF NOT BinContent.GET('HL',IntercompanyOrderEntry."Box Bin Content",'BOX',IntercompanyOrderEntry.SerialNo,'STCK') THEN BEGIN
      //        IntercompanyOrderEntry."Error description":=ErrorBinbox;
      //        IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status:=IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler;
            //END;
          IntercompanyOrderEntry.MODIFY(FALSE);
        UNTIL IntercompanyOrderEntry.NEXT=0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetCorrectUnitPrice@301510004();
    VAR
      SystemValueLine@301510000 : Record 5105031;
      SalesHeader@301510001 : Record 36;
      SalesLine@301510002 : Record 37;
      ReleaseSalesDocument@301510003 : Codeunit 414;
      SHOpen@301510004 : Record 36;
      LocSerialNo@301510005 : Code[20];
      UnitPriceIC@301510006 : Decimal;
      IntercompanyOrderEntry@301510007 : Record 85004;
    BEGIN
      IF SystemValueLine.GET(61033,'CUSTBV') THEN
        IF SystemValueLine."Bool 1" THEN BEGIN
          SalesHeader.RESET;
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE(Status,SalesHeader.Status::Released);
          SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.",SystemValueLine."Code Value 1");
          IF SalesHeader.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company Sales Order",SalesHeader."No.");
              IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETRANGE("Company SO Ext.No",SalesHeader."External Document No.");
              IntercompanyOrderEntry.SETFILTER(Status,'%1|%2',IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Bearbeitung,IntercompanyOrderEntry.Status::Fehler);
              IF IntercompanyOrderEntry.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN

                SHOpen.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type",SalesHeader."No.");
                ReleaseSalesDocument.Reopen(SHOpen);
                SalesLine.RESET;
                SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type");
                SalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
                SalesLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesLine.Type::Item);
                SalesLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
                IF SalesLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                  REPEAT
                    LocSerialNo:=FoundCorrectItemLedger(SalesLine);
                    CalcUnitPriceICwithSerial(SalesLine,LocSerialNo);
                    SalesLine.MODIFY(FALSE);
                  UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT=0;
                END;
                ReleaseSalesDocument.ReleaseSalesHeader(SHOpen,FALSE);
              END;
            UNTIL SalesHeader.NEXT=0;
          END;
        END;
      COMMIT;
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalcUnitPriceIC_@301510005(SalesLine@301490000 : Record 37) : Decimal;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301490001 : Record 32;
      UnitPriceLoc@301490002 : Decimal;
      VATPostingSetup@301490003 : Record 325;
    BEGIN
      //EK-Preis aus Artikelposten ermitteln. Aufruf Create Order
      CLEAR(UnitPriceLoc);
      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.",Open,"Variant Code",Positive,"Location Code","Posting Date","Duty Sign");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",SalesLine."No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",SalesLine."Variant Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      //ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Expected)", "Cost Amount (Actual)");
        UnitPriceLoc:=(ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Expected)"+ItemLedgerEntry."Cost Amount (Actual)") /ItemLedgerEntry.Quantity;
        //IF NOT SalesLine."Use Of Diff. Tax. Possible" THEN BEGIN
        IF NOT ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN BEGIN
          IF VATPostingSetup.GET(SalesLine."VAT Bus. Posting Group",SalesLine."VAT Prod. Posting Group") THEN BEGIN
            UnitPriceLoc:=(UnitPriceLoc/100)*(100+VATPostingSetup."VAT %");
            UnitPriceLoc := ROUND(UnitPriceLoc, 0.01, '>');
          END;
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(UnitPriceLoc);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 21.04.20 NKON ERP-25 Intercompany Prozess
      // 01 11.11.20 NKON ERP-149wenn Auftrag zurÅckgesetzt wird muss es modifiziert werden.
      // 01 16.12.20 NKON ERP-174 bei zeitgleiche Buchung bei mehreren offenen Artikelposten wird Diff. besteuert falsch gesetzt
      // 01 26.01.21 NKON ERP-193 Kommissionierung erstellt Warenausgang kann nicht gebucht werden.
      // 01 01.02.21 NKON Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
      // 01 01.03.21 NKON ERP-75 Bugfix Jahresabschlu·
      // GF 09.06.22 JHAN MSD-19229 InterCompany Order
      // 01 30.08.22 JHAN MSD-19229 Intercompany / ArtikelverfÅgbarkeit
      // 01 14.02.23 JHAN MSD-22499 Intercompany Dead Created Orders
      // 01 04.10.23 NKON CHRON-34 prÅfen ob gebucht
    }
    END.
  }
}

      ResponseCount := 1;

      StringOperation := StringOperation.StringOperation;
      IF StringOperation.LoadString(OutStream,8) THEN BEGIN
        c := StringOperation.SplitStringByNewLine();

        SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);

        FOR i := 0 TO c - 1 DO BEGIN

      TempInMsg.RESET;

      IF TempInMsg.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT

          HeadMsg := TempInMsg;
          HeadMsg."Entry No." := 0;
          HeadMsg.Status := HeadMsg.Status::"to process";

        EXIT(TRUE);

      END;

      EXIT(FALSE);
    END;

OBJECT Codeunit 87020 PROCESS UWS Scoring Class
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=07.12.16;
    Time=14:18:36;
    Version List=,;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    TableNo=5275375;
    OnRun=BEGIN
            IF NOT ImportUWSScoringClass(Rec) THEN
              ERROR('Fehler in CU 87020!');
          END;

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      Text000@1000000000 : TextConst 'DEU=Sie kînnen fÅr eine leere Referenzart keine %1 eingeben.;ENU=You cannot enter a  %1 for a blank Cross-Reference Type.';

    PROCEDURE ImportUWSScoringClass@1000000003(VAR Rec@1000000005 : Record 5275375) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceInboundMessage@1000000000 : Record 5275375;
      ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt@1000000002 : Codeunit 5275373;
      RFMRManagement@1001050004 : Codeunit 5275330;
      RFMRScoringEntry@1001050000 : Record 5275414;
      RFMRScoringResultLine@1001050007 : Record 5275413;
      RFMRSetup@1001050001 : Record 5275410;
      Customer@1001050002 : Record 18;
      Contact@1001050003 : Record 5050;
      VIP@1001050005 : Boolean;
      Text0001@1001050006 : TextConst 'DEU=IMPORT;ENU=IMPORT';
      VIPInt@1001050008 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // VIP-RFMR-Satz ermitteln
      RFMRSetup.RESET;
      RFMRSetup.SETRANGE("VIP Scoring Class Y/N",TRUE);
      IF NOT RFMRSetup.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt.SetMessageForInMsg(Rec,'IUWS_E01',Rec."Free Text 2",'','','','',FALSE,TRUE);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      // 1: JA, 0: Nein
      EVALUATE(VIPInt,Rec."Free Text 3");
      VIP := VIPInt = 1;

      IF Customer.GET(Rec."Free Text 2") THEN BEGIN
        Contact.GET(RFMRManagement.GetCustomerContactNo(Customer."No."));
        CASE TRUE OF
          (Contact."RFMR Scoring Class" = RFMRSetup.Code) AND (VIP): BEGIN
            // Mache nichts, VIP ist bereits gesetzt
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END;
          (VIP): BEGIN
            // öbernehme den UWS-VIP-Status
            Customer.VALIDATE("RFMR Scoring Class",RFMRSetup.Code);
            Customer.MODIFY;

            Contact.VALIDATE("RFMR Scoring Class",RFMRSetup.Code);
            Contact.MODIFY;

            // Posten bauen
            IF RFMRScoringEntry.GET(2,Customer."No.",TODAY,Text0001) THEN
              RFMRScoringEntry.DELETE;

            RFMRScoringEntry.INIT;
            RFMRScoringEntry."Scoring Type" := 2;
            RFMRScoringEntry."No." := Customer."No.";
            RFMRScoringEntry."Take Over Date" := TODAY;
            RFMRScoringEntry."Scoring No." := Text0001;
            RFMRScoringEntry."RFMR Scoring Class" := RFMRSetup.Code;
            RFMRScoringEntry."Base Date" := TODAY;
            RFMRScoringEntry."Manual Scoring Class Y/N" := FALSE;
            RFMRScoringEntry.INSERT;
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END;
          (NOT VIP): BEGIN
            // UWS meldet keinen VIP-Status mehr, Kundeklasse muss neu berechnet werden
            RFMRScoringResultLine.RESET;
            IF RFMRScoringResultLine.SETCURRENTKEY("No.","Customer Group","Customer Type") THEN;
            RFMRScoringResultLine.SETRANGE("No.",Customer."No.");
            RFMRScoringResultLine.MODIFYALL("Valid until",CALCDATE('<-1d>',TODAY));
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END ELSE
            EXIT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 04.06.15 DPET 10052156 Erstellung UWS-Import fÅr Scoring-Class
    }
    END.
  }
}

                    FileCnt += 1;

                  END;
                END;
              UNTIL PromotionMedium.NEXT = 0;

            IF TempExtInterfaceOutboundFile.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                TempExtInterfaceOutboundFile.CALCFIELDS(SourceFile);
                ExtInterfaceOutboundFile := TempExtInterfaceOutboundFile;

                ExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Entry No." := 0;
                ExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE);
              UNTIL TempExtInterfaceOutboundFile.NEXT = 0;
          END;

    PROCEDURE PropagateInsertQuickSalesLine@7(VAR pQuickSalesLine@1000 : Record 5104607);
    VAR
      lQuickSalesHeader@1001 : Record 5104606;
      lQuickSalesLine@1002 : Record 5104607;
      lLastUsedQuickSalesLine@1004 : Record 5104607;
    BEGIN
      VerifyCRUDIsPossibleForQuickSalesLine(pQuickSalesLine,lQuickSalesHeader);

      IF pQuickSalesLine."Line No." = 0 THEN BEGIN
        lLastUsedQuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",lLastUsedQuickSalesLine."Document Type"::Order);
        lLastUsedQuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",lQuickSalesHeader."No.");
        IF lLastUsedQuickSalesLine.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
          pQuickSalesLine."Line No." := lLastUsedQuickSalesLine."Line No." + 10000;
        END ELSE
          pQuickSalesLine."Line No." := 10000;

        lQuickSalesLine."Line No." := pQuickSalesLine."Line No.";
      END ELSE
        IF lQuickSalesLine.GET(lQuickSalesHeader."No.",pQuickSalesLine."Line No.") THEN
          ERROR(CannotInsertALineThatAlreadyExistsErr);

      lQuickSalesLine.TRANSFERFIELDS(pQuickSalesLine);
      lQuickSalesLine."Document Type" := lQuickSalesLine."Document Type"::Order;
      lQuickSalesLine."Document No." := lQuickSalesHeader."No.";
      lQuickSalesLine.INSERT(TRUE);
      lQuickSalesLine.FIND;

      pQuickSalesLine.TRANSFERFIELDS(lQuickSalesLine, TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE VerifyCRUDIsPossibleForQuickSalesLine@60(VAR pQuickSalesLine@1001 : Record 5104607;VAR pQuickSalesHeader@1000 : Record 5104606);
    VAR
      lQuickSalesHeader@1002 : Record 5104606;
      lDocumentIdFilter@1003 : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF ISNULLGUID(pQuickSalesLine."Document Id") THEN BEGIN
        lDocumentIdFilter := pQuickSalesLine.GETFILTER("Document Id");
        IF lDocumentIdFilter = '' THEN
          ERROR(DocumentIDNotSpecifiedForLinesErr);
        pQuickSalesHeader.SETFILTER(Id,lDocumentIdFilter);
      END ELSE
        pQuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE(Id,pQuickSalesLine."Document Id");

      IF NOT pQuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR(DocumentDoesNotExistErr);

      lQuickSalesHeader.COPY(pQuickSalesHeader);
      IF lQuickSalesHeader.NEXT <> 0 THEN
        ERROR(MultipleDocumentsFoundForIdErr);
    END;

    PROCEDURE WriteDivaLogEntry@301490004(pVariant@301490001 : Variant);
    VAR
      lViewDiVALog@301490000 : Record 5104824;

OBJECT Codeunit 88018 CHNX Delivery Times Aggr. Test
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.08.19;
    Time=09:48:22;

    Version List=CHNX;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    TableNo=88014;
    OnRun=VAR
            ItemVariant@301480002 : Record 5401;
            CountryRegion@301480001 : Record 9;
            TempDeliveryTimesAggregate@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 88014;
            CHNXDeliveryTimesAggregator@301480003 : Codeunit 88019;
          BEGIN
            // Code aus Codeunit 88019 Funktion OnRun kopiert
            // Aufruf aus Page 50020
            //TEST:
            IF NOT Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
              ERROR('Tabelle ist nicht temporÑr.');

            // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur
            LogIsDeactivated := TRUE;
            // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur ENDE

            TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.COPYFILTERS(Rec);

            IF TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.GETFILTER("Item No.") <> '' THEN
              ItemVariant.SETFILTER("Item No.",TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.GETFILTER("Item No."));
            IF TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.GETFILTER("Variant Code") <> '' THEN
              ItemVariant.SETFILTER(Code,TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.GETFILTER("Variant Code"));
            IF ItemVariant.FINDSET THEN
              REPEAT
                IF TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.GETFILTER("Country/Region Code") <> '' THEN
                  CountryRegion.SETFILTER(Code,TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.GETFILTER("Country/Region Code"));
                IF CountryRegion.FINDSET THEN
                  REPEAT
                    IF NOT TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.GET(ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,CountryRegion.Code) THEN BEGIN
                      TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.INIT;
                      TempDeliveryTimesAggregate."Item No." := ItemVariant."Item No.";
                      TempDeliveryTimesAggregate."Variant Code" := ItemVariant.Code;
                      TempDeliveryTimesAggregate."Country/Region Code" := CountryRegion.Code;
                      CASE CountryRegion."Taxation Type" OF
                      CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Both :
                        TempDeliveryTimesAggregate."Delivery Time" := CHNXDeliveryTimesAggregator.CalcDeliveryTime(ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,CountryRegion.Code,CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::" ");
                      CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Diff :
                        TempDeliveryTimesAggregate."Delivery Time" := CHNXDeliveryTimesAggregator.CalcDeliveryTime(ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,CountryRegion.Code,CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Diff);
                      CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Full :
                        TempDeliveryTimesAggregate."Delivery Time" := CHNXDeliveryTimesAggregator.CalcDeliveryTime(ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,CountryRegion.Code,CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Full);
                      END;
                      TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.INSERT;
                    END;
                  UNTIL CountryRegion.NEXT = 0;
              UNTIL ItemVariant.NEXT = 0;

            IF TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
              Rec.DELETEALL;
              REPEAT
                Rec.INIT;
                Rec := TempDeliveryTimesAggregate;
                Rec.INSERT;
              UNTIL TempDeliveryTimesAggregate.NEXT = 0;
            END;
          END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForCountryRegion@301480029(CountryRegion@301480001 : Record 9;ShowStatusWindow@301480007 : Boolean) : Boolean;
    VAR
      DeliveryTimesAggregate@301480000 : Record 88014;
      ItemVariant@301480002 : Record 5401;
      Counter@301480004 : Integer;
      CounterTotal@301480005 : Integer;
      Window@301480006 : Dialog;
      ProgressDateTime@301480003 : DateTime;
    BEGIN
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForCountryRegion
      IF (FORMAT(CountryRegion."Delivery Time") <> '') AND (CountryRegion."Taxation Type" <> CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::" ") THEN BEGIN
        IF ShowStatusWindow THEN
          ShowStatusWindow := GUIALLOWED;
        DeliveryTimesAggregate.RESET;
        DeliveryTimesAggregate.SETRANGE("Country/Region Code",CountryRegion.Code);
        IF DeliveryTimesAggregate.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
            Counter := 0;
            CounterTotal := DeliveryTimesAggregate.COUNT;
            Window.OPEN('@1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@');
            ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
          END;

          REPEAT

            IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
              Counter += 1;
              IF ProgressDateTime < CURRENTDATETIME - 1000 THEN BEGIN
                ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
                Window.UPDATE(1,ROUND(Counter / CounterTotal * 9999.99,1));
              END;
            END;

            InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForItemNoAndVariantCodeAndCountryRegion(
               DeliveryTimesAggregate."Item No.",DeliveryTimesAggregate."Variant Code",CountryRegion);

          UNTIL DeliveryTimesAggregate.NEXT = 0;
          IF ShowStatusWindow THEN
            Window.CLOSE;
          EXIT(TRUE);
        END ELSE BEGIN
          // 01 23.04.20 LACK MSD-11069 HotFix
          //SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
          CustomerSetup.GET;
          // 01 23.04.20 LACK MSD-11069 HotFix Ende
          CustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");
          ItemVariant.RESET;
          ItemVariant.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1',CustomerSetup."Box Item");
          IF ItemVariant.FINDSET THEN BEGIN

            IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
              Counter := 0;
              CounterTotal := DeliveryTimesAggregate.COUNT;
              Window.OPEN('@1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@');
              ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
            END;

            REPEAT

              IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
                Counter += 1;
                IF ProgressDateTime < CURRENTDATETIME - 1000 THEN BEGIN
                  ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
                  Window.UPDATE(1,ROUND(Counter / CounterTotal * 9999.99,1));
                END;
              END;

              InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForItemNoAndVariantCodeAndCountryRegion(
                 ItemVariant."Item No.",ItemVariant.Code,CountryRegion);

            UNTIL ItemVariant.NEXT = 0;
            IF ShowStatusWindow THEN
              Window.CLOSE;
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForCountryRegion ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertOrModifyFromReservationEntry@301510012(pReservEntry@301480000 : Record 337;MessageReason@301480002 : Text[20];Action@301510002 : 'SL,TL');
    VAR
      l_recTL@301510000 : Record 5741;
      GraphMgtCHNXItemStock@301510003 : Codeunit 88021;
      l_recSL@301510001 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 <<
      IF (pReservEntry."Item No." = '') OR (pReservEntry."Variant Code" = '') THEN
        EXIT;
      {
      CustomerSetup.GET;
      CASE CustomerSetup."ExtInterf DeliveryTime Changes" OF
        CustomerSetup."ExtInterf DeliveryTime Changes"::File:
          InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForAllRelevantCountryRegions(pReservEntry."Item No.",pReservEntry."Variant Code");
        CustomerSetup."ExtInterf DeliveryTime Changes"::"Message (And File)":
          CreateExternalInterfaceMessage(pReservEntry."Item No.",pReservEntry."Variant Code",'','',MessageReason);
      END;
      }
      COMMIT;

      IF Action = 0 THEN BEGIN
        l_recSL.RESET;
        l_recSL.SETRANGE("Document Type",l_recSL."Document Type"::Order);
        l_recSL.SETRANGE("Document No.",pReservEntry."Source ID");
        l_recSL.SETRANGE("Line No.",pReservEntry."Source Ref. No.");
        l_recSL.SETRANGE("No.",pReservEntry."Item No.");
        l_recSL.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pReservEntry."Variant Code");
        IF l_recSL.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
           IF l_recSL."No." <> 'BOX' THEN BEGIN
             l_recSL.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity");
             IF l_recSL."Reserved Quantity" > 0 THEN BEGIN
                GraphMgtCHNXItemStock.UpdateItemStockEntityReserved(l_recSL,TRUE);
             END
             ELSE BEGIN
                GraphMgtCHNXItemStock.UpdateItemStockEntityReserved(l_recSL,FALSE);
             END;
           END
           ELSE BEGIN
             EXIT;
           END;
        END;
      END;

      IF Action = 1 THEN BEGIN
        l_recTL.RESET;
        l_recTL.SETRANGE("Document No.",pReservEntry."Source ID");
        l_recTL.SETRANGE("Line No.",pReservEntry."Source Ref. No.");
        l_recTL.SETRANGE("Item No.",pReservEntry."Item No.");
        l_recTL.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pReservEntry."Variant Code");
        IF l_recTL.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
           IF l_recTL."Item No." <> 'BOX' THEN BEGIN
             l_recTL.CALCFIELDS("Reserved Quantity Outbnd.");
             IF l_recTL."Reserved Quantity Outbnd." > 0 THEN BEGIN
                GraphMgtCHNXItemStock.UpdateItemStockEntityReserved2(l_recTL,TRUE);
             END
             ELSE BEGIN
                GraphMgtCHNXItemStock.UpdateItemStockEntityReserved2(l_recTL,FALSE);
             END;
           END
           ELSE BEGIN
             EXIT;
           END;
        END;
      END;
      // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 >>
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForAllRelevantCountryRegions@301480034(ItemNo@1000 : Code[20];VariantCode@301480001 : Code[10]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      CountryRegion@301480000 : Record 9;
    BEGIN
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForAllRelevantCountryRegions
      CountryRegion.RESET;
      CountryRegion.SETFILTER("Taxation Type",'<>%1',CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::" ");
      IF CountryRegion.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForItemNoAndVariantCodeAndCountryRegion(ItemNo,VariantCode,CountryRegion);

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForItemNoAndVariantCodeAndCountryRegion@301480016(ItemNo@1000 : Code[20];VariantCode@301480001 : Code[10];CountryRegion@301480002 : Record 9) : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForItemNoAndVariantCodeAndCountryRegion
      CASE CountryRegion."Taxation Type" OF
        CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Both: InsertDeliveryTimesAggregate(ItemNo,VariantCode,CountryRegion.Code,CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::" ");
        CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Diff: InsertDeliveryTimesAggregate(ItemNo,VariantCode,CountryRegion.Code,CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Diff);
        CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Full: InsertDeliveryTimesAggregate(ItemNo,VariantCode,CountryRegion.Code,CountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Full);
        ELSE
          EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
      EXIT(TRUE);
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForItemNoAndVariantCodeAndCountryRegion ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CalcDeliveryTime@301480000(pItemNo@301480000 : Code[20];pItemVariantCode@301480001 : Code[10];pCountryRegionCode@301480006 : Code[10];pTaxationType@301480002 : ' ,Full,Diff,Both') : Integer;

      lCountryRegion.GET(pCountryRegionCode);
      // 01 23.04.20 LACK MSD-11069 HotFix
      //lSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      CustomerSetup.GET;
      // 01 23.04.20 LACK MSD-11069 HotFix Ende
      // 01 02.07.19 MKLE CHR-702 Nicht wiederbeschaffbare Diff-EinzelstÅcke sollen weltweit angezeigt werden
      // Wenn Bestand > 0 und "nicht wiederbeschaffbar" ist es ein EinzelstÅck, das abverkauft wird.
      // Dieses soll in den "full" LÑndern verfÅgbar gemacht werden (1+Land), auch wenn es diff. eingekauft wurde.

      IF (lCountryRegion."Taxation Type" = lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Full) AND // Land = Full
         (lCustomerManagement.CalcAvailableQuantity(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,CustomerSetup."Delivery Time Loc. Code Filter",2) > 0) AND // diff. eingekauft
         NOT Procurable(DATABASE::"Item Variant",pItemNo,pItemVariantCode) THEN BEGIN // nicht wiederbeschaffbar
           FillNameValueBuffer(NameValueBuffer);
           IF NameValueBuffer.FINDSET THEN // Alle Lagerorte (HL|V|VLO|VBE|VMA|VHO...)
             REPEAT
               AvailableQty := lCustomerManagement.CalcAvailableQuantity(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,NameValueBuffer.Name,2); // diff. eingekauft
               IF (AvailableQty > 0) THEN BEGIN // Bestand diff. eingekauft in Lager NameValueBuffer.Name gefunden
                 IF EVALUATE(lDeliveryTimeInDays,FORMAT(CALCDATE(lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",CALCDATE(NameValueBuffer.Value,TODAY))-TODAY)) THEN BEGIN
                   WriteLogEntry(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode,NameValueBuffer.Name,pTaxationType,AvailableQty,lDeliveryTimeInDays,
                     STRSUBSTNO('EinzelstÅck: Land %1 + Lagerort: %2',lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",NameValueBuffer.Value));
                   EXIT(lDeliveryTimeInDays);
                 END;
               END;
             UNTIL NameValueBuffer.NEXT = 0;
      END;

      NameValueBuffer.RESET;
      IF NameValueBuffer.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        NameValueBuffer.DELETEALL;

      // 01 02.07.19 MKLE CHR-702 Nicht wiederbeschaffbare Diff-EinzelstÅcke sollen weltweit angezeigt werden ENDE

      // NF 12.12.18 MBLA CHR-186 Verkauf: Fehlender Aufschlag der Lieferzeiten bei Vitrinen-Lagerorten
      // IF lCustomerManagement.CalcAvailableQuantity(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,CustomerSetup."Delivery Time Loc. Code Filter",pTaxationType) > 0 THEN
      //  IF EVALUATE(lDeliveryTimeInDays,FORMAT(CALCDATE(lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",TODAY + 1) - TODAY)) THEN
      //    EXIT(lDeliveryTimeInDays);
      // 01 07.03.19 MBLA CHR-482 VerfÅgbarkeit Variante V11465
      IF lCustomerManagement.CalcAvailableQuantity(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,CustomerSetup."Delivery Time Loc. Code Filter",pTaxationType) > 0 THEN BEGIN
      // 01 07.03.19 MBLA CHR-482 VerfÅgbarkeit Variante V11465 ENDE
        FillNameValueBuffer(NameValueBuffer);
        IF NameValueBuffer.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
          // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur
          //IF lCustomerManagement.CalcAvailableQuantity(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,NameValueBuffer.Name,pTaxationType) > 0 THEN
          //  IF EVALUATE(lDeliveryTimeInDays,FORMAT(CALCDATE(lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",CALCDATE(NameValueBuffer.Value,TODAY))-TODAY)) THEN
          //    EXIT(lDeliveryTimeInDays);
          AvailableQty := lCustomerManagement.CalcAvailableQuantity(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,NameValueBuffer.Name,pTaxationType);
          IF AvailableQty > 0 THEN BEGIN
            IF EVALUATE(lDeliveryTimeInDays,FORMAT(CALCDATE(lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",CALCDATE(NameValueBuffer.Value,TODAY))-TODAY)) THEN BEGIN
              WriteLogEntry(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode,NameValueBuffer.Name,pTaxationType,AvailableQty,lDeliveryTimeInDays,
                STRSUBSTNO('VerfÅgbar: Land %1 + Lagerort: %2',lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",NameValueBuffer.Value));
              EXIT(lDeliveryTimeInDays);
            END;
          END;
          // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur ENDE
        UNTIL NameValueBuffer.NEXT = 0;
        // NF 12.12.18 MBLA CHR-186 Verkauf: Fehlender Aufschlag der Lieferzeiten bei Vitrinen-Lagerorten ENDE

      // 01 07.03.19 MBLA CHR-482 VerfÅgbarkeit Variante V11465
      END;
      // 01 07.03.19 MBLA CHR-482 VerfÅgbarkeit Variante V11465 ENDE

      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur
      // IF NOT Procurable(DATABASE::"Item Variant",pItemNo,pItemVariantCode) THEN
      //  EXIT(-1);
      IF NOT Procurable(DATABASE::"Item Variant",pItemNo,pItemVariantCode) THEN BEGIN
        WriteLogEntry(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode,'',pTaxationType,0,-1,'Nicht Wiederbeschaffbar');
        EXIT(-1);
      END;
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur ENDE

      lDeliveryTimeFromVariant := GetDeliveryTimeFromVariant(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode);
      IF lDeliveryTimeFromVariant <> GetNonSpecifiedValue THEN
        // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur
        //IF EVALUATE(lDeliveryTimeInDays,FORMAT(CALCDATE(lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",CALCDATE(lDeliveryTimeFromVariant,TODAY)) - TODAY)) THEN
        //  EXIT(lDeliveryTimeInDays);
        IF EVALUATE(lDeliveryTimeInDays,FORMAT(CALCDATE(lCountryRegion."Delivery Time",CALCDATE(lDeliveryTimeFromVariant,TODAY)) - TODAY)) THEN BEGIN
          WriteLogEntry(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode,'',pTaxationType,0,lDeliveryTimeInDays,'Lieferzeit Variante');
          EXIT(lDeliveryTimeInDays);
        END;
        // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur ENDE

      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur
      WriteLogEntry(pItemNo,pItemVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode,'',pTaxationType,0,lDeliveryTimeInDays,'Kein Ergebnis: -1');
      // 01 15.02.19 MBLA CHR-414 EinzelstÅck wieder online durch Korrektur ENDE

      EXIT(-1);
    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertDeliveryTimesAggregate@301480002(pItemNo@301480000 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301480001 : Code[10];pCountryRegionCode@301480002 : Code[10];pTaxationType@301480003 : ' ,Full,Diff,Both');
    VAR
      lDeliveryTimesAggregate@301480004 : Record 88014;
      lDeliveryTime@301480005 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      WITH lDeliveryTimesAggregate DO
        IF NOT GET(pItemNo,pVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode) THEN BEGIN
          INIT;
          "Item No." := pItemNo;
          "Variant Code" := pVariantCode;
          "Country/Region Code" := pCountryRegionCode;
          "Delivery Time" := CalcDeliveryTime(pItemNo,pVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode,pTaxationType);
          INSERT(TRUE);
        END ELSE BEGIN
          lDeliveryTime := CalcDeliveryTime(pItemNo,pVariantCode,pCountryRegionCode,pTaxationType);
          IF "Delivery Time" <> lDeliveryTime THEN BEGIN
            "Delivery Time" := lDeliveryTime;
            MODIFY(TRUE);
          END;
        END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Procurable@301480001(pTableNo@301480003 : Integer;pItemNo@301480000 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301480001 : Code[10]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301480002 : Record 7505;
      DummyBool@301480004 : Boolean;
      ItemAttributeID@301480005 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      ItemAttributeID := CustomerSetup."Procureable Attribute";
      IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(DATABASE::"Item Variant",pItemNo,ItemAttributeID,pVariantCode,'') THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text") THEN
        // 01 07.03.19 MBLA CHR-482 VerfÅgbarkeit Variante V11465
        //EXIT(ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" IN ['ja','yes']);
        EXIT(LOWERCASE(ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text") IN ['ja','yes']);
        // 01 07.03.19 MBLA CHR-482 VerfÅgbarkeit Variante V11465 ENDE
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetDeliveryTimeFromVariant@301480003(pItemNo@301480000 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301480001 : Code[10]) : Text;
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301480002 : Record 7505;
      DummyInt@301480003 : Integer;
      ItemAttributeID@301480004 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      ItemAttributeID := CustomerSetup."Delivery Time Attribute";
      IF NOT ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(DATABASE::"Item Variant",pItemNo,ItemAttributeID,pVariantCode,'') THEN
        EXIT(GetNonSpecifiedValue);

      ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
      IF NOT EVALUATE(DummyInt,ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text") THEN
        EXIT(GetNonSpecifiedValue);

      EXIT(STRSUBSTNO('<%1D>',DummyInt));
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetNonSpecifiedValue@301480004() : Text;
    BEGIN
      EXIT('<999D>');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE HasProcureableAndDeliveryTimeAttribute@301480058(pTableId@301480003 : Integer;pItemNo@301480002 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301480001 : Code[10]) rHasBoth : Boolean;
    VAR
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480000 : Record 7505;
      lCustomerSetup@301480004 : Record 87000;
      lHasProcureableAttribute@301480005 : Boolean;
      lHasDeliveryTimeAttribute@301480006 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      lCustomerSetup.GET;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Table ID",pTableId);
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",pItemNo);
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",pVariantCode);
      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Serial No.",'');

      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Procureable Attribute");
      IF NOT lItemAttributeValueMapping.ISEMPTY THEN
        lHasProcureableAttribute := TRUE;

      lItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",lCustomerSetup."Delivery Time Attribute");
      IF NOT lItemAttributeValueMapping.ISEMPTY THEN
        lHasDeliveryTimeAttribute := TRUE;

      rHasBoth := lHasDeliveryTimeAttribute AND lHasProcureableAttribute;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,7505,OnAfterDeleteEvent)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE Handle_OnAfterDeleteEvent_T7505@301480020(VAR Rec@301480000 : Record 7505;RunTrigger@301480001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      lCustomerSetup@301480002 : Record 87000;
    BEGIN
      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-000 Bei Subscribern sicherstellen, dass Abfrage auf TEMPORARY zu Beginn stattfindet
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;
      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-000 Bei Subscribern sicherstellen, dass Abfrage auf TEMPORARY zu Beginn stattfindet ENDE

      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-692 AusfÅhren von Subscribern Åber Steuerung ggf. unterbinden (z.B. fÅr Korrekturstapeln)
      IF gSubscriberSkipManagement.SkipSubscriber(CODEUNIT::"CHNX Delivery Times Aggregator",'Handle_OnAfterDeleteEvent_T7505') THEN
        EXIT;
      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-692 AusfÅhren von Subscribern Åber Steuerung ggf. unterbinden (z.B. fÅr Korrekturstapeln) ENDE

      //ITEM VARIANT PROCUREABLE AND DELIVERY TIME

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillNameValueBuffer@301510006(VAR NameValueBuffer@301510000 : TEMPORARY Record 823);
    VAR
      Location@301510001 : Record 14;
      TempRecordBuffer@301510007 : TEMPORARY Record 6529;
      LocationFilter@301510005 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      Values@301510004 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Array";
      Seperator@301510003 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      LocationValue@301510002 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.String";
      DeliveryTimeInDays@301510006 : Integer;
      EntryNo@301510008 : Integer;
      MainLocationTopUp@301480000 : DateFormula;
      LocationTopUp@301480001 : DateFormula;
    BEGIN
      // NF 12.12.18 MBLA CHR-186 Verkauf: Fehlender Aufschlag der Lieferzeiten bei Vitrinen-Lagerorten
      LocationFilter := CustomerSetup."Delivery Time Loc. Code Filter";
      Seperator := '|';
      Values := LocationFilter.Split(Seperator.ToCharArray);
      EntryNo := 0;
      FOREACH LocationValue IN Values DO BEGIN
        IF Location.GET(LocationValue) THEN BEGIN

          TempRecordBuffer.INIT;
          EntryNo += 1;
          TempRecordBuffer."Entry No." := EntryNo;
          TempRecordBuffer."Search Record ID" := Location.Code;
          // 01 14.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HOTFIX
          // das so mit weil das T/W etc abgeschnitten wird, allerdings ist mir total unklar warum das Åberhuapt gemacht wird?
          // Am ende kommt doch dadurch wieder raus was in DElivery Time top up steht? Keine Ahnugn Warum aber so sollte es egehn mit der énderung unten
          //IF EVALUATE(TempRecordBuffer."Table No.",FORMAT(CALCDATE(Location."Delivery Time Top Up",TODAY) - TODAY)) THEN
          TempRecordBuffer."Table Name" := FORMAT(CALCDATE(Location."Delivery Time Top Up",TODAY) - TODAY);
          IF EVALUATE(TempRecordBuffer."Table No.",TempRecordBuffer."Table Name") THEN
          // 01 14.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HOTFIX Ende
          TempRecordBuffer.INSERT;
        END;
      END;

      // handle main location: make sure main location is first entry in buffer
      TempRecordBuffer.SETRANGE("Search Record ID",CustomerSetup."Mail Order Location Code");
      IF TempRecordBuffer.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        // 01 14.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HOTFIX
        Location.GET(TempRecordBuffer."Search Record ID");
        NameValueBuffer.AddNewEntry(TempRecordBuffer."Search Record ID",FORMAT(Location."Delivery Time Top Up"));
        // 01 14.12.18 LACK CHR-000 HOTFIX Ende
        // 01 12.02.19 MBLA CHR-186 Verkauf: Fehlender Aufschlag der Lieferzeiten bei Vitrinen-Lagerorten: MainlocationTopUp
        MainLocationTopUp := Location."Delivery Time Top Up";
        // 01 12.02.19 MBLA CHR-186 Verkauf: Fehlender Aufschlag der Lieferzeiten bei Vitrinen-Lagerorten: MainlocationTopUp ENDE
        TempRecordBuffer.DELETE;
      END;

      // sort locations: sorting on "Table No." in ascending order
      TempRecordBuffer.RESET;
      TempRecordBuffer.SETCURRENTKEY("Table No.","Search Record ID");
      TempRecordBuffer.SETASCENDING("Table No.",TRUE);
      IF TempRecordBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          Location.GET(TempRecordBuffer."Search Record ID");
          // 01 12.02.19 MBLA CHR-186 Verkauf: Fehlender Aufschlag der Lieferzeiten bei Vitrinen-Lagerorten: MainlocationTopUp
          //NameValueBuffer.AddNewEntry(TempRecordBuffer."Search Record ID",FORMAT(Location."Delivery Time Top Up"));
          IF EVALUATE(LocationTopUp, STRSUBSTNO('%1+%2',Location."Delivery Time Top Up",MainLocationTopUp)) THEN
            NameValueBuffer.AddNewEntry(TempRecordBuffer."Search Record ID",FORMAT(LocationTopUp));
          // 01 12.02.19 MBLA CHR-186 Verkauf: Fehlender Aufschlag der Lieferzeiten bei Vitrinen-Lagerorten: MainlocationTopUp ENDE
        UNTIL TempRecordBuffer.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForLocation@301480005(Location@301480001 : Record 14;ShowStatusWindow@301480002 : Boolean) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301480000 : Record 32;
      NameValueBuffer@301510001 : TEMPORARY Record 823;
      Counter@301480006 : Integer;
      CounterTotal@301480005 : Integer;
      Window@301480004 : Dialog;
      ProgressDateTime@301480003 : DateTime;
    BEGIN
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForLocation
      IF FORMAT(Location."Delivery Time Top Up") <> ''  THEN BEGIN
        IF ShowStatusWindow THEN
          ShowStatusWindow := GUIALLOWED;

        //SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
        CustomerSetup.GET;
        ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",Location.Code);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1',CustomerSetup."Box Item");
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDSET THEN BEGIN

          IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
            Counter := 0;
            CounterTotal := ItemLedgerEntry.COUNT;
            Window.OPEN('@1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@');
            ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
          END;

          REPEAT

            IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
              Counter += 1;
              IF ProgressDateTime < CURRENTDATETIME - 1000 THEN BEGIN
                ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
                Window.UPDATE(1,ROUND(Counter / CounterTotal * 9999.99,1));
              END;
            END;

            NameValueBuffer.RESET;
            NameValueBuffer.SETRANGE(Name,ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
            NameValueBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");

            IF NameValueBuffer.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
              NameValueBuffer.ID := ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.";
              NameValueBuffer.Name := ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.";
              NameValueBuffer.Value := ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code";
              NameValueBuffer.INSERT;
            END;
          UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT = 0;
          IF ShowStatusWindow THEN
            Window.CLOSE;
        END;


        NameValueBuffer.RESET;
        IF NameValueBuffer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN

          IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
            Counter := 0;
            CounterTotal := NameValueBuffer.COUNT;
            Window.OPEN('@1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@');
            ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
          END;

          REPEAT

            IF ShowStatusWindow THEN BEGIN
              Counter += 1;
              IF ProgressDateTime < CURRENTDATETIME - 1000 THEN BEGIN
                ProgressDateTime := CURRENTDATETIME;
                Window.UPDATE(1,ROUND(Counter / CounterTotal * 9999.99,1));
              END;
            END;

          EXIT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForLocation ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateItemLedgerAttributes@301490004(pItemAttributeValueMapping@301490003 : Record 7505);
    VAR
      lSetupGet@301490002 : Codeunit 5105007;
      lCustomerSetup@301490001 : Record 87000;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301490000 : Record 32;
      lWarrantyDate@301490004 : Date;
      lManufacturerSerialNo@301490005 : Code[20];
      lDateText@301490006 : Text;
    BEGIN
      // LF 24.05.19 MKLE CHR-548 UpdateItemLedgerAttributes
      // 01 23.04.20 LACK MSD-11069 HotFix
      //lSetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(lCustomerSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      lCustomerSetup.GET;
      // 01 23.04.20 LACK MSD-11069 HotFix Ende
      IF (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" = lCustomerSetup."Warranty Date Attribute") OR
         (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" = lCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu") THEN
           IF (pItemAttributeValueMapping."No." <> '') AND
              (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code" <> '') AND
              (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No." <> '') THEN BEGIN
                IF (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = '') THEN
                  pItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
                IF (pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" = '') THEN
                  EXIT;
                lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemAttributeValueMapping."No.");
                lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Variant Code");
                lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No.");
                CASE pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute ID" OF
                  lCustomerSetup."Warranty Date Attribute" : BEGIN
                    IF EVALUATE(lWarrantyDate,pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text") THEN
                      lItemLedgerEntry.MODIFYALL("Warranty Date Attr.",lWarrantyDate)
                    ELSE BEGIN  // yyyymmdd zu ddmmyyyy
                      lDateText :=
                        COPYSTR(DELCHR(pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text",'=','-'),7,2) +
                        COPYSTR(DELCHR(pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text",'=','-'),5,2) +
                        COPYSTR(DELCHR(pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text",'=','-'),1,4);
                      IF EVALUATE(lWarrantyDate,lDateText) THEN
                        lItemLedgerEntry.MODIFYALL("Warranty Date Attr.",lWarrantyDate);
                    END;
                  END;
                  lCustomerSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu" : BEGIN
                    IF EVALUATE(lManufacturerSerialNo,pItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text") THEN
                      lItemLedgerEntry.MODIFYALL("Manufacturer Serial No. Attr.",lManufacturerSerialNo);
                  END;
                END;
           END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Table,32,OnBeforeInsertEvent)]
    PROCEDURE Handle_OnBeforeInsertEvent_T32@301490005(VAR Rec@301490000 : Record 32;RunTrigger@301490001 : Boolean);
    VAR
      CustSetup@301490003 : Record 87000;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301490002 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      // 01 05.07.19 GWUL CHR-661 Garantie-Datum und Herstellerseriennr. aus den Attributen setzen
      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-000 Bei Subscribern sicherstellen, dass Abfrage auf TEMPORARY zu Beginn stattfindet
      IF Rec.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;
      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-000 Bei Subscribern sicherstellen, dass Abfrage auf TEMPORARY zu Beginn stattfindet ENDE

      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-692 AusfÅhren von Subscribern Åber Steuerung ggf. unterbinden (z.B. fÅr Korrekturstapeln)
      IF gSubscriberSkipManagement.SkipSubscriber(CODEUNIT::"CHNX Delivery Times Aggregator",'Handle_OnBeforeInsertEvent_T32') THEN
        EXIT;
      // 01 01.08.19 MJAN CHR-692 AusfÅhren von Subscribern Åber Steuerung ggf. unterbinden (z.B. fÅr Korrekturstapeln) ENDE

      //SetupGet."Get Customer Setup"(CustSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      CustSetup.GET;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.RESET;
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("No.",Rec."Item No.");
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",Rec."Variant Code");
      ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Serial No.",Rec."Serial No.");
      // Garantie-Datum
      IF Rec."Warranty Date Attr." = 0D THEN BEGIN
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",CustSetup."Warranty Date Attribute");
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" <> '' THEN
