        END;
      END;

      // Herstellerseriennr.
      IF Rec."Manufacturer Serial No. Attr." = '' THEN BEGIN
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",CustSetup."Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
          IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text" <> '' THEN
            Rec."Manufacturer Serial No. Attr." := ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text";
        END;
      END;
      // 01 05.07.19 GWUL CHR-661 Garantie-Datum und Herstellergarantie aus den Attributen setzen ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE InitDeliveryTimes@301490007(pItemNoFilter@301490010 : Text;pVariantCodeFilter@301490011 : Text;pLogIsDeactivated@301490012 : Boolean);
    VAR
      lDeliveryTimesAggregate@301490000 : Record 88014;
      lTextDeleteDeliveryTimesConfirm@301490001 : TextConst 'DEU=Mîchten Sie alle Lieferzeiten lîschen?;ENU=Do you want to delete all delivery times?';
      lCountryRegion@301490002 : Record 9;
      lItemVariant@301490003 : Record 5401;
      lCustomerSetup@301490004 : Record 87000;
      lStep@301490005 : Integer;
      lDialog@301490006 : Dialog;
      lProgress@301490007 : Integer;
      lTotalSteps@301490008 : Integer;
      lTimeProgress@301490009 : Time;
    BEGIN
      // GF 11.07.19 MKLE CHR-702 InitDeliveryTimes

      LogIsDeactivated := pLogIsDeactivated;

      IF CONFIRM(lTextDeleteDeliveryTimesConfirm,FALSE) THEN BEGIN // Clean Up
        lDeliveryTimesAggregate.RESET;
        lDeliveryTimesAggregate.DELETEALL;
        COMMIT;
      END;

      IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
        lStep := 0;
        lDialog.OPEN('@1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@\',lProgress);
      END;

      lCustomerSetup.GET;
      lCustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");

      lItemVariant.RESET;
      lItemVariant.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1',lCustomerSetup."Box Item");

      IF (pItemNoFilter <> '') THEN
        lItemVariant.SETFILTER("Item No.",pItemNoFilter);

      IF (pVariantCodeFilter <> '') THEN
        lItemVariant.SETFILTER(Code,pVariantCodeFilter);

      IF lItemVariant.FINDSET THEN BEGIN // FÅr alle Variante :

        IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
          lTotalSteps := lItemVariant.COUNT;
          lTimeProgress := TIME;
        END;

        REPEAT

          lCountryRegion.RESET;
          lCountryRegion.SETFILTER("Taxation Type",'<>%1',lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::" ");
          IF lCountryRegion.FINDSET THEN // FÅr alle LÑnder mit Besteuerungsart
            REPEAT
              CASE lCountryRegion."Taxation Type" OF
                lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Both : InsertDeliveryTimesAggregate(lItemVariant."Item No.",lItemVariant.Code,
                  lCountryRegion.Code,lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::" ");
                lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Diff : InsertDeliveryTimesAggregate(lItemVariant."Item No.",lItemVariant.Code,
                  lCountryRegion.Code,lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Diff);
                lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Full : InsertDeliveryTimesAggregate(lItemVariant."Item No.",lItemVariant.Code,
                  lCountryRegion.Code,lCountryRegion."Taxation Type"::Full);
              END;
            UNTIL lCountryRegion.NEXT = 0;

          IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
            lStep := lStep + 1;
            IF lTimeProgress < TIME - 1000 THEN BEGIN
              lTimeProgress := TIME;
              lProgress := ROUND(lStep / lTotalSteps * 10000,1);
              lDialog.UPDATE;
            END;
          END;

          COMMIT;

        UNTIL lItemVariant.NEXT = 0;

      END;

      lDialog.CLOSE;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertOrModifyFromExtInterfaceMessage@301480012(ExtInterfOutboundMessage@301480000 : Record 5275376) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceSetup@301480001 : Record 5275373;
      CountryRegion@301480002 : Record 9;
      Location@301480004 : Record 14;
      SetToProcessed@301480003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyFromExtInterfaceMessage
      SetToProcessed := FALSE;
      SetupGet."Get ExtIntSetup"(ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Ext Interface Setup Name",ExtInterfaceSetup,FALSE,FALSE);
      CASE ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Sub Code" OF
        STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::"Item Variant"):
          IF InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForAllRelevantCountryRegions(ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code,ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Code 2") THEN
            SetToProcessed := TRUE;
        STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::"Country/Region"):
          IF CountryRegion.GET(ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code) THEN
            IF InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForCountryRegion(CountryRegion,FALSE) THEN
              SetToProcessed := TRUE;
        STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::Location):
          IF Location.GET(ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code) THEN
            IF InsertOrModifyDeliveryTimesAggregateForLocation(Location,FALSE) THEN
              SetToProcessed := TRUE;
      END;

      IF SetToProcessed THEN BEGIN
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.User := USERID;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::processed;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Processed at" := CURRENTDATETIME;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.MODIFY;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
      EXIT(FALSE);
      // LF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 InsertOrModifyFromExtInterfaceMessage ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceMessage@301480011(ItemNo@301480001 : Code[20];VariantCode@301480008 : Code[10];CountryCode@301480007 : Code[10];LocationCode@301480009 : Code[10];MessageReason@301480006 : Text[20]);
    VAR
      ExtInterfaceSetup@301480002 : Record 5275373;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage@301480000 : Record 5275376;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage2@301480004 : Record 5275376;
      ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt@301480005 : Codeunit 5275373;
      CreateMessage@301480003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // GF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateExternalInterfaceMessage
      // 01 15.01.20 LACK MSD-14348 Funktion wird nicht mehr benîtigt
      EXIT;
      // 01 15.01.20 LACK MSD-14348 Funktion wird nicht mehr benîtigt  Ende
      IF NOT SetupGet."Get ExtIntSetup"('UPDDLT',ExtInterfaceSetup,TRUE,FALSE) THEN
        ERROR(gText_Error_ExtInterfaceNotImplemented);

      ExtInterfaceSetup.TESTFIELD("Message Code");

      CreateMessage := FALSE;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.RESET;
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETCURRENTKEY("Message Code",Status,Hold,Code,"Code 2");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Message Code",ExtInterfaceSetup."Message Code");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETFILTER(Status,'%1|%2',ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::new,ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::"to process");
      ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Hold,FALSE);
      CASE TRUE OF
        (ItemNo <> '') AND (VariantCode <> ''):
          BEGIN
            ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Message Sub Code",STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::"Item Variant"));
            ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Code,ItemNo);
            ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Code 2",VariantCode);
          END;
        CountryCode <> '':
          BEGIN
            ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Message Sub Code",STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::"Country/Region"));
            ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Code,CountryCode);
          END;
        LocationCode <> '':
          BEGIN
            ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE("Message Sub Code",STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::Location));
            ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Code,LocationCode);
          END;
        ELSE
          ERROR('');
      END;
      IF ExtInterfOutboundMessage.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        // Fehlerhafte EintrÑge zurÅcksetzen
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.SETRANGE(Status,ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::error);
        IF ExtInterfOutboundMessage.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.GET(ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Entry No.");
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.Status::"to process";
          ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt.InsertProtocolEntry(
             DATABASE::"Ext. Interf. Outbound Message",
             ExtInterfOutboundMessage2."Entry No.",
             'SYSTEM','SYS002',USERID,'','','','');
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2."Message Reason" := MessageReason;
          ExtInterfOutboundMessage2.MODIFY;
          ExtInterfaceProtocolMgt.WriteBackProtocolEntries;
        END ELSE
          // Wenn keine zu verarbeitenden oder fehlerhaften EintrÑge vorhanden sind, neuen erstellen
          CreateMessage := TRUE;
      END;

      IF CreateMessage THEN BEGIN
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.RESET;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.INIT;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Entry No." := 0;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status := ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Status::"to process";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Code" := ExtInterfaceSetup."Message Code";
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Ext Interface Setup Name" := ExtInterfaceSetup.Code;
        CASE TRUE OF
          (ItemNo <> '') AND (VariantCode <> ''):
            BEGIN
              ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Sub Code" := STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::"Item Variant");
              ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code := ItemNo;
              ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Code 2" := VariantCode;
            END;
          CountryCode <> '':
            BEGIN
              ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Sub Code" := STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::"Country/Region");
              ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code := CountryCode;
            END;
          LocationCode <> '':
            BEGIN
              ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Sub Code" := STRSUBSTNO('T%1',DATABASE::Location);
              ExtInterfOutboundMessage.Code := LocationCode;
            END;
        END;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage."Message Reason" := MessageReason;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.User := USERID;
        ExtInterfOutboundMessage.INSERT(TRUE);
      END;
      // GF 19.08.19 MJAN CHR-539 CreateExternalInterfaceMessage ENDE
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 31.08.18 MKLE CHR-116 Added new object

    END;

    PROCEDURE InsertOrUpdate@301480006(VAR vItemPictureMappingTemp@301480000 : TEMPORARY Record 85002) rSucces : Boolean;
    VAR
      lItemPictureMapping@301480001 : Record 85002;
      lLastEntryNo@301480002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // Handle POST

      IF NOT vItemPictureMappingTemp.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      // Update by Id
      IF NOT ISNULLGUID(vItemPictureMappingTemp.Id) THEN BEGIN
        lItemPictureMapping.RESET;
        lItemPictureMapping.SETFILTER(Id,vItemPictureMappingTemp.Id);
        IF lItemPictureMapping.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          lItemPictureMapping.URL := vItemPictureMappingTemp.URL;
          lItemPictureMapping.MODIFY;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp := lItemPictureMapping;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Action Type" := vItemPictureMappingTemp."Action Type"::InsertOrUpdate;
          rSucces := TRUE;
          EXIT;
        END;
      END;

      // Last Entry No
      lLastEntryNo := 0;
      lItemPictureMapping.RESET;
      lItemPictureMapping.SETFILTER("Item No.",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No.");
      lItemPictureMapping.SETFILTER("Variant Code",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code");
      IF lItemPictureMapping.FINDLAST THEN
        lLastEntryNo := lItemPictureMapping."Entry No.";

      // Insert or Update by Filter
      IF lItemPictureMapping.GET(
        vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No.",
        vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code",
        vItemPictureMappingTemp."Entry No.") THEN BEGIN
          lItemPictureMapping.URL := vItemPictureMappingTemp.URL;
          lItemPictureMapping.MODIFY;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp := lItemPictureMapping;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Action Type" := vItemPictureMappingTemp."Action Type"::InsertOrUpdate;
          rSucces := TRUE;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        lItemPictureMapping.RESET;
        lItemPictureMapping.INIT;
        lItemPictureMapping.TRANSFERFIELDS(vItemPictureMappingTemp);
        lItemPictureMapping.TESTFIELD("Item No.");
        lItemPictureMapping.TESTFIELD("Variant Code");
        lItemPictureMapping.TESTFIELD(URL);
        IF lItemPictureMapping."Entry No." = 0 THEN
          lItemPictureMapping."Entry No." := lLastEntryNo + 1;
        lItemPictureMapping.INSERT;
        vItemPictureMappingTemp := lItemPictureMapping;
        vItemPictureMappingTemp."Action Type" := vItemPictureMappingTemp."Action Type"::InsertOrUpdate;
        rSucces := TRUE;
      END;
    END;

      lJSONManagement.InitializeCollection(pJsonArray);
      lJSONManagement.GetJsonArray(lJsonArray);

      IF NOT (lJSONManagement.GetCollectionCount > 0) THEN BEGIN
        rSucces := TRUE;
        EXIT;
      END;

      IF vItemPictureMappingTemp.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        vItemPictureMappingTemp.DELETEALL;

      FOR i := 1 TO lJSONManagement.GetCollectionCount DO BEGIN

          lJSONManagement.GetJObjectFromCollectionByIndex(lJObject,i-1);
          lJSONManagement.GetStringPropertyValueFromJObjectByName(lJObject,'itemNo',lItemNoRaw);
          lJSONManagement.GetStringPropertyValueFromJObjectByName(lJObject,'variantCode',lVariantCodeRaw);
          lJSONManagement.GetStringPropertyValueFromJObjectByName(lJObject,'entryNo',lEntryNoRaw);
          lJSONManagement.GetStringPropertyValueFromJObjectByName(lJObject,'url',lURLRaw);

          IF lItemNoRaw <> '' THEN
            EVALUATE(lItemNo,lItemNoRaw)
          ELSE
            ERROR(ParameterEmpty,'itemNo');

          IF lVariantCodeRaw <> '' THEN
            EVALUATE(lVariantCode,lVariantCodeRaw)
          ELSE
            ERROR(ParameterEmpty,'variantCode');

          IF lEntryNoRaw <> '' THEN
            EVALUATE(lEntryNo,lEntryNoRaw)
          ELSE
            ERROR(ParameterEmpty,'entryNo');

          IF lURLRaw <> '' THEN
            EVALUATE(lURL,lURLRaw)
          ELSE
            ERROR(ParameterEmpty,'url');

          vItemPictureMappingTemp.INIT;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No." := lItemNo;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code" := lVariantCode;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.URL := lURL;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Entry No." := lEntryNo;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.INSERT;

      END;

      // GROUP BY itemNo, variantCode
      // DELETEALL
      vItemPictureMappingTemp.RESET;
      vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code");
      IF vItemPictureMappingTemp.FIND('-') THEN
        REPEAT
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No.");
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code");
          IF NOT vItemPictureMappingTemp.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            lItemPictureMapping.RESET;
            lItemPictureMapping.SETRANGE("Item No.",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No.");
            lItemPictureMapping.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code");
            IF lItemPictureMapping.FINDSET THEN
              lItemPictureMapping.DELETEALL;
          END;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.FIND('+');
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.");
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Variant Code");
        UNTIL vItemPictureMappingTemp.NEXT = 0;

      // GROUP BY itemNo, variantCode
      // INSERTALL
      vItemPictureMappingTemp.RESET;
      vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code");
      IF vItemPictureMappingTemp.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT

          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No.");
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code");

          IF vItemPictureMappingTemp.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
              lItemPictureMappingTemp := vItemPictureMappingTemp;
              InsertOrUpdate(lItemPictureMappingTemp);
            UNTIL vItemPictureMappingTemp.NEXT = 0;

          vItemPictureMappingTemp.FIND('+');
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.");
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Variant Code");

        UNTIL vItemPictureMappingTemp.NEXT = 0;
        rSucces := TRUE;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE DeleteMultiple@301480000(pJsonArray@301480000 : Text;VAR vItemPictureMappingTemp@301480004 : TEMPORARY Record 85002) rSucces : Boolean;

      lItemPictureMapping@301480013 : Record 85002;

        rSucces := TRUE;
        EXIT;

          lJSONManagement.GetJObjectFromCollectionByIndex(lJObject,i-1);
          lJSONManagement.GetStringPropertyValueFromJObjectByName(lJObject,'itemNo',lItemNoRaw);

          IF lItemNoRaw <> '' THEN

          ELSE
            ERROR(ParameterEmpty,'itemNo');

          IF lVariantCodeRaw <> '' THEN
            EVALUATE(lVariantCode,lVariantCodeRaw)
          ELSE
            ERROR(ParameterEmpty,'variantCode');

          vItemPictureMappingTemp.INIT;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No." := lItemNo;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code" := lVariantCode;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp."Entry No." := i;
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.INSERT;

      END;

      // GROUP BY itemNo, variantCode
      // DELETEALL
      vItemPictureMappingTemp.RESET;
      vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code");
      IF vItemPictureMappingTemp.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No.");
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code");

          IF vItemPictureMappingTemp.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            lItemPictureMapping.RESET;
            lItemPictureMapping.SETRANGE("Item No.",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Item No.");
            lItemPictureMapping.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vItemPictureMappingTemp."Variant Code");
            IF lItemPictureMapping.FINDSET THEN
              lItemPictureMapping.DELETEALL;
          END;

          vItemPictureMappingTemp.FIND('+');
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.");
          vItemPictureMappingTemp.SETRANGE("Variant Code");

        UNTIL vItemPictureMappingTemp.NEXT = 0;
        rSucces := TRUE;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateInitialItemStockEntity@301510006();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;
      lStep@301510005 : Integer;
      lTotalSteps@301510004 : Integer;
      lDialog@301510003 : Dialog;
      lTimeProgress@301510002 : Time;
      lProgress@301510001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Serial No.",'<>%1','');
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDSET THEN BEGIN

        IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
          lDialog.OPEN('@1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@\',lProgress);
          lTotalSteps := ItemLedgerEntry.COUNT;
          lTimeProgress := TIME;
        END;

        REPEAT

          UpdateItemStockEntity(ItemLedgerEntry);

          IF GUIALLOWED THEN BEGIN
            lStep := lStep + 1;
            IF lTimeProgress < TIME - 1500 THEN BEGIN
              lTimeProgress := TIME;
              lProgress := ROUND(lStep / lTotalSteps * 9999.9,1);
              lDialog.UPDATE;
            END;
          END;

        UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT = 0;
        IF GUIALLOWED THEN
          lDialog.CLOSE;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateItemStockEntity@301510000(VAR ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32);
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry2@301510001 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      ItemLedgerEntry2.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry2.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry2.SETRANGE("Location Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code");
      ItemLedgerEntry2.SETRANGE("Serial No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
      IF ItemLedgerEntry2.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry2.CALCSUMS(Quantity);
        IF ItemLedgerEntry2.Quantity <> 0 THEN
          InsertOrUpdateItemStockEntity(ItemLedgerEntry2)
        ELSE
          DeleteItemStockEntity(ItemLedgerEntry2);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertOrUpdateItemStockEntity@301510004(VAR ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32);
    VAR
      ItemStockEntity@301510001 : Record 88021;
      l_recReservEntry@301510002 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      //PK: Item No.,Variant Code,Serial No.,Location Code
      WITH ItemStockEntity DO
        IF NOT GET(ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code") THEN BEGIN
          INIT;
          "Item No." := ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.";
          "Variant Code" := ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code";
          "Serial No." := ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.";
          "Location Code" := ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code";
          "Differential Taxation Purchase" := ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
          // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 <<
          Reserved := FALSE;
          "Sales Order No." := '';
          "Sales Order Line No." := 0;
          "Transfer Order No." := '';
          "Transfer Order Line No." := 0;
          "Date Time" := FORMAT(CURRENTDATETIME,0,'<Day,2>-<Month,2>-<Year4> <Hours24,2>:<Minutes,2>:<Seconds,2><Second dec>'); // 01 01.06.21 VMO ERP-251
          // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 >>
          INSERT;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          "Differential Taxation Purchase" := ItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase";
          "Date Time" := FORMAT(CURRENTDATETIME,0,'<Day,2>-<Month,2>-<Year4> <Hours24,2>:<Minutes,2>:<Seconds,2><Second dec>'); // 01 01.06.21 VMO ERP-251
          MODIFY;
        END;
    END;

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateExternalInterfaceFile@301480003(pItemStockEntity@301480001 : Record 88021);
    VAR
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480000 : Record 5275378;
      lExtInterfaceSetup@301480002 : Record 5275373;
      NotImplemented@301490000 : TextConst 'DEU=Externes Interface %1 ist nicht implementiert.;ENU=External Interface %1 is not implemented';
    BEGIN
      IF NOT lExtInterfaceSetup.GET('UPDSTO') THEN
        ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(NotImplemented,'UPDSTO'));

      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INIT;
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status := lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Status::"to process";
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile."Message Code" := 'UPDSTOFILE';
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.Filename :=
        'serialno=' + FORMAT(pItemStockEntity."Serial No.",0,9) +
        '&itemNo=' + FORMAT(pItemStockEntity."Item No.",0,9) +
        '&code=' + FORMAT(pItemStockEntity."Variant Code",0,9)+
        '&locationCode=' + FORMAT(pItemStockEntity."Location Code",0,9);

      CreateSourceFile(lExtInterfaceOutboundFile,pItemStockEntity);
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.User := USERID;
      lExtInterfaceOutboundFile.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateSourceFile@301480008(VAR vExtInterfaceOutboundFile@301480007 : Record 5275378;pRec@301480000 : Variant);
    VAR
      lJSONManagement@301480001 : Codeunit 5459;
      lDataTypeManagement@301480004 : Codeunit 701;
      lJObject@301480002 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
      lRecordRef@301480003 : RecordRef;
      lFieldRef@301480005 : FieldRef;
      lFieldCount@301480006 : Integer;
      lOStream@301480008 : OutStream;
      lPropertyName@301480009 : Text;
      lCurrentPropertyName@301480010 : Text;
      lJsonPropertyNames@301480011 : DotNet "'mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Collections.Generic.List`1";
    BEGIN
      IF NOT lDataTypeManagement.GetRecordRef(pRec, lRecordRef) THEN
        EXIT;

      lJObject := lJObject.JObject;
      lJSONManagement.GetJsonPropertyNamesByEntity(PAGE::"CHNX Item Stock Entity",lJsonPropertyNames);
      FOR lFieldCount := 1 TO lRecordRef.FIELDCOUNT DO BEGIN
        lFieldRef := lRecordRef.FIELDINDEX(lFieldCount);
        IF ProcessFieldRef(lFieldRef) THEN BEGIN
          lPropertyName := lJSONManagement.PrettifyJsonProperty(lFieldRef.NAME);
          FOREACH lCurrentPropertyName IN lJsonPropertyNames DO BEGIN
            IF UPPERCASE(lPropertyName) = UPPERCASE(lCurrentPropertyName) THEN
              lPropertyName := lCurrentPropertyName;
          END;
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,lPropertyName,lFieldRef.VALUE);
        END;
      END;

      vExtInterfaceOutboundFile.SourceFile.CREATEOUTSTREAM(lOStream, TEXTENCODING::UTF8);
      lOStream.WRITE(lJObject.ToString());
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ProcessFieldRef@301480021(VAR vFieldRef@301480000 : FieldRef) : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // Handle Special Cases

      // 01 24.04.19 MKLE CHR-428 FlowFilter
      //IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) IN ['MEDIA','MEDIASET','BLOB'] THEN
      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) IN ['MEDIA','MEDIASET','BLOB','FLOWFILTER'] THEN
      // 01 24.04.19 MKLE CHR-428 FlowFilter ENDE
        EXIT(FALSE);

      IF UPPERCASE(FORMAT(vFieldRef.CLASS)) = 'FLOWFIELD' THEN BEGIN
        vFieldRef.CALCFIELD;
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    END;

    PROCEDURE GetItemStockEntities@301490002(VAR vItemStockEntityTemp@301490000 : TEMPORARY Record 88021);
    VAR
      lItemStockEntity@301490002 : Record 88021;
      lItemStockEntityTemp@301490005 : TEMPORARY Record 88021;
      lLastItemoNo@301490001 : Code[20];
      lItem@301490003 : Record 27;
      lCustomerSetup@301490004 : Record 87000;
    BEGIN
      // GF 18.04.19 MKLE CHR-428 GetItemStockEntities
      IF NOT vItemStockEntityTemp.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      // Items with stock
      lItemStockEntity.RESET;
      lItemStockEntity.COPYFILTERS(vItemStockEntityTemp);
      IF lItemStockEntity.GETFILTER("Location Filter") <> '' THEN
        lItemStockEntity.SETRANGE("Location Code",lItemStockEntity.GETFILTER("Location Filter"));

      IF lItemStockEntity.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        IF lItemStockEntity."Item No." <> lLastItemoNo THEN BEGIN
          vItemStockEntityTemp := lItemStockEntity;
          vItemStockEntityTemp.INSERT;
          // 01 08.10.20 TIST MSD-13237 Api hat doppelte Artikel ausgegeben, wenn Stock gefÅllt
          lItemStockEntityTemp := lItemStockEntity;
          lItemStockEntityTemp.INSERT;
          // 01 08.10.20 TIST MSD-13237 Api hat doppelte Artikel ausgegeben, wenn Stock gefÅllt ENDE
        END;
        lLastItemoNo := lItemStockEntity."Item No.";
      UNTIL lItemStockEntity.NEXT = 0;

      // Items without stock
      lCustomerSetup.GET;
      // 01 08.10.20 TIST MSD-13237 Api hat doppelte Artikel ausgegeben, wenn Stock gefÅllt
      //lItemStockEntityTemp := vItemStockEntityTemp;
      // 01 08.10.20 TIST MSD-13237 Api hat doppelte Artikel ausgegeben, wenn Stock gefÅllt ENDE
      lItemStockEntityTemp.RESET;
      lItem.RESET;
      IF lItem.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        IF lItem."No." <> lCustomerSetup."Box Item" THEN BEGIN
          lItemStockEntityTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.",lItem."No.");
          IF lItemStockEntityTemp.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Item No." := lItem."No.";
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Variant Code" := '';
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Serial No." := '';
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Location Code" := '';
            // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 <<
            vItemStockEntityTemp.Reserved := FALSE;
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Sales Order No." := '';
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Sales Order Line No." := 0;
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Transfer Order No." := '';
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Transfer Order Line No." := 0;
            vItemStockEntityTemp."Date Time" := FORMAT(CURRENTDATETIME,0,'<Day,2>-<Month,2>-<Year4> <Hours24,2>:<Minutes,2>:<Seconds,2><Second dec>'); // 01 01.06.21 VMO ERP-251
            vItemStockEntityTemp.INSERT;
            // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 >>
          END;
        END;
      UNTIL lItem.NEXT = 0;
      IF vItemStockEntityTemp.FINDFIRST THEN;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetItemVariantStockEntities@301490008(VAR vItemStockEntityTemp@301490000 : TEMPORARY Record 88021);
    VAR
      lItemStockEntity@301490002 : Record 88021;
      lLastVariantCode@301490001 : Code[10];
      lItemStockEntityTemp@301490003 : TEMPORARY Record 88021;
      lItemVariant@301490004 : Record 5401;
      InvalidOperationException@301490005 : TextConst 'DEU=Operation kann nicht ausgefÅhrt werden, da kein Artikel-Filter angegeben ist.;ENU=Operation can not be executed because no item filter is set.';
    BEGIN
      // GF 18.04.19 MKLE CHR-428 GetItemVariantStockEntities
      IF NOT vItemStockEntityTemp.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF (vItemStockEntityTemp.GETFILTER("Item No.") = '') OR (vItemStockEntityTemp.GETFILTER("Item No.") = '''''') THEN
        ERROR(InvalidOperationException);

      // Variants with stock
      lItemStockEntity.RESET;
      lItemStockEntity.COPYFILTERS(vItemStockEntityTemp);
      IF lItemStockEntity.GETFILTER("Location Filter") <> '''''' THEN
        lItemStockEntity.SETRANGE("Location Code",lItemStockEntity.GETFILTER("Location Filter"));

      IF lItemStockEntity.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        IF lItemStockEntity."Variant Code" <> lLastVariantCode THEN BEGIN
          vItemStockEntityTemp := lItemStockEntity;
          vItemStockEntityTemp.INSERT;
        END;
        lLastVariantCode := lItemStockEntity."Variant Code";
      UNTIL lItemStockEntity.NEXT = 0;

      // Variants without stock
      lItemStockEntityTemp := vItemStockEntityTemp;
      lItemStockEntityTemp.RESET;
      lItemVariant.RESET;
      lItemVariant.SETRANGE("Item No.",vItemStockEntityTemp.GETFILTER("Item No."));
      IF lItemVariant.FINDSET THEN REPEAT
        lItemStockEntityTemp.SETRANGE("Item No.",lItemVariant."Item No.");
        lItemStockEntityTemp.SETRANGE("Variant Code",lItemVariant.Code);
        IF lItemStockEntity.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Item No." := lItemVariant."Item No.";
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Variant Code" := lItemVariant.Code;
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Serial No." := '';
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Location Code" := '';
          // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 <<
          vItemStockEntityTemp.Reserved := FALSE;
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Sales Order No." := '';
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Sales Order Line No." := 0;
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Transfer Order No." := '';
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Transfer Order Line No." := 0;
          vItemStockEntityTemp."Date Time" := FORMAT(CURRENTDATETIME,0,'<Day,2>-<Month,2>-<Year4> <Hours24,2>:<Minutes,2>:<Seconds,2><Second dec>'); // 01 01.06.21 VMO ERP-251
          // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689 >>
          vItemStockEntityTemp.INSERT;
        END;
      UNTIL lItemVariant.NEXT = 0;
      IF vItemStockEntityTemp.FINDFIRST THEN;
    END;

    PROCEDURE FillStock@301490003(VAR vItemStockEntityTemp@301490000 : TEMPORARY Record 88021;VAR vStock@301490001 : Text);
    VAR
      lItemStockEntity@301490005 : Record 88021;
      lJSONManagement@301490002 : Codeunit 5459;
      lJArray@301490004 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=4.5.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray";
      lJObject@301490003 : DotNet "'Newtonsoft.Json, Version=9.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=30ad4fe6b2a6aeed'.Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject";
    BEGIN
      // GF 18.04.19 MKLE CHR-428 FillStock
      IF NOT vItemStockEntityTemp.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      IF (vItemStockEntityTemp."Serial No." = '') AND (vItemStockEntityTemp."Location Code" = '') THEN
        EXIT;

      lItemStockEntity.RESET;
      lItemStockEntity.COPYFILTERS(vItemStockEntityTemp);
      IF lItemStockEntity.GETFILTER("Location Filter") <> '''''' THEN
        lItemStockEntity.SETRANGE("Location Code",lItemStockEntity.GETFILTER("Location Filter"));
      lItemStockEntity.SETRANGE("Variant Code",vItemStockEntityTemp."Variant Code");

      IF lItemStockEntity.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        lJSONManagement.InitializeEmptyCollection;
        REPEAT
          lJSONManagement.InitializeEmptyObject;
          lJSONManagement.GetJSONObject(lJObject);
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'serialNo',lItemStockEntity."Serial No.");
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'locationCode',lItemStockEntity."Location Code");
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'differentialTaxation',lItemStockEntity."Differential Taxation Purchase");
          lJSONManagement.AddJPropertyToJObject(lJObject,'reserved',lItemStockEntity.Reserved); // 01 22.03.21 VMO SHOPS-689
          lJSONManagement.AddJObjectToCollection(lJObject);
        UNTIL lItemStockEntity.NEXT = 0;
        vStock := lJSONManagement.WriteCollectionToString;
      END;
    END;
